30:     - name: JDK 8

36:     - name: Upload coverage to Codecov

================
File: .mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.java
================
 1: import java.net.*;
 2: import java.io.*;
 3: import java.nio.channels.*;
 4: import java.util.Properties;
 5: public class MavenWrapperDownloader {
 6:     private static final String DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_URL =
 7:             "https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/takari/maven-wrapper/0.4.2/maven-wrapper-0.4.2.jar";
 8:     private static final String MAVEN_WRAPPER_PROPERTIES_PATH =
 9:             ".mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties";
10:     private static final String MAVEN_WRAPPER_JAR_PATH =
11:             ".mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar";
12:     private static final String PROPERTY_NAME_WRAPPER_URL = "wrapperUrl";
13:     public static void main(String args[]) {
14:         System.out.println("- Downloader started");
15:         File baseDirectory = new File(args[0]);
16:         System.out.println("- Using base directory: " + baseDirectory.getAbsolutePath());
17:         File mavenWrapperPropertyFile = new File(baseDirectory, MAVEN_WRAPPER_PROPERTIES_PATH);
18:         String url = DEFAULT_DOWNLOAD_URL;
19:         if(mavenWrapperPropertyFile.exists()) {
20:             FileInputStream mavenWrapperPropertyFileInputStream = null;
21:             try {
22:                 mavenWrapperPropertyFileInputStream = new FileInputStream(mavenWrapperPropertyFile);
23:                 Properties mavenWrapperProperties = new Properties();
24:                 mavenWrapperProperties.load(mavenWrapperPropertyFileInputStream);
25:                 url = mavenWrapperProperties.getProperty(PROPERTY_NAME_WRAPPER_URL, url);
26:             } catch (IOException e) {
27:                 System.out.println("- ERROR loading '" + MAVEN_WRAPPER_PROPERTIES_PATH + "'");
28:             } finally {
29:                 try {
30:                     if(mavenWrapperPropertyFileInputStream != null) {
31:                         mavenWrapperPropertyFileInputStream.close();
32:                     }
33:                 } catch (IOException e) {
34:                 }
35:             }
36:         }
37:         System.out.println("- Downloading from: : " + url);
38:         File outputFile = new File(baseDirectory.getAbsolutePath(), MAVEN_WRAPPER_JAR_PATH);
39:         if(!outputFile.getParentFile().exists()) {
40:             if(!outputFile.getParentFile().mkdirs()) {
41:                 System.out.println(
42:                         "- ERROR creating output direcrory '" + outputFile.getParentFile().getAbsolutePath() + "'");
43:             }
44:         }
45:         System.out.println("- Downloading to: " + outputFile.getAbsolutePath());
46:         try {
47:             downloadFileFromURL(url, outputFile);
48:             System.out.println("Done");
49:             System.exit(0);
50:         } catch (Throwable e) {
51:             System.out.println("- Error downloading");
52:             e.printStackTrace();
53:             System.exit(1);
54:         }
55:     }
56:     private static void downloadFileFromURL(String urlString, File destination) throws Exception {
57:         URL website = new URL(urlString);
58:         ReadableByteChannel rbc;
59:         rbc = Channels.newChannel(website.openStream());
60:         FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(destination);
61:         fos.getChannel().transferFrom(rbc, 0, Long.MAX_VALUE);
62:         fos.close();
63:         rbc.close();
64:     }
65: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.adminservice.aop;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Item;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Namespace;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.NamespaceLock;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.ItemService;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.NamespaceLockService;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.NamespaceService;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.ServiceException;
 13: import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Aspect;
 14: import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Before;
 15: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 16: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 17: import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
 18: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 19: @Aspect
 20: @Component
 21: public class NamespaceAcquireLockAspect {
 22:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(NamespaceAcquireLockAspect.class);
 23:   private final NamespaceLockService namespaceLockService;
 24:   private final NamespaceService namespaceService;
 25:   private final ItemService itemService;
 26:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
 27:   public NamespaceAcquireLockAspect(
 28:       final NamespaceLockService namespaceLockService,
 29:       final NamespaceService namespaceService,
 30:       final ItemService itemService,
 31:       final BizConfig bizConfig) {
 32:     this.namespaceLockService = namespaceLockService;
 33:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 34:     this.itemService = itemService;
 35:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
 36:   }
 37:   @Before("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, item, ..)")
 38:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 39:                                 ItemDTO item) {
 40:     acquireLock(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, item.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 41:   }
 42:   @Before("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, itemId, item, ..)")
 43:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName, long itemId,
 44:                                 ItemDTO item) {
 45:     acquireLock(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, item.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 46:   }
 47:   @Before("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSet, ..)")
 48:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 49:                                 ItemChangeSets changeSet) {
 50:     acquireLock(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSet.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 51:   }
 52:   @Before("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(itemId, operator, ..)")
 53:   public void requireLockAdvice(long itemId, String operator) {
 54:     Item item = itemService.findOne(itemId);
 55:     if (item == null){
 56:       throw new BadRequestException("item not exist.");
 57:     }
 58:     acquireLock(item.getNamespaceId(), operator);
 59:   }
 60:   void acquireLock(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 61:                            String currentUser) {
 62:     if (bizConfig.isNamespaceLockSwitchOff()) {
 63:       return;
 64:     }
 65:     Namespace namespace = namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 66:     acquireLock(namespace, currentUser);
 67:   }
 68:   void acquireLock(long namespaceId, String currentUser) {
 69:     if (bizConfig.isNamespaceLockSwitchOff()) {
 70:       return;
 71:     }
 72:     Namespace namespace = namespaceService.findOne(namespaceId);
 73:     acquireLock(namespace, currentUser);
 74:   }
 75:   private void acquireLock(Namespace namespace, String currentUser) {
 76:     if (namespace == null) {
 77:       throw new BadRequestException("namespace not exist.");
 78:     }
 79:     long namespaceId = namespace.getId();
 80:     NamespaceLock namespaceLock = namespaceLockService.findLock(namespaceId);
 81:     if (namespaceLock == null) {
 82:       try {
 83:         tryLock(namespaceId, currentUser);
 84:       } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException e) {
 85:         namespaceLock = namespaceLockService.findLock(namespaceId);
 86:         checkLock(namespace, namespaceLock, currentUser);
 87:       } catch (Exception e) {
 88:         logger.error("try lock error", e);
 89:         throw e;
 90:       }
 91:     } else {
 92:       checkLock(namespace, namespaceLock, currentUser);
 93:     }
 94:   }
 95:   private void tryLock(long namespaceId, String user) {
 96:     NamespaceLock lock = new NamespaceLock();
 97:     lock.setNamespaceId(namespaceId);
 98:     lock.setDataChangeCreatedBy(user);
 99:     lock.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(user);
100:     namespaceLockService.tryLock(lock);
101:   }
102:   private void checkLock(Namespace namespace, NamespaceLock namespaceLock,
103:                          String currentUser) {
104:     if (namespaceLock == null) {
105:       throw new ServiceException(
106:           String.format("Check lock for %s failed, please retry.", namespace.getNamespaceName()));
107:     }
108:     String lockOwner = namespaceLock.getDataChangeCreatedBy();
109:     if (!lockOwner.equals(currentUser)) {
110:       throw new BadRequestException(
111:           "namespace:" + namespace.getNamespaceName() + " is modified by " + lockOwner);
112:     }
113:   }
114: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.adminservice.aop;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Item;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Namespace;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Release;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.ItemService;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.NamespaceLockService;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.NamespaceService;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.ReleaseService;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.constants.GsonType;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;
 13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 15: import com.google.common.collect.MapDifference;
 16: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 17: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 18: import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.After;
 19: import org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Aspect;
 20: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 21: import java.util.List;
 22: import java.util.Map;
 23: @Aspect
 24: @Component
 25: public class NamespaceUnlockAspect {
 26:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 27:   private final NamespaceLockService namespaceLockService;
 28:   private final NamespaceService namespaceService;
 29:   private final ItemService itemService;
 30:   private final ReleaseService releaseService;
 31:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
 32:   public NamespaceUnlockAspect(
 33:       final NamespaceLockService namespaceLockService,
 34:       final NamespaceService namespaceService,
 35:       final ItemService itemService,
 36:       final ReleaseService releaseService,
 37:       final BizConfig bizConfig) {
 38:     this.namespaceLockService = namespaceLockService;
 39:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 40:     this.itemService = itemService;
 41:     this.releaseService = releaseService;
 42:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
 43:   }
 44:   @After("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, item, ..)")
 45:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 46:                                 ItemDTO item) {
 47:     tryUnlock(namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName));
 48:   }
 49:   @After("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, itemId, item, ..)")
 50:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName, long itemId,
 51:                                 ItemDTO item) {
 52:     tryUnlock(namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName));
 53:   }
 54:   @After("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSet, ..)")
 55:   public void requireLockAdvice(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 56:                                 ItemChangeSets changeSet) {
 57:     tryUnlock(namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName));
 58:   }
 59:   @After("@annotation(PreAcquireNamespaceLock) && args(itemId, operator, ..)")
 60:   public void requireLockAdvice(long itemId, String operator) {
 61:     Item item = itemService.findOne(itemId);
 62:     if (item == null) {
 63:       throw new BadRequestException("item not exist.");
 64:     }
 65:     tryUnlock(namespaceService.findOne(item.getNamespaceId()));
 66:   }
 67:   private void tryUnlock(Namespace namespace) {
 68:     if (bizConfig.isNamespaceLockSwitchOff()) {
 69:       return;
 70:     }
 71:     if (!isModified(namespace)) {
 72:       namespaceLockService.unlock(namespace.getId());
 73:     }
 74:   }
 75:   boolean isModified(Namespace namespace) {
 76:     Release release = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(namespace);
 77:     List<Item> items = itemService.findItemsWithoutOrdered(namespace.getId());
 78:     if (release == null) {
 79:       return hasNormalItems(items);
 80:     }
 81:     Map<String, String> releasedConfiguration = GSON.fromJson(release.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
 82:     Map<String, String> configurationFromItems = generateConfigurationFromItems(namespace, items);
 83:     MapDifference<String, String> difference = Maps.difference(releasedConfiguration, configurationFromItems);
 84:     return !difference.areEqual();
 85:   }
 86:   private boolean hasNormalItems(List<Item> items) {
 87:     for (Item item : items) {
 88:       if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(item.getKey())) {
 89:         return true;
 90:       }
 91:     }
 92:     return false;
 93:   }
 94:   private Map<String, String> generateConfigurationFromItems(Namespace namespace, List<Item> namespaceItems) {
 95:     Map<String, String> configurationFromItems = Maps.newHashMap();
 96:     Namespace parentNamespace = namespaceService.findParentNamespace(namespace);
 97:     if (parentNamespace == null) {
 98:       generateMapFromItems(namespaceItems, configurationFromItems);
 99:     } else {
100:       Release parentRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(parentNamespace);
101:       if (parentRelease != null) {
102:         configurationFromItems = GSON.fromJson(parentRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
103:       }
104:       generateMapFromItems(namespaceItems, configurationFromItems);
105:     }
106:     return configurationFromItems;
107:   }
108:   private Map<String, String> generateMapFromItems(List<Item> items, Map<String, String> configurationFromItems) {
109:     for (Item item : items) {
110:       String key = item.getKey();
111:       if (StringUtils.isBlank(key)) {
112:         continue;
113:       }
114:       configurationFromItems.put(key, item.getValue());
115:     }
116:     return configurationFromItems;
117:   }
118: }

 33: @RestController
 34: @RequestMapping("/instances")
 35: public class InstanceConfigController {
 36:   private static final Splitter RELEASES_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings()
 37:       .trimResults();
 38:   private final ReleaseService releaseService;
 39:   private final InstanceService instanceService;
 40:   public InstanceConfigController(final ReleaseService releaseService, final InstanceService instanceService) {
 41:     this.releaseService = releaseService;
 42:     this.instanceService = instanceService;
 43:   }
 44:   @GetMapping("/by-release")
 45:   public PageDTO<InstanceDTO> getByRelease(@RequestParam("releaseId") long releaseId,
 46:                                            Pageable pageable) {
 47:     Release release = releaseService.findOne(releaseId);
 48:     if (release == null) {
 49:       throw new NotFoundException(String.format("release not found for %s", releaseId));
 50:     }
 51:     Page<InstanceConfig> instanceConfigsPage = instanceService.findActiveInstanceConfigsByReleaseKey
 52:         (release.getReleaseKey(), pageable);
 53:     List<InstanceDTO> instanceDTOs = Collections.emptyList();
 54:     if (instanceConfigsPage.hasContent()) {
 55:       Multimap<Long, InstanceConfig> instanceConfigMap = HashMultimap.create();
 56:       Set<String> otherReleaseKeys = Sets.newHashSet();
 57:       for (InstanceConfig instanceConfig : instanceConfigsPage.getContent()) {
 58:         instanceConfigMap.put(instanceConfig.getInstanceId(), instanceConfig);
 59:         otherReleaseKeys.add(instanceConfig.getReleaseKey());
 60:       }
 61:       Set<Long> instanceIds = instanceConfigMap.keySet();
 62:       List<Instance> instances = instanceService.findInstancesByIds(instanceIds);
 63:       if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(instances)) {
 64:         instanceDTOs = BeanUtils.batchTransform(InstanceDTO.class, instances);
 65:       }
 66:       for (InstanceDTO instanceDTO : instanceDTOs) {
 67:         Collection<InstanceConfig> configs = instanceConfigMap.get(instanceDTO.getId());
 68:         List<InstanceConfigDTO> configDTOs = configs.stream().map(instanceConfig -> {
 69:           InstanceConfigDTO instanceConfigDTO = new InstanceConfigDTO();
 70:           instanceConfigDTO.setRelease(null);
 71:           instanceConfigDTO.setReleaseDeliveryTime(instanceConfig.getReleaseDeliveryTime());
 72:           instanceConfigDTO.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(instanceConfig
 73:               .getDataChangeLastModifiedTime());
 74:           return instanceConfigDTO;
 75:         }).collect(Collectors.toList());
 76:         instanceDTO.setConfigs(configDTOs);
 77:       }
 78:     }
 79:     return new PageDTO<>(instanceDTOs, pageable, instanceConfigsPage.getTotalElements());
 80:   }
 81:   @GetMapping("/by-namespace-and-releases-not-in")
 82:   public List<InstanceDTO> getByReleasesNotIn(@RequestParam("appId") String appId,
 83:                                               @RequestParam("clusterName") String clusterName,
 84:                                               @RequestParam("namespaceName") String namespaceName,
 85:                                               @RequestParam("releaseIds") String releaseIds) {
 86:     Set<Long> releaseIdSet = RELEASES_SPLITTER.splitToList(releaseIds).stream().map(Long::parseLong)
 87:         .collect(Collectors.toSet());
 88:     List<Release> releases = releaseService.findByReleaseIds(releaseIdSet);
 89:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(releases)) {
 90:       throw new NotFoundException(String.format("releases not found for %s", releaseIds));
 91:     }
 92:     Set<String> releaseKeys = releases.stream().map(Release::getReleaseKey).collect(Collectors
 93:         .toSet());
 94:     List<InstanceConfig> instanceConfigs = instanceService
 95:         .findInstanceConfigsByNamespaceWithReleaseKeysNotIn(appId, clusterName, namespaceName,
 96:             releaseKeys);
 97:     Multimap<Long, InstanceConfig> instanceConfigMap = HashMultimap.create();
 98:     Set<String> otherReleaseKeys = Sets.newHashSet();
 99:     for (InstanceConfig instanceConfig : instanceConfigs) {
100:       instanceConfigMap.put(instanceConfig.getInstanceId(), instanceConfig);
101:       otherReleaseKeys.add(instanceConfig.getReleaseKey());
102:     }
103:     List<Instance> instances = instanceService.findInstancesByIds(instanceConfigMap.keySet());
104:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(instances)) {
105:       return Collections.emptyList();
106:     }
107:     List<InstanceDTO> instanceDTOs = BeanUtils.batchTransform(InstanceDTO.class, instances);
108:     List<Release> otherReleases = releaseService.findByReleaseKeys(otherReleaseKeys);
109:     Map<String, ReleaseDTO> releaseMap = Maps.newHashMap();
110:     for (Release release : otherReleases) {
111:       release.setConfigurations(null);
112:       ReleaseDTO releaseDTO = BeanUtils.transform(ReleaseDTO.class, release);
113:       releaseMap.put(release.getReleaseKey(), releaseDTO);
114:     }
115:     for (InstanceDTO instanceDTO : instanceDTOs) {
116:       Collection<InstanceConfig> configs = instanceConfigMap.get(instanceDTO.getId());
117:       List<InstanceConfigDTO> configDTOs = configs.stream().map(instanceConfig -> {
118:         InstanceConfigDTO instanceConfigDTO = new InstanceConfigDTO();
119:         instanceConfigDTO.setRelease(releaseMap.get(instanceConfig.getReleaseKey()));
120:         instanceConfigDTO.setReleaseDeliveryTime(instanceConfig.getReleaseDeliveryTime());
121:         instanceConfigDTO.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(instanceConfig
122:             .getDataChangeLastModifiedTime());
123:         return instanceConfigDTO;
124:       }).collect(Collectors.toList());
125:       instanceDTO.setConfigs(configDTOs);
126:     }
127:     return instanceDTOs;
128:   }
129:   @GetMapping("/by-namespace")
130:   public PageDTO<InstanceDTO> getInstancesByNamespace(

141:           clusterName, namespaceName, pageable);

144:     return new PageDTO<>(instanceDTOs, pageable, instances.getTotalElements());

 37:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 38:     this.commitService = commitService;
 39:     this.releaseService = releaseService;
 40:   }
 41:   @PreAcquireNamespaceLock
 42:   @PostMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items")
 43:   public ItemDTO create(@PathVariable("appId") String appId,
 44:                         @PathVariable("clusterName") String clusterName,
 45:                         @PathVariable("namespaceName") String namespaceName, @RequestBody ItemDTO dto) {
 46:     Item entity = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, dto);
 47:     ConfigChangeContentBuilder builder = new ConfigChangeContentBuilder();
 48:     Item managedEntity = itemService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, entity.getKey());
 49:     if (managedEntity != null) {
 50:       throw new BadRequestException("item already exists");
 51:     }
 52:     entity = itemService.save(entity);
 53:     builder.createItem(entity);
 54:     dto = BeanUtils.transform(ItemDTO.class, entity);
 55:     Commit commit = new Commit();
 56:     commit.setAppId(appId);
 57:     commit.setClusterName(clusterName);
 58:     commit.setNamespaceName(namespaceName);
 59:     commit.setChangeSets(builder.build());
 60:     commit.setDataChangeCreatedBy(dto.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 61:     commit.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(dto.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 62:     commitService.save(commit);
 63:     return dto;
 64:   }
 65:   @PreAcquireNamespaceLock
 66:   @PutMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items/{itemId}")
 67:   public ItemDTO update(@PathVariable("appId") String appId,
 68:                         @PathVariable("clusterName") String clusterName,
 69:                         @PathVariable("namespaceName") String namespaceName,
 70:                         @PathVariable("itemId") long itemId,
 71:                         @RequestBody ItemDTO itemDTO) {
 72:     Item managedEntity = itemService.findOne(itemId);
 73:     if (managedEntity == null) {
 74:       throw new NotFoundException("item not found for itemId " + itemId);
 75:     }
 76:     Namespace namespace = namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 77:     if (namespace == null || namespace.getId() != managedEntity.getNamespaceId()) {
 78:       throw new BadRequestException("Invalid request, item and namespace do not match!");
 79:     }
 80:     Item entity = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, itemDTO);
 81:     ConfigChangeContentBuilder builder = new ConfigChangeContentBuilder();
 82:     Item beforeUpdateItem = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, managedEntity);
 83:     managedEntity.setValue(entity.getValue());
 84:     managedEntity.setComment(entity.getComment());
 85:     managedEntity.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(entity.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 86:     entity = itemService.update(managedEntity);
 87:     builder.updateItem(beforeUpdateItem, entity);
 88:     itemDTO = BeanUtils.transform(ItemDTO.class, entity);
 89:     if (builder.hasContent()) {
 90:       Commit commit = new Commit();
 91:       commit.setAppId(appId);
 92:       commit.setClusterName(clusterName);
 93:       commit.setNamespaceName(namespaceName);
 94:       commit.setChangeSets(builder.build());
 95:       commit.setDataChangeCreatedBy(itemDTO.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 96:       commit.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(itemDTO.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 97:       commitService.save(commit);
 98:     }
 99:     return itemDTO;
100:   }
101:   @PreAcquireNamespaceLock
102:   @DeleteMapping("/items/{itemId}")
103:   public void delete(@PathVariable("itemId") long itemId, @RequestParam String operator) {
104:     Item entity = itemService.findOne(itemId);
105:     if (entity == null) {
106:       throw new NotFoundException("item not found for itemId " + itemId);
107:     }
108:     itemService.delete(entity.getId(), operator);
109:     Namespace namespace = namespaceService.findOne(entity.getNamespaceId());
110:     Commit commit = new Commit();
111:     commit.setAppId(namespace.getAppId());
112:     commit.setClusterName(namespace.getClusterName());
113:     commit.setNamespaceName(namespace.getNamespaceName());
114:     commit.setChangeSets(new ConfigChangeContentBuilder().deleteItem(entity).build());
115:     commit.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
116:     commit.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
117:     commitService.save(commit);
118:   }
119:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items")

121:                                  @PathVariable("clusterName") String clusterName,
122:                                  @PathVariable("namespaceName") String namespaceName) {
123:     return BeanUtils.batchTransform(ItemDTO.class, itemService.findItemsWithOrdered(appId, clusterName, namespaceName));

125:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items/deleted")
126:   public List<ItemDTO> findDeletedItems(@PathVariable("appId") String appId,
127:                                         @PathVariable("clusterName") String clusterName,
128:                                         @PathVariable("namespaceName") String namespaceName) {
129:     Release latestActiveRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
130:     List<Commit> commits;
131:     if (Objects.nonNull(latestActiveRelease)) {
132:       commits = commitService.find(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, latestActiveRelease.getDataChangeCreatedTime(), null);
133:     } else {
134:       commits = commitService.find(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, null);
135:     }
136:     if (Objects.nonNull(commits)) {
137:       List<Item> deletedItems = commits.stream()
138:           .map(item -> ConfigChangeContentBuilder.convertJsonString(item.getChangeSets()).getDeleteItems())
139:           .flatMap(Collection::stream)

148:     if (item == null) {
149:       throw new NotFoundException("item not found for itemId " + itemId);
150:     }

 36:   }
 37:   @PostMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches")
 38:   public NamespaceDTO createBranch(@PathVariable String appId,
 39:                                    @PathVariable String clusterName,
 40:                                    @PathVariable String namespaceName,
 41:                                    @RequestParam("operator") String operator) {
 42:     checkNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 43:     Namespace createdBranch = namespaceBranchService.createBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, operator);
 44:     return BeanUtils.transform(NamespaceDTO.class, createdBranch);
 45:   }
 46:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches/{branchName}/rules")
 47:   public GrayReleaseRuleDTO findBranchGrayRules(@PathVariable String appId,
 48:                                                 @PathVariable String clusterName,
 49:                                                 @PathVariable String namespaceName,
 50:                                                 @PathVariable String branchName) {
 51:     checkBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 52:     GrayReleaseRule rules = namespaceBranchService.findBranchGrayRules(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 53:     if (rules == null) {
 54:       return null;
 55:     }
 56:     GrayReleaseRuleDTO ruleDTO =
 57:         new GrayReleaseRuleDTO(rules.getAppId(), rules.getClusterName(), rules.getNamespaceName(),
 58:                                rules.getBranchName());
 59:     ruleDTO.setReleaseId(rules.getReleaseId());
 60:     ruleDTO.setRuleItems(GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer.batchTransformFromJSON(rules.getRules()));
 61:     return ruleDTO;
 62:   }
 63:   @Transactional
 64:   @PutMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches/{branchName}/rules")
 65:   public void updateBranchGrayRules(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String clusterName,
 66:                                     @PathVariable String namespaceName, @PathVariable String branchName,
 67:                                     @RequestBody GrayReleaseRuleDTO newRuleDto) {
 68:     checkBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 69:     GrayReleaseRule newRules = BeanUtils.transform(GrayReleaseRule.class, newRuleDto);
 70:     newRules.setRules(GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer.batchTransformToJSON(newRuleDto.getRuleItems()));
 71:     newRules.setBranchStatus(NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE);
 72:     namespaceBranchService.updateBranchGrayRules(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, newRules);
 73:     messageSender.sendMessage(ReleaseMessageKeyGenerator.generate(appId, clusterName, namespaceName),
 74:                               Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC);
 75:   }
 76:   @Transactional
 77:   @DeleteMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches/{branchName}")
 78:   public void deleteBranch(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String clusterName,
 79:                            @PathVariable String namespaceName, @PathVariable String branchName,
 80:                            @RequestParam("operator") String operator) {
 81:     checkBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 82:     namespaceBranchService
 83:         .deleteBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, NamespaceBranchStatus.DELETED, operator);
 84:     messageSender.sendMessage(ReleaseMessageKeyGenerator.generate(appId, clusterName, namespaceName),
 85:                               Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC);
 86:   }
 87:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches")
 88:   public NamespaceDTO loadNamespaceBranch(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String clusterName,
 89:                                           @PathVariable String namespaceName) {
 90:     checkNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 91:     Namespace childNamespace = namespaceBranchService.findBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 92:     if (childNamespace == null) {
 93:       return null;
 94:     }
 95:     return BeanUtils.transform(NamespaceDTO.class, childNamespace);
 96:   }
 97:   private void checkBranch(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName, String branchName) {
 98:     checkNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
 99:     Namespace childNamespace = namespaceService.findOne(appId, branchName, namespaceName);
100:     if (childNamespace == null) {
101:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Namespace's branch not exist. AppId = %s, ClusterName = %s, "
102:                                                   + "NamespaceName = %s, BranchName = %s",
103:                                                   appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName));
104:     }
105:   }
106:   private void checkNamespace(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
107:     Namespace parentNamespace = namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
108:     if (parentNamespace == null) {
109:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Namespace not exist. AppId = %s, ClusterName = %s, NamespaceName = %s", appId,
110:                                                   clusterName, namespaceName));
111:     }
112:   }
113: }

40:       @RequestParam("operation") int operation,
41:       Pageable pageable) {
42:     Page<ReleaseHistory> result = releaseHistoryService.findByReleaseIdAndOperation(releaseId, operation, pageable);
43:     return transform2PageDTO(result, pageable);
44:   }
45:   @GetMapping("/releases/histories/by_previous_release_id_and_operation")
46:   public PageDTO<ReleaseHistoryDTO> findReleaseHistoryByPreviousReleaseIdAndOperation(
47:       @RequestParam("previousReleaseId") long previousReleaseId,
48:       @RequestParam("operation") int operation,
49:       Pageable pageable) {
50:     Page<ReleaseHistory> result = releaseHistoryService.findByPreviousReleaseIdAndOperation(previousReleaseId, operation, pageable);
51:     return transform2PageDTO(result, pageable);
52:   }
53:   private PageDTO<ReleaseHistoryDTO> transform2PageDTO(Page<ReleaseHistory> releaseHistoriesPage, Pageable pageable){
54:     if (!releaseHistoriesPage.hasContent()) {
55:       return null;
56:     }
57:     List<ReleaseHistory> releaseHistories = releaseHistoriesPage.getContent();
58:     List<ReleaseHistoryDTO> releaseHistoryDTOs = new ArrayList<>(releaseHistories.size());
59:     for (ReleaseHistory releaseHistory : releaseHistories) {
60:       releaseHistoryDTOs.add(transformReleaseHistory2DTO(releaseHistory));
61:     }
62:     return new PageDTO<>(releaseHistoryDTOs, pageable, releaseHistoriesPage.getTotalElements());
63:   }
64:   private ReleaseHistoryDTO transformReleaseHistory2DTO(ReleaseHistory releaseHistory) {
65:     ReleaseHistoryDTO dto = new ReleaseHistoryDTO();
66:     BeanUtils.copyProperties(releaseHistory, dto, "operationContext");
67:     dto.setOperationContext(GSON.fromJson(releaseHistory.getOperationContext(),
68:                                           configurationTypeReference));
69:     return dto;
70:   }
71: }

================
File: apollo-adminservice/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/adminservice/filter/AdminServiceAuthenticationFilter.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.adminservice.filter;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
 3: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
 4: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 5: import java.io.IOException;
 6: import java.util.List;
 7: import javax.servlet.Filter;
 8: import javax.servlet.FilterChain;
 9: import javax.servlet.FilterConfig;
10: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
11: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;
12: import javax.servlet.ServletResponse;
13: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
14: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
15: import org.slf4j.Logger;
16: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
17: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
18: public class AdminServiceAuthenticationFilter implements Filter {
19:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory
20:       .getLogger(AdminServiceAuthenticationFilter.class);
21:   private static final Splitter ACCESS_TOKEN_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings()
22:       .trimResults();
23:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
24:   private volatile String lastAccessTokens;
25:   private volatile List<String> accessTokenList;
26:   public AdminServiceAuthenticationFilter(BizConfig bizConfig) {
27:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
28:   }
29:   @Override
30:   public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {
31:   }
32:   @Override
33:   public void doFilter(ServletRequest req, ServletResponse resp, FilterChain chain)
34:       throws IOException, ServletException {
35:     if (bizConfig.isAdminServiceAccessControlEnabled()) {
36:       HttpServletRequest request = (HttpServletRequest) req;
37:       HttpServletResponse response = (HttpServletResponse) resp;
38:       String token = request.getHeader(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);
39:       if (!checkAccessToken(token)) {
40:         logger.warn("Invalid access token: {} for uri: {}", token, request.getRequestURI());
41:         response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED, "Unauthorized");
42:         return;
43:       }
44:     }
45:     chain.doFilter(req, resp);
46:   }
47:   private boolean checkAccessToken(String token) {
48:     String accessTokens = bizConfig.getAdminServiceAccessTokens();
49:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(accessTokens)) {
50:       return true;
51:     }
52:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(token)) {
53:       return false;
54:     }
55:     if (!accessTokens.equals(lastAccessTokens)) {
56:       synchronized (this) {
57:         accessTokenList = ACCESS_TOKEN_SPLITTER.splitToList(accessTokens);
58:         lastAccessTokens = accessTokens;
59:       }
60:     }
61:     return accessTokenList.contains(token);
62:   }
63:   @Override
64:   public void destroy() {
65:   }
66: }

21:     logger.info(commonContext.getId() + " isActive: " + commonContext.isActive());

23:       ConfigurableApplicationContext configContext =
24:           new SpringApplicationBuilder(ConfigServiceApplication.class).parent(commonContext)
25:               .sources(RefreshScope.class).run(args);
26:       logger.info(configContext.getId() + " isActive: " + configContext.isActive());
27:     }
28:     if (commonContext.getEnvironment().containsProperty("adminservice")) {

30:           new SpringApplicationBuilder(AdminServiceApplication.class).parent(commonContext)
31:               .sources(RefreshScope.class).run(args);
32:       logger.info(adminContext.getId() + " isActive: " + adminContext.isActive());
33:     }
34:     if (commonContext.getEnvironment().containsProperty("portal")) {
35:       ConfigurableApplicationContext portalContext =
36:           new SpringApplicationBuilder(PortalApplication.class).parent(commonContext)
37:               .sources(RefreshScope.class).run(args);
38:       logger.info(portalContext.getId() + " isActive: " + portalContext.isActive());
39:     }
40:   }

File: apollo-biz/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/biz/grayReleaseRule/GrayReleaseRulesHolder.java

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.grayReleaseRule;
  2: import com.google.common.base.Joiner;
  3: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
  4: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
  5: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
  6: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
  7: import com.google.common.collect.Multimaps;
  8: import com.google.common.collect.Ordering;
  9: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.GrayReleaseRule;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.ReleaseMessage;
 13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.message.ReleaseMessageListener;
 14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.message.Topics;
 15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.repository.GrayReleaseRuleRepository;
 16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.constants.NamespaceBranchStatus;
 17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO;
 18: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils.GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer;
 19: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ConfigConsts;
 20: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 21: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 22: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
 23: import com.google.common.collect.TreeMultimap;
 24: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 25: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 26: import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
 27: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 28: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 29: import java.util.List;
 30: import java.util.Set;
 31: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 32: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 33: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 34: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
 35: public class GrayReleaseRulesHolder implements ReleaseMessageListener, InitializingBean {
 36:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GrayReleaseRulesHolder.class);
 37:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR);
 38:   private static final Splitter STRING_SPLITTER =
 39:       Splitter.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR).omitEmptyStrings();
 40:   @Autowired
 41:   private GrayReleaseRuleRepository grayReleaseRuleRepository;
 42:   @Autowired
 43:   private BizConfig bizConfig;
 44:   private int databaseScanInterval;
 45:   private ScheduledExecutorService executorService;
 46:   private Multimap<String, GrayReleaseRuleCache> grayReleaseRuleCache;
 47:   private Multimap<String, Long> reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache;
 48:   private AtomicLong loadVersion;
 49:   public GrayReleaseRulesHolder() {
 50:     loadVersion = new AtomicLong();
 51:     grayReleaseRuleCache = Multimaps.synchronizedSetMultimap(
 52:         TreeMultimap.create(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER, Ordering.natural()));
 53:     reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache = Multimaps.synchronizedSetMultimap(
 54:         TreeMultimap.create(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER, Ordering.natural()));
 55:     executorService = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory
 56:         .create("GrayReleaseRulesHolder", true));
 57:   }
 58:   @Override
 59:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
 60:     populateDataBaseInterval();
 61:     periodicScanRules();
 62:     executorService.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::periodicScanRules,
 63:         getDatabaseScanIntervalSecond(), getDatabaseScanIntervalSecond(), getDatabaseScanTimeUnit()
 64:     );
 65:   }
 66:   @Override
 67:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
 68:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
 69:     String releaseMessage = message.getMessage();
 70:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(releaseMessage)) {
 71:       return;
 72:     }
 73:     List<String> keys = STRING_SPLITTER.splitToList(releaseMessage);
 74:     if (keys.size() != 3) {
 75:       logger.error("message format invalid - {}", releaseMessage);
 76:       return;
 77:     }
 78:     String appId = keys.get(0);
 79:     String cluster = keys.get(1);
 80:     String namespace = keys.get(2);
 81:     List<GrayReleaseRule> rules = grayReleaseRuleRepository
 82:         .findByAppIdAndClusterNameAndNamespaceName(appId, cluster, namespace);
 83:     mergeGrayReleaseRules(rules);
 84:   }
 85:   private void periodicScanRules() {
 86:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.GrayReleaseRulesScanner",
 87:         "scanGrayReleaseRules");
 88:     try {
 89:       loadVersion.incrementAndGet();
 90:       scanGrayReleaseRules();
 91:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 92:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 93:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
 94:       logger.error("Scan gray release rule failed", ex);
 95:     } finally {
 96:       transaction.complete();
 97:     }
 98:   }
 99:   public Long findReleaseIdFromGrayReleaseRule(String clientAppId, String clientIp, String
100:       configAppId, String configCluster, String configNamespaceName) {
101:     String key = assembleGrayReleaseRuleKey(configAppId, configCluster, configNamespaceName);
102:     if (!grayReleaseRuleCache.containsKey(key)) {
103:       return null;
104:     }
105:     List<GrayReleaseRuleCache> rules = Lists.newArrayList(grayReleaseRuleCache.get(key));
106:     for (GrayReleaseRuleCache rule : rules) {
107:       if (rule.getBranchStatus() != NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE) {
108:         continue;
109:       }
110:       if (rule.matches(clientAppId, clientIp)) {
111:         return rule.getReleaseId();
112:       }
113:     }
114:     return null;
115:   }
116:   public boolean hasGrayReleaseRule(String clientAppId, String clientIp, String namespaceName) {
117:     return reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache.containsKey(assembleReversedGrayReleaseRuleKey(clientAppId,
118:         namespaceName, clientIp)) || reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache.containsKey
119:         (assembleReversedGrayReleaseRuleKey(clientAppId, namespaceName, GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO
120:             .ALL_IP));
121:   }
122:   private void scanGrayReleaseRules() {
123:     long maxIdScanned = 0;
124:     boolean hasMore = true;
125:     while (hasMore && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
126:       List<GrayReleaseRule> grayReleaseRules = grayReleaseRuleRepository
127:           .findFirst500ByIdGreaterThanOrderByIdAsc(maxIdScanned);
128:       if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(grayReleaseRules)) {
129:         break;
130:       }
131:       mergeGrayReleaseRules(grayReleaseRules);
132:       int rulesScanned = grayReleaseRules.size();
133:       maxIdScanned = grayReleaseRules.get(rulesScanned - 1).getId();
134:       hasMore = rulesScanned == 500;
135:     }
136:   }
137:   private void mergeGrayReleaseRules(List<GrayReleaseRule> grayReleaseRules) {
138:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(grayReleaseRules)) {
139:       return;
140:     }
141:     for (GrayReleaseRule grayReleaseRule : grayReleaseRules) {
142:       if (grayReleaseRule.getReleaseId() == null || grayReleaseRule.getReleaseId() == 0) {
143:         continue;
144:       }
145:       String key = assembleGrayReleaseRuleKey(grayReleaseRule.getAppId(), grayReleaseRule
146:           .getClusterName(), grayReleaseRule.getNamespaceName());
147:       List<GrayReleaseRuleCache> rules = Lists.newArrayList(grayReleaseRuleCache.get(key));
148:       GrayReleaseRuleCache oldRule = null;
149:       for (GrayReleaseRuleCache ruleCache : rules) {
150:         if (ruleCache.getBranchName().equals(grayReleaseRule.getBranchName())) {
151:           oldRule = ruleCache;
152:           break;
153:         }
154:       }
155:       if (oldRule == null && grayReleaseRule.getBranchStatus() != NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE) {
156:         continue;
157:       }
158:       if (oldRule == null || grayReleaseRule.getId() > oldRule.getRuleId()) {
159:         addCache(key, transformRuleToRuleCache(grayReleaseRule));
160:         if (oldRule != null) {
161:           removeCache(key, oldRule);
162:         }
163:       } else {
164:         if (oldRule.getBranchStatus() == NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE) {
165:           oldRule.setLoadVersion(loadVersion.get());
166:         } else if ((loadVersion.get() - oldRule.getLoadVersion()) > 1) {
167:           removeCache(key, oldRule);
168:         }
169:       }
170:     }
171:   }
172:   private void addCache(String key, GrayReleaseRuleCache ruleCache) {
173:     if (ruleCache.getBranchStatus() == NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE) {
174:       for (GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO ruleItemDTO : ruleCache.getRuleItems()) {
175:         for (String clientIp : ruleItemDTO.getClientIpList()) {
176:           reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache.put(assembleReversedGrayReleaseRuleKey(ruleItemDTO
177:               .getClientAppId(), ruleCache.getNamespaceName(), clientIp), ruleCache.getRuleId());
178:         }
179:       }
180:     }
181:     grayReleaseRuleCache.put(key, ruleCache);
182:   }
183:   private void removeCache(String key, GrayReleaseRuleCache ruleCache) {
184:     grayReleaseRuleCache.remove(key, ruleCache);
185:     for (GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO ruleItemDTO : ruleCache.getRuleItems()) {
186:       for (String clientIp : ruleItemDTO.getClientIpList()) {
187:         reversedGrayReleaseRuleCache.remove(assembleReversedGrayReleaseRuleKey(ruleItemDTO
188:             .getClientAppId(), ruleCache.getNamespaceName(), clientIp), ruleCache.getRuleId());
189:       }
190:     }
191:   }
192:   private GrayReleaseRuleCache transformRuleToRuleCache(GrayReleaseRule grayReleaseRule) {
193:     Set<GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO> ruleItems;
194:     try {
195:       ruleItems = GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer.batchTransformFromJSON(grayReleaseRule.getRules());
196:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
197:       ruleItems = Sets.newHashSet();
198:       Tracer.logError(ex);
199:       logger.error("parse rule for gray release rule {} failed", grayReleaseRule.getId(), ex);
200:     }
201:     GrayReleaseRuleCache ruleCache = new GrayReleaseRuleCache(grayReleaseRule.getId(),
202:         grayReleaseRule.getBranchName(), grayReleaseRule.getNamespaceName(), grayReleaseRule
203:         .getReleaseId(), grayReleaseRule.getBranchStatus(), loadVersion.get(), ruleItems);
204:     return ruleCache;
205:   }
206:   private void populateDataBaseInterval() {
207:     databaseScanInterval = bizConfig.grayReleaseRuleScanInterval();
208:   }
209:   private int getDatabaseScanIntervalSecond() {
210:     return databaseScanInterval;
211:   }
212:   private TimeUnit getDatabaseScanTimeUnit() {
213:     return TimeUnit.SECONDS;
214:   }
215:   private String assembleGrayReleaseRuleKey(String configAppId, String configCluster, String
216:       configNamespaceName) {
217:     return STRING_JOINER.join(configAppId, configCluster, configNamespaceName);
218:   }
219:   private String assembleReversedGrayReleaseRuleKey(String clientAppId, String
220:       clientNamespaceName, String clientIp) {
221:     return STRING_JOINER.join(clientAppId, clientNamespaceName, clientIp);
222:   }
223: }

File: apollo-biz/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/biz/message/DatabaseMessageSender.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.message;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.ReleaseMessage;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.repository.ReleaseMessageRepository;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
 7: import com.google.common.collect.Queues;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
11: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
12: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
13: import java.util.List;
14: import java.util.Objects;
15: import java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue;
16: import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
17: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
18: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
19: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
20: @Component
21: public class DatabaseMessageSender implements MessageSender {
22:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DatabaseMessageSender.class);
23:   private static final int CLEAN_QUEUE_MAX_SIZE = 100;
24:   private BlockingQueue<Long> toClean = Queues.newLinkedBlockingQueue(CLEAN_QUEUE_MAX_SIZE);
25:   private final ExecutorService cleanExecutorService;
26:   private final AtomicBoolean cleanStopped;
27:   private final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository;
28:   public DatabaseMessageSender(final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository) {
29:     cleanExecutorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(ApolloThreadFactory.create("DatabaseMessageSender", true));
30:     cleanStopped = new AtomicBoolean(false);
31:     this.releaseMessageRepository = releaseMessageRepository;
32:   }
33:   @Override
34:   @Transactional
35:   public void sendMessage(String message, String channel) {
36:     logger.info("Sending message {} to channel {}", message, channel);
37:     if (!Objects.equals(channel, Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC)) {
38:       logger.warn("Channel {} not supported by DatabaseMessageSender!", channel);
39:       return;
40:     }
41:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.AdminService.ReleaseMessage", message);
42:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.AdminService", "sendMessage");
43:     try {
44:       ReleaseMessage newMessage = releaseMessageRepository.save(new ReleaseMessage(message));
45:       toClean.offer(newMessage.getId());
46:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
47:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
48:       logger.error("Sending message to database failed", ex);
49:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
50:       throw ex;
51:     } finally {
52:       transaction.complete();
53:     }
54:   }
55:   @PostConstruct
56:   private void initialize() {
57:     cleanExecutorService.submit(() -> {
58:       while (!cleanStopped.get() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
59:         try {
60:           Long rm = toClean.poll(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
61:           if (rm != null) {
62:             cleanMessage(rm);
63:           } else {
64:             TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(5);
65:           }
66:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
67:           Tracer.logError(ex);
68:         }
69:       }
70:     });
71:   }
72:   private void cleanMessage(Long id) {
73:     ReleaseMessage releaseMessage = releaseMessageRepository.findById(id).orElse(null);
74:     if (releaseMessage == null) {
75:       return;
76:     }
77:     boolean hasMore = true;
78:     while (hasMore && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
79:       List<ReleaseMessage> messages = releaseMessageRepository.findFirst100ByMessageAndIdLessThanOrderByIdAsc(
80:           releaseMessage.getMessage(), releaseMessage.getId());
81:       releaseMessageRepository.deleteAll(messages);
82:       hasMore = messages.size() == 100;
83:       messages.forEach(toRemove -> Tracer.logEvent(
84:           String.format("ReleaseMessage.Clean.%s", toRemove.getMessage()), String.valueOf(toRemove.getId())));
85:     }
86:   }
87:   void stopClean() {
88:     cleanStopped.set(true);
89:   }
90: }

File: apollo-biz/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/biz/message/ReleaseMessageScanner.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.message;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 5: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
10: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.ReleaseMessage;
13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.repository.ReleaseMessageRepository;
14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
17: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
18: public class ReleaseMessageScanner implements InitializingBean {
19:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ReleaseMessageScanner.class);
20:   @Autowired
21:   private BizConfig bizConfig;
22:   @Autowired
23:   private ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository;
24:   private int databaseScanInterval;
25:   private List<ReleaseMessageListener> listeners;
26:   private ScheduledExecutorService executorService;
27:   private long maxIdScanned;
28:   public ReleaseMessageScanner() {
29:     listeners = Lists.newCopyOnWriteArrayList();
30:     executorService = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory
31:         .create("ReleaseMessageScanner", true));
32:   }
33:   @Override
34:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
35:     databaseScanInterval = bizConfig.releaseMessageScanIntervalInMilli();
36:     maxIdScanned = loadLargestMessageId();
37:     executorService.scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> {
38:       Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ReleaseMessageScanner", "scanMessage");
39:       try {
40:         scanMessages();
41:         transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
42:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
43:         transaction.setStatus(ex);
44:         logger.error("Scan and send message failed", ex);
45:       } finally {
46:         transaction.complete();
47:       }
48:     }, databaseScanInterval, databaseScanInterval, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
49:   }
50:   public void addMessageListener(ReleaseMessageListener listener) {
51:     if (!listeners.contains(listener)) {
52:       listeners.add(listener);
53:     }
54:   }
55:   private void scanMessages() {
56:     boolean hasMoreMessages = true;
57:     while (hasMoreMessages && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
58:       hasMoreMessages = scanAndSendMessages();
59:     }
60:   }
61:   private boolean scanAndSendMessages() {
62:     List<ReleaseMessage> releaseMessages =
63:         releaseMessageRepository.findFirst500ByIdGreaterThanOrderByIdAsc(maxIdScanned);
64:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(releaseMessages)) {
65:       return false;
66:     }
67:     fireMessageScanned(releaseMessages);
68:     int messageScanned = releaseMessages.size();
69:     maxIdScanned = releaseMessages.get(messageScanned - 1).getId();
70:     return messageScanned == 500;
71:   }
72:   private long loadLargestMessageId() {
73:     ReleaseMessage releaseMessage = releaseMessageRepository.findTopByOrderByIdDesc();
74:     return releaseMessage == null ? 0 : releaseMessage.getId();
75:   }
76:   private void fireMessageScanned(List<ReleaseMessage> messages) {
77:     for (ReleaseMessage message : messages) {
78:       for (ReleaseMessageListener listener : listeners) {
79:         try {
80:           listener.handleMessage(message, Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC);
81:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
82:           Tracer.logError(ex);
83:           logger.error("Failed to invoke message listener {}", listener.getClass(), ex);
84:         }
85:       }
86:     }
87:   }
88: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.AccessKey;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Audit;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.repository.AccessKeyRepository;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 6: import java.util.List;
 7: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 8: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
 9: @Service
10: public class AccessKeyService {
11:   private static final int ACCESSKEY_COUNT_LIMIT = 5;
12:   private final AccessKeyRepository accessKeyRepository;
13:   private final AuditService auditService;
14:   public AccessKeyService(
15:       AccessKeyRepository accessKeyRepository,
16:       AuditService auditService) {
17:     this.accessKeyRepository = accessKeyRepository;
18:     this.auditService = auditService;
19:   }
20:   public List<AccessKey> findByAppId(String appId) {
21:     return accessKeyRepository.findByAppId(appId);
22:   }
23:   @Transactional
24:   public AccessKey create(String appId, AccessKey entity) {
25:     long count = accessKeyRepository.countByAppId(appId);
26:     if (count >= ACCESSKEY_COUNT_LIMIT) {
27:       throw new BadRequestException("AccessKeys count limit exceeded");
28:     }
29:     entity.setId(0L);
30:     entity.setAppId(appId);
31:     entity.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(entity.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
32:     AccessKey accessKey = accessKeyRepository.save(entity);
33:     auditService.audit(AccessKey.class.getSimpleName(), accessKey.getId(), Audit.OP.INSERT,
34:         accessKey.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
35:     return accessKey;
36:   }
37:   @Transactional
38:   public AccessKey update(String appId, AccessKey entity) {
39:     long id = entity.getId();
40:     String operator = entity.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy();
41:     AccessKey accessKey = accessKeyRepository.findOneByAppIdAndId(appId, id);
42:     if (accessKey == null) {
43:       throw new BadRequestException("AccessKey not exist");
44:     }
45:     accessKey.setEnabled(entity.isEnabled());
46:     accessKey.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
47:     accessKeyRepository.save(accessKey);
48:     auditService.audit(AccessKey.class.getSimpleName(), id, Audit.OP.UPDATE, operator);
49:     return accessKey;
50:   }
51:   @Transactional
52:   public void delete(String appId, long id, String operator) {
53:     AccessKey accessKey = accessKeyRepository.findOneByAppIdAndId(appId, id);
54:     if (accessKey == null) {
55:       throw new BadRequestException("AccessKey not exist");
56:     }
57:     if (accessKey.isEnabled()) {
58:       throw new BadRequestException("AccessKey should disable first");
59:     }
60:     accessKey.setDeleted(Boolean.TRUE);
61:     accessKey.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
62:     accessKeyRepository.save(accessKey);
63:     auditService.audit(AccessKey.class.getSimpleName(), id, Audit.OP.DELETE, operator);
64:   }
65: }

 29:   private final AuditService auditService;
 30:   public AppNamespaceService(
 31:       final AppNamespaceRepository appNamespaceRepository,
 32:       final @Lazy NamespaceService namespaceService,
 33:       final @Lazy ClusterService clusterService,
 34:       final AuditService auditService) {
 35:     this.appNamespaceRepository = appNamespaceRepository;
 36:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 37:     this.clusterService = clusterService;
 38:     this.auditService = auditService;
 39:   }
 40:   public boolean isAppNamespaceNameUnique(String appId, String namespaceName) {
 41:     Objects.requireNonNull(appId, "AppId must not be null");
 42:     Objects.requireNonNull(namespaceName, "Namespace must not be null");
 43:     return Objects.isNull(appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName));
 44:   }
 45:   public AppNamespace findPublicNamespaceByName(String namespaceName) {
 46:     Preconditions.checkArgument(namespaceName != null, "Namespace must not be null");
 47:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByNameAndIsPublicTrue(namespaceName);
 48:   }
 49:   public List<AppNamespace> findByAppId(String appId) {
 50:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppId(appId);
 51:   }
 52:   public List<AppNamespace> findPublicNamespacesByNames(Set<String> namespaceNames) {
 53:     if (namespaceNames == null || namespaceNames.isEmpty()) {
 54:       return Collections.emptyList();
 55:     }
 56:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByNameInAndIsPublicTrue(namespaceNames);
 57:   }
 58:   public List<AppNamespace> findPrivateAppNamespace(String appId) {
 59:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndIsPublic(appId, false);
 60:   }
 61:   public AppNamespace findOne(String appId, String namespaceName) {
 62:     Preconditions
 63:         .checkArgument(!StringUtils.isContainEmpty(appId, namespaceName), "appId or Namespace must not be null");
 64:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
 65:   }
 66:   public List<AppNamespace> findByAppIdAndNamespaces(String appId, Set<String> namespaceNames) {
 67:     Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(appId), "appId must not be null");
 68:     if (namespaceNames == null || namespaceNames.isEmpty()) {
 69:       return Collections.emptyList();
 70:     }
 71:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndNameIn(appId, namespaceNames);
 72:   }
 73:   @Transactional
 74:   public void createDefaultAppNamespace(String appId, String createBy) {
 75:     if (!isAppNamespaceNameUnique(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION)) {
 76:       throw new ServiceException("appnamespace not unique");
 77:     }
 78:     AppNamespace appNs = new AppNamespace();
 79:     appNs.setAppId(appId);
 80:     appNs.setName(ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION);
 81:     appNs.setComment("default app namespace");
 82:     appNs.setFormat(ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue());
 83:     appNs.setDataChangeCreatedBy(createBy);
 84:     appNs.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(createBy);
 85:     appNamespaceRepository.save(appNs);
 86:     auditService.audit(AppNamespace.class.getSimpleName(), appNs.getId(), Audit.OP.INSERT,
 87:                        createBy);
 88:   }
 89:   @Transactional
 90:   public AppNamespace createAppNamespace(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
 91:     String createBy = appNamespace.getDataChangeCreatedBy();
 92:     if (!isAppNamespaceNameUnique(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName())) {
 93:       throw new ServiceException("appnamespace not unique");
 94:     }
 95:     appNamespace.setId(0);
 96:     appNamespace.setDataChangeCreatedBy(createBy);
 97:     appNamespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(createBy);
 98:     appNamespace = appNamespaceRepository.save(appNamespace);
 99:     createNamespaceForAppNamespaceInAllCluster(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName(), createBy);
100:     auditService.audit(AppNamespace.class.getSimpleName(), appNamespace.getId(), Audit.OP.INSERT, createBy);
101:     return appNamespace;
102:   }
103:   public AppNamespace update(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
104:     AppNamespace managedNs = appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName());
105:     BeanUtils.copyEntityProperties(appNamespace, managedNs);
106:     managedNs = appNamespaceRepository.save(managedNs);
107:     auditService.audit(AppNamespace.class.getSimpleName(), managedNs.getId(), Audit.OP.UPDATE,
108:                        managedNs.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
109:     return managedNs;
110:   }
111:   public void createNamespaceForAppNamespaceInAllCluster(String appId, String namespaceName, String createBy) {
112:     List<Cluster> clusters = clusterService.findParentClusters(appId);
113:     for (Cluster cluster : clusters) {
114:       if (!namespaceService.isNamespaceUnique(appId, cluster.getName(), namespaceName)) {
115:         continue;
116:       }
117:       Namespace namespace = new Namespace();
118:       namespace.setClusterName(cluster.getName());
119:       namespace.setAppId(appId);
120:       namespace.setNamespaceName(namespaceName);
121:       namespace.setDataChangeCreatedBy(createBy);
122:       namespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(createBy);
123:       namespaceService.save(namespace);
124:     }
125:   }
126:   @Transactional
127:   public void batchDelete(String appId, String operator) {
128:     appNamespaceRepository.batchDeleteByAppId(appId, operator);
129:   }
130:   @Transactional
131:   public void deleteAppNamespace(AppNamespace appNamespace, String operator) {
132:     String appId = appNamespace.getAppId();
133:     String namespaceName = appNamespace.getName();
134:     logger.info("{} is deleting AppNamespace, appId: {}, namespace: {}", operator, appId, namespaceName);
135:     List<Namespace> namespaces = namespaceService.findByAppIdAndNamespaceName(appId, namespaceName);
136:     if (namespaces != null) {
137:       for (Namespace namespace : namespaces) {
138:         namespaceService.deleteNamespace(namespace, operator);
139:       }
140:     }
141:     appNamespaceRepository.delete(appId, namespaceName, operator);
142:   }
143: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service;
 2: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.ServerConfig;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.repository.ServerConfigRepository;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.config.RefreshablePropertySource;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ConfigConsts;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.Foundation;
 9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
11: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
12: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
13: import java.util.Map;
14: import java.util.Objects;
15: @Component
16: public class BizDBPropertySource extends RefreshablePropertySource {
17:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BizDBPropertySource.class);
18:   @Autowired
19:   private ServerConfigRepository serverConfigRepository;
20:   public BizDBPropertySource(String name, Map<String, Object> source) {
21:     super(name, source);
22:   }
23:   public BizDBPropertySource() {
24:     super("DBConfig", Maps.newConcurrentMap());
25:   }
26:   String getCurrentDataCenter() {
27:     return Foundation.server().getDataCenter();
28:   }
29:   @Override
30:   protected void refresh() {
31:     Iterable<ServerConfig> dbConfigs = serverConfigRepository.findAll();
32:     Map<String, Object> newConfigs = Maps.newHashMap();
33:     for (ServerConfig config : dbConfigs) {
34:       if (Objects.equals(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAME_DEFAULT, config.getCluster())) {
35:         newConfigs.put(config.getKey(), config.getValue());
36:       }
37:     }
38:     String dataCenter = getCurrentDataCenter();
39:     for (ServerConfig config : dbConfigs) {
40:       if (Objects.equals(dataCenter, config.getCluster())) {
41:         newConfigs.put(config.getKey(), config.getValue());
42:       }
43:     }
44:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(System.getProperty(ConfigConsts.APOLLO_CLUSTER_KEY))) {
45:       String cluster = System.getProperty(ConfigConsts.APOLLO_CLUSTER_KEY);
46:       for (ServerConfig config : dbConfigs) {
47:         if (Objects.equals(cluster, config.getCluster())) {
48:           newConfigs.put(config.getKey(), config.getValue());
49:         }
50:       }
51:     }
52:     for (Map.Entry<String, Object> config: newConfigs.entrySet()){
53:       String key = config.getKey();
54:       Object value = config.getValue();
55:       if (this.source.get(key) == null) {
56:         logger.info("Load config from DB : {} = {}", key, value);
57:       } else if (!Objects.equals(this.source.get(key), value)) {
58:         logger.info("Load config from DB : {} = {}. Old value = {}", key,
59:                     value, this.source.get(key));
60:       }
61:       this.source.put(key, value);
62:     }
63:   }
64: }

 76:     List<Instance> instances = Collections.emptyList();
 77:     if (instanceIdResult.hasContent()) {

 91:         return null;
 92:       }).filter(Objects::nonNull).collect(Collectors.toSet());
 93:       instances = findInstancesByIds(instanceIds);

110:       int lineNum = lastItem == null ? 1 : lastItem.getLineNum() + 1;
111:       entity.setLineNum(lineNum);

115:                        item.getDataChangeCreatedBy());

122:     BeanUtils.copyEntityProperties(item, managedItem);
123:     managedItem = itemRepository.save(managedItem);

125:                        managedItem.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());

128:   private boolean checkItemValueLength(long namespaceId, String value) {
129:     int limit = getItemValueLengthLimit(namespaceId);
130:     if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(value) && value.length() > limit) {
131:       throw new BadRequestException("value too long. length limit:" + limit);
132:     }
133:     return true;
134:   }
135:   private boolean checkItemKeyLength(String key) {
136:     if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(key) && key.length() > bizConfig.itemKeyLengthLimit()) {
137:       throw new BadRequestException("key too long. length limit:" + bizConfig.itemKeyLengthLimit());
138:     }
139:     return true;
140:   }
141:   private int getItemValueLengthLimit(long namespaceId) {
142:     Map<Long, Integer> namespaceValueLengthOverride = bizConfig.namespaceValueLengthLimitOverride();
143:     if (namespaceValueLengthOverride != null && namespaceValueLengthOverride.containsKey(namespaceId)) {
144:       return namespaceValueLengthOverride.get(namespaceId);
145:     }
146:     return bizConfig.itemValueLengthLimit();
147:   }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Audit;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Commit;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Item;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Namespace;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.utils.ConfigChangeContentBuilder;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;
 9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.NotFoundException;
10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils.BeanUtils;
11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
12: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
13: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
14: @Service
15: public class ItemSetService {
16:   private final AuditService auditService;
17:   private final CommitService commitService;
18:   private final ItemService itemService;
19:   public ItemSetService(
20:       final AuditService auditService,
21:       final CommitService commitService,
22:       final ItemService itemService) {
23:     this.auditService = auditService;
24:     this.commitService = commitService;
25:     this.itemService = itemService;
26:   }
27:   @Transactional
28:   public ItemChangeSets updateSet(Namespace namespace, ItemChangeSets changeSets){
29:     return updateSet(namespace.getAppId(), namespace.getClusterName(), namespace.getNamespaceName(), changeSets);
30:   }
31:   @Transactional
32:   public ItemChangeSets updateSet(String appId, String clusterName,
33:                                   String namespaceName, ItemChangeSets changeSet) {
34:     String operator = changeSet.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy();
35:     ConfigChangeContentBuilder configChangeContentBuilder = new ConfigChangeContentBuilder();
36:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(changeSet.getCreateItems())) {
37:       for (ItemDTO item : changeSet.getCreateItems()) {
38:         Item entity = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, item);
39:         entity.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
40:         entity.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
41:         Item createdItem = itemService.save(entity);
42:         configChangeContentBuilder.createItem(createdItem);
43:       }
44:       auditService.audit("ItemSet", null, Audit.OP.INSERT, operator);
45:     }
46:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(changeSet.getUpdateItems())) {
47:       for (ItemDTO item : changeSet.getUpdateItems()) {
48:         Item entity = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, item);
49:         Item managedItem = itemService.findOne(entity.getId());
50:         if (managedItem == null) {
51:           throw new NotFoundException(String.format("item not found.(key=%s)", entity.getKey()));
52:         }
53:         Item beforeUpdateItem = BeanUtils.transform(Item.class, managedItem);
54:         managedItem.setValue(entity.getValue());
55:         managedItem.setComment(entity.getComment());
56:         managedItem.setLineNum(entity.getLineNum());
57:         managedItem.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
58:         Item updatedItem = itemService.update(managedItem);
59:         configChangeContentBuilder.updateItem(beforeUpdateItem, updatedItem);
60:       }
61:       auditService.audit("ItemSet", null, Audit.OP.UPDATE, operator);
62:     }
63:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(changeSet.getDeleteItems())) {
64:       for (ItemDTO item : changeSet.getDeleteItems()) {
65:         Item deletedItem = itemService.delete(item.getId(), operator);
66:         configChangeContentBuilder.deleteItem(deletedItem);
67:       }
68:       auditService.audit("ItemSet", null, Audit.OP.DELETE, operator);
69:     }
70:     if (configChangeContentBuilder.hasContent()){
71:       createCommit(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, configChangeContentBuilder.build(),
72:                    changeSet.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
73:     }
74:     return changeSet;
75:   }
76:   private void createCommit(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName, String configChangeContent,
77:                             String operator) {
78:     Commit commit = new Commit();
79:     commit.setAppId(appId);
80:     commit.setClusterName(clusterName);
81:     commit.setNamespaceName(namespaceName);
82:     commit.setChangeSets(configChangeContent);
83:     commit.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
84:     commit.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
85:     commitService.save(commit);
86:   }

 42:   public Namespace createBranch(String appId, String parentClusterName, String namespaceName, String operator){
 43:     Namespace childNamespace = findBranch(appId, parentClusterName, namespaceName);
 44:     if (childNamespace != null){
 45:       throw new BadRequestException("namespace already has branch");
 46:     }
 47:     Cluster parentCluster = clusterService.findOne(appId, parentClusterName);
 48:     if (parentCluster == null || parentCluster.getParentClusterId() != 0) {
