 67:                                     String branchName, GrayReleaseRule newRules) {
 68:     doUpdateBranchGrayRules(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, newRules, true, ReleaseOperation.APPLY_GRAY_RULES);
 69:   }
 70:   private void doUpdateBranchGrayRules(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 71:                                               String branchName, GrayReleaseRule newRules, boolean recordReleaseHistory, int releaseOperation) {
 72:     GrayReleaseRule oldRules = grayReleaseRuleRepository
 73:         .findTopByAppIdAndClusterNameAndNamespaceNameAndBranchNameOrderByIdDesc(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 74:     Release latestBranchRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(appId, branchName, namespaceName);
 75:     long latestBranchReleaseId = latestBranchRelease != null ? latestBranchRelease.getId() : 0;
 76:     newRules.setReleaseId(latestBranchReleaseId);
 77:     grayReleaseRuleRepository.save(newRules);
 78:     if (oldRules != null) {
 79:       grayReleaseRuleRepository.delete(oldRules);
 80:     }
 81:     if (recordReleaseHistory) {
 82:       Map<String, Object> releaseOperationContext = Maps.newHashMap();
 83:       releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.RULES, GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer
 84:           .batchTransformFromJSON(newRules.getRules()));
 85:       if (oldRules != null) {
 86:         releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.OLD_RULES,
 87:             GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer.batchTransformFromJSON(oldRules.getRules()));
 88:       }
 89:       releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, latestBranchReleaseId,
 90:           latestBranchReleaseId, releaseOperation, releaseOperationContext, newRules.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 91:     }
 92:   }
 93:   @Transactional
 94:   public GrayReleaseRule updateRulesReleaseId(String appId, String clusterName,
 95:                                    String namespaceName, String branchName,
 96:                                    long latestReleaseId, String operator) {
 97:     GrayReleaseRule oldRules = grayReleaseRuleRepository.
 98:         findTopByAppIdAndClusterNameAndNamespaceNameAndBranchNameOrderByIdDesc(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
 99:     if (oldRules == null) {
100:       return null;
101:     }
102:     GrayReleaseRule newRules = new GrayReleaseRule();
103:     newRules.setBranchStatus(NamespaceBranchStatus.ACTIVE);
104:     newRules.setReleaseId(latestReleaseId);
105:     newRules.setRules(oldRules.getRules());
106:     newRules.setAppId(oldRules.getAppId());
107:     newRules.setClusterName(oldRules.getClusterName());
108:     newRules.setNamespaceName(oldRules.getNamespaceName());
109:     newRules.setBranchName(oldRules.getBranchName());
110:     newRules.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
111:     newRules.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
112:     grayReleaseRuleRepository.save(newRules);
113:     grayReleaseRuleRepository.delete(oldRules);
114:     return newRules;
115:   }
116:   @Transactional
117:   public void deleteBranch(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
118:                            String branchName, int branchStatus, String operator) {
119:     Cluster toDeleteCluster = clusterService.findOne(appId, branchName);
120:     if (toDeleteCluster == null) {
121:       return;
122:     }
123:     Release latestBranchRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(appId, branchName, namespaceName);
124:     long latestBranchReleaseId = latestBranchRelease != null ? latestBranchRelease.getId() : 0;
125:     GrayReleaseRule deleteRule = new GrayReleaseRule();
126:     deleteRule.setRules("[]");
127:     deleteRule.setAppId(appId);
128:     deleteRule.setClusterName(clusterName);
129:     deleteRule.setNamespaceName(namespaceName);
130:     deleteRule.setBranchName(branchName);
131:     deleteRule.setBranchStatus(branchStatus);
132:     deleteRule.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
133:     deleteRule.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
134:     doUpdateBranchGrayRules(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, deleteRule, false, -1);
135:     clusterService.delete(toDeleteCluster.getId(), operator);
136:     int releaseOperation = branchStatus == NamespaceBranchStatus.MERGED ? ReleaseOperation
137:         .GRAY_RELEASE_DELETED_AFTER_MERGE : ReleaseOperation.ABANDON_GRAY_RELEASE;
138:     releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, latestBranchReleaseId,
139:         latestBranchReleaseId, releaseOperation, null, operator);
140:     auditService.audit("Branch", toDeleteCluster.getId(), Audit.OP.DELETE, operator);
141:   }

203:   @Transactional
204:   public Namespace deleteNamespace(Namespace namespace, String operator) {
205:     String appId = namespace.getAppId();
206:     String clusterName = namespace.getClusterName();
207:     String namespaceName = namespace.getNamespaceName();
208:     itemService.batchDelete(namespace.getId(), operator);
209:     commitService.batchDelete(appId, clusterName, namespace.getNamespaceName(), operator);
210:     if (!isChildNamespace(namespace)) {
211:       releaseService.batchDelete(appId, clusterName, namespace.getNamespaceName(), operator);
212:     }
213:     Namespace childNamespace = findChildNamespace(namespace);
214:     if (childNamespace != null) {
215:       namespaceBranchService.deleteBranch(appId, clusterName, namespaceName,
216:                                           childNamespace.getClusterName(), NamespaceBranchStatus.DELETED, operator);
217:       releaseService.batchDelete(appId, childNamespace.getClusterName(), namespaceName, operator);
218:     }
219:     releaseHistoryService.batchDelete(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, operator);
220:     instanceService.batchDeleteInstanceConfig(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
221:     namespaceLockService.unlock(namespace.getId());
222:     namespace.setDeleted(true);
223:     namespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
224:     auditService.audit(Namespace.class.getSimpleName(), namespace.getId(), Audit.OP.DELETE, operator);
225:     Namespace deleted = namespaceRepository.save(namespace);
226:     messageSender.sendMessage(ReleaseMessageKeyGenerator.generate(appId, clusterName, namespaceName),
227:         Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC);
228:     return deleted;
229:   }

265:   public Map<String, Boolean> namespacePublishInfo(String appId) {
266:     List<Cluster> clusters = clusterService.findParentClusters(appId);
267:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(clusters)) {
268:       throw new BadRequestException("app not exist");
269:     }
270:     Map<String, Boolean> clusterHasNotPublishedItems = Maps.newHashMap();
271:     for (Cluster cluster : clusters) {
272:       String clusterName = cluster.getName();
273:       List<Namespace> namespaces = findNamespaces(appId, clusterName);
274:       for (Namespace namespace : namespaces) {
275:         boolean isNamespaceNotPublished = isNamespaceNotPublished(namespace);
276:         if (isNamespaceNotPublished) {
277:           clusterHasNotPublishedItems.put(clusterName, true);
278:           break;
279:         }
280:       }
281:       clusterHasNotPublishedItems.putIfAbsent(clusterName, false);
282:     }
283:     return clusterHasNotPublishedItems;
284:   }
285:   private boolean isNamespaceNotPublished(Namespace namespace) {
286:     Release latestRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(namespace);
287:     long namespaceId = namespace.getId();
288:     if (latestRelease == null) {
289:       Item lastItem = itemService.findLastOne(namespaceId);
290:       return lastItem != null;
291:     }
292:     Date lastPublishTime = latestRelease.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime();
293:     List<Item> itemsModifiedAfterLastPublish = itemService.findItemsModifiedAfterDate(namespaceId, lastPublishTime);
294:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(itemsModifiedAfterLastPublish)) {
295:       return false;
296:     }
297:     Map<String, String> publishedConfiguration = GSON.fromJson(latestRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
298:     for (Item item : itemsModifiedAfterLastPublish) {
299:       if (!Objects.equals(item.getValue(), publishedConfiguration.get(item.getKey()))) {
300:         return true;
301:       }
302:     }
303:     return false;
304:   }

 7: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 8: import java.util.Collection;
 9: import java.util.Collections;
10: import java.util.List;
11: @Service
12: public class ReleaseMessageService {
13:   private final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository;
14:   public ReleaseMessageService(final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository) {
15:     this.releaseMessageRepository = releaseMessageRepository;
16:   }
17:   public ReleaseMessage findLatestReleaseMessageForMessages(Collection<String> messages) {
18:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(messages)) {
19:       return null;
20:     }
21:     return releaseMessageRepository.findTopByMessageInOrderByIdDesc(messages);
22:   }
23:   public List<ReleaseMessage> findLatestReleaseMessagesGroupByMessages(Collection<String> messages) {
24:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(messages)) {
25:       return Collections.emptyList();
26:     }
27:     List<Object[]> result =
28:         releaseMessageRepository.findLatestReleaseMessagesGroupByMessages(messages);
29:     List<ReleaseMessage> releaseMessages = Lists.newArrayList();
30:     for (Object[] o : result) {
31:       try {
32:         ReleaseMessage releaseMessage = new ReleaseMessage((String) o[0]);
33:         releaseMessage.setId((Long) o[1]);
34:         releaseMessages.add(releaseMessage);
35:       } catch (Exception ex) {
36:         Tracer.logError("Parsing LatestReleaseMessagesGroupByMessages failed", ex);
37:       }
38:     }
39:     return releaseMessages;
40:   }
41: }

128:   @Transactional
129:   public Release mergeBranchChangeSetsAndRelease(Namespace namespace, String branchName, String releaseName,
130:                                                  String releaseComment, boolean isEmergencyPublish,
131:                                                  ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
132:     checkLock(namespace, isEmergencyPublish, changeSets.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
133:     itemSetService.updateSet(namespace, changeSets);
134:     Release branchRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(namespace.getAppId(), branchName, namespace
135:         .getNamespaceName());
136:     long branchReleaseId = branchRelease == null ? 0 : branchRelease.getId();
137:     Map<String, String> operateNamespaceItems = getNamespaceItems(namespace);
138:     Map<String, Object> operationContext = Maps.newLinkedHashMap();
139:     operationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.SOURCE_BRANCH, branchName);
140:     operationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.BASE_RELEASE_ID, branchReleaseId);
141:     operationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.IS_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH, isEmergencyPublish);
142:     return masterRelease(namespace, releaseName, releaseComment, operateNamespaceItems,
143:                          changeSets.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy(),
144:                          ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE_MERGE_TO_MASTER, operationContext);
145:   }
146:   @Transactional
147:   public Release publish(Namespace namespace, String releaseName, String releaseComment,
148:                          String operator, boolean isEmergencyPublish) {
149:     checkLock(namespace, isEmergencyPublish, operator);
150:     Map<String, String> operateNamespaceItems = getNamespaceItems(namespace);
151:     Namespace parentNamespace = namespaceService.findParentNamespace(namespace);
152:     if (parentNamespace != null) {
153:       return publishBranchNamespace(parentNamespace, namespace, operateNamespaceItems,
154:                                     releaseName, releaseComment, operator, isEmergencyPublish);
155:     }
156:     Namespace childNamespace = namespaceService.findChildNamespace(namespace);
157:     Release previousRelease = null;
158:     if (childNamespace != null) {
159:       previousRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(namespace);
160:     }
161:     Map<String, Object> operationContext = Maps.newLinkedHashMap();
162:     operationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.IS_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH, isEmergencyPublish);
163:     Release release = masterRelease(namespace, releaseName, releaseComment, operateNamespaceItems,
164:                                     operator, ReleaseOperation.NORMAL_RELEASE, operationContext);
165:     if (childNamespace != null) {
166:       mergeFromMasterAndPublishBranch(namespace, childNamespace, operateNamespaceItems,
167:                                       releaseName, releaseComment, operator, previousRelease,
168:                                       release, isEmergencyPublish);
169:     }
170:     return release;
171:   }
172:   private Release publishBranchNamespace(Namespace parentNamespace, Namespace childNamespace,
173:                                          Map<String, String> childNamespaceItems,
174:                                          String releaseName, String releaseComment,
175:                                          String operator, boolean isEmergencyPublish, Set<String> grayDelKeys) {
176:     Release parentLatestRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(parentNamespace);
177:     Map<String, String> parentConfigurations = parentLatestRelease != null ?
178:             GSON.fromJson(parentLatestRelease.getConfigurations(),
179:                           GsonType.CONFIG) : new LinkedHashMap<>();
180:     long baseReleaseId = parentLatestRelease == null ? 0 : parentLatestRelease.getId();
181:     Map<String, String> configsToPublish = mergeConfiguration(parentConfigurations, childNamespaceItems);
182:     if(!(grayDelKeys == null || grayDelKeys.size()==0)){
183:       for (String key : grayDelKeys){
184:         configsToPublish.remove(key);
185:       }
186:     }
187:     return branchRelease(parentNamespace, childNamespace, releaseName, releaseComment,
188:         configsToPublish, baseReleaseId, operator, ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE, isEmergencyPublish,
189:         childNamespaceItems.keySet());
190:   }
191:   @Transactional
192:   public Release grayDeletionPublish(Namespace namespace, String releaseName, String releaseComment,
193:                                      String operator, boolean isEmergencyPublish, Set<String> grayDelKeys) {
194:     checkLock(namespace, isEmergencyPublish, operator);
195:     Map<String, String> operateNamespaceItems = getNamespaceItems(namespace);
196:     Namespace parentNamespace = namespaceService.findParentNamespace(namespace);
197:     if (parentNamespace != null) {
198:       return publishBranchNamespace(parentNamespace, namespace, operateNamespaceItems,
199:               releaseName, releaseComment, operator, isEmergencyPublish, grayDelKeys);
200:     }
201:     throw new NotFoundException("Parent namespace not found");
202:   }
203:   private void checkLock(Namespace namespace, boolean isEmergencyPublish, String operator) {
204:     if (!isEmergencyPublish) {
205:       NamespaceLock lock = namespaceLockService.findLock(namespace.getId());
206:       if (lock != null && lock.getDataChangeCreatedBy().equals(operator)) {
207:         throw new BadRequestException("Config can not be published by yourself.");
208:       }
209:     }
210:   }
211:   private void mergeFromMasterAndPublishBranch(Namespace parentNamespace, Namespace childNamespace,
212:                                                Map<String, String> parentNamespaceItems,
213:                                                String releaseName, String releaseComment,
214:                                                String operator, Release masterPreviousRelease,
215:                                                Release parentRelease, boolean isEmergencyPublish) {
216:     Release childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(childNamespace);
217:     Map<String, String> childReleaseConfiguration;
218:     Collection<String> branchReleaseKeys;
219:     if (childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease != null) {
220:       childReleaseConfiguration = GSON.fromJson(childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
221:       branchReleaseKeys = getBranchReleaseKeys(childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease.getId());
222:     } else {
223:       childReleaseConfiguration = Collections.emptyMap();
224:       branchReleaseKeys = null;
225:     }
226:     Map<String, String> parentNamespaceOldConfiguration = masterPreviousRelease == null ?
227:                                                           null : GSON.fromJson(masterPreviousRelease.getConfigurations(),
228:                                                                                GsonType.CONFIG);
229:     Map<String, String> childNamespaceToPublishConfigs =
230:         calculateChildNamespaceToPublishConfiguration(parentNamespaceOldConfiguration, parentNamespaceItems,
231:             childReleaseConfiguration, branchReleaseKeys);
232:     if (!childNamespaceToPublishConfigs.equals(childReleaseConfiguration)) {
233:       branchRelease(parentNamespace, childNamespace, releaseName, releaseComment,
234:                     childNamespaceToPublishConfigs, parentRelease.getId(), operator,
235:                     ReleaseOperation.MASTER_NORMAL_RELEASE_MERGE_TO_GRAY, isEmergencyPublish, branchReleaseKeys);
236:     }
237:   }
238:   private Collection<String> getBranchReleaseKeys(long releaseId) {
239:     Page<ReleaseHistory> releaseHistories = releaseHistoryService
240:         .findByReleaseIdAndOperationInOrderByIdDesc(releaseId, BRANCH_RELEASE_OPERATIONS, FIRST_ITEM);
241:     if (!releaseHistories.hasContent()) {
242:       return null;
243:     }
244:     Map<String, Object> operationContext = GSON
245:         .fromJson(releaseHistories.getContent().get(0).getOperationContext(), OPERATION_CONTEXT_TYPE_REFERENCE);
246:     if (operationContext == null || !operationContext.containsKey(ReleaseOperationContext.BRANCH_RELEASE_KEYS)) {
247:       return null;
248:     }
249:     return (Collection<String>) operationContext.get(ReleaseOperationContext.BRANCH_RELEASE_KEYS);
250:   }
251:   private Release publishBranchNamespace(Namespace parentNamespace, Namespace childNamespace,
252:                                          Map<String, String> childNamespaceItems,
253:                                          String releaseName, String releaseComment,
254:                                          String operator, boolean isEmergencyPublish) {
255:     return publishBranchNamespace(parentNamespace, childNamespace, childNamespaceItems, releaseName, releaseComment,
256:             operator, isEmergencyPublish, null);
257:   }
258:   private Release masterRelease(Namespace namespace, String releaseName, String releaseComment,
259:                                 Map<String, String> configurations, String operator,
260:                                 int releaseOperation, Map<String, Object> operationContext) {
261:     Release lastActiveRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(namespace);
262:     long previousReleaseId = lastActiveRelease == null ? 0 : lastActiveRelease.getId();
263:     Release release = createRelease(namespace, releaseName, releaseComment,
264:                                     configurations, operator);
265:     releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(namespace.getAppId(), namespace.getClusterName(),
266:                                                namespace.getNamespaceName(), namespace.getClusterName(),
267:                                                release.getId(), previousReleaseId, releaseOperation,
268:                                                operationContext, operator);
269:     return release;
270:   }
271:   private Release branchRelease(Namespace parentNamespace, Namespace childNamespace,
272:                                 String releaseName, String releaseComment,
273:                                 Map<String, String> configurations, long baseReleaseId,
274:                                 String operator, int releaseOperation, boolean isEmergencyPublish, Collection<String> branchReleaseKeys) {
275:     Release previousRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(childNamespace.getAppId(),
276:                                                       childNamespace.getClusterName(),
277:                                                       childNamespace.getNamespaceName());
278:     long previousReleaseId = previousRelease == null ? 0 : previousRelease.getId();
279:     Map<String, Object> releaseOperationContext = Maps.newLinkedHashMap();
280:     releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.BASE_RELEASE_ID, baseReleaseId);
281:     releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.IS_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH, isEmergencyPublish);
282:     releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.BRANCH_RELEASE_KEYS, branchReleaseKeys);
283:     Release release =
284:         createRelease(childNamespace, releaseName, releaseComment, configurations, operator);
285:     GrayReleaseRule grayReleaseRule = namespaceBranchService.updateRulesReleaseId(childNamespace.getAppId(),
286:                                                                                   parentNamespace.getClusterName(),
287:                                                                                   childNamespace.getNamespaceName(),
288:                                                                                   childNamespace.getClusterName(),
289:                                                                                   release.getId(), operator);
290:     if (grayReleaseRule != null) {
291:       releaseOperationContext.put(ReleaseOperationContext.RULES, GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer
292:           .batchTransformFromJSON(grayReleaseRule.getRules()));
293:     }
294:     releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(parentNamespace.getAppId(), parentNamespace.getClusterName(),
295:                                                parentNamespace.getNamespaceName(), childNamespace.getClusterName(),
296:                                                release.getId(),
297:                                                previousReleaseId, releaseOperation, releaseOperationContext, operator);
298:     return release;
299:   }
300:   private Map<String, String> mergeConfiguration(Map<String, String> baseConfigurations,
301:                                                  Map<String, String> coverConfigurations) {
302:     Map<String, String> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
303:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : baseConfigurations.entrySet()) {
304:       result.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
305:     }
306:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : coverConfigurations.entrySet()) {
307:       result.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
308:     }
309:     return result;
310:   }
311:   private Map<String, String> getNamespaceItems(Namespace namespace) {
312:     List<Item> items = itemService.findItemsWithOrdered(namespace.getId());
313:     Map<String, String> configurations = new LinkedHashMap<>();
314:     for (Item item : items) {
315:       if (StringUtils.isEmpty(item.getKey())) {
316:         continue;
317:       }
318:       configurations.put(item.getKey(), item.getValue());
319:     }
320:     return configurations;
321:   }
322:   private Release createRelease(Namespace namespace, String name, String comment,
323:                                 Map<String, String> configurations, String operator) {
324:     Release release = new Release();
325:     release.setReleaseKey(ReleaseKeyGenerator.generateReleaseKey(namespace));
326:     release.setDataChangeCreatedTime(new Date());
327:     release.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
328:     release.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
329:     release.setName(name);
330:     release.setComment(comment);
331:     release.setAppId(namespace.getAppId());
332:     release.setClusterName(namespace.getClusterName());
333:     release.setNamespaceName(namespace.getNamespaceName());
334:     release.setConfigurations(GSON.toJson(configurations));
335:     release = releaseRepository.save(release);
336:     namespaceLockService.unlock(namespace.getId());
337:     auditService.audit(Release.class.getSimpleName(), release.getId(), Audit.OP.INSERT,
338:                        release.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
339:     return release;
340:   }
341:   @Transactional
342:   public Release rollback(long releaseId, String operator) {
343:     Release release = findOne(releaseId);
344:     if (release == null) {
345:       throw new NotFoundException("release not found");
346:     }
347:     if (release.isAbandoned()) {
348:       throw new BadRequestException("release is not active");
349:     }
350:     String appId = release.getAppId();
351:     String clusterName = release.getClusterName();
352:     String namespaceName = release.getNamespaceName();
353:     PageRequest page = PageRequest.of(0, 2);
354:     List<Release> twoLatestActiveReleases = findActiveReleases(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, page);
355:     if (twoLatestActiveReleases == null || twoLatestActiveReleases.size() < 2) {
356:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format(
357:           "Can't rollback namespace(appId=%s, clusterName=%s, namespaceName=%s) because there is only one active release",
358:           appId,
359:           clusterName,
360:           namespaceName));
361:     }
362:     release.setAbandoned(true);
363:     release.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
364:     releaseRepository.save(release);
365:     releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(appId, clusterName,
366:                                                namespaceName, clusterName, twoLatestActiveReleases.get(1).getId(),
367:                                                release.getId(), ReleaseOperation.ROLLBACK, null, operator);
368:     rollbackChildNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, twoLatestActiveReleases, operator);
369:     return release;
370:   }
371:   @Transactional
372:   public Release rollbackTo(long releaseId, long toReleaseId, String operator) {
373:     if (releaseId == toReleaseId) {
374:       throw new BadRequestException("current release equal to target release");
375:     }
376:     Release release = findOne(releaseId);
377:     Release toRelease = findOne(toReleaseId);
378:     if (release == null || toRelease == null) {
379:       throw new NotFoundException("release not found");
380:     }
381:     if (release.isAbandoned() || toRelease.isAbandoned()) {
382:       throw new BadRequestException("release is not active");
383:     }
384:     String appId = release.getAppId();
385:     String clusterName = release.getClusterName();
386:     String namespaceName = release.getNamespaceName();
387:     List<Release> releases = findActiveReleasesBetween(appId, clusterName, namespaceName,
388:                                                        toReleaseId, releaseId);
389:     for (int i = 0; i < releases.size() - 1; i++) {
390:       releases.get(i).setAbandoned(true);
391:       releases.get(i).setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
392:     }
393:     releaseRepository.saveAll(releases);
394:     releaseHistoryService.createReleaseHistory(appId, clusterName,
395:                                                namespaceName, clusterName, toReleaseId,
396:                                                release.getId(), ReleaseOperation.ROLLBACK, null, operator);
397:     rollbackChildNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, Lists.newArrayList(release, toRelease), operator);
398:     return release;
399:   }
400:   private void rollbackChildNamespace(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
401:                                       List<Release> parentNamespaceTwoLatestActiveRelease, String operator) {
402:     Namespace parentNamespace = namespaceService.findOne(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
403:     Namespace childNamespace = namespaceService.findChildNamespace(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
404:     if (parentNamespace == null || childNamespace == null) {
405:       return;
406:     }
407:     Release childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease = findLatestActiveRelease(childNamespace);
408:     Map<String, String> childReleaseConfiguration;
409:     Collection<String> branchReleaseKeys;
410:     if (childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease != null) {
411:       childReleaseConfiguration = GSON.fromJson(childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
412:       branchReleaseKeys = getBranchReleaseKeys(childNamespaceLatestActiveRelease.getId());
413:     } else {
414:       childReleaseConfiguration = Collections.emptyMap();
415:       branchReleaseKeys = null;
416:     }
417:     Release abandonedRelease = parentNamespaceTwoLatestActiveRelease.get(0);
418:     Release parentNamespaceNewLatestRelease = parentNamespaceTwoLatestActiveRelease.get(1);
419:     Map<String, String> parentNamespaceAbandonedConfiguration = GSON.fromJson(abandonedRelease.getConfigurations(),
420:                                                                               GsonType.CONFIG);
421:     Map<String, String>
422:         parentNamespaceNewLatestConfiguration =
423:         GSON.fromJson(parentNamespaceNewLatestRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
424:     Map<String, String>
425:         childNamespaceNewConfiguration =
426:         calculateChildNamespaceToPublishConfiguration(parentNamespaceAbandonedConfiguration,
427:             parentNamespaceNewLatestConfiguration, childReleaseConfiguration, branchReleaseKeys);
428:     if (!childNamespaceNewConfiguration.equals(childReleaseConfiguration)) {
429:       branchRelease(parentNamespace, childNamespace,
430:           TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.format(new Date()) + "-master-rollback-merge-to-gray", "",
431:           childNamespaceNewConfiguration, parentNamespaceNewLatestRelease.getId(), operator,
432:           ReleaseOperation.MATER_ROLLBACK_MERGE_TO_GRAY, false, branchReleaseKeys);
433:     }
434:   }
435:   private Map<String, String> calculateChildNamespaceToPublishConfiguration(
436:       Map<String, String> parentNamespaceOldConfiguration, Map<String, String> parentNamespaceNewConfiguration,
437:       Map<String, String> childNamespaceLatestActiveConfiguration, Collection<String> branchReleaseKeys) {
438:     Map<String, String> childNamespaceModifiedConfiguration = calculateBranchModifiedItemsAccordingToRelease(
439:         parentNamespaceOldConfiguration, childNamespaceLatestActiveConfiguration, branchReleaseKeys);
440:     return mergeConfiguration(parentNamespaceNewConfiguration, childNamespaceModifiedConfiguration);
441:   }
442:   private Map<String, String> calculateBranchModifiedItemsAccordingToRelease(
443:       Map<String, String> masterReleaseConfigs, Map<String, String> branchReleaseConfigs,
444:       Collection<String> branchReleaseKeys) {
445:     Map<String, String> modifiedConfigs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
446:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(branchReleaseConfigs)) {
447:       return modifiedConfigs;
448:     }
449:     if (branchReleaseKeys != null) {
450:       for (String branchReleaseKey : branchReleaseKeys) {
451:         if (branchReleaseConfigs.containsKey(branchReleaseKey)) {
452:           modifiedConfigs.put(branchReleaseKey, branchReleaseConfigs.get(branchReleaseKey));
453:         }
454:       }
455:       return modifiedConfigs;
456:     }
457:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(masterReleaseConfigs)) {
458:       return branchReleaseConfigs;
459:     }
460:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : branchReleaseConfigs.entrySet()) {
461:       if (!Objects.equals(entry.getValue(), masterReleaseConfigs.get(entry.getKey()))) {
462:         modifiedConfigs.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
463:       }
464:     }
465:     return modifiedConfigs;
466:   }
467:   @Transactional
468:   public int batchDelete(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName, String operator) {
469:     return releaseRepository.batchDelete(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, operator);
470:   }
471: }

File: apollo-biz/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/biz/utils/ConfigChangeContentBuilder.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.utils;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Item;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 4: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 5: import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
 6: import java.util.Date;
 7: import java.util.LinkedList;
 8: import java.util.List;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils;
10: public class ConfigChangeContentBuilder {
11:   private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss").create();
12:   private List<Item> createItems = new LinkedList<>();
13:   private List<ItemPair> updateItems = new LinkedList<>();
14:   private List<Item> deleteItems = new LinkedList<>();
15:   public ConfigChangeContentBuilder createItem(Item item) {
16:     if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(item.getKey())){
17:       createItems.add(cloneItem(item));
18:     }
19:     return this;
20:   }
21:   public ConfigChangeContentBuilder updateItem(Item oldItem, Item newItem) {
22:     if (!oldItem.getValue().equals(newItem.getValue())){
23:       ItemPair itemPair = new ItemPair(cloneItem(oldItem), cloneItem(newItem));
24:       updateItems.add(itemPair);
25:     }
26:     return this;
27:   }
28:   public ConfigChangeContentBuilder deleteItem(Item item) {
29:     if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(item.getKey())) {
30:       deleteItems.add(cloneItem(item));
31:     }
32:     return this;
33:   }
34:   public boolean hasContent(){
35:     return !createItems.isEmpty() || !updateItems.isEmpty() || !deleteItems.isEmpty();
36:   }
37:   public String build() {
38:     Date now = new Date();
39:     for (Item item : createItems) {
40:       item.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(now);
41:     }
42:     for (ItemPair item : updateItems) {
43:       item.newItem.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(now);
44:     }
45:     for (Item item : deleteItems) {
46:       item.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(now);
47:     }
48:     return GSON.toJson(this);
49:   }
50:   static class ItemPair {
51:     Item oldItem;
52:     Item newItem;
53:     public ItemPair(Item oldItem, Item newItem) {
54:       this.oldItem = oldItem;
55:       this.newItem = newItem;
56:     }
57:   }
58:   Item cloneItem(Item source) {
59:     Item target = new Item();
60:     BeanUtils.copyProperties(source, target);
61:     return target;
62:   }
63:   public static ConfigChangeContentBuilder convertJsonString(String content) {
64:     return GSON.fromJson(content, ConfigChangeContentBuilder.class);
65:   }
66:   public List<Item> getCreateItems() {
67:     return createItems;
68:   }
69:   public List<ItemPair> getUpdateItems() {
70:     return updateItems;
71:   }
72:   public List<Item> getDeleteItems() {
73:     return deleteItems;
74:   }
75: }

 9: @Component

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/build/ApolloInjector.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.exceptions.ApolloConfigException;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.Injector;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.ServiceBootstrap;
 6: public class ApolloInjector {
 7:   private static volatile Injector s_injector;
 8:   private static final Object lock = new Object();
 9:   private static Injector getInjector() {
10:     if (s_injector == null) {
11:       synchronized (lock) {
12:         if (s_injector == null) {
13:           try {
14:             s_injector = ServiceBootstrap.loadFirst(Injector.class);
15:           } catch (Throwable ex) {
16:             ApolloConfigException exception = new ApolloConfigException("Unable to initialize Apollo Injector!", ex);
17:             Tracer.logError(exception);
18:             throw exception;
19:           }
20:         }
21:       }
22:     }
23:     return s_injector;
24:   }
25:   public static <T> T getInstance(Class<T> clazz) {
26:     try {
27:       return getInjector().getInstance(clazz);
28:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
29:       Tracer.logError(ex);
30:       throw new ApolloConfigException(String.format("Unable to load instance for type %s!", clazz.getName()), ex);
31:     }
32:   }
33:   public static <T> T getInstance(Class<T> clazz, String name) {
34:     try {
35:       return getInjector().getInstance(clazz, name);
36:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
37:       Tracer.logError(ex);
38:       throw new ApolloConfigException(
39:           String.format("Unable to load instance for type %s and name %s !", clazz.getName(), name), ex);
40:     }
41:   }
42: }

 73:   @Override

 75:     if (!m_listeners.contains(listener)) {
 76:       m_listeners.add(listener);
 77:       if (interestedKeys != null && !interestedKeys.isEmpty()) {
 78:         m_interestedKeys.put(listener, Sets.newHashSet(interestedKeys));
 79:       }
 80:       if (interestedKeyPrefixes != null && !interestedKeyPrefixes.isEmpty()) {
 81:         m_interestedKeyPrefixes.put(listener, Sets.newHashSet(interestedKeyPrefixes));
 82:       }
 83:     }
 84:   }

326:       if (value != null) {
327:         return function.apply(value);
328:       }
329:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
330:       Tracer.logError(new ApolloConfigException(
331:               String.format("getProperty for %s failed, return default value %s", key,
332:                       defaultValue), ex));
333:     }
334:     return defaultValue;
335:   }
336:   private <T> T getValueFromCache(String key, Function<String, T> parser, Cache<String, T> cache, T defaultValue) {
337:     T result = cache.getIfPresent(key);
338:     if (result != null) {
339:       return result;
340:     }
341:     return getValueAndStoreToCache(key, parser, cache, defaultValue);
342:   }
343:   private <T> T getValueAndStoreToCache(String key, Function<String, T> parser, Cache<String, T> cache, T defaultValue) {
344:     long currentConfigVersion = m_configVersion.get();
345:     String value = getProperty(key, null);
346:     if (value != null) {
347:       T result = parser.apply(value);
348:       if (result != null) {
349:         synchronized (this) {
350:           if (m_configVersion.get() == currentConfigVersion) {
351:             cache.put(key, result);
352:           }
353:         }
354:         return result;
355:       }
356:     }
357:     return defaultValue;
358:   }
359:   private <T> Cache<String, T> newCache() {
360:     Cache<String, T> cache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder()
361:         .maximumSize(m_configUtil.getMaxConfigCacheSize())
362:         .expireAfterAccess(m_configUtil.getConfigCacheExpireTime(), m_configUtil.getConfigCacheExpireTimeUnit())
363:         .build();
364:     allCaches.add(cache);
365:     return cache;
366:   }
367:   protected void clearConfigCache() {
368:     synchronized (this) {
369:       for (Cache c : allCaches) {
370:         if (c != null) {
371:           c.invalidateAll();
372:         }
373:       }
374:       m_configVersion.incrementAndGet();
375:     }
376:   }
377:   protected void fireConfigChange(final ConfigChangeEvent changeEvent) {
378:     for (final ConfigChangeListener listener : m_listeners) {
379:       if (!isConfigChangeListenerInterested(listener, changeEvent)) {
380:         continue;
381:       }
382:       m_executorService.submit(new Runnable() {
383:         @Override
384:         public void run() {
385:           String listenerName = listener.getClass().getName();
386:           Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigChangeListener", listenerName);
387:           try {
388:             listener.onChange(changeEvent);
389:             transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
390:           } catch (Throwable ex) {
391:             transaction.setStatus(ex);
392:             Tracer.logError(ex);
393:             logger.error("Failed to invoke config change listener {}", listenerName, ex);
394:           } finally {
395:             transaction.complete();
396:           }
397:         }
398:       });
399:     }
400:   }
401:   private boolean isConfigChangeListenerInterested(ConfigChangeListener configChangeListener, ConfigChangeEvent configChangeEvent) {
402:     Set<String> interestedKeys = m_interestedKeys.get(configChangeListener);
403:     Set<String> interestedKeyPrefixes = m_interestedKeyPrefixes.get(configChangeListener);
404:     if ((interestedKeys == null || interestedKeys.isEmpty())
405:         && (interestedKeyPrefixes == null || interestedKeyPrefixes.isEmpty())) {
406:       return true;
407:     }
408:     if (interestedKeys != null) {
409:       for (String interestedKey : interestedKeys) {
410:         if (configChangeEvent.isChanged(interestedKey)) {
411:           return true;
412:         }
413:       }
414:     }
415:     if (interestedKeyPrefixes != null) {
416:       for (String prefix : interestedKeyPrefixes) {
417:         for (final String changedKey : configChangeEvent.changedKeys()) {
418:           if (changedKey.startsWith(prefix)) {
419:             return true;
420:           }
421:         }
422:       }
423:     }
424:     return false;
425:   }
426:   List<ConfigChange> calcPropertyChanges(String namespace, Properties previous,
427:                                          Properties current) {
428:     if (previous == null) {
429:       previous = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
430:     }
431:     if (current == null) {
432:       current =  propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
433:     }
434:     Set<String> previousKeys = previous.stringPropertyNames();
435:     Set<String> currentKeys = current.stringPropertyNames();
436:     Set<String> commonKeys = Sets.intersection(previousKeys, currentKeys);
437:     Set<String> newKeys = Sets.difference(currentKeys, commonKeys);
438:     Set<String> removedKeys = Sets.difference(previousKeys, commonKeys);
439:     List<ConfigChange> changes = Lists.newArrayList();
440:     for (String newKey : newKeys) {
441:       changes.add(new ConfigChange(namespace, newKey, null, current.getProperty(newKey),
442:           PropertyChangeType.ADDED));
443:     }
444:     for (String removedKey : removedKeys) {
445:       changes.add(new ConfigChange(namespace, removedKey, previous.getProperty(removedKey), null,
446:           PropertyChangeType.DELETED));
447:     }
448:     for (String commonKey : commonKeys) {
449:       String previousValue = previous.getProperty(commonKey);
450:       String currentValue = current.getProperty(commonKey);
451:       if (Objects.equal(previousValue, currentValue)) {
452:         continue;
453:       }
454:       changes.add(new ConfigChange(namespace, commonKey, previousValue, currentValue,
455:           PropertyChangeType.MODIFIED));
456:     }
457:     return changes;
458:   }
459: }

 30: public class ConfigServiceLocator {
 31:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigServiceLocator.class);
 32:   private HttpClient m_httpClient;
 33:   private ConfigUtil m_configUtil;
 34:   private AtomicReference<List<ServiceDTO>> m_configServices;
 35:   private Type m_responseType;
 36:   private ScheduledExecutorService m_executorService;
 37:   private static final Joiner.MapJoiner MAP_JOINER = Joiner.on("&").withKeyValueSeparator("=");
 38:   private static final Escaper queryParamEscaper = UrlEscapers.urlFormParameterEscaper();
 39:   public ConfigServiceLocator() {
 40:     List<ServiceDTO> initial = Lists.newArrayList();
 41:     m_configServices = new AtomicReference<>(initial);
 42:     m_responseType = new TypeToken<List<ServiceDTO>>() {
 43:     }.getType();
 44:     m_httpClient = ApolloInjector.getInstance(HttpClient.class);
 45:     m_configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 46:     this.m_executorService = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1,
 47:         ApolloThreadFactory.create("ConfigServiceLocator", true));
 48:     initConfigServices();
 49:   }
 50:   private void initConfigServices() {
 51:     List<ServiceDTO> customizedConfigServices = getCustomizedConfigService();
 52:     if (customizedConfigServices != null) {
 53:       setConfigServices(customizedConfigServices);
 54:       return;
 55:     }
 56:     this.tryUpdateConfigServices();
 57:     this.schedulePeriodicRefresh();
 58:   }
 59:   private List<ServiceDTO> getCustomizedConfigService() {
 60:     String configServices = System.getProperty("apollo.configService");
 61:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(configServices)) {
 62:       configServices = System.getenv("APOLLO_CONFIGSERVICE");
 63:     }
 64:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(configServices)) {
 65:       configServices = Foundation.server().getProperty("apollo.configService", null);
 66:     }
 67:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(configServices)) {
 68:       return null;
 69:     }
 70:     logger.warn("Located config services from apollo.configService configuration: {}, will not refresh config services from remote meta service!", configServices);
 71:     String[] configServiceUrls = configServices.split(",");
 72:     List<ServiceDTO> serviceDTOS = Lists.newArrayList();
 73:     for (String configServiceUrl : configServiceUrls) {
 74:       configServiceUrl = configServiceUrl.trim();
 75:       ServiceDTO serviceDTO = new ServiceDTO();
 76:       serviceDTO.setHomepageUrl(configServiceUrl);
 77:       serviceDTO.setAppName(ServiceNameConsts.APOLLO_CONFIGSERVICE);
 78:       serviceDTO.setInstanceId(configServiceUrl);
 79:       serviceDTOS.add(serviceDTO);
 80:     }
 81:     return serviceDTOS;
 82:   }
 83:   public List<ServiceDTO> getConfigServices() {
 84:     if (m_configServices.get().isEmpty()) {
 85:       updateConfigServices();
 86:     }
 87:     return m_configServices.get();
 88:   }
 89:   private boolean tryUpdateConfigServices() {
 90:     try {
 91:       updateConfigServices();
 92:       return true;
 93:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 94:     }
 95:     return false;
 96:   }
 97:   private void schedulePeriodicRefresh() {
 98:     this.m_executorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(
 99:         new Runnable() {
100:           @Override
101:           public void run() {
102:             logger.debug("refresh config services");
103:             Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.MetaService", "periodicRefresh");
104:             tryUpdateConfigServices();
105:           }
106:         }, m_configUtil.getRefreshInterval(), m_configUtil.getRefreshInterval(),
107:         m_configUtil.getRefreshIntervalTimeUnit());
108:   }
109:   private synchronized void updateConfigServices() {
110:     String url = assembleMetaServiceUrl();
111:     HttpRequest request = new HttpRequest(url);
112:     int maxRetries = 2;
113:     Throwable exception = null;
114:     for (int i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {
115:       Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.MetaService", "getConfigService");
116:       transaction.addData("Url", url);
117:       try {
118:         HttpResponse<List<ServiceDTO>> response = m_httpClient.doGet(request, m_responseType);
119:         transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
120:         List<ServiceDTO> services = response.getBody();
121:         if (services == null || services.isEmpty()) {
122:           logConfigService("Empty response!");
123:           continue;
124:         }
125:         setConfigServices(services);
126:         return;
127:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
128:         Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
129:         transaction.setStatus(ex);
130:         exception = ex;
131:       } finally {
132:         transaction.complete();
133:       }
134:       try {
135:         m_configUtil.getOnErrorRetryIntervalTimeUnit().sleep(m_configUtil.getOnErrorRetryInterval());
136:       } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
137:       }
138:     }
139:     throw new ApolloConfigException(
140:         String.format("Get config services failed from %s", url), exception);
141:   }
142:   private void setConfigServices(List<ServiceDTO> services) {
143:     m_configServices.set(services);
144:     logConfigServices(services);
145:   }
146:   private String assembleMetaServiceUrl() {
147:     String domainName = m_configUtil.getMetaServerDomainName();
148:     String appId = m_configUtil.getAppId();
149:     String localIp = m_configUtil.getLocalIp();
150:     Map<String, String> queryParams = Maps.newHashMap();
151:     queryParams.put("appId", queryParamEscaper.escape(appId));
152:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(localIp)) {
153:       queryParams.put("ip", queryParamEscaper.escape(localIp));
154:     }
155:     return domainName + "/services/config?" + MAP_JOINER.join(queryParams);
156:   }
157:   private void logConfigServices(List<ServiceDTO> serviceDtos) {
158:     for (ServiceDTO serviceDto : serviceDtos) {
159:       logConfigService(serviceDto.getHomepageUrl());
160:     }
161:   }
162:   private void logConfigService(String serviceUrl) {
163:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Config.Services", serviceUrl);
164:   }
165: }

 75:   @Override

 79:   private Set<String> stringPropertyNames(Properties properties) {
 80:     Map<String, String> h = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 81:     for (Map.Entry<Object, Object> e : properties.entrySet()) {
 82:       Object k = e.getKey();
 83:       Object v = e.getValue();
 84:       if (k instanceof String && v instanceof String) {
 85:         h.put((String) k, (String) v);
 86:       }
 87:     }
 88:     return h.keySet();
 89:   }
 90:   @Override
 91:   public synchronized void onRepositoryChange(String namespace, Properties newProperties) {
 92:     if (newProperties.equals(m_configProperties.get())) {
 93:       return;
 94:     }
 95:     ConfigSourceType sourceType = m_configRepository.getSourceType();
 96:     Properties newConfigProperties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
 97:     newConfigProperties.putAll(newProperties);
 98:     Map<String, ConfigChange> actualChanges = updateAndCalcConfigChanges(newConfigProperties, sourceType);
 99:     if (actualChanges.isEmpty()) {
100:       return;
101:     }
102:     this.fireConfigChange(new ConfigChangeEvent(m_namespace, actualChanges));
103:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Client.ConfigChanges", m_namespace);
104:   }
105:   private void updateConfig(Properties newConfigProperties, ConfigSourceType sourceType) {
106:     m_configProperties.set(newConfigProperties);
107:     m_sourceType = sourceType;
108:   }
109:   private Map<String, ConfigChange> updateAndCalcConfigChanges(Properties newConfigProperties,
110:       ConfigSourceType sourceType) {
111:     List<ConfigChange> configChanges =
112:         calcPropertyChanges(m_namespace, m_configProperties.get(), newConfigProperties);
113:     ImmutableMap.Builder<String, ConfigChange> actualChanges =
114:         new ImmutableMap.Builder<>();
115:     for (ConfigChange change : configChanges) {
116:       change.setOldValue(this.getProperty(change.getPropertyName(), change.getOldValue()));
117:     }
118:     updateConfig(newConfigProperties, sourceType);
119:     clearConfigCache();
120:     for (ConfigChange change : configChanges) {
121:       change.setNewValue(this.getProperty(change.getPropertyName(), change.getNewValue()));
122:       switch (change.getChangeType()) {
123:         case ADDED:
124:           if (Objects.equals(change.getOldValue(), change.getNewValue())) {
125:             break;
126:           }
127:           if (change.getOldValue() != null) {
128:             change.setChangeType(PropertyChangeType.MODIFIED);
129:           }
130:           actualChanges.put(change.getPropertyName(), change);
131:           break;
132:         case MODIFIED:
133:           if (!Objects.equals(change.getOldValue(), change.getNewValue())) {
134:             actualChanges.put(change.getPropertyName(), change);
135:           }
136:           break;
137:         case DELETED:
138:           if (Objects.equals(change.getOldValue(), change.getNewValue())) {
139:             break;
140:           }
141:           if (change.getNewValue() != null) {
142:             change.setChangeType(PropertyChangeType.MODIFIED);
143:           }
144:           actualChanges.put(change.getPropertyName(), change);
145:           break;
146:         default:
147:           break;
148:       }
149:     }
150:     return actualChanges.build();
151:   }
152:   private Properties loadFromResource(String namespace) {
153:     String name = String.format("META-INF/config/%s.properties", namespace);
154:     InputStream in = ClassLoaderUtil.getLoader().getResourceAsStream(name);
155:     Properties properties = null;
156:     if (in != null) {
157:       properties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
158:       try {
159:         properties.load(in);
160:       } catch (IOException ex) {
161:         Tracer.logError(ex);
162:         logger.error("Load resource config for namespace {} failed", namespace, ex);
163:       } finally {
164:         try {
165:           in.close();
166:         } catch (IOException ex) {
167:         }
168:       }
169:     }
170:     return properties;
171:   }
172: }

 25: public class LocalFileConfigRepository extends AbstractConfigRepository
 26:     implements RepositoryChangeListener {
 27:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LocalFileConfigRepository.class);
 28:   private static final String CONFIG_DIR = "/config-cache";
 29:   private final String m_namespace;
 30:   private File m_baseDir;
 31:   private final ConfigUtil m_configUtil;
 32:   private volatile Properties m_fileProperties;
 33:   private volatile ConfigRepository m_upstream;
 34:   private volatile ConfigSourceType m_sourceType = ConfigSourceType.LOCAL;
 35:   public LocalFileConfigRepository(String namespace) {
 36:     this(namespace, null);
 37:   }
 38:   public LocalFileConfigRepository(String namespace, ConfigRepository upstream) {
 39:     m_namespace = namespace;
 40:     m_configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 41:     this.setLocalCacheDir(findLocalCacheDir(), false);
 42:     this.setUpstreamRepository(upstream);
 43:     this.trySync();
 44:   }
 45:   void setLocalCacheDir(File baseDir, boolean syncImmediately) {
 46:     m_baseDir = baseDir;
 47:     this.checkLocalConfigCacheDir(m_baseDir);
 48:     if (syncImmediately) {
 49:       this.trySync();
 50:     }
 51:   }
 52:   private File findLocalCacheDir() {
 53:     try {
 54:       String defaultCacheDir = m_configUtil.getDefaultLocalCacheDir();
 55:       Path path = Paths.get(defaultCacheDir);
 56:       if (!Files.exists(path)) {
 57:         Files.createDirectories(path);
 58:       }
 59:       if (Files.exists(path) && Files.isWritable(path)) {
 60:         return new File(defaultCacheDir, CONFIG_DIR);
 61:       }
 62:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 63:     }
 64:     return new File(ClassLoaderUtil.getClassPath(), CONFIG_DIR);
 65:   }
 66:   @Override
 67:   public Properties getConfig() {
 68:     if (m_fileProperties == null) {
 69:       sync();
 70:     }
 71:     Properties result = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
 72:     result.putAll(m_fileProperties);
 73:     return result;
 74:   }
 75:   @Override
 76:   public void setUpstreamRepository(ConfigRepository upstreamConfigRepository) {
 77:     if (upstreamConfigRepository == null) {
 78:       return;
 79:     }
 80:     if (m_upstream != null) {
 81:       m_upstream.removeChangeListener(this);
 82:     }
 83:     m_upstream = upstreamConfigRepository;
 84:     trySyncFromUpstream();
 85:     upstreamConfigRepository.addChangeListener(this);
 86:   }
 87:   @Override
 88:   public ConfigSourceType getSourceType() {
 89:     return m_sourceType;
 90:   }
 91:   @Override
 92:   public void onRepositoryChange(String namespace, Properties newProperties) {
 93:     if (newProperties.equals(m_fileProperties)) {
 94:       return;
 95:     }
 96:     Properties newFileProperties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
 97:     newFileProperties.putAll(newProperties);
 98:     updateFileProperties(newFileProperties, m_upstream.getSourceType());
 99:     this.fireRepositoryChange(namespace, newProperties);
100:   }
101:   @Override
102:   protected void sync() {
103:     boolean syncFromUpstreamResultSuccess = trySyncFromUpstream();
104:     if (syncFromUpstreamResultSuccess) {
105:       return;
106:     }
107:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigService", "syncLocalConfig");
108:     Throwable exception = null;
109:     try {
110:       transaction.addData("Basedir", m_baseDir.getAbsolutePath());
111:       m_fileProperties = this.loadFromLocalCacheFile(m_baseDir, m_namespace);
112:       m_sourceType = ConfigSourceType.LOCAL;
113:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
114:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
115:       Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
116:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
117:       exception = ex;
118:     } finally {
119:       transaction.complete();
120:     }
121:     if (m_fileProperties == null) {
122:       m_sourceType = ConfigSourceType.NONE;
123:       throw new ApolloConfigException(
124:           "Load config from local config failed!", exception);
125:     }
126:   }
127:   private boolean trySyncFromUpstream() {
128:     if (m_upstream == null) {
129:       return false;
130:     }
131:     try {
132:       updateFileProperties(m_upstream.getConfig(), m_upstream.getSourceType());
133:       return true;
134:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
135:       Tracer.logError(ex);
136:       logger
137:           .warn("Sync config from upstream repository {} failed, reason: {}", m_upstream.getClass(),
138:               ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
139:     }
140:     return false;
141:   }
142:   private synchronized void updateFileProperties(Properties newProperties, ConfigSourceType sourceType) {
143:     this.m_sourceType = sourceType;
144:     if (newProperties.equals(m_fileProperties)) {
145:       return;
146:     }
147:     this.m_fileProperties = newProperties;
148:     persistLocalCacheFile(m_baseDir, m_namespace);
149:   }
150:   private Properties loadFromLocalCacheFile(File baseDir, String namespace) throws IOException {
151:     Preconditions.checkNotNull(baseDir, "Basedir cannot be null");
152:     File file = assembleLocalCacheFile(baseDir, namespace);
153:     Properties properties = null;
154:     if (file.isFile() && file.canRead()) {
155:       InputStream in = null;
156:       try {
157:         in = new FileInputStream(file);
158:         properties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
159:         properties.load(in);
160:         logger.debug("Loading local config file {} successfully!", file.getAbsolutePath());
161:       } catch (IOException ex) {
162:         Tracer.logError(ex);
163:         throw new ApolloConfigException(String
164:             .format("Loading config from local cache file %s failed", file.getAbsolutePath()), ex);
165:       } finally {
166:         try {
167:           if (in != null) {
168:             in.close();
169:           }
170:         } catch (IOException ex) {
171:         }
172:       }
173:     } else {
174:       throw new ApolloConfigException(
175:           String.format("Cannot read from local cache file %s", file.getAbsolutePath()));
176:     }
177:     return properties;
178:   }
179:   void persistLocalCacheFile(File baseDir, String namespace) {
180:     if (baseDir == null) {
181:       return;
182:     }
183:     File file = assembleLocalCacheFile(baseDir, namespace);
184:     OutputStream out = null;
185:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigService", "persistLocalConfigFile");
186:     transaction.addData("LocalConfigFile", file.getAbsolutePath());
187:     try {
188:       out = new FileOutputStream(file);
189:       m_fileProperties.store(out, "Persisted by DefaultConfig");
190:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
191:     } catch (IOException ex) {
192:       ApolloConfigException exception =
193:           new ApolloConfigException(
194:               String.format("Persist local cache file %s failed", file.getAbsolutePath()), ex);
195:       Tracer.logError(exception);
196:       transaction.setStatus(exception);
197:       logger.warn("Persist local cache file {} failed, reason: {}.", file.getAbsolutePath(),
198:           ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
199:     } finally {
200:       if (out != null) {
201:         try {
202:           out.close();
203:         } catch (IOException ex) {
204:         }
205:       }
206:       transaction.complete();
207:     }
208:   }
209:   private void checkLocalConfigCacheDir(File baseDir) {
210:     if (baseDir.exists()) {
211:       return;
212:     }
213:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigService", "createLocalConfigDir");
214:     transaction.addData("BaseDir", baseDir.getAbsolutePath());
215:     try {
216:       Files.createDirectory(baseDir.toPath());
217:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
218:     } catch (IOException ex) {
219:       ApolloConfigException exception =
220:           new ApolloConfigException(
221:               String.format("Create local config directory %s failed", baseDir.getAbsolutePath()),
222:               ex);
223:       Tracer.logError(exception);
224:       transaction.setStatus(exception);
225:       logger.warn(
226:           "Unable to create local config cache directory {}, reason: {}. Will not able to cache config file.",
227:           baseDir.getAbsolutePath(), ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
228:     } finally {
229:       transaction.complete();
230:     }
231:   }
232:   File assembleLocalCacheFile(File baseDir, String namespace) {
233:     String fileName =
234:         String.format("%s.properties", Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR)
235:             .join(m_configUtil.getAppId(), m_configUtil.getCluster(), namespace));
236:     return new File(baseDir, fileName);
237:   }
238: }

 44: public class RemoteConfigLongPollService {
 45:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RemoteConfigLongPollService.class);
 46:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR);
 47:   private static final Joiner.MapJoiner MAP_JOINER = Joiner.on("&").withKeyValueSeparator("=");
 48:   private static final Escaper queryParamEscaper = UrlEscapers.urlFormParameterEscaper();
 49:   private static final long INIT_NOTIFICATION_ID = ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER;
 50:   private static final int LONG_POLLING_READ_TIMEOUT = 90 * 1000;
 51:   private final ExecutorService m_longPollingService;
 52:   private final AtomicBoolean m_longPollingStopped;
 53:   private SchedulePolicy m_longPollFailSchedulePolicyInSecond;
 54:   private RateLimiter m_longPollRateLimiter;
 55:   private final AtomicBoolean m_longPollStarted;

 59:   private Type m_responseType;
 60:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 61:   private ConfigUtil m_configUtil;
 62:   private HttpClient m_httpClient;
 63:   private ConfigServiceLocator m_serviceLocator;
 64:   public RemoteConfigLongPollService() {
 65:     m_longPollFailSchedulePolicyInSecond = new ExponentialSchedulePolicy(1, 120);
 66:     m_longPollingStopped = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 67:     m_longPollingService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(
 68:         ApolloThreadFactory.create("RemoteConfigLongPollService", true));
 69:     m_longPollStarted = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 70:     m_longPollNamespaces =
 71:         Multimaps.synchronizedSetMultimap(HashMultimap.<String, RemoteConfigRepository>create());
 72:     m_notifications = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 73:     m_remoteNotificationMessages = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 74:     m_responseType = new TypeToken<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>() {
 75:     }.getType();
 76:     m_configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 77:     m_httpClient = ApolloInjector.getInstance(HttpClient.class);
 78:     m_serviceLocator = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigServiceLocator.class);
 79:     m_longPollRateLimiter = RateLimiter.create(m_configUtil.getLongPollQPS());
 80:   }
 81:   public boolean submit(String namespace, RemoteConfigRepository remoteConfigRepository) {
 82:     boolean added = m_longPollNamespaces.put(namespace, remoteConfigRepository);
 83:     m_notifications.putIfAbsent(namespace, INIT_NOTIFICATION_ID);
 84:     if (!m_longPollStarted.get()) {
 85:       startLongPolling();
 86:     }
 87:     return added;
 88:   }
 89:   private void startLongPolling() {
 90:     if (!m_longPollStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
 91:       return;
 92:     }
 93:     try {
 94:       final String appId = m_configUtil.getAppId();
 95:       final String cluster = m_configUtil.getCluster();
 96:       final String dataCenter = m_configUtil.getDataCenter();
 97:       final String secret = m_configUtil.getAccessKeySecret();
 98:       final long longPollingInitialDelayInMills = m_configUtil.getLongPollingInitialDelayInMills();
 99:       m_longPollingService.submit(new Runnable() {
100:         @Override
101:         public void run() {
102:           if (longPollingInitialDelayInMills > 0) {
103:             try {
104:               logger.debug("Long polling will start in {} ms.", longPollingInitialDelayInMills);
105:               TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.sleep(longPollingInitialDelayInMills);
106:             } catch (InterruptedException e) {
107:             }
108:           }
109:           doLongPollingRefresh(appId, cluster, dataCenter, secret);
110:         }
111:       });
112:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
113:       m_longPollStarted.set(false);
114:       ApolloConfigException exception =
115:           new ApolloConfigException("Schedule long polling refresh failed", ex);
116:       Tracer.logError(exception);
117:       logger.warn(ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(exception));
118:     }
119:   }
120:   void stopLongPollingRefresh() {
121:     this.m_longPollingStopped.compareAndSet(false, true);
122:   }
123:   private void doLongPollingRefresh(String appId, String cluster, String dataCenter, String secret) {
124:     final Random random = new Random();
125:     ServiceDTO lastServiceDto = null;
126:     while (!m_longPollingStopped.get() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
127:       if (!m_longPollRateLimiter.tryAcquire(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
128:         try {
129:           TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(5);
130:         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
131:         }
132:       }
133:       Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigService", "pollNotification");
134:       String url = null;
135:       try {
136:         if (lastServiceDto == null) {
137:           List<ServiceDTO> configServices = getConfigServices();
138:           lastServiceDto = configServices.get(random.nextInt(configServices.size()));
139:         }
140:         url =
141:             assembleLongPollRefreshUrl(lastServiceDto.getHomepageUrl(), appId, cluster, dataCenter,
142:                 m_notifications);
143:         logger.debug("Long polling from {}", url);
144:         HttpRequest request = new HttpRequest(url);
145:         request.setReadTimeout(LONG_POLLING_READ_TIMEOUT);
146:         if (!StringUtils.isBlank(secret)) {
147:           Map<String, String> headers = Signature.buildHttpHeaders(url, appId, secret);
148:           request.setHeaders(headers);
149:         }
150:         transaction.addData("Url", url);
151:         final HttpResponse<List<ApolloConfigNotification>> response =
152:             m_httpClient.doGet(request, m_responseType);
153:         logger.debug("Long polling response: {}, url: {}", response.getStatusCode(), url);
154:         if (response.getStatusCode() == 200 && response.getBody() != null) {
155:           updateNotifications(response.getBody());
156:           updateRemoteNotifications(response.getBody());
157:           transaction.addData("Result", response.getBody().toString());
158:           notify(lastServiceDto, response.getBody());
159:         }
160:         if (response.getStatusCode() == 304 && random.nextBoolean()) {
161:           lastServiceDto = null;
162:         }
163:         m_longPollFailSchedulePolicyInSecond.success();
164:         transaction.addData("StatusCode", response.getStatusCode());
165:         transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
166:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
167:         lastServiceDto = null;
168:         Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
169:         transaction.setStatus(ex);
170:         long sleepTimeInSecond = m_longPollFailSchedulePolicyInSecond.fail();
171:         logger.warn(
172:             "Long polling failed, will retry in {} seconds. appId: {}, cluster: {}, namespaces: {}, long polling url: {}, reason: {}",
173:             sleepTimeInSecond, appId, cluster, assembleNamespaces(), url, ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
174:         try {
175:           TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(sleepTimeInSecond);
176:         } catch (InterruptedException ie) {
177:         }
178:       } finally {
179:         transaction.complete();
180:       }
181:     }
182:   }
183:   private void notify(ServiceDTO lastServiceDto, List<ApolloConfigNotification> notifications) {
184:     if (notifications == null || notifications.isEmpty()) {
185:       return;
186:     }
187:     for (ApolloConfigNotification notification : notifications) {
188:       String namespaceName = notification.getNamespaceName();
189:       List<RemoteConfigRepository> toBeNotified =
190:           Lists.newArrayList(m_longPollNamespaces.get(namespaceName));
191:       ApolloNotificationMessages originalMessages = m_remoteNotificationMessages.get(namespaceName);
192:       ApolloNotificationMessages remoteMessages = originalMessages == null ? null : originalMessages.clone();
193:       toBeNotified.addAll(m_longPollNamespaces
194:           .get(String.format("%s.%s", namespaceName, ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue())));
195:       for (RemoteConfigRepository remoteConfigRepository : toBeNotified) {
196:         try {
197:           remoteConfigRepository.onLongPollNotified(lastServiceDto, remoteMessages);
198:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
199:           Tracer.logError(ex);
200:         }
201:       }
202:     }
203:   }
204:   private void updateNotifications(List<ApolloConfigNotification> deltaNotifications) {
205:     for (ApolloConfigNotification notification : deltaNotifications) {
206:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(notification.getNamespaceName())) {
207:         continue;
208:       }
209:       String namespaceName = notification.getNamespaceName();
210:       if (m_notifications.containsKey(namespaceName)) {
211:         m_notifications.put(namespaceName, notification.getNotificationId());
212:       }
213:       String namespaceNameWithPropertiesSuffix =
214:           String.format("%s.%s", namespaceName, ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue());
215:       if (m_notifications.containsKey(namespaceNameWithPropertiesSuffix)) {
216:         m_notifications.put(namespaceNameWithPropertiesSuffix, notification.getNotificationId());
217:       }
218:     }
219:   }
220:   private void updateRemoteNotifications(List<ApolloConfigNotification> deltaNotifications) {
221:     for (ApolloConfigNotification notification : deltaNotifications) {
222:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(notification.getNamespaceName())) {
223:         continue;
224:       }
225:       if (notification.getMessages() == null || notification.getMessages().isEmpty()) {
226:         continue;
227:       }
228:       ApolloNotificationMessages localRemoteMessages =
229:           m_remoteNotificationMessages.get(notification.getNamespaceName());
230:       if (localRemoteMessages == null) {
231:         localRemoteMessages = new ApolloNotificationMessages();
232:         m_remoteNotificationMessages.put(notification.getNamespaceName(), localRemoteMessages);
233:       }
234:       localRemoteMessages.mergeFrom(notification.getMessages());
235:     }
236:   }
237:   private String assembleNamespaces() {
238:     return STRING_JOINER.join(m_longPollNamespaces.keySet());
239:   }
240:   String assembleLongPollRefreshUrl(String uri, String appId, String cluster, String dataCenter,
241:                                     Map<String, Long> notificationsMap) {
242:     Map<String, String> queryParams = Maps.newHashMap();
243:     queryParams.put("appId", queryParamEscaper.escape(appId));
244:     queryParams.put("cluster", queryParamEscaper.escape(cluster));
245:     queryParams
246:         .put("notifications", queryParamEscaper.escape(assembleNotifications(notificationsMap)));
247:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter)) {
248:       queryParams.put("dataCenter", queryParamEscaper.escape(dataCenter));
249:     }
250:     String localIp = m_configUtil.getLocalIp();
251:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(localIp)) {
252:       queryParams.put("ip", queryParamEscaper.escape(localIp));
253:     }
254:     String params = MAP_JOINER.join(queryParams);
255:     if (!uri.endsWith("/")) {
256:       uri += "/";
257:     }
258:     return uri + "notifications/v2?" + params;
259:   }
260:   String assembleNotifications(Map<String, Long> notificationsMap) {
261:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> notifications = Lists.newArrayList();
262:     for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : notificationsMap.entrySet()) {
263:       ApolloConfigNotification notification = new ApolloConfigNotification(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
264:       notifications.add(notification);
265:     }
266:     return GSON.toJson(notifications);
267:   }
268:   private List<ServiceDTO> getConfigServices() {
269:     List<ServiceDTO> services = m_serviceLocator.getConfigServices();
270:     if (services.size() == 0) {
271:       throw new ApolloConfigException("No available config service");
272:     }
273:     return services;
274:   }
275: }

 96:   private void schedulePeriodicRefresh() {
 97:     logger.debug("Schedule periodic refresh with interval: {} {}",
 98:         m_configUtil.getRefreshInterval(), m_configUtil.getRefreshIntervalTimeUnit());
 99:     m_executorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(
100:         new Runnable() {
101:           @Override
102:           public void run() {
103:             Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.ConfigService", String.format("periodicRefresh: %s", m_namespace));
104:             logger.debug("refresh config for namespace: {}", m_namespace);
105:             trySync();
106:             Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Client.Version", Apollo.VERSION);
107:           }

109:         m_configUtil.getRefreshIntervalTimeUnit());

111:   @Override

116:       ApolloConfig current = loadApolloConfig();
117:       if (previous != current) {
118:         logger.debug("Remote Config refreshed!");
119:         m_configCache.set(current);
120:         this.fireRepositoryChange(m_namespace, this.getConfig());
121:       }
122:       if (current != null) {
123:         Tracer.logEvent(String.format("Apollo.Client.Configs.%s", current.getNamespaceName()),
124:             current.getReleaseKey());
125:       }
126:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
127:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
