139:   private ApolloConfig loadApolloConfig() {
140:     if (!m_loadConfigRateLimiter.tryAcquire(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
141:       try {
142:         TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(5);
143:       } catch (InterruptedException e) {
144:       }
145:     }
146:     String appId = m_configUtil.getAppId();
147:     String cluster = m_configUtil.getCluster();
148:     String dataCenter = m_configUtil.getDataCenter();
149:     String secret = m_configUtil.getAccessKeySecret();
150:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Client.ConfigMeta", STRING_JOINER.join(appId, cluster, m_namespace));
151:     int maxRetries = m_configNeedForceRefresh.get() ? 2 : 1;
152:     long onErrorSleepTime = 0;
153:     Throwable exception = null;
154:     List<ServiceDTO> configServices = getConfigServices();
155:     String url = null;
156:     retryLoopLabel:
157:     for (int i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {
158:       List<ServiceDTO> randomConfigServices = Lists.newLinkedList(configServices);
159:       Collections.shuffle(randomConfigServices);
160:       if (m_longPollServiceDto.get() != null) {
161:         randomConfigServices.add(0, m_longPollServiceDto.getAndSet(null));
162:       }
163:       for (ServiceDTO configService : randomConfigServices) {
164:         if (onErrorSleepTime > 0) {
165:           logger.warn(
166:               "Load config failed, will retry in {} {}. appId: {}, cluster: {}, namespaces: {}",
167:               onErrorSleepTime, m_configUtil.getOnErrorRetryIntervalTimeUnit(), appId, cluster, m_namespace);
168:           try {
169:             m_configUtil.getOnErrorRetryIntervalTimeUnit().sleep(onErrorSleepTime);
170:           } catch (InterruptedException e) {
171:           }
172:         }
173:         url = assembleQueryConfigUrl(configService.getHomepageUrl(), appId, cluster, m_namespace,
174:                 dataCenter, m_remoteMessages.get(), m_configCache.get());
175:         logger.debug("Loading config from {}", url);
176:         HttpRequest request = new HttpRequest(url);
177:         if (!StringUtils.isBlank(secret)) {
178:           Map<String, String> headers = Signature.buildHttpHeaders(url, appId, secret);
179:           request.setHeaders(headers);
180:         }
181:         Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ConfigService", "queryConfig");
182:         transaction.addData("Url", url);
183:         try {
184:           HttpResponse<ApolloConfig> response = m_httpClient.doGet(request, ApolloConfig.class);
185:           m_configNeedForceRefresh.set(false);
186:           m_loadConfigFailSchedulePolicy.success();
187:           transaction.addData("StatusCode", response.getStatusCode());
188:           transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
189:           if (response.getStatusCode() == 304) {
190:             logger.debug("Config server responds with 304 HTTP status code.");
191:             return m_configCache.get();
192:           }
193:           ApolloConfig result = response.getBody();
194:           logger.debug("Loaded config for {}: {}", m_namespace, result);
195:           return result;
196:         } catch (ApolloConfigStatusCodeException ex) {
197:           ApolloConfigStatusCodeException statusCodeException = ex;
198:           if (ex.getStatusCode() == 404) {
199:             String message = String.format(
200:                 "Could not find config for namespace - appId: %s, cluster: %s, namespace: %s, " +
201:                     "please check whether the configs are released in Apollo!",
202:                 appId, cluster, m_namespace);
203:             statusCodeException = new ApolloConfigStatusCodeException(ex.getStatusCode(),
204:                 message);
205:           }
206:           Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(statusCodeException));
207:           transaction.setStatus(statusCodeException);
208:           exception = statusCodeException;
209:           if(ex.getStatusCode() == 404) {
210:             break retryLoopLabel;
211:           }
212:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
213:           Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
214:           transaction.setStatus(ex);
215:           exception = ex;
216:         } finally {
217:           transaction.complete();
218:         }
219:         onErrorSleepTime = m_configNeedForceRefresh.get() ? m_configUtil.getOnErrorRetryInterval() :
220:             m_loadConfigFailSchedulePolicy.fail();
221:       }
222:     }
223:     String message = String.format(
224:         "Load Apollo Config failed - appId: %s, cluster: %s, namespace: %s, url: %s",
225:         appId, cluster, m_namespace, url);
226:     throw new ApolloConfigException(message, exception);
227:   }
228:   String assembleQueryConfigUrl(String uri, String appId, String cluster, String namespace,
229:                                 String dataCenter, ApolloNotificationMessages remoteMessages, ApolloConfig previousConfig) {
230:     String path = "configs/%s/%s/%s";
231:     List<String> pathParams =
232:         Lists.newArrayList(pathEscaper.escape(appId), pathEscaper.escape(cluster),
233:             pathEscaper.escape(namespace));
234:     Map<String, String> queryParams = Maps.newHashMap();
235:     if (previousConfig != null) {
236:       queryParams.put("releaseKey", queryParamEscaper.escape(previousConfig.getReleaseKey()));
237:     }
238:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter)) {
239:       queryParams.put("dataCenter", queryParamEscaper.escape(dataCenter));
240:     }
241:     String localIp = m_configUtil.getLocalIp();
242:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(localIp)) {
243:       queryParams.put("ip", queryParamEscaper.escape(localIp));
244:     }
245:     if (remoteMessages != null) {
246:       queryParams.put("messages", queryParamEscaper.escape(GSON.toJson(remoteMessages)));
247:     }
248:     String pathExpanded = String.format(path, pathParams.toArray());
249:     if (!queryParams.isEmpty()) {
250:       pathExpanded += "?" + MAP_JOINER.join(queryParams);
251:     }
252:     if (!uri.endsWith("/")) {
253:       uri += "/";
254:     }
255:     return uri + pathExpanded;
256:   }
257:   private void scheduleLongPollingRefresh() {
258:     remoteConfigLongPollService.submit(m_namespace, this);
259:   }
260:   public void onLongPollNotified(ServiceDTO longPollNotifiedServiceDto, ApolloNotificationMessages remoteMessages) {
261:     m_longPollServiceDto.set(longPollNotifiedServiceDto);
262:     m_remoteMessages.set(remoteMessages);
263:     m_executorService.submit(new Runnable() {
264:       @Override
265:       public void run() {
266:         m_configNeedForceRefresh.set(true);
267:         trySync();
268:       }
269:     });
270:   }
271:   private List<ServiceDTO> getConfigServices() {
272:     List<ServiceDTO> services = m_serviceLocator.getConfigServices();
273:     if (services.size() == 0) {
274:       throw new ApolloConfigException("No available config service");
275:     }
276:     return services;
277:   }
278: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.enums.ConfigSourceType;
 3: import java.util.Collections;
 4: import java.util.List;
 5: import java.util.Map;
 6: import java.util.Properties;
 7: import java.util.Set;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChange;
11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChangeEvent;
12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ExceptionUtil;
14: import com.google.common.base.Function;
15: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
16: public class SimpleConfig extends AbstractConfig implements RepositoryChangeListener {
17:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SimpleConfig.class);
18:   private final String m_namespace;
19:   private final ConfigRepository m_configRepository;
20:   private volatile Properties m_configProperties;
21:   private volatile ConfigSourceType m_sourceType = ConfigSourceType.NONE;
22:   public SimpleConfig(String namespace, ConfigRepository configRepository) {
23:     m_namespace = namespace;
24:     m_configRepository = configRepository;
25:     this.initialize();
26:   }
27:   private void initialize() {
28:     try {
29:       updateConfig(m_configRepository.getConfig(), m_configRepository.getSourceType());
30:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
31:       Tracer.logError(ex);
32:       logger.warn("Init Apollo Simple Config failed - namespace: {}, reason: {}", m_namespace,
33:           ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
34:     } finally {
35:       m_configRepository.addChangeListener(this);
36:     }
37:   }
38:   @Override
39:   public String getProperty(String key, String defaultValue) {
40:     if (m_configProperties == null) {
41:       logger.warn("Could not load config from Apollo, always return default value!");
42:       return defaultValue;
43:     }
44:     return this.m_configProperties.getProperty(key, defaultValue);
45:   }
46:   @Override
47:   public Set<String> getPropertyNames() {
48:     if (m_configProperties == null) {
49:       return Collections.emptySet();
50:     }
51:     return m_configProperties.stringPropertyNames();
52:   }
53:   @Override
54:   public ConfigSourceType getSourceType() {
55:     return m_sourceType;
56:   }
57:   @Override
58:   public synchronized void onRepositoryChange(String namespace, Properties newProperties) {
59:     if (newProperties.equals(m_configProperties)) {
60:       return;
61:     }
62:     Properties newConfigProperties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
63:     newConfigProperties.putAll(newProperties);
64:     List<ConfigChange> changes = calcPropertyChanges(namespace, m_configProperties, newConfigProperties);
65:     Map<String, ConfigChange> changeMap = Maps.uniqueIndex(changes,
66:         new Function<ConfigChange, String>() {
67:           @Override
68:           public String apply(ConfigChange input) {
69:             return input.getPropertyName();
70:           }
71:         });
72:     updateConfig(newConfigProperties, m_configRepository.getSourceType());
73:     clearConfigCache();
74:     this.fireConfigChange(new ConfigChangeEvent(m_namespace, changeMap));
75:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Client.ConfigChanges", m_namespace);
76:   }
77:   private void updateConfig(Properties newConfigProperties, ConfigSourceType sourceType) {
78:     m_configProperties = newConfigProperties;
79:     m_sourceType = sourceType;
80:   }
81: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ExceptionUtil;
 3: import java.util.Properties;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.PropertiesCompatibleConfigFile;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.ConfigFileFormat;
 9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.exceptions.ApolloConfigException;
10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.yaml.YamlParser;
12: public class YamlConfigFile extends PlainTextConfigFile implements PropertiesCompatibleConfigFile {
13:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(YamlConfigFile.class);
14:   private volatile Properties cachedProperties;
15:   public YamlConfigFile(String namespace, ConfigRepository configRepository) {
16:     super(namespace, configRepository);
17:     tryTransformToProperties();
18:   }
19:   @Override
20:   public ConfigFileFormat getConfigFileFormat() {
21:     return ConfigFileFormat.YAML;
22:   }
23:   @Override
24:   protected void update(Properties newProperties) {
25:     super.update(newProperties);
26:     tryTransformToProperties();
27:   }
28:   @Override
29:   public Properties asProperties() {
30:     if (cachedProperties == null) {
31:       transformToProperties();
32:     }
33:     return cachedProperties;
34:   }
35:   private boolean tryTransformToProperties() {
36:     try {
37:       transformToProperties();
38:       return true;
39:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
40:       Tracer.logEvent("ApolloConfigException", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
41:       logger.warn("yaml to properties failed, reason: {}", ExceptionUtil.getDetailMessage(ex));
42:     }
43:     return false;
44:   }
45:   private synchronized void transformToProperties() {
46:     cachedProperties = toProperties();
47:   }
48:   private Properties toProperties() {
49:     if (!this.hasContent()) {
50:       return propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
51:     }
52:     try {
53:       return ApolloInjector.getInstance(YamlParser.class).yamlToProperties(getContent());
54:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
55:       ApolloConfigException exception = new ApolloConfigException(
56:           "Parse yaml file content failed for namespace: " + m_namespace, ex);
57:       Tracer.logError(exception);
58:       throw exception;
59:     }
60:   }
61: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spi;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigService;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.PropertiesCompatibleConfigFile;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.PropertiesCompatibleFileConfigRepository;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.TxtConfigFile;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Config;
 9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigFile;
10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.ConfigFileFormat;
12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.ConfigRepository;
13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.DefaultConfig;
14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.JsonConfigFile;
15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.LocalFileConfigRepository;
16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.PropertiesConfigFile;
17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.RemoteConfigRepository;
18: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.XmlConfigFile;
19: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.YamlConfigFile;
20: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.YmlConfigFile;
21: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
22: public class DefaultConfigFactory implements ConfigFactory {
23:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultConfigFactory.class);
24:   private ConfigUtil m_configUtil;
25:   public DefaultConfigFactory() {
26:     m_configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
27:   }
28:   @Override
29:   public Config create(String namespace) {
30:     ConfigFileFormat format = determineFileFormat(namespace);
31:     if (ConfigFileFormat.isPropertiesCompatible(format)) {
32:       return new DefaultConfig(namespace, createPropertiesCompatibleFileConfigRepository(namespace, format));
33:     }
34:     return new DefaultConfig(namespace, createLocalConfigRepository(namespace));
35:   }
36:   @Override
37:   public ConfigFile createConfigFile(String namespace, ConfigFileFormat configFileFormat) {
38:     ConfigRepository configRepository = createLocalConfigRepository(namespace);
39:     switch (configFileFormat) {
40:       case Properties:
41:         return new PropertiesConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
42:       case XML:
43:         return new XmlConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
44:       case JSON:
45:         return new JsonConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
46:       case YAML:
47:         return new YamlConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
48:       case YML:
49:         return new YmlConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
50:       case TXT:
51:         return new TxtConfigFile(namespace, configRepository);
52:     }
53:     return null;
54:   }
55:   LocalFileConfigRepository createLocalConfigRepository(String namespace) {
56:     if (m_configUtil.isInLocalMode()) {
57:       logger.warn(
58:           "==== Apollo is in local mode! Won't pull configs from remote server for namespace {} ! ====",
59:           namespace);
60:       return new LocalFileConfigRepository(namespace);
61:     }
62:     return new LocalFileConfigRepository(namespace, createRemoteConfigRepository(namespace));
63:   }
64:   RemoteConfigRepository createRemoteConfigRepository(String namespace) {
65:     return new RemoteConfigRepository(namespace);
66:   }
67:   PropertiesCompatibleFileConfigRepository createPropertiesCompatibleFileConfigRepository(String namespace,
68:       ConfigFileFormat format) {
69:     String actualNamespaceName = trimNamespaceFormat(namespace, format);
70:     PropertiesCompatibleConfigFile configFile = (PropertiesCompatibleConfigFile) ConfigService
71:         .getConfigFile(actualNamespaceName, format);
72:     return new PropertiesCompatibleFileConfigRepository(configFile);
73:   }
74:   ConfigFileFormat determineFileFormat(String namespaceName) {
75:     String lowerCase = namespaceName.toLowerCase();
76:     for (ConfigFileFormat format : ConfigFileFormat.values()) {
77:       if (lowerCase.endsWith("." + format.getValue())) {
78:         return format;
79:       }
80:     }
81:     return ConfigFileFormat.Properties;
82:   }
83:   String trimNamespaceFormat(String namespaceName, ConfigFileFormat format) {
84:     String extension = "." + format.getValue();
85:     if (!namespaceName.toLowerCase().endsWith(extension)) {
86:       return namespaceName;
87:     }
88:     return namespaceName.substring(0, namespaceName.length() - extension.length());
89:   }
90: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spi;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
 4: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 5: public class DefaultConfigFactoryManager implements ConfigFactoryManager {
 6:   private ConfigRegistry m_registry;
 7:   private Map<String, ConfigFactory> m_factories = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 8:   public DefaultConfigFactoryManager() {
 9:     m_registry = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigRegistry.class);
10:   }
11:   @Override
12:   public ConfigFactory getFactory(String namespace) {
13:     ConfigFactory factory = m_registry.getFactory(namespace);
14:     if (factory != null) {
15:       return factory;
16:     }
17:     factory = m_factories.get(namespace);
18:     if (factory != null) {
19:       return factory;
20:     }
21:     factory = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigFactory.class, namespace);
22:     if (factory != null) {
23:       return factory;
24:     }
25:     factory = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigFactory.class);
26:     m_factories.put(namespace, factory);
27:     return factory;
28:   }
29: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spi;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 5: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 6: public class DefaultConfigRegistry implements ConfigRegistry {
 7:   private static final Logger s_logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultConfigRegistry.class);
 8:   private Map<String, ConfigFactory> m_instances = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 9:   @Override
10:   public void register(String namespace, ConfigFactory factory) {
11:     if (m_instances.containsKey(namespace)) {
12:       s_logger.warn("ConfigFactory({}) is overridden by {}!", namespace, factory.getClass());
13:     }
14:     m_instances.put(namespace, factory);
15:   }
16:   @Override
17:   public ConfigFactory getFactory(String namespace) {
18:     ConfigFactory config = m_instances.get(namespace);
19:     return config;
20:   }
21: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.annotation;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Config;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigChangeListener;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigService;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChangeEvent;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.PlaceholderHelper;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValue;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValueRegistry;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
 12: import com.google.common.base.Preconditions;
 13: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 14: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
 15: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 16: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 17: import java.util.Set;
 18: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 19: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 20: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 21: import org.springframework.beans.BeansException;
 22: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactory;
 23: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactoryAware;
 24: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableBeanFactory;
 25: import org.springframework.context.EnvironmentAware;
 26: import org.springframework.core.annotation.AnnotationUtils;
 27: import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
 28: import org.springframework.util.ReflectionUtils;
 29: public class ApolloAnnotationProcessor extends ApolloProcessor implements BeanFactoryAware,
 30:     EnvironmentAware {
 31:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApolloAnnotationProcessor.class);
 32:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 33:   private final ConfigUtil configUtil;
 34:   private final PlaceholderHelper placeholderHelper;
 35:   private final SpringValueRegistry springValueRegistry;
 36:   private ConfigurableBeanFactory configurableBeanFactory;
 37:   private Environment environment;
 38:   public ApolloAnnotationProcessor() {
 39:     configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 40:     placeholderHelper = SpringInjector.getInstance(PlaceholderHelper.class);
 41:     springValueRegistry = SpringInjector.getInstance(SpringValueRegistry.class);
 42:   }
 43:   @Override
 44:   protected void processField(Object bean, String beanName, Field field) {
 45:     this.processApolloConfig(bean, field);
 46:     this.processApolloJsonValue(bean, beanName, field);
 47:   }
 48:   @Override
 49:   protected void processMethod(final Object bean, String beanName, final Method method) {
 50:     this.processApolloConfigChangeListener(bean, method);
 51:     this.processApolloJsonValue(bean, beanName, method);
 52:   }
 53:   private void processApolloConfig(Object bean, Field field) {
 54:     ApolloConfig annotation = AnnotationUtils.getAnnotation(field, ApolloConfig.class);
 55:     if (annotation == null) {
 56:       return;
 57:     }
 58:     Preconditions.checkArgument(Config.class.isAssignableFrom(field.getType()),
 59:         "Invalid type: %s for field: %s, should be Config", field.getType(), field);
 60:     final String namespace = annotation.value();
 61:     final String resolvedNamespace = this.environment.resolveRequiredPlaceholders(namespace);
 62:     Config config = ConfigService.getConfig(resolvedNamespace);
 63:     ReflectionUtils.makeAccessible(field);
 64:     ReflectionUtils.setField(field, bean, config);
 65:   }
 66:   private void processApolloConfigChangeListener(final Object bean, final Method method) {
 67:     ApolloConfigChangeListener annotation = AnnotationUtils
 68:         .findAnnotation(method, ApolloConfigChangeListener.class);
 69:     if (annotation == null) {
 70:       return;
 71:     }
 72:     Class<?>[] parameterTypes = method.getParameterTypes();
 73:     Preconditions.checkArgument(parameterTypes.length == 1,
 74:         "Invalid number of parameters: %s for method: %s, should be 1", parameterTypes.length,
 75:         method);
 76:     Preconditions.checkArgument(ConfigChangeEvent.class.isAssignableFrom(parameterTypes[0]),
 77:         "Invalid parameter type: %s for method: %s, should be ConfigChangeEvent", parameterTypes[0],
 78:         method);
 79:     ReflectionUtils.makeAccessible(method);
 80:     String[] namespaces = annotation.value();
 81:     String[] annotatedInterestedKeys = annotation.interestedKeys();
 82:     String[] annotatedInterestedKeyPrefixes = annotation.interestedKeyPrefixes();
 83:     ConfigChangeListener configChangeListener = new ConfigChangeListener() {
 84:       @Override
 85:       public void onChange(ConfigChangeEvent changeEvent) {
 86:         ReflectionUtils.invokeMethod(method, bean, changeEvent);
 87:       }
 88:     };
 89:     Set<String> interestedKeys =
 90:         annotatedInterestedKeys.length > 0 ? Sets.newHashSet(annotatedInterestedKeys) : null;
 91:     Set<String> interestedKeyPrefixes =
 92:         annotatedInterestedKeyPrefixes.length > 0 ? Sets.newHashSet(annotatedInterestedKeyPrefixes)
 93:             : null;
 94:     for (String namespace : namespaces) {
 95:       final String resolvedNamespace = this.environment.resolveRequiredPlaceholders(namespace);
 96:       Config config = ConfigService.getConfig(resolvedNamespace);
 97:       if (interestedKeys == null && interestedKeyPrefixes == null) {
 98:         config.addChangeListener(configChangeListener);
 99:       } else {
100:         config.addChangeListener(configChangeListener, interestedKeys, interestedKeyPrefixes);
101:       }
102:     }
103:   }
104:   private void processApolloJsonValue(Object bean, String beanName, Field field) {
105:     ApolloJsonValue apolloJsonValue = AnnotationUtils.getAnnotation(field, ApolloJsonValue.class);
106:     if (apolloJsonValue == null) {
107:       return;
108:     }
109:     String placeholder = apolloJsonValue.value();
110:     Object propertyValue = placeholderHelper
111:         .resolvePropertyValue(this.configurableBeanFactory, beanName, placeholder);
112:     if (!(propertyValue instanceof String)) {
113:       return;
114:     }
115:     boolean accessible = field.isAccessible();
116:     field.setAccessible(true);
117:     ReflectionUtils
118:         .setField(field, bean, parseJsonValue((String) propertyValue, field.getGenericType()));
119:     field.setAccessible(accessible);
120:     if (configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled()) {
121:       Set<String> keys = placeholderHelper.extractPlaceholderKeys(placeholder);
122:       for (String key : keys) {
123:         SpringValue springValue = new SpringValue(key, placeholder, bean, beanName, field, true);
124:         springValueRegistry.register(this.configurableBeanFactory, key, springValue);
125:         logger.debug("Monitoring {}", springValue);
126:       }
127:     }
128:   }
129:   private void processApolloJsonValue(Object bean, String beanName, Method method) {
130:     ApolloJsonValue apolloJsonValue = AnnotationUtils.getAnnotation(method, ApolloJsonValue.class);
131:     if (apolloJsonValue == null) {
132:       return;
133:     }
134:     String placeHolder = apolloJsonValue.value();
135:     Object propertyValue = placeholderHelper
136:         .resolvePropertyValue(this.configurableBeanFactory, beanName, placeHolder);
137:     if (!(propertyValue instanceof String)) {
138:       return;
139:     }
140:     Type[] types = method.getGenericParameterTypes();
141:     Preconditions.checkArgument(types.length == 1,
142:         "Ignore @Value setter {}.{}, expecting 1 parameter, actual {} parameters",
143:         bean.getClass().getName(), method.getName(), method.getParameterTypes().length);
144:     boolean accessible = method.isAccessible();
145:     method.setAccessible(true);
146:     ReflectionUtils.invokeMethod(method, bean, parseJsonValue((String) propertyValue, types[0]));
147:     method.setAccessible(accessible);
148:     if (configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled()) {
149:       Set<String> keys = placeholderHelper.extractPlaceholderKeys(placeHolder);
150:       for (String key : keys) {
151:         SpringValue springValue = new SpringValue(key, apolloJsonValue.value(), bean, beanName,
152:             method, true);
153:         springValueRegistry.register(this.configurableBeanFactory, key, springValue);
154:         logger.debug("Monitoring {}", springValue);
155:       }
156:     }
157:   }
158:   private Object parseJsonValue(String json, Type targetType) {
159:     try {
160:       return GSON.fromJson(json, targetType);
161:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
162:       logger.error("Parsing json '{}' to type {} failed!", json, targetType, ex);
163:       throw ex;
164:     }
165:   }
166:   @Override
167:   public void setBeanFactory(BeanFactory beanFactory) throws BeansException {
168:     this.configurableBeanFactory = (ConfigurableBeanFactory) beanFactory;
169:   }
170:   @Override
171:   public void setEnvironment(Environment environment) {
172:     this.environment = environment;
173:   }
174: }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/spring/annotation/ApolloProcessor.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.annotation;
 2: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
 3: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 4: import java.util.LinkedList;
 5: import java.util.List;
 6: import org.springframework.beans.BeansException;
 7: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanPostProcessor;
 8: import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
 9: import org.springframework.core.PriorityOrdered;
10: import org.springframework.util.ReflectionUtils;
11: public abstract class ApolloProcessor implements BeanPostProcessor, PriorityOrdered {
12:   @Override
13:   public Object postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object bean, String beanName)
14:       throws BeansException {
15:     Class clazz = bean.getClass();
16:     for (Field field : findAllField(clazz)) {
17:       processField(bean, beanName, field);
18:     }
19:     for (Method method : findAllMethod(clazz)) {
20:       processMethod(bean, beanName, method);
21:     }
22:     return bean;
23:   }
24:   @Override
25:   public Object postProcessAfterInitialization(Object bean, String beanName) throws BeansException {
26:     return bean;
27:   }
28:   protected abstract void processField(Object bean, String beanName, Field field);
29:   protected abstract void processMethod(Object bean, String beanName, Method method);
30:   @Override
31:   public int getOrder() {
32:     return Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE;
33:   }
34:   private List<Field> findAllField(Class clazz) {
35:     final List<Field> res = new LinkedList<>();
36:     ReflectionUtils.doWithFields(clazz, new ReflectionUtils.FieldCallback() {
37:       @Override
38:       public void doWith(Field field) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalAccessException {
39:         res.add(field);
40:       }
41:     });
42:     return res;
43:   }
44:   private List<Method> findAllMethod(Class clazz) {
45:     final List<Method> res = new LinkedList<>();
46:     ReflectionUtils.doWithMethods(clazz, new ReflectionUtils.MethodCallback() {
47:       @Override
48:       public void doWith(Method method) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalAccessException {
49:         res.add(method);
50:       }
51:     });
52:     return res;
53:   }
54: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.annotation;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.PlaceholderHelper;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValue;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValueDefinition;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValueDefinitionProcessor;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.SpringValueRegistry;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
 10: import com.google.common.collect.LinkedListMultimap;
 11: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
 12: import java.beans.PropertyDescriptor;
 13: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
 14: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 15: import java.util.Collection;
 16: import java.util.Set;
 17: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 18: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 19: import org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils;
 20: import org.springframework.beans.BeansException;
 21: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactory;
 22: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactoryAware;
 23: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 24: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanFactoryPostProcessor;
 25: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableListableBeanFactory;
 26: import org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionRegistry;
 27: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 28: public class SpringValueProcessor extends ApolloProcessor implements BeanFactoryPostProcessor, BeanFactoryAware {
 29:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SpringValueProcessor.class);
 30:   private final ConfigUtil configUtil;
 31:   private final PlaceholderHelper placeholderHelper;
 32:   private final SpringValueRegistry springValueRegistry;
 33:   private BeanFactory beanFactory;
 34:   private Multimap<String, SpringValueDefinition> beanName2SpringValueDefinitions;
 35:   public SpringValueProcessor() {
 36:     configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 37:     placeholderHelper = SpringInjector.getInstance(PlaceholderHelper.class);
 38:     springValueRegistry = SpringInjector.getInstance(SpringValueRegistry.class);
 39:     beanName2SpringValueDefinitions = LinkedListMultimap.create();
 40:   }
 41:   @Override
 42:   public void postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory)
 43:       throws BeansException {
 44:     if (configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled() && beanFactory instanceof BeanDefinitionRegistry) {
 45:       beanName2SpringValueDefinitions = SpringValueDefinitionProcessor
 46:           .getBeanName2SpringValueDefinitions((BeanDefinitionRegistry) beanFactory);
 47:     }
 48:   }
 49:   @Override
 50:   public Object postProcessBeforeInitialization(Object bean, String beanName)
 51:       throws BeansException {
 52:     if (configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled()) {
 53:       super.postProcessBeforeInitialization(bean, beanName);
 54:       processBeanPropertyValues(bean, beanName);
 55:     }
 56:     return bean;
 57:   }
 58:   @Override
 59:   protected void processField(Object bean, String beanName, Field field) {
 60:     Value value = field.getAnnotation(Value.class);
 61:     if (value == null) {
 62:       return;
 63:     }
 64:     Set<String> keys = placeholderHelper.extractPlaceholderKeys(value.value());
 65:     if (keys.isEmpty()) {
 66:       return;
 67:     }
 68:     for (String key : keys) {
 69:       SpringValue springValue = new SpringValue(key, value.value(), bean, beanName, field, false);
 70:       springValueRegistry.register(beanFactory, key, springValue);
 71:       logger.debug("Monitoring {}", springValue);
 72:     }
 73:   }
 74:   @Override
 75:   protected void processMethod(Object bean, String beanName, Method method) {
 76:     Value value = method.getAnnotation(Value.class);
 77:     if (value == null) {
 78:       return;
 79:     }
 80:     if (method.getAnnotation(Bean.class) != null) {
 81:       return;
 82:     }
 83:     if (method.getParameterTypes().length != 1) {
 84:       logger.error("Ignore @Value setter {}.{}, expecting 1 parameter, actual {} parameters",
 85:           bean.getClass().getName(), method.getName(), method.getParameterTypes().length);
 86:       return;
 87:     }
 88:     Set<String> keys = placeholderHelper.extractPlaceholderKeys(value.value());
 89:     if (keys.isEmpty()) {
 90:       return;
 91:     }
 92:     for (String key : keys) {
 93:       SpringValue springValue = new SpringValue(key, value.value(), bean, beanName, method, false);
 94:       springValueRegistry.register(beanFactory, key, springValue);
 95:       logger.info("Monitoring {}", springValue);
 96:     }
 97:   }
 98:   private void processBeanPropertyValues(Object bean, String beanName) {
 99:     Collection<SpringValueDefinition> propertySpringValues = beanName2SpringValueDefinitions
100:         .get(beanName);
101:     if (propertySpringValues == null || propertySpringValues.isEmpty()) {
102:       return;
103:     }
104:     for (SpringValueDefinition definition : propertySpringValues) {
105:       try {
106:         PropertyDescriptor pd = BeanUtils
107:             .getPropertyDescriptor(bean.getClass(), definition.getPropertyName());
108:         Method method = pd.getWriteMethod();
109:         if (method == null) {
110:           continue;
111:         }
112:         SpringValue springValue = new SpringValue(definition.getKey(), definition.getPlaceholder(),
113:             bean, beanName, method, false);
114:         springValueRegistry.register(beanFactory, definition.getKey(), springValue);
115:         logger.debug("Monitoring {}", springValue);
116:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
117:         logger.error("Failed to enable auto update feature for {}.{}", bean.getClass(),
118:             definition.getPropertyName());
119:       }
120:     }
121:     beanName2SpringValueDefinitions.removeAll(beanName);
122:   }
123:   @Override
124:   public void setBeanFactory(BeanFactory beanFactory) throws BeansException {
125:     this.beanFactory = beanFactory;
126:   }
127: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.boot;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Config;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigService;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ConfigConsts;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.config.ConfigPropertySourceFactory;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.config.PropertySourcesConstants;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.factory.PropertiesFactory;
 9: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
10: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
11: import java.util.List;
12: import org.slf4j.Logger;
13: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
14: import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
15: import org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor;
16: import org.springframework.context.ApplicationContextInitializer;
17: import org.springframework.context.ConfigurableApplicationContext;
18: import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
19: import org.springframework.core.env.CompositePropertySource;
20: import org.springframework.core.env.ConfigurableEnvironment;
21: public class ApolloApplicationContextInitializer implements
22:     ApplicationContextInitializer<ConfigurableApplicationContext> , EnvironmentPostProcessor, Ordered {
23:   public static final int DEFAULT_ORDER = 0;
24:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApolloApplicationContextInitializer.class);
25:   private static final Splitter NAMESPACE_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings().trimResults();
26:   private static final String[] APOLLO_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES = {"app.id", ConfigConsts.APOLLO_CLUSTER_KEY,
27:       "apollo.cacheDir", "apollo.accesskey.secret", ConfigConsts.APOLLO_META_KEY, PropertiesFactory.APOLLO_PROPERTY_ORDER_ENABLE};
28:   private final ConfigPropertySourceFactory configPropertySourceFactory = SpringInjector
29:       .getInstance(ConfigPropertySourceFactory.class);
30:   private int order = DEFAULT_ORDER;
31:   @Override
32:   public void initialize(ConfigurableApplicationContext context) {
33:     ConfigurableEnvironment environment = context.getEnvironment();
34:     if (!environment.getProperty(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED, Boolean.class, false)) {
35:       logger.debug("Apollo bootstrap config is not enabled for context {}, see property: ${{}}", context, PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED);
36:       return;
37:     }
38:     logger.debug("Apollo bootstrap config is enabled for context {}", context);
39:     initialize(environment);
40:   }
41:   protected void initialize(ConfigurableEnvironment environment) {
42:     if (environment.getPropertySources().contains(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME)) {
43:       return;
44:     }
45:     String namespaces = environment.getProperty(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_NAMESPACES, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION);
46:     logger.debug("Apollo bootstrap namespaces: {}", namespaces);
47:     List<String> namespaceList = NAMESPACE_SPLITTER.splitToList(namespaces);
48:     CompositePropertySource composite = new CompositePropertySource(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME);
49:     for (String namespace : namespaceList) {
50:       Config config = ConfigService.getConfig(namespace);
51:       composite.addPropertySource(configPropertySourceFactory.getConfigPropertySource(namespace, config));
52:     }
53:     environment.getPropertySources().addFirst(composite);
54:   }
55:   void initializeSystemProperty(ConfigurableEnvironment environment) {
56:     for (String propertyName : APOLLO_SYSTEM_PROPERTIES) {
57:       fillSystemPropertyFromEnvironment(environment, propertyName);
58:     }
59:   }
60:   private void fillSystemPropertyFromEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment environment, String propertyName) {
61:     if (System.getProperty(propertyName) != null) {
62:       return;
63:     }
64:     String propertyValue = environment.getProperty(propertyName);
65:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(propertyValue)) {
66:       return;
67:     }
68:     System.setProperty(propertyName, propertyValue);
69:   }
70:   @Override
71:   public void postProcessEnvironment(ConfigurableEnvironment configurableEnvironment, SpringApplication springApplication) {
72:     initializeSystemProperty(configurableEnvironment);
73:     Boolean eagerLoadEnabled = configurableEnvironment.getProperty(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_EAGER_LOAD_ENABLED, Boolean.class, false);
74:     if (!eagerLoadEnabled) {
75:       return;
76:     }
77:     Boolean bootstrapEnabled = configurableEnvironment.getProperty(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED, Boolean.class, false);
78:     if (bootstrapEnabled) {
79:       initialize(configurableEnvironment);
80:     }
81:   }
82:   @Override
83:   public int getOrder() {
84:     return order;
85:   }
86:   public void setOrder(int order) {
87:     this.order = order;
88:   }
89: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.config;

11: public class NamespaceHandler extends NamespaceHandlerSupport {
12:   private static final Splitter NAMESPACE_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings()
13:       .trimResults();
14:   @Override
15:   public void init() {
16:     registerBeanDefinitionParser("config", new BeanParser());
17:   }
18:   static class BeanParser extends AbstractSingleBeanDefinitionParser {
19:     @Override
20:     protected Class<?> getBeanClass(Element element) {
21:       return ConfigPropertySourcesProcessor.class;
22:     }
23:     @Override
24:     protected boolean shouldGenerateId() {
25:       return true;
26:     }
27:     private String resolveNamespaces(Element element) {
28:       String namespaces = element.getAttribute("namespaces");
29:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(namespaces)) {
30:         return ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION;
31:       }
32:       return SystemPropertyUtils.resolvePlaceholders(namespaces);
33:     }
34:     @Override
35:     protected void doParse(Element element, BeanDefinitionBuilder builder) {
36:       String namespaces = this.resolveNamespaces(element);
37:       int order = Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE;
38:       String orderAttribute = element.getAttribute("order");
39:       if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(orderAttribute)) {
40:         try {
41:           order = Integer.parseInt(orderAttribute);
42:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
43:           throw new IllegalArgumentException(
44:               String.format("Invalid order: %s for namespaces: %s", orderAttribute, namespaces));
45:         }
46:       }
47:       PropertySourcesProcessor.addNamespaces(NAMESPACE_SPLITTER.splitToList(namespaces), order);
48:     }
49:   }
50: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.config;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property.AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
  6: import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableSortedSet;
  7: import com.google.common.collect.LinkedHashMultimap;
  8: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Config;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigService;
 11: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 12: import java.util.List;
 13: import java.util.Set;
 14: import org.springframework.beans.BeansException;
 15: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactory;
 16: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanFactoryPostProcessor;
 17: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableListableBeanFactory;
 18: import org.springframework.context.EnvironmentAware;
 19: import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
 20: import org.springframework.core.PriorityOrdered;
 21: import org.springframework.core.env.CompositePropertySource;
 22: import org.springframework.core.env.ConfigurableEnvironment;
 23: import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
 24: import java.util.Collection;
 25: import java.util.Iterator;
 26: import org.springframework.core.env.MutablePropertySources;
 27: import org.springframework.core.env.PropertySource;
 28: public class PropertySourcesProcessor implements BeanFactoryPostProcessor, EnvironmentAware, PriorityOrdered {
 29:   private static final Multimap<Integer, String> NAMESPACE_NAMES = LinkedHashMultimap.create();
 30:   private static final Set<BeanFactory> AUTO_UPDATE_INITIALIZED_BEAN_FACTORIES = Sets.newConcurrentHashSet();
 31:   private final ConfigPropertySourceFactory configPropertySourceFactory = SpringInjector
 32:       .getInstance(ConfigPropertySourceFactory.class);
 33:   private final ConfigUtil configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 34:   private ConfigurableEnvironment environment;
 35:   public static boolean addNamespaces(Collection<String> namespaces, int order) {
 36:     return NAMESPACE_NAMES.putAll(order, namespaces);
 37:   }
 38:   @Override
 39:   public void postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory) throws BeansException {
 40:     initializePropertySources();
 41:     initializeAutoUpdatePropertiesFeature(beanFactory);
 42:   }
 43:   private void initializePropertySources() {
 44:     if (environment.getPropertySources().contains(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME)) {
 45:       return;
 46:     }
 47:     CompositePropertySource composite = new CompositePropertySource(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME);
 48:     ImmutableSortedSet<Integer> orders = ImmutableSortedSet.copyOf(NAMESPACE_NAMES.keySet());
 49:     Iterator<Integer> iterator = orders.iterator();
 50:     while (iterator.hasNext()) {
 51:       int order = iterator.next();
 52:       for (String namespace : NAMESPACE_NAMES.get(order)) {
 53:         Config config = ConfigService.getConfig(namespace);
 54:         composite.addPropertySource(configPropertySourceFactory.getConfigPropertySource(namespace, config));
 55:       }
 56:     }
 57:     NAMESPACE_NAMES.clear();
 58:     if (environment.getPropertySources()
 59:         .contains(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME)) {
 60:       ensureBootstrapPropertyPrecedence(environment);
 61:       environment.getPropertySources()
 62:           .addAfter(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME, composite);
 63:     } else {
 64:       environment.getPropertySources().addFirst(composite);
 65:     }
 66:   }
 67:   private void ensureBootstrapPropertyPrecedence(ConfigurableEnvironment environment) {
 68:     MutablePropertySources propertySources = environment.getPropertySources();
 69:     PropertySource<?> bootstrapPropertySource = propertySources
 70:         .get(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME);
 71:     if (bootstrapPropertySource == null || propertySources.precedenceOf(bootstrapPropertySource) == 0) {
 72:       return;
 73:     }
 74:     propertySources.remove(PropertySourcesConstants.APOLLO_BOOTSTRAP_PROPERTY_SOURCE_NAME);
 75:     propertySources.addFirst(bootstrapPropertySource);
 76:   }
 77:   private void initializeAutoUpdatePropertiesFeature(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory) {
 78:     if (!configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled() ||
 79:         !AUTO_UPDATE_INITIALIZED_BEAN_FACTORIES.add(beanFactory)) {
 80:       return;
 81:     }
 82:     AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener autoUpdateConfigChangeListener = new AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener(
 83:         environment, beanFactory);
 84:     List<ConfigPropertySource> configPropertySources = configPropertySourceFactory.getAllConfigPropertySources();
 85:     for (ConfigPropertySource configPropertySource : configPropertySources) {
 86:       configPropertySource.addChangeListener(autoUpdateConfigChangeListener);
 87:     }
 88:   }
 89:   @Override
 90:   public void setEnvironment(Environment environment) {
 91:     this.environment = (ConfigurableEnvironment) environment;
 92:   }
 93:   @Override
 94:   public int getOrder() {
 95:     return Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE;
 96:   }
 97:   static void reset() {
 98:     NAMESPACE_NAMES.clear();
 99:     AUTO_UPDATE_INITIALIZED_BEAN_FACTORIES.clear();
100:   }
101: }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/spring/property/AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigChangeListener;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChangeEvent;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
 5: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 6: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
 7: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 8: import java.util.Collection;
 9: import java.util.Set;
10: import org.slf4j.Logger;
11: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
12: import org.springframework.beans.TypeConverter;
13: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableBeanFactory;
14: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableListableBeanFactory;
15: import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
16: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
17: public class AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener implements ConfigChangeListener{
18:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener.class);
19:   private final boolean typeConverterHasConvertIfNecessaryWithFieldParameter;
20:   private final Environment environment;
21:   private final ConfigurableBeanFactory beanFactory;
22:   private final TypeConverter typeConverter;
23:   private final PlaceholderHelper placeholderHelper;
24:   private final SpringValueRegistry springValueRegistry;
25:   private final Gson gson;
26:   public AutoUpdateConfigChangeListener(Environment environment, ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory){
27:     this.typeConverterHasConvertIfNecessaryWithFieldParameter = testTypeConverterHasConvertIfNecessaryWithFieldParameter();
28:     this.beanFactory = beanFactory;
29:     this.typeConverter = this.beanFactory.getTypeConverter();
30:     this.environment = environment;
31:     this.placeholderHelper = SpringInjector.getInstance(PlaceholderHelper.class);
32:     this.springValueRegistry = SpringInjector.getInstance(SpringValueRegistry.class);
33:     this.gson = new Gson();
34:   }
35:   @Override
36:   public void onChange(ConfigChangeEvent changeEvent) {
37:     Set<String> keys = changeEvent.changedKeys();
38:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(keys)) {
39:       return;
40:     }
41:     for (String key : keys) {
42:       Collection<SpringValue> targetValues = springValueRegistry.get(beanFactory, key);
43:       if (targetValues == null || targetValues.isEmpty()) {
44:         continue;
45:       }
46:       for (SpringValue val : targetValues) {
47:         updateSpringValue(val);
48:       }
49:     }
50:   }
51:   private void updateSpringValue(SpringValue springValue) {
52:     try {
53:       Object value = resolvePropertyValue(springValue);
54:       springValue.update(value);
55:       logger.info("Auto update apollo changed value successfully, new value: {}, {}", value,
56:           springValue);
57:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
58:       logger.error("Auto update apollo changed value failed, {}", springValue.toString(), ex);
59:     }
60:   }
61:   private Object resolvePropertyValue(SpringValue springValue) {
62:     Object value = placeholderHelper
63:         .resolvePropertyValue(beanFactory, springValue.getBeanName(), springValue.getPlaceholder());
64:     if (springValue.isJson()) {
65:       value = parseJsonValue((String)value, springValue.getGenericType());
66:     } else {
67:       if (springValue.isField()) {
68:         if (typeConverterHasConvertIfNecessaryWithFieldParameter) {
69:           value = this.typeConverter
70:               .convertIfNecessary(value, springValue.getTargetType(), springValue.getField());
71:         } else {
72:           value = this.typeConverter.convertIfNecessary(value, springValue.getTargetType());
73:         }
74:       } else {
75:         value = this.typeConverter.convertIfNecessary(value, springValue.getTargetType(),
76:             springValue.getMethodParameter());
77:       }
78:     }
79:     return value;
80:   }
81:   private Object parseJsonValue(String json, Type targetType) {
82:     try {
83:       return gson.fromJson(json, targetType);
84:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
85:       logger.error("Parsing json '{}' to type {} failed!", json, targetType, ex);
86:       throw ex;
87:     }
88:   }
89:   private boolean testTypeConverterHasConvertIfNecessaryWithFieldParameter() {
90:     try {
91:       TypeConverter.class.getMethod("convertIfNecessary", Object.class, Class.class, Field.class);
92:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
93:       return false;
94:     }
95:     return true;
96:   }
97: }

================
File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/spring/property/PlaceholderHelper.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property;
  2: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
  3: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
  4: import java.util.Set;
  5: import java.util.Stack;
  6: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanDefinition;
  7: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanExpressionContext;
  8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableBeanFactory;
  9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.Scope;
 10: import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
 11: public class PlaceholderHelper {
 12:   private static final String PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX = "${";
 13:   private static final String PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX = "}";
 14:   private static final String VALUE_SEPARATOR = ":";
 15:   private static final String SIMPLE_PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX = "{";
 16:   private static final String EXPRESSION_PREFIX = "#{";
 17:   private static final String EXPRESSION_SUFFIX = "}";
 18:   public Object resolvePropertyValue(ConfigurableBeanFactory beanFactory, String beanName, String placeholder) {
 19:     String strVal = beanFactory.resolveEmbeddedValue(placeholder);
 20:     BeanDefinition bd = (beanFactory.containsBean(beanName) ? beanFactory
 21:         .getMergedBeanDefinition(beanName) : null);
 22:     return evaluateBeanDefinitionString(beanFactory, strVal, bd);
 23:   }
 24:   private Object evaluateBeanDefinitionString(ConfigurableBeanFactory beanFactory, String value,
 25:       BeanDefinition beanDefinition) {
 26:     if (beanFactory.getBeanExpressionResolver() == null) {
 27:       return value;
 28:     }
 29:     Scope scope = (beanDefinition != null ? beanFactory
 30:         .getRegisteredScope(beanDefinition.getScope()) : null);
 31:     return beanFactory.getBeanExpressionResolver()
 32:         .evaluate(value, new BeanExpressionContext(beanFactory, scope));
 33:   }
 34:   public Set<String> extractPlaceholderKeys(String propertyString) {
 35:     Set<String> placeholderKeys = Sets.newHashSet();
 36:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(propertyString) || (!isNormalizedPlaceholder(propertyString) && !isExpressionWithPlaceholder(propertyString))) {
 37:       return placeholderKeys;
 38:     }
 39:     Stack<String> stack = new Stack<>();
 40:     stack.push(propertyString);
 41:     while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
 42:       String strVal = stack.pop();
 43:       int startIndex = strVal.indexOf(PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX);
 44:       if (startIndex == -1) {
 45:         placeholderKeys.add(strVal);
 46:         continue;
 47:       }
 48:       int endIndex = findPlaceholderEndIndex(strVal, startIndex);
 49:       if (endIndex == -1) {
 50:         continue;
 51:       }
 52:       String placeholderCandidate = strVal.substring(startIndex + PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX.length(), endIndex);
 53:       if (placeholderCandidate.startsWith(PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX)) {
 54:         stack.push(placeholderCandidate);
 55:       } else {
 56:         int separatorIndex = placeholderCandidate.indexOf(VALUE_SEPARATOR);
 57:         if (separatorIndex == -1) {
 58:           stack.push(placeholderCandidate);
 59:         } else {
 60:           stack.push(placeholderCandidate.substring(0, separatorIndex));
 61:           String defaultValuePart =
 62:               normalizeToPlaceholder(placeholderCandidate.substring(separatorIndex + VALUE_SEPARATOR.length()));
 63:           if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(defaultValuePart)) {
 64:             stack.push(defaultValuePart);
 65:           }
 66:         }
 67:       }
 68:       if (endIndex + PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX.length() < strVal.length() - 1) {
 69:         String remainingPart = normalizeToPlaceholder(strVal.substring(endIndex + PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX.length()));
 70:         if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(remainingPart)) {
 71:           stack.push(remainingPart);
 72:         }
 73:       }
 74:     }
 75:     return placeholderKeys;
 76:   }
 77:   private boolean isNormalizedPlaceholder(String propertyString) {
 78:     return propertyString.startsWith(PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX) && propertyString.contains(PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX);
 79:   }
 80:   private boolean isExpressionWithPlaceholder(String propertyString) {
 81:     return propertyString.startsWith(EXPRESSION_PREFIX) && propertyString.contains(EXPRESSION_SUFFIX)
 82:         && propertyString.contains(PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX) && propertyString.contains(PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX);
 83:   }
 84:   private String normalizeToPlaceholder(String strVal) {
 85:     int startIndex = strVal.indexOf(PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX);
 86:     if (startIndex == -1) {
 87:       return null;
 88:     }
 89:     int endIndex = strVal.lastIndexOf(PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX);
 90:     if (endIndex == -1) {
 91:       return null;
 92:     }
 93:     return strVal.substring(startIndex, endIndex + PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX.length());
 94:   }
 95:   private int findPlaceholderEndIndex(CharSequence buf, int startIndex) {
 96:     int index = startIndex + PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX.length();
 97:     int withinNestedPlaceholder = 0;
 98:     while (index < buf.length()) {
 99:       if (StringUtils.substringMatch(buf, index, PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX)) {
100:         if (withinNestedPlaceholder > 0) {
101:           withinNestedPlaceholder--;
102:           index = index + PLACEHOLDER_SUFFIX.length();
103:         } else {
104:           return index;
105:         }
106:       } else if (StringUtils.substringMatch(buf, index, SIMPLE_PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX)) {
107:         withinNestedPlaceholder++;
108:         index = index + SIMPLE_PLACEHOLDER_PREFIX.length();
109:       } else {
110:         index++;
111:       }
112:     }
113:     return -1;
114:   }
115: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property;
  2: import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
  3: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
  4: import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
  5: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
  6: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
  7: import org.springframework.core.MethodParameter;
  8: public class SpringValue {
  9:   private MethodParameter methodParameter;
 10:   private Field field;
 11:   private WeakReference<Object> beanRef;
 12:   private String beanName;
 13:   private String key;
 14:   private String placeholder;
 15:   private Class<?> targetType;
 16:   private Type genericType;
 17:   private boolean isJson;
 18:   public SpringValue(String key, String placeholder, Object bean, String beanName, Field field, boolean isJson) {
 19:     this.beanRef = new WeakReference<>(bean);
 20:     this.beanName = beanName;
 21:     this.field = field;
 22:     this.key = key;
 23:     this.placeholder = placeholder;
 24:     this.targetType = field.getType();
 25:     this.isJson = isJson;
 26:     if(isJson){
 27:       this.genericType = field.getGenericType();
 28:     }
 29:   }
 30:   public SpringValue(String key, String placeholder, Object bean, String beanName, Method method, boolean isJson) {
 31:     this.beanRef = new WeakReference<>(bean);
 32:     this.beanName = beanName;
 33:     this.methodParameter = new MethodParameter(method, 0);
 34:     this.key = key;
 35:     this.placeholder = placeholder;
 36:     Class<?>[] paramTps = method.getParameterTypes();
 37:     this.targetType = paramTps[0];
 38:     this.isJson = isJson;
 39:     if(isJson){
 40:       this.genericType = method.getGenericParameterTypes()[0];
 41:     }
 42:   }
 43:   public void update(Object newVal) throws IllegalAccessException, InvocationTargetException {
 44:     if (isField()) {
 45:       injectField(newVal);
 46:     } else {
 47:       injectMethod(newVal);
 48:     }
 49:   }
 50:   private void injectField(Object newVal) throws IllegalAccessException {
 51:     Object bean = beanRef.get();
 52:     if (bean == null) {
 53:       return;
 54:     }
 55:     boolean accessible = field.isAccessible();
 56:     field.setAccessible(true);
 57:     field.set(bean, newVal);
 58:     field.setAccessible(accessible);
 59:   }
 60:   private void injectMethod(Object newVal)
 61:       throws InvocationTargetException, IllegalAccessException {
 62:     Object bean = beanRef.get();
 63:     if (bean == null) {
 64:       return;
 65:     }
 66:     methodParameter.getMethod().invoke(bean, newVal);
 67:   }
 68:   public String getBeanName() {
 69:     return beanName;
 70:   }
 71:   public Class<?> getTargetType() {
 72:     return targetType;
 73:   }
 74:   public String getPlaceholder() {
 75:     return this.placeholder;
 76:   }
 77:   public MethodParameter getMethodParameter() {
 78:     return methodParameter;
 79:   }
 80:   public boolean isField() {
 81:     return this.field != null;
 82:   }
 83:   public Field getField() {
 84:     return field;
 85:   }
 86:   public Type getGenericType() {
 87:     return genericType;
 88:   }
 89:   public boolean isJson() {
 90:     return isJson;
 91:   }
 92:   boolean isTargetBeanValid() {
 93:     return beanRef.get() != null;
 94:   }
 95:   @Override
 96:   public String toString() {
 97:     Object bean = beanRef.get();
 98:     if (bean == null) {
 99:       return "";
100:     }
101:     if (isField()) {
102:       return String
103:           .format("key: %s, beanName: %s, field: %s.%s", key, beanName, bean.getClass().getName(), field.getName());
104:     }
105:     return String.format("key: %s, beanName: %s, method: %s.%s", key, beanName, bean.getClass().getName(),
106:         methodParameter.getMethod().getName());
107:   }
108: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util.SpringInjector;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 4: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 5: import java.util.List;
 6: import java.util.Map;
 7: import java.util.Set;
 8: import org.springframework.beans.BeansException;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.MutablePropertyValues;
10: import org.springframework.beans.PropertyValue;
11: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanDefinition;
12: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.ConfigurableListableBeanFactory;
13: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.TypedStringValue;
14: import org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionRegistry;
15: import org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor;
16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
18: import com.google.common.collect.LinkedListMultimap;
19: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
20: public class SpringValueDefinitionProcessor implements BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor {
21:   private static final Map<BeanDefinitionRegistry, Multimap<String, SpringValueDefinition>> beanName2SpringValueDefinitions =
22:       Maps.newConcurrentMap();
23:   private static final Set<BeanDefinitionRegistry> PROPERTY_VALUES_PROCESSED_BEAN_FACTORIES = Sets.newConcurrentHashSet();
24:   private final ConfigUtil configUtil;
25:   private final PlaceholderHelper placeholderHelper;
26:   public SpringValueDefinitionProcessor() {
27:     configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
28:     placeholderHelper = SpringInjector.getInstance(PlaceholderHelper.class);
29:   }
30:   @Override
31:   public void postProcessBeanDefinitionRegistry(BeanDefinitionRegistry registry) throws BeansException {
32:     if (configUtil.isAutoUpdateInjectedSpringPropertiesEnabled()) {
33:       processPropertyValues(registry);
34:     }
35:   }
36:   @Override
37:   public void postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory) throws BeansException {
38:   }
39:   public static Multimap<String, SpringValueDefinition> getBeanName2SpringValueDefinitions(BeanDefinitionRegistry registry) {
40:     Multimap<String, SpringValueDefinition> springValueDefinitions = beanName2SpringValueDefinitions.get(registry);
41:     if (springValueDefinitions == null) {
42:       springValueDefinitions = LinkedListMultimap.create();
43:     }
44:     return springValueDefinitions;
45:   }
46:   private void processPropertyValues(BeanDefinitionRegistry beanRegistry) {
47:     if (!PROPERTY_VALUES_PROCESSED_BEAN_FACTORIES.add(beanRegistry)) {
48:       return;
49:     }
50:     if (!beanName2SpringValueDefinitions.containsKey(beanRegistry)) {
51:       beanName2SpringValueDefinitions.put(beanRegistry, LinkedListMultimap.<String, SpringValueDefinition>create());
52:     }
53:     Multimap<String, SpringValueDefinition> springValueDefinitions = beanName2SpringValueDefinitions.get(beanRegistry);
54:     String[] beanNames = beanRegistry.getBeanDefinitionNames();
55:     for (String beanName : beanNames) {
56:       BeanDefinition beanDefinition = beanRegistry.getBeanDefinition(beanName);
57:       MutablePropertyValues mutablePropertyValues = beanDefinition.getPropertyValues();
58:       List<PropertyValue> propertyValues = mutablePropertyValues.getPropertyValueList();
59:       for (PropertyValue propertyValue : propertyValues) {
60:         Object value = propertyValue.getValue();
61:         if (!(value instanceof TypedStringValue)) {
62:           continue;
63:         }
64:         String placeholder = ((TypedStringValue) value).getValue();
65:         Set<String> keys = placeholderHelper.extractPlaceholderKeys(placeholder);
66:         if (keys.isEmpty()) {
67:           continue;
68:         }
69:         for (String key : keys) {
70:           springValueDefinitions.put(beanName, new SpringValueDefinition(key, placeholder, propertyValue.getName()));
71:         }
72:       }
73:     }
74:   }
75: }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/spring/property/SpringValueRegistry.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.property;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.LinkedListMultimap;
 4: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 5: import com.google.common.collect.Multimap;
 6: import java.util.Collection;
 7: import java.util.Iterator;
 8: import java.util.Map;
 9: import java.util.Map.Entry;
10: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
11: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
12: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
13: import com.google.common.collect.Multimaps;
14: import org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactory;
15: public class SpringValueRegistry {
16:   private static final long CLEAN_INTERVAL_IN_SECONDS = 5;
17:   private final Map<BeanFactory, Multimap<String, SpringValue>> registry = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
18:   private final AtomicBoolean initialized = new AtomicBoolean(false);
19:   private final Object LOCK = new Object();
20:   public void register(BeanFactory beanFactory, String key, SpringValue springValue) {
21:     if (!registry.containsKey(beanFactory)) {
22:       synchronized (LOCK) {
23:         if (!registry.containsKey(beanFactory)) {
24:           registry.put(beanFactory, Multimaps.synchronizedListMultimap(LinkedListMultimap.<String, SpringValue>create()));
25:         }
26:       }
27:     }
28:     registry.get(beanFactory).put(key, springValue);
29:     if (initialized.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
30:       initialize();
31:     }
32:   }
33:   public Collection<SpringValue> get(BeanFactory beanFactory, String key) {
34:     Multimap<String, SpringValue> beanFactorySpringValues = registry.get(beanFactory);
35:     if (beanFactorySpringValues == null) {
36:       return null;
37:     }
38:     return beanFactorySpringValues.get(key);
39:   }
40:   private void initialize() {
41:     Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(ApolloThreadFactory.create("SpringValueRegistry", true)).scheduleAtFixedRate(
42:         new Runnable() {
43:           @Override
44:           public void run() {
45:             try {
46:               scanAndClean();
47:             } catch (Throwable ex) {
48:               ex.printStackTrace();
49:             }
50:           }
51:         }, CLEAN_INTERVAL_IN_SECONDS, CLEAN_INTERVAL_IN_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
52:   }
53:   private void scanAndClean() {
54:     Iterator<Multimap<String, SpringValue>> iterator = registry.values().iterator();
55:     while (!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() && iterator.hasNext()) {
56:       Multimap<String, SpringValue> springValues = iterator.next();
57:       Iterator<Entry<String, SpringValue>> springValueIterator = springValues.entries().iterator();
58:       while (springValueIterator.hasNext()) {
59:         Entry<String, SpringValue> springValue = springValueIterator.next();
60:         if (!springValue.getValue().isTargetBeanValid()) {
61:           springValueIterator.remove();
62:         }
63:       }
64:     }
65:   }
66: }

34:         ApolloAnnotationProcessor.class);
35:     BeanRegistrationUtil.registerBeanDefinitionIfNotExists(registry, SpringValueProcessor.class.getName(),
36:         SpringValueProcessor.class);
37:     BeanRegistrationUtil.registerBeanDefinitionIfNotExists(registry, SpringValueDefinitionProcessor.class.getName(),
38:         SpringValueDefinitionProcessor.class);
39:   }
40:   private String[] resolveNamespaces(String[] namespaces) {
41:     String[] resolvedNamespaces = new String[namespaces.length];
42:     for (int i = 0; i < namespaces.length; i++) {
43:       resolvedNamespaces[i] = this.environment.resolveRequiredPlaceholders(namespaces[i]);
44:     }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.spring.util;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: import java.util.Objects;
 4: import org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanDefinition;
 5: import org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionBuilder;
 6: import org.springframework.beans.factory.support.BeanDefinitionRegistry;
 7: public class BeanRegistrationUtil {
 8:   public static boolean registerBeanDefinitionIfNotExists(BeanDefinitionRegistry registry, String beanName,
 9:       Class<?> beanClass) {
10:     return registerBeanDefinitionIfNotExists(registry, beanName, beanClass, null);
11:   }
12:   public static boolean registerBeanDefinitionIfNotExists(BeanDefinitionRegistry registry, String beanName,
13:                                                           Class<?> beanClass, Map<String, Object> extraPropertyValues) {
14:     if (registry.containsBeanDefinition(beanName)) {
15:       return false;
16:     }
17:     String[] candidates = registry.getBeanDefinitionNames();
18:     for (String candidate : candidates) {
19:       BeanDefinition beanDefinition = registry.getBeanDefinition(candidate);
20:       if (Objects.equals(beanDefinition.getBeanClassName(), beanClass.getName())) {
21:         return false;
22:       }
23:     }
24:     BeanDefinition beanDefinition = BeanDefinitionBuilder.genericBeanDefinition(beanClass).getBeanDefinition();
25:     if (extraPropertyValues != null) {
26:       for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : extraPropertyValues.entrySet()) {
27:         beanDefinition.getPropertyValues().add(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
28:       }
29:     }
30:     registry.registerBeanDefinition(beanName, beanDefinition);
31:     return true;
32:   }
33: }

10: import com.google.inject.Singleton;
11: public class SpringInjector {
12:   private static volatile Injector s_injector;
13:   private static final Object lock = new Object();
14:   private static Injector getInjector() {
15:     if (s_injector == null) {
16:       synchronized (lock) {
17:         if (s_injector == null) {
18:           try {
19:             s_injector = Guice.createInjector(new SpringModule());
20:           } catch (Throwable ex) {
21:             ApolloConfigException exception = new ApolloConfigException("Unable to initialize Apollo Spring Injector!", ex);
22:             Tracer.logError(exception);
23:             throw exception;
24:           }
25:         }
26:       }
27:     }
28:     return s_injector;
29:   }
30:   public static <T> T getInstance(Class<T> clazz) {
31:     try {
32:       return getInjector().getInstance(clazz);
33:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
34:       Tracer.logError(ex);
35:       throw new ApolloConfigException(
36:           String.format("Unable to load instance for %s!", clazz.getName()), ex);
37:     }
38:   }
39:   private static class SpringModule extends AbstractModule {
40:     @Override
41:     protected void configure() {
42:       bind(PlaceholderHelper.class).in(Singleton.class);
43:       bind(ConfigPropertySourceFactory.class).in(Singleton.class);
44:       bind(SpringValueRegistry.class).in(Singleton.class);
45:     }
46:   }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/util/ExceptionUtil.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 4: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 5: public class ExceptionUtil {
 6:   public static String getDetailMessage(Throwable ex) {
 7:     if (ex == null || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(ex.getMessage())) {
 8:       return "";
 9:     }
10:     StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(ex.getMessage());
11:     List<Throwable> causes = Lists.newLinkedList();
12:     int counter = 0;
13:     Throwable current = ex;
14:     //retrieve up to 10 causes
15:     while (current.getCause() != null && counter < 10) {
16:       Throwable next = current.getCause();
17:       causes.add(next);
18:       current = next;
19:       counter++;
20:     }
21:     for (Throwable cause : causes) {
22:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(cause.getMessage())) {
23:         counter--;
24:         continue;
25:       }
26:       builder.append(" [Cause: ").append(cause.getMessage());
27:     }
28:     builder.append(Strings.repeat("]", counter));
29:     return builder.toString();
30:   }
31: }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/util/http/DefaultHttpClient.java
