  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.http;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.exceptions.ApolloConfigException;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.exceptions.ApolloConfigStatusCodeException;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.ConfigUtil;
  6: import com.google.common.base.Function;
  7: import com.google.common.io.CharStreams;
  8: import com.google.gson.Gson;
  9: import java.io.IOException;
 10: import java.io.InputStream;
 11: import java.io.InputStreamReader;
 12: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 13: import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
 14: import java.net.URL;
 15: import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
 16: import java.util.Map;
 17: public class DefaultHttpClient implements HttpClient {
 18:   private ConfigUtil m_configUtil;
 19:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 20:   public DefaultHttpClient() {
 21:     m_configUtil = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigUtil.class);
 22:   }
 23:   @Override
 24:   public <T> HttpResponse<T> doGet(HttpRequest httpRequest, final Class<T> responseType) {
 25:     Function<String, T> convertResponse = new Function<String, T>() {
 26:       @Override
 27:       public T apply(String input) {
 28:         return GSON.fromJson(input, responseType);
 29:       }
 30:     };
 31:     return doGetWithSerializeFunction(httpRequest, convertResponse);
 32:   }
 33:   @Override
 34:   public <T> HttpResponse<T> doGet(HttpRequest httpRequest, final Type responseType) {
 35:     Function<String, T> convertResponse = new Function<String, T>() {
 36:       @Override
 37:       public T apply(String input) {
 38:         return GSON.fromJson(input, responseType);
 39:       }
 40:     };
 41:     return doGetWithSerializeFunction(httpRequest, convertResponse);
 42:   }
 43:   private <T> HttpResponse<T> doGetWithSerializeFunction(HttpRequest httpRequest,
 44:                                                          Function<String, T> serializeFunction) {
 45:     InputStreamReader isr = null;
 46:     InputStreamReader esr = null;
 47:     int statusCode;
 48:     try {
 49:       HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(httpRequest.getUrl()).openConnection();
 50:       conn.setRequestMethod("GET");
 51:       Map<String, String> headers = httpRequest.getHeaders();
 52:       if (headers != null && headers.size() > 0) {
 53:         for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : headers.entrySet()) {
 54:           conn.setRequestProperty(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
 55:         }
 56:       }
 57:       int connectTimeout = httpRequest.getConnectTimeout();
 58:       if (connectTimeout < 0) {
 59:         connectTimeout = m_configUtil.getConnectTimeout();
 60:       }
 61:       int readTimeout = httpRequest.getReadTimeout();
 62:       if (readTimeout < 0) {
 63:         readTimeout = m_configUtil.getReadTimeout();
 64:       }
 65:       conn.setConnectTimeout(connectTimeout);
 66:       conn.setReadTimeout(readTimeout);
 67:       conn.connect();
 68:       statusCode = conn.getResponseCode();
 69:       String response;
 70:       try {
 71:         isr = new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
 72:         response = CharStreams.toString(isr);
 73:       } catch (IOException ex) {
 74:         InputStream errorStream = conn.getErrorStream();
 75:         if (errorStream != null) {
 76:           esr = new InputStreamReader(errorStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
 77:           try {
 78:             CharStreams.toString(esr);
 79:           } catch (IOException ioe) {
 80:           }
 81:         }
 82:         if (statusCode == 200 || statusCode == 304) {
 83:           throw ex;
 84:         }
 85:         throw new ApolloConfigStatusCodeException(statusCode, ex);
 86:       }
 87:       if (statusCode == 200) {
 88:         return new HttpResponse<>(statusCode, serializeFunction.apply(response));
 89:       }
 90:       if (statusCode == 304) {
 91:         return new HttpResponse<>(statusCode, null);
 92:       }
 93:     } catch (ApolloConfigStatusCodeException ex) {
 94:       throw ex;
 95:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 96:       throw new ApolloConfigException("Could not complete get operation", ex);
 97:     } finally {
 98:       if (isr != null) {
 99:         try {
100:           isr.close();
101:         } catch (IOException ex) {
102:         }
103:       }
104:       if (esr != null) {
105:         try {
106:           esr.close();
107:         } catch (IOException ex) {
108:         }
109:       }
110:     }
111:     throw new ApolloConfigStatusCodeException(statusCode,
112:         String.format("Get operation failed for %s", httpRequest.getUrl()));
113:   }
114: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util;
 2: import java.util.Collections;
 3: import java.util.Enumeration;
 4: import java.util.Iterator;
 5: import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
 6: import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
 7: import java.util.Map;
 8: import java.util.Map.Entry;
 9: import java.util.Properties;
10: import java.util.Set;
11: public class OrderedProperties extends Properties {
12:   private static final long serialVersionUID = -1741073539526213291L;
13:   private final Set<String> propertyNames;
14:   public OrderedProperties() {
15:     propertyNames = Collections.synchronizedSet(new LinkedHashSet<String>());
16:   }
17:   @Override
18:   public synchronized Object put(Object key, Object value) {
19:     addPropertyName(key);
20:     return super.put(key, value);
21:   }
22:   private void addPropertyName(Object key) {
23:     if (key instanceof String) {
24:       propertyNames.add((String) key);
25:     }
26:   }
27:   @Override
28:   public Set<String> stringPropertyNames() {
29:     return propertyNames;
30:   }
31:   @Override
32:   public Enumeration<?> propertyNames() {
33:     return Collections.enumeration(propertyNames);
34:   }
35:   @Override
36:   public synchronized Enumeration<Object> keys() {
37:     return new Enumeration<Object>() {
38:       private final Iterator<String> i = propertyNames.iterator();
39:       @Override
40:       public boolean hasMoreElements() {
41:         return i.hasNext();
42:       }
43:       @Override
44:       public Object nextElement() {
45:         return i.next();
46:       }
47:     };
48:   }
49:   @Override
50:   public Set<Object> keySet() {
51:     return new LinkedHashSet<Object>(propertyNames);
52:   }
53:   @Override
54:   public Set<Entry<Object, Object>> entrySet() {
55:     Set<Entry<Object, Object>> original = super.entrySet();
56:     LinkedHashMap<Object, Entry<Object, Object>> entryMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
57:     for (String propertyName : propertyNames) {
58:       entryMap.put(propertyName, null);
59:     }
60:     for (Entry<Object, Object> entry : original) {
61:       entryMap.put(entry.getKey(), entry);
62:     }
63:     return new LinkedHashSet<>(entryMap.values());
64:   }
65:   @Override
66:   public synchronized void putAll(Map<?, ?> t) {
67:     super.putAll(t);
68:     for (Object name : t.keySet()) {
69:       addPropertyName(name);
70:     }
71:   }
72:   @Override
73:   public synchronized void clear() {
74:     super.clear();
75:     this.propertyNames.clear();
76:   }
77:   @Override
78:   public synchronized Object remove(Object key) {
79:     if (key instanceof String) {
80:       this.propertyNames.remove(key);
81:     }
82:     return super.remove(key);
83:   }
84: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.parser;
 2: import java.text.ParseException;
 3: import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
 4: import java.util.Date;
 5: import java.util.Locale;
 6: import java.util.regex.Matcher;
 7: import java.util.regex.Pattern;
 8: public class Parsers {
 9:   public static DateParser forDate() {
10:     return DateParser.INSTANCE;
11:   }
12:   public static DurationParser forDuration() {
13:     return DurationParser.INSTANCE;
14:   }
15:   public enum DateParser {
16:     INSTANCE;
17:     private static final String LONG_DATE_FORMAT = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS";
18:     private static final String MEDIUM_DATE_FORMAT = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss";
19:     private static final String SHORT_DATE_FORMAT = "yyyy-MM-dd";
20:     public Date parse(String text) throws ParserException {
21:       text = text.trim();
22:       int length = text.length();
23:       if (length == LONG_DATE_FORMAT.length()) {
24:         return parse(text, LONG_DATE_FORMAT);
25:       }
26:       if (length == MEDIUM_DATE_FORMAT.length()) {
27:         return parse(text, MEDIUM_DATE_FORMAT);
28:       }
29:       return parse(text, SHORT_DATE_FORMAT);
30:     }
31:     public Date parse(String text, String format) throws ParserException {
32:       return parse(text, format, Locale.US);
33:     }
34:     public Date parse(String text, String format, Locale locale) throws ParserException {
35:       SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = getDateFormat(format, locale);
36:       try {
37:         return dateFormat.parse(text.trim());
38:       } catch (ParseException e) {
39:         throw new ParserException("Error when parsing date(" + dateFormat.toPattern() + ") from " + text, e);
40:       }
41:     }
42:     private SimpleDateFormat getDateFormat(String format, Locale locale) {
43:       return new SimpleDateFormat(format, locale);
44:     }
45:   }
46:   public enum DurationParser {
47:     INSTANCE;
48:     private static final Pattern PATTERN =
49:         Pattern.compile("(?:([0-9]+)D)?(?:([0-9]+)H)?(?:([0-9]+)M)?(?:([0-9]+)S)?(?:([0-9]+)(?:MS)?)?",
50:             Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
51:     private static final int HOURS_PER_DAY = 24;
52:     private static final int MINUTES_PER_HOUR = 60;
53:     private static final int SECONDS_PER_MINUTE = 60;
54:     private static final int MILLIS_PER_SECOND = 1000;
55:     private static final int MILLIS_PER_MINUTE = MILLIS_PER_SECOND * SECONDS_PER_MINUTE;
56:     private static final int MILLIS_PER_HOUR = MILLIS_PER_MINUTE * MINUTES_PER_HOUR;
57:     private static final int MILLIS_PER_DAY = MILLIS_PER_HOUR * HOURS_PER_DAY;
58:     public long parseToMillis(String text) throws ParserException {
59:       Matcher matcher = PATTERN.matcher(text);
60:       if (matcher.matches()) {
61:         String dayMatch = matcher.group(1);
62:         String hourMatch = matcher.group(2);
63:         String minuteMatch = matcher.group(3);
64:         String secondMatch = matcher.group(4);
65:         String fractionMatch = matcher.group(5);
66:         if (dayMatch != null || hourMatch != null || minuteMatch != null || secondMatch != null || fractionMatch != null) {
67:           int daysAsMilliSecs = parseNumber(dayMatch, MILLIS_PER_DAY);
68:           int hoursAsMilliSecs = parseNumber(hourMatch, MILLIS_PER_HOUR);
69:           int minutesAsMilliSecs = parseNumber(minuteMatch, MILLIS_PER_MINUTE);
70:           int secondsAsMilliSecs = parseNumber(secondMatch, MILLIS_PER_SECOND);
71:           int milliseconds = parseNumber(fractionMatch, 1);
72:           return daysAsMilliSecs + hoursAsMilliSecs + minutesAsMilliSecs + secondsAsMilliSecs + milliseconds;
73:         }
74:       }
75:       throw new ParserException(String.format("Text %s cannot be parsed to duration)", text));
76:     }
77:     private static int parseNumber(String parsed, int multiplier) {
78:       if (parsed == null || parsed.trim().isEmpty()) {
79:         return 0;
80:       }
81:       return Integer.parseInt(parsed) * multiplier;
82:     }
83:   }
84: }

File: apollo-client/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/util/yaml/YamlParser.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.yaml;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.util.factory.PropertiesFactory;
  4: import java.util.AbstractMap;
  5: import java.util.Collection;
  6: import java.util.Collections;
  7: import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
  8: import java.util.Map;
  9: import java.util.Properties;
 10: import java.util.Set;
 11: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 12: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 13: import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;
 14: import org.yaml.snakeyaml.constructor.SafeConstructor;
 15: import org.yaml.snakeyaml.nodes.MappingNode;
 16: import org.yaml.snakeyaml.parser.ParserException;
 17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 18: public class YamlParser {
 19:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(YamlParser.class);
 20:   private PropertiesFactory propertiesFactory = ApolloInjector.getInstance(PropertiesFactory.class);
 21:   public Properties yamlToProperties(String yamlContent) {
 22:     Yaml yaml = createYaml();
 23:     final Properties result = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
 24:     process(new MatchCallback() {
 25:       @Override
 26:       public void process(Properties properties, Map<String, Object> map) {
 27:         result.putAll(properties);
 28:       }
 29:     }, yaml, yamlContent);
 30:     return result;
 31:   }
 32:   private Yaml createYaml() {
 33:     return new Yaml(new StrictMapAppenderConstructor());
 34:   }
 35:   private boolean process(MatchCallback callback, Yaml yaml, String content) {
 36:     int count = 0;
 37:     if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
 38:       logger.debug("Loading from YAML: " + content);
 39:     }
 40:     for (Object object : yaml.loadAll(content)) {
 41:       if (object != null && process(asMap(object), callback)) {
 42:         count++;
 43:       }
 44:     }
 45:     if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
 46:       logger.debug("Loaded " + count + " document" + (count > 1 ? "s" : "") + " from YAML resource: " + content);
 47:     }
 48:     return (count > 0);
 49:   }
 50:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 51:   private Map<String, Object> asMap(Object object) {
 52:     Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 53:     if (!(object instanceof Map)) {
 54:       result.put("document", object);
 55:       return result;
 56:     }
 57:     Map<Object, Object> map = (Map<Object, Object>) object;
 58:     for (Map.Entry<Object, Object> entry : map.entrySet()) {
 59:       Object value = entry.getValue();
 60:       if (value instanceof Map) {
 61:         value = asMap(value);
 62:       }
 63:       Object key = entry.getKey();
 64:       if (key instanceof CharSequence) {
 65:         result.put(key.toString(), value);
 66:       } else {
 67:         result.put("[" + key.toString() + "]", value);
 68:       }
 69:     }
 70:     return result;
 71:   }
 72:   private boolean process(Map<String, Object> map, MatchCallback callback) {
 73:     Properties properties = propertiesFactory.getPropertiesInstance();
 74:     properties.putAll(getFlattenedMap(map));
 75:     if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
 76:       logger.debug("Merging document (no matchers set): " + map);
 77:     }
 78:     callback.process(properties, map);
 79:     return true;
 80:   }
 81:   private Map<String, Object> getFlattenedMap(Map<String, Object> source) {
 82:     Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 83:     buildFlattenedMap(result, source, null);
 84:     return result;
 85:   }
 86:   private void buildFlattenedMap(Map<String, Object> result, Map<String, Object> source, String path) {
 87:     for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : source.entrySet()) {
 88:       String key = entry.getKey();
 89:       if (!StringUtils.isBlank(path)) {
 90:         if (key.startsWith("[")) {
 91:           key = path + key;
 92:         } else {
 93:           key = path + '.' + key;
 94:         }
 95:       }
 96:       Object value = entry.getValue();
 97:       if (value instanceof String) {
 98:         result.put(key, value);
 99:       } else if (value instanceof Map) {
100:         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
101:         Map<String, Object> map = (Map<String, Object>) value;
102:         buildFlattenedMap(result, map, key);
103:       } else if (value instanceof Collection) {
104:         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
105:         Collection<Object> collection = (Collection<Object>) value;
106:         int count = 0;
107:         for (Object object : collection) {
108:           buildFlattenedMap(result, Collections.singletonMap("[" + (count++) + "]", object), key);
109:         }
110:       } else {
111:         result.put(key, (value != null ? value.toString() : ""));
112:       }
113:     }
114:   }
115:   private interface MatchCallback {
116:     void process(Properties properties, Map<String, Object> map);
117:   }
118:   /**
119:    * A specialized {@link SafeConstructor} that checks for duplicate keys.
120:    */
121:   private static class StrictMapAppenderConstructor extends SafeConstructor {
122:     // Declared as public for use in subclasses
123:     StrictMapAppenderConstructor() {
124:       super();
125:     }
126:     @Override
127:     protected Map<Object, Object> constructMapping(MappingNode node) {
128:       try {
129:         return super.constructMapping(node);
130:       } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
131:         throw new ParserException("while parsing MappingNode", node.getStartMark(), ex.getMessage(), node.getEndMark());
132:       }
133:     }
134:     @Override
135:     protected Map<Object, Object> createDefaultMap() {
136:       final Map<Object, Object> delegate = super.createDefaultMap();
137:       return new AbstractMap<Object, Object>() {
138:         @Override
139:         public Object put(Object key, Object value) {
140:           if (delegate.containsKey(key)) {
141:             throw new IllegalStateException("Duplicate key: " + key);
142:           }
143:           return delegate.put(key, value);
144:         }
145:         @Override
146:         public Set<Entry<Object, Object>> entrySet() {
147:           return delegate.entrySet();
148:         }
149:       };
150:     }
151:   }
152: }

================
File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/condition/OnProfileCondition.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.condition;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 3: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Condition;
 4: import org.springframework.context.annotation.ConditionContext;
 5: import org.springframework.core.type.AnnotatedTypeMetadata;
 6: import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;
 7: import java.util.Collections;
 8: import java.util.List;
 9: import java.util.Set;
10: public class OnProfileCondition implements Condition {
11:   @Override
12:   public boolean matches(ConditionContext context, AnnotatedTypeMetadata metadata) {
13:     Set<String> activeProfiles = Sets.newHashSet(context.getEnvironment().getActiveProfiles());
14:     Set<String> requiredActiveProfiles = retrieveAnnotatedProfiles(metadata, ConditionalOnProfile.class.getName());
15:     Set<String> requiredInactiveProfiles = retrieveAnnotatedProfiles(metadata, ConditionalOnMissingProfile.class
16:         .getName());
17:     return Sets.difference(requiredActiveProfiles, activeProfiles).isEmpty()
18:         && Sets.intersection(requiredInactiveProfiles, activeProfiles).isEmpty();
19:   }
20:   private Set<String> retrieveAnnotatedProfiles(AnnotatedTypeMetadata metadata, String annotationType) {
21:     if (!metadata.isAnnotated(annotationType)) {
22:       return Collections.emptySet();
23:     }
24:     MultiValueMap<String, Object> attributes = metadata.getAllAnnotationAttributes(annotationType);
25:     if (attributes == null) {
26:       return Collections.emptySet();
27:     }
28:     Set<String> profiles = Sets.newHashSet();
29:     List<?> values = attributes.get("value");
30:     if (values != null) {
31:       for (Object value : values) {
32:         if (value instanceof String[]) {
33:           Collections.addAll(profiles, (String[]) value);
34:         }
35:         else {
36:           profiles.add((String) value);
37:         }
38:       }
39:     }
40:     return profiles;
41:   }
42: }

File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/config/RefreshableConfig.java

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.config;
 2: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
 3: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 9: import org.springframework.core.env.ConfigurableEnvironment;
10: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
11: import java.util.List;
12: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
13: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
14: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
15: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
16: public abstract class RefreshableConfig {
17:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RefreshableConfig.class);
18:   private static final String LIST_SEPARATOR = ",";
19:   private static final int CONFIG_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 60;
20:   protected Splitter splitter = Splitter.on(LIST_SEPARATOR).omitEmptyStrings().trimResults();
21:   @Autowired
22:   private ConfigurableEnvironment environment;
23:   private List<RefreshablePropertySource> propertySources;
24:   protected abstract List<RefreshablePropertySource> getRefreshablePropertySources();
25:   @PostConstruct
26:   public void setup() {
27:     propertySources = getRefreshablePropertySources();
28:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(propertySources)) {
29:       throw new IllegalStateException("Property sources can not be empty.");
30:     }
31:     for (RefreshablePropertySource propertySource : propertySources) {
32:       propertySource.refresh();
33:       environment.getPropertySources().addLast(propertySource);
34:     }
35:     ScheduledExecutorService
36:         executorService =
37:         Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory.create("ConfigRefresher", true));
38:     executorService
39:         .scheduleWithFixedDelay(() -> {
40:           try {
41:             propertySources.forEach(RefreshablePropertySource::refresh);
42:           } catch (Throwable t) {
43:             logger.error("Refresh configs failed.", t);
44:             Tracer.logError("Refresh configs failed.", t);
45:           }
46:         }, CONFIG_REFRESH_INTERVAL, CONFIG_REFRESH_INTERVAL, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
47:   }
48:   public int getIntProperty(String key, int defaultValue) {
49:     try {
50:       String value = getValue(key);
51:       return value == null ? defaultValue : Integer.parseInt(value);
52:     } catch (Throwable e) {
53:       Tracer.logError("Get int property failed.", e);
54:       return defaultValue;
55:     }
56:   }
57:   public boolean getBooleanProperty(String key, boolean defaultValue) {
58:     try {
59:       String value = getValue(key);
60:       return value == null ? defaultValue : "true".equals(value);
61:     } catch (Throwable e) {
62:       Tracer.logError("Get boolean property failed.", e);
63:       return defaultValue;
64:     }
65:   }
66:   public String[] getArrayProperty(String key, String[] defaultValue) {
67:     try {
68:       String value = getValue(key);
69:       return Strings.isNullOrEmpty(value) ? defaultValue : value.split(LIST_SEPARATOR);
70:     } catch (Throwable e) {
71:       Tracer.logError("Get array property failed.", e);
72:       return defaultValue;
73:     }
74:   }
75:   public String getValue(String key, String defaultValue) {
76:     try {
77:       return environment.getProperty(key, defaultValue);
78:     } catch (Throwable e) {
79:       Tracer.logError("Get value failed.", e);
80:       return defaultValue;
81:     }
82:   }
83:   public String getValue(String key) {
84:     return environment.getProperty(key);
85:   }
86: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.controller;

  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;

  6: import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken;
  7: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
  8: import java.time.LocalDateTime;
  9: import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
 10: import java.util.HashMap;
 11: import java.util.Map;
 12: import java.util.Optional;
 13: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 14: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 15: import javax.validation.ConstraintViolationException;
 16: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 17: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 18: import org.slf4j.event.Level;
 19: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
 20: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
 21: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
 22: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
 23: import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
 24: import org.springframework.validation.ObjectError;
 25: import org.springframework.web.HttpMediaTypeException;
 26: import org.springframework.web.HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException;
 27: import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
 28: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice;
 29: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
 30: import org.springframework.web.client.HttpStatusCodeException;
 31: import static org.slf4j.event.Level.ERROR;
 32: import static org.slf4j.event.Level.WARN;
 33: import static org.springframework.http.HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST;
 34: import static org.springframework.http.HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN;
 35: import static org.springframework.http.HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
 36: @ControllerAdvice
 37: public class GlobalDefaultExceptionHandler {
 38:   private Gson gson = new Gson();
 39:   private static Type mapType = new TypeToken<Map<String, Object>>() {
 40:   }.getType();
 41:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GlobalDefaultExceptionHandler.class);
 42:   @ExceptionHandler(Throwable.class)
 43:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> exception(HttpServletRequest request, Throwable ex) {
 44:     return handleError(request, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, ex);
 45:   }
 46:   @ExceptionHandler({HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class, HttpMediaTypeException.class})
 47:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> badRequest(HttpServletRequest request,
 48:                                                         ServletException ex) {
 49:     return handleError(request, BAD_REQUEST, ex, WARN);
 50:   }
 51:   @ExceptionHandler(HttpStatusCodeException.class)
 52:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> restTemplateException(HttpServletRequest request,
 53:                                                                    HttpStatusCodeException ex) {
 54:     return handleError(request, ex.getStatusCode(), ex);
 55:   }
 56:   @ExceptionHandler(AccessDeniedException.class)
 57:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> accessDeny(HttpServletRequest request,
 58:                                                         AccessDeniedException ex) {
 59:     return handleError(request, FORBIDDEN, ex);
 60:   }
 61:   @ExceptionHandler({AbstractApolloHttpException.class})
 62:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> badRequest(HttpServletRequest request, AbstractApolloHttpException ex) {
 63:     return handleError(request, ex.getHttpStatus(), ex);
 64:   }
 65:   @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
 66:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleMethodArgumentNotValidException(
 67:       HttpServletRequest request, MethodArgumentNotValidException ex
 68:   ) {
 69:     final Optional<ObjectError> firstError = ex.getBindingResult().getAllErrors().stream().findFirst();
 70:     if (firstError.isPresent()) {
 71:       final String firstErrorMessage = firstError.get().getDefaultMessage();
 72:       return handleError(request, BAD_REQUEST, new BadRequestException(firstErrorMessage));
 73:     }
 74:     return handleError(request, BAD_REQUEST, ex);
 75:   }
 76:   @ExceptionHandler(ConstraintViolationException.class)
 77:   public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleConstraintViolationException(
 78:       HttpServletRequest request, ConstraintViolationException ex
 79:   ) {
 80:     return handleError(request, BAD_REQUEST, new BadRequestException(ex.getMessage()));
 81:   }
 82:   private ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleError(HttpServletRequest request,
 83:                                                           HttpStatus status, Throwable ex) {
 84:     return handleError(request, status, ex, ERROR);
 85:   }
 86:   private ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> handleError(HttpServletRequest request,
 87:                                                           HttpStatus status, Throwable ex, Level logLevel) {
 88:     String message = ex.getMessage();
 89:     printLog(message, ex, logLevel);
 90:     Map<String, Object> errorAttributes = new HashMap<>();
 91:     boolean errorHandled = false;
 92:     if (ex instanceof HttpStatusCodeException) {
 93:       try {
 94:         errorAttributes = gson.fromJson(((HttpStatusCodeException) ex).getResponseBodyAsString(), mapType);
 95:         status = ((HttpStatusCodeException) ex).getStatusCode();
 96:         errorHandled = true;
 97:       } catch (Throwable th) {
 98:       }
 99:     }
100:     if (!errorHandled) {
101:       errorAttributes.put("status", status.value());
102:       errorAttributes.put("message", message);
103:       errorAttributes.put("timestamp",
104:           LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME));
105:       errorAttributes.put("exception", ex.getClass().getName());
106:     }
107:     HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
108:     headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_UTF8);
109:     return new ResponseEntity<>(errorAttributes, headers, status);
110:   }
111:   private void printLog(String message, Throwable ex, Level logLevel) {
112:     switch (logLevel) {
113:       case ERROR:
114:         logger.error(message, ex);
115:         break;
116:       case WARN:
117:         logger.warn(message, ex);
118:         break;
119:       case DEBUG:
120:         logger.debug(message, ex);
121:         break;
122:       case INFO:
123:         logger.info(message, ex);
124:         break;
125:       case TRACE:
126:         logger.trace(message, ex);
127:         break;
128:     }
129:     Tracer.logError(ex);
130:   }
131: }

File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/customize/LoggingCustomizer.java

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.customize;
 2: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.Foundation;
 5: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7: import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
 8: import org.springframework.util.ClassUtils;
 9: import org.springframework.util.ReflectionUtils;
10: import ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext;
11: import ch.qos.logback.core.Appender;
12: public abstract class LoggingCustomizer implements InitializingBean {
13:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(LoggingCustomizer.class);
14:   private static final String cLoggingAppenderClass =
15:       "com.ctrip.framework.clogging.agent.appender.CLoggingAppender";
16:   private static boolean cLoggingAppenderPresent =
17:       ClassUtils.isPresent(cLoggingAppenderClass, LoggingCustomizer.class.getClassLoader());
18:   @Override
19:   public void afterPropertiesSet() {
20:     if (!cLoggingAppenderPresent) {
21:       return;
22:     }
23:     try {
24:       tryConfigCLogging();
25:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
26:       logger.error("Config CLogging failed", ex);
27:       Tracer.logError(ex);
28:     }
29:   }
30:   private void tryConfigCLogging() throws Exception {
31:     String appId = Foundation.app().getAppId();
32:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(appId)) {
33:       logger.warn("App id is null or empty!");
34:       return;
35:     }
36:     LoggerContext loggerContext = (LoggerContext) LoggerFactory.getILoggerFactory();
37:     Class clazz = Class.forName(cLoggingAppenderClass);
38:     Appender cLoggingAppender = (Appender) clazz.newInstance();
39:     ReflectionUtils.findMethod(clazz, "setAppId", String.class).invoke(cLoggingAppender, appId);
40:     ReflectionUtils.findMethod(clazz, "setServerIp", String.class)
41:         .invoke(cLoggingAppender, cloggingUrl());
42:     ReflectionUtils.findMethod(clazz, "setServerPort", int.class)
43:         .invoke(cLoggingAppender, Integer.parseInt(cloggingPort()));
44:     cLoggingAppender.setName("CentralLogging");
45:     cLoggingAppender.setContext(loggerContext);
46:     cLoggingAppender.start();
47:     ch.qos.logback.classic.Logger logger =
48:         (ch.qos.logback.classic.Logger) LoggerFactory.getLogger("root");
49:     logger.addAppender(cLoggingAppender);
50:   }
51:   protected abstract String cloggingUrl();
52:   protected abstract String cloggingPort();
53: }

File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/dto/GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO.java

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 3: import java.util.Set;
 4: import static com.google.common.base.MoreObjects.toStringHelper;
 5: public class GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO {
 6:   public static final String ALL_IP = "*";
 7:   private String clientAppId;
 8:   private Set<String> clientIpList;
 9:   public GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO(String clientAppId) {
10:     this(clientAppId, Sets.newHashSet());
11:   }
12:   public GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO(String clientAppId, Set<String> clientIpList) {
13:     this.clientAppId = clientAppId;
14:     this.clientIpList = clientIpList;
15:   }
16:   public String getClientAppId() {
17:     return clientAppId;
18:   }
19:   public Set<String> getClientIpList() {
20:     return clientIpList;
21:   }
22:   public boolean matches(String clientAppId, String clientIp) {
23:     return appIdMatches(clientAppId) && ipMatches(clientIp);
24:   }
25:   private boolean appIdMatches(String clientAppId) {
26:     return this.clientAppId.equalsIgnoreCase(clientAppId);
27:   }
28:   private boolean ipMatches(String clientIp) {
29:     return this.clientIpList.contains(ALL_IP) || clientIpList.contains(clientIp);
30:   }
31:   @Override
32:   public String toString() {
33:     return toStringHelper(this).add("clientAppId", clientAppId)
34:         .add("clientIpList", clientIpList).toString();
35:   }
36: }

 4: import java.util.List;
 5: public class PageDTO<T> {
 6:   private final long total;
 7:   private final List<T> content;
 8:   private final int page;
 9:   private final int size;
10:   public PageDTO(List<T> content, Pageable pageable, long total) {
11:     this.total = total;
12:     this.content = content;
13:     this.page = pageable.getPageNumber();
14:     this.size = pageable.getPageSize();
15:   }

17:     return total;
18:   }
19:   public List<T> getContent() {
20:     return Collections.unmodifiableList(content);
21:   }
22:   public int getPage() {
23:     return page;
24:   }
25:   public int getSize() {
26:     return size;
27:   }
28:   public boolean hasContent(){
29:     return content != null && content.size() > 0;
30:   }
31: }

File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/utils/BeanUtils.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BeanUtilsException;
  3: import org.springframework.beans.BeanWrapper;
  4: import org.springframework.beans.BeanWrapperImpl;
  5: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
  6: import java.beans.PropertyDescriptor;
  7: import java.lang.reflect.Field;
  8: import java.util.ArrayList;
  9: import java.util.Collections;
 10: import java.util.HashMap;
 11: import java.util.HashSet;
 12: import java.util.List;
 13: import java.util.Map;
 14: import java.util.Set;
 15: public class BeanUtils {
 16:   public static <T> List<T> batchTransform(final Class<T> clazz, List<?> srcList) {
 17:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(srcList)) {
 18:       return Collections.emptyList();
 19:     }
 20:     List<T> result = new ArrayList<>(srcList.size());
 21:     for (Object srcObject : srcList) {
 22:       result.add(transform(clazz, srcObject));
 23:     }
 24:     return result;
 25:   }
 26:   public static <T> T transform(Class<T> clazz, Object src) {
 27:     if (src == null) {
 28:       return null;
 29:     }
 30:     T instance;
 31:     try {
 32:       instance = clazz.newInstance();
 33:     } catch (Exception e) {
 34:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
 35:     }
 36:     org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils.copyProperties(src, instance, getNullPropertyNames(src));
 37:     return instance;
 38:   }
 39:   private static String[] getNullPropertyNames(Object source) {
 40:     final BeanWrapper src = new BeanWrapperImpl(source);
 41:     PropertyDescriptor[] pds = src.getPropertyDescriptors();
 42:     Set<String> emptyNames = new HashSet<>();
 43:     for (PropertyDescriptor pd : pds) {
 44:       Object srcValue = src.getPropertyValue(pd.getName());
 45:       if (srcValue == null) {
 46:           emptyNames.add(pd.getName());
 47:       }
 48:     }
 49:     String[] result = new String[emptyNames.size()];
 50:     return emptyNames.toArray(result);
 51:   }
 52:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 53:   public static <K, V> Map<K, V> mapByKey(String key, List<?> list) {
 54:     Map<K, V> map = new HashMap<>();
 55:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(list)) {
 56:       return map;
 57:     }
 58:     try {
 59:       Class<?> clazz = list.get(0).getClass();
 60:       Field field = deepFindField(clazz, key);
 61:       if (field == null) {
 62:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not find the key");
 63:       }
 64:       field.setAccessible(true);
 65:       for (Object o : list) {
 66:         map.put((K) field.get(o), (V) o);
 67:       }
 68:     } catch (Exception e) {
 69:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
 70:     }
 71:     return map;
 72:   }
 73:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 74:   public static <K, V> Map<K, List<V>> aggByKeyToList(String key, List<?> list) {
 75:     Map<K, List<V>> map = new HashMap<>();
 76:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(list)) {
 77:       return map;
 78:     }
 79:     try {
 80:       Class<?> clazz = list.get(0).getClass();
 81:       Field field = deepFindField(clazz, key);
 82:       if (field == null) {
 83:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not find the key");
 84:       }
 85:       field.setAccessible(true);
 86:       for (Object o : list) {
 87:         K k = (K) field.get(o);
 88:         map.computeIfAbsent(k, k1 -> new ArrayList<>());
 89:         map.get(k).add((V) o);
 90:       }
 91:     } catch (Exception e) {
 92:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
 93:     }
 94:     return map;
 95:   }
 96:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 97:   public static <K> Set<K> toPropertySet(String key, List<?> list) {
 98:     Set<K> set = new HashSet<>();
 99:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(list)) {
100:       return set;
101:     }
102:     try {
103:       Class<?> clazz = list.get(0).getClass();
104:       Field field = deepFindField(clazz, key);
105:       if (field == null) {
106:           throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not find the key");
107:       }
108:       field.setAccessible(true);
109:       for (Object o : list) {
110:         set.add((K)field.get(o));
111:       }
112:     } catch (Exception e) {
113:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
114:     }
115:     return set;
116:   }
117:   private static Field deepFindField(Class<?> clazz, String key) {
118:     Field field = null;
119:     while (!clazz.getName().equals(Object.class.getName())) {
120:       try {
121:         field = clazz.getDeclaredField(key);
122:         if (field != null) {
123:           break;
124:         }
125:       } catch (Exception e) {
126:         clazz = clazz.getSuperclass();
127:       }
128:     }
129:     return field;
130:   }
131:   public static Object getProperty(Object obj, String fieldName) {
132:     try {
133:       Field field = deepFindField(obj.getClass(), fieldName);
134:       if (field != null) {
135:         field.setAccessible(true);
136:         return field.get(obj);
137:       }
138:     } catch (Exception e) {
139:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
140:     }
141:     return null;
142:   }
143:   public static void setProperty(Object obj, String fieldName, Object value) {
144:     try {
145:       Field field = deepFindField(obj.getClass(), fieldName);
146:       if (field != null) {
147:         field.setAccessible(true);
148:         field.set(obj, value);
149:       }
150:     } catch (Exception e) {
151:       throw new BeanUtilsException(e);
152:     }
153:   }
154:   public static void copyProperties(Object source, Object target, String... ignoreProperties) {
155:     org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils.copyProperties(source, target, ignoreProperties);
156:   }
157:   public static void copyEntityProperties(Object source, Object target) {
158:     org.springframework.beans.BeanUtils.copyProperties(source, target, COPY_IGNORED_PROPERTIES);
159:   }
160:   private static final String[] COPY_IGNORED_PROPERTIES = {"id", "dataChangeCreatedBy", "dataChangeCreatedTime", "dataChangeLastModifiedTime"};
161: }

18:           .add("exception", errorAttributes.get("exception"))
19:           .add("errorCode", errorAttributes.get("errorCode"))
20:           .add("stackTrace", errorAttributes.get("stackTrace")).toString();
21:     }
22:     return "";
23:   }

File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/utils/InputValidator.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 3: import java.util.regex.Pattern;
 4: public class InputValidator {
 5:   public static final String INVALID_CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_MESSAGE = "Only digits, alphabets and symbol - _ . are allowed";
 6:   public static final String INVALID_NAMESPACE_NAMESPACE_MESSAGE = "not allowed to end with .json, .yml, .yaml, .xml, .properties";
 7:   public static final String CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_VALIDATOR = "[0-9a-zA-Z_.-]+";
 8:   private static final String APP_NAMESPACE_VALIDATOR = "[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+(?<!\\.(json|yml|yaml|xml|properties))$";
 9:   private static final Pattern CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_VALIDATOR);
10:   private static final Pattern APP_NAMESPACE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(APP_NAMESPACE_VALIDATOR);
11:   public static boolean isValidClusterNamespace(String name) {
12:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(name)){
13:       return false;
14:     }
15:     return CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_PATTERN.matcher(name).matches();
16:   }
17:   public static boolean isValidAppNamespace(String name){
18:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(name)){
19:       return false;
20:     }
21:     return APP_NAMESPACE_PATTERN.matcher(name).matches();
22:   }
23: }

================
File: apollo-common/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/common/utils/UniqueKeyGenerator.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils;
 2: import com.google.common.base.Joiner;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ByteUtil;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.MachineUtil;
 5: import org.apache.commons.lang.time.FastDateFormat;
 6: import java.security.SecureRandom;
 7: import java.util.Date;
 8: import java.util.Objects;
 9: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
10: public class UniqueKeyGenerator {
11:   private static final FastDateFormat TIMESTAMP_FORMAT = FastDateFormat.getInstance("yyyyMMddHHmmss");
12:   private static final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(new SecureRandom().nextInt());
13:   private static final Joiner KEY_JOINER = Joiner.on("-");
14:   public static String generate(Object... args){
15:     String hexIdString =
16:         ByteUtil.toHexString(toByteArray(Objects.hash(args), MachineUtil.getMachineIdentifier(),
17:                                          counter.incrementAndGet()));
18:     return KEY_JOINER.join(TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.format(new Date()), hexIdString);
19:   }
20:   protected static byte[] toByteArray(int keyHashCode, int machineIdentifier, int counter) {
21:     byte[] bytes = new byte[8];
22:     bytes[0] = ByteUtil.int1(keyHashCode);
23:     bytes[1] = ByteUtil.int0(keyHashCode);
24:     bytes[2] = ByteUtil.int2(machineIdentifier);
25:     bytes[3] = ByteUtil.int1(machineIdentifier);
26:     bytes[4] = ByteUtil.int0(machineIdentifier);
27:     bytes[5] = ByteUtil.int2(counter);
28:     bytes[6] = ByteUtil.int1(counter);
29:     bytes[7] = ByteUtil.int0(counter);
30:     return bytes;
31:   }
32: }

 42:       }.getType();
 43:   public ConfigController(
 44:       final ConfigService configService,
 45:       final AppNamespaceServiceWithCache appNamespaceService,
 46:       final NamespaceUtil namespaceUtil,
 47:       final InstanceConfigAuditUtil instanceConfigAuditUtil,
 48:       final Gson gson) {
 49:     this.configService = configService;
 50:     this.appNamespaceService = appNamespaceService;
 51:     this.namespaceUtil = namespaceUtil;
 52:     this.instanceConfigAuditUtil = instanceConfigAuditUtil;
 53:     this.gson = gson;

 55:   @GetMapping(value = "/{appId}/{clusterName}/{namespace:.+}")
 56:   public ApolloConfig queryConfig(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String clusterName,
 57:                                   @PathVariable String namespace,
 58:                                   @RequestParam(value = "dataCenter", required = false) String dataCenter,
 59:                                   @RequestParam(value = "releaseKey", defaultValue = "-1") String clientSideReleaseKey,
 60:                                   @RequestParam(value = "ip", required = false) String clientIp,
 61:                                   @RequestParam(value = "messages", required = false) String messagesAsString,
 62:                                   HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
 63:     String originalNamespace = namespace;
 64:     namespace = namespaceUtil.filterNamespaceName(namespace);
 65:     namespace = namespaceUtil.normalizeNamespace(appId, namespace);
 66:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(clientIp)) {
 67:       clientIp = tryToGetClientIp(request);
 68:     }
 69:     ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages = transformMessages(messagesAsString);
 70:     List<Release> releases = Lists.newLinkedList();
 71:     String appClusterNameLoaded = clusterName;
 72:     if (!ConfigConsts.NO_APPID_PLACEHOLDER.equalsIgnoreCase(appId)) {
 73:       Release currentAppRelease = configService.loadConfig(appId, clientIp, appId, clusterName, namespace,
 74:           dataCenter, clientMessages);
 75:       if (currentAppRelease != null) {
 76:         releases.add(currentAppRelease);
 77:         appClusterNameLoaded = currentAppRelease.getClusterName();
 78:       }
 79:     }
 80:     if (!namespaceBelongsToAppId(appId, namespace)) {
 81:       Release publicRelease = this.findPublicConfig(appId, clientIp, clusterName, namespace,
 82:           dataCenter, clientMessages);
 83:       if (!Objects.isNull(publicRelease)) {
 84:         releases.add(publicRelease);
 85:       }
 86:     }
 87:     if (releases.isEmpty()) {
 88:       response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
 89:           String.format(
 90:               "Could not load configurations with appId: %s, clusterName: %s, namespace: %s",
 91:               appId, clusterName, originalNamespace));
 92:       Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Config.NotFound",
 93:           assembleKey(appId, clusterName, originalNamespace, dataCenter));
 94:       return null;
 95:     }
 96:     auditReleases(appId, clusterName, dataCenter, clientIp, releases);
 97:     String mergedReleaseKey = releases.stream().map(Release::getReleaseKey)
 98:             .collect(Collectors.joining(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR));
 99:     if (mergedReleaseKey.equals(clientSideReleaseKey)) {
100:       response.setStatus(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_MODIFIED);
101:       Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Config.NotModified",
102:           assembleKey(appId, appClusterNameLoaded, originalNamespace, dataCenter));
103:       return null;
104:     }
105:     ApolloConfig apolloConfig = new ApolloConfig(appId, appClusterNameLoaded, originalNamespace,
106:         mergedReleaseKey);
107:     apolloConfig.setConfigurations(mergeReleaseConfigurations(releases));
108:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Config.Found", assembleKey(appId, appClusterNameLoaded,
109:         originalNamespace, dataCenter));
110:     return apolloConfig;
111:   }
112:   private boolean namespaceBelongsToAppId(String appId, String namespaceName) {
113:     if (Objects.equals(ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION, namespaceName)) {
114:       return true;
115:     }
116:     if (ConfigConsts.NO_APPID_PLACEHOLDER.equalsIgnoreCase(appId)) {
117:       return false;
118:     }
119:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findByAppIdAndNamespace(appId, namespaceName);
120:     return appNamespace != null;
121:   }
122:   private Release findPublicConfig(String clientAppId, String clientIp, String clusterName,
123:                                    String namespace, String dataCenter, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages) {
124:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findPublicNamespaceByName(namespace);
125:     if (Objects.isNull(appNamespace) || Objects.equals(clientAppId, appNamespace.getAppId())) {
126:       return null;
127:     }
128:     String publicConfigAppId = appNamespace.getAppId();
129:     return configService.loadConfig(clientAppId, clientIp, publicConfigAppId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter,
130:         clientMessages);
131:   }
132:   Map<String, String> mergeReleaseConfigurations(List<Release> releases) {
133:     Map<String, String> result = Maps.newLinkedHashMap();
134:     for (Release release : Lists.reverse(releases)) {
135:       result.putAll(gson.fromJson(release.getConfigurations(), configurationTypeReference));
136:     }
137:     return result;
138:   }
139:   private String assembleKey(String appId, String cluster, String namespace, String dataCenter) {
140:     List<String> keyParts = Lists.newArrayList(appId, cluster, namespace);
141:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter)) {
142:       keyParts.add(dataCenter);
143:     }
144:     return String.join(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR, keyParts);
145:   }
146:   private void auditReleases(String appId, String cluster, String dataCenter, String clientIp,
147:                              List<Release> releases) {
148:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(clientIp)) {
149:       return;
150:     }
151:     for (Release release : releases) {
152:       instanceConfigAuditUtil.audit(appId, cluster, dataCenter, clientIp, release.getAppId(),
153:           release.getClusterName(),
154:           release.getNamespaceName(), release.getReleaseKey());
155:     }
156:   }
157:   private String tryToGetClientIp(HttpServletRequest request) {
158:     String forwardedFor = request.getHeader("X-FORWARDED-FOR");
159:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(forwardedFor)) {
160:       return X_FORWARDED_FOR_SPLITTER.splitToList(forwardedFor).get(0);
161:     }
162:     return request.getRemoteAddr();
163:   }
164:   ApolloNotificationMessages transformMessages(String messagesAsString) {
165:     ApolloNotificationMessages notificationMessages = null;
166:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(messagesAsString)) {
167:       try {
168:         notificationMessages = gson.fromJson(messagesAsString, ApolloNotificationMessages.class);
169:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
170:         Tracer.logError(ex);
171:       }
172:     }
173:     return notificationMessages;
174:   }

 41: @RestController
 42: @RequestMapping("/configfiles")
 43: public class ConfigFileController implements ReleaseMessageListener {
 44:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigFileController.class);
 45:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR);
 46:   private static final Splitter X_FORWARDED_FOR_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings()
 47:       .trimResults();
 48:   private static final long MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024;
 49:   private static final long EXPIRE_AFTER_WRITE = 30;
 50:   private final HttpHeaders propertiesResponseHeaders;
 51:   private final HttpHeaders jsonResponseHeaders;
 52:   private final ResponseEntity<String> NOT_FOUND_RESPONSE;
 53:   private Cache<String, String> localCache;
 54:   private final Multimap<String, String>
 55:       watchedKeys2CacheKey = Multimaps.synchronizedSetMultimap(HashMultimap.create());
 56:   private final Multimap<String, String>
 57:       cacheKey2WatchedKeys = Multimaps.synchronizedSetMultimap(HashMultimap.create());
 58:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 59:   private final ConfigController configController;
 60:   private final NamespaceUtil namespaceUtil;
 61:   private final WatchKeysUtil watchKeysUtil;
 62:   private final GrayReleaseRulesHolder grayReleaseRulesHolder;
 63:   public ConfigFileController(
 64:       final ConfigController configController,
 65:       final NamespaceUtil namespaceUtil,
 66:       final WatchKeysUtil watchKeysUtil,
 67:       final GrayReleaseRulesHolder grayReleaseRulesHolder) {
 68:     localCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder()
 69:         .expireAfterWrite(EXPIRE_AFTER_WRITE, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
 70:         .weigher((Weigher<String, String>) (key, value) -> value == null ? 0 : value.length())
 71:         .maximumWeight(MAX_CACHE_SIZE)
 72:         .removalListener(notification -> {
 73:           String cacheKey = notification.getKey();
 74:           logger.debug("removing cache key: {}", cacheKey);
 75:           if (!cacheKey2WatchedKeys.containsKey(cacheKey)) {
 76:             return;
 77:           }
 78:           List<String> watchedKeys = new ArrayList<>(cacheKey2WatchedKeys.get(cacheKey));
 79:           for (String watchedKey : watchedKeys) {
 80:             watchedKeys2CacheKey.remove(watchedKey, cacheKey);
 81:           }
 82:           cacheKey2WatchedKeys.removeAll(cacheKey);
 83:           logger.debug("removed cache key: {}", cacheKey);
 84:         })
 85:         .build();
 86:     propertiesResponseHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
 87:     propertiesResponseHeaders.add("Content-Type", "text/plain;charset=UTF-8");
 88:     jsonResponseHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
 89:     jsonResponseHeaders.add("Content-Type", "application/json;charset=UTF-8");
 90:     NOT_FOUND_RESPONSE = new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
 91:     this.configController = configController;
 92:     this.namespaceUtil = namespaceUtil;
 93:     this.watchKeysUtil = watchKeysUtil;
 94:     this.grayReleaseRulesHolder = grayReleaseRulesHolder;
 95:   }
 96:   @GetMapping(value = "/{appId}/{clusterName}/{namespace:.+}")
 97:   public ResponseEntity<String> queryConfigAsProperties(@PathVariable String appId,
 98:                                                         @PathVariable String clusterName,
 99:                                                         @PathVariable String namespace,
100:                                                         @RequestParam(value = "dataCenter", required = false) String dataCenter,
101:                                                         @RequestParam(value = "ip", required = false) String clientIp,
102:                                                         HttpServletRequest request,
103:                                                         HttpServletResponse response)
104:       throws IOException {

107:             clientIp, request, response);

116:                                                   @PathVariable String namespace,
117:                                                   @RequestParam(value = "dataCenter", required = false) String dataCenter,
118:                                                   @RequestParam(value = "ip", required = false) String clientIp,
119:                                                   HttpServletRequest request,
120:                                                   HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
121:     String result =
122:         queryConfig(ConfigFileOutputFormat.JSON, appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter,
123:             clientIp, request, response);
124:     if (result == null) {
125:       return NOT_FOUND_RESPONSE;
126:     }
127:     return new ResponseEntity<>(result, jsonResponseHeaders, HttpStatus.OK);

129:   String queryConfig(ConfigFileOutputFormat outputFormat, String appId, String clusterName,
130:                      String namespace, String dataCenter, String clientIp,
131:                      HttpServletRequest request,
132:                      HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
133:     namespace = namespaceUtil.filterNamespaceName(namespace);
134:     namespace = namespaceUtil.normalizeNamespace(appId, namespace);
135:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(clientIp)) {
136:       clientIp = tryToGetClientIp(request);
137:     }
138:     boolean hasGrayReleaseRule = grayReleaseRulesHolder.hasGrayReleaseRule(appId, clientIp,
139:         namespace);
140:     String cacheKey = assembleCacheKey(outputFormat, appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter);
141:     if (hasGrayReleaseRule) {
142:       Tracer.logEvent("ConfigFile.Cache.GrayRelease", cacheKey);
143:       return loadConfig(outputFormat, appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter, clientIp,
144:           request, response);
145:     }
146:     String result = localCache.getIfPresent(cacheKey);
147:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(result)) {
148:       Tracer.logEvent("ConfigFile.Cache.Miss", cacheKey);
149:       result = loadConfig(outputFormat, appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter, clientIp,
150:           request, response);
151:       if (result == null) {
152:         return null;
153:       }
154:       if (grayReleaseRulesHolder.hasGrayReleaseRule(appId, clientIp, namespace)) {
155:         Tracer.logEvent("ConfigFile.Cache.GrayReleaseConflict", cacheKey);
156:         return loadConfig(outputFormat, appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter, clientIp,
157:             request, response);
158:       }
159:       localCache.put(cacheKey, result);
160:       logger.debug("adding cache for key: {}", cacheKey);
161:       Set<String> watchedKeys =
162:           watchKeysUtil.assembleAllWatchKeys(appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter);
163:       for (String watchedKey : watchedKeys) {
164:         watchedKeys2CacheKey.put(watchedKey, cacheKey);
165:       }
166:       cacheKey2WatchedKeys.putAll(cacheKey, watchedKeys);
167:       logger.debug("added cache for key: {}", cacheKey);
168:     } else {
169:       Tracer.logEvent("ConfigFile.Cache.Hit", cacheKey);
170:     }
171:     return result;
172:   }
173:   private String loadConfig(ConfigFileOutputFormat outputFormat, String appId, String clusterName,
174:                             String namespace, String dataCenter, String clientIp,
175:                             HttpServletRequest request,
176:                             HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
177:     ApolloConfig apolloConfig = configController.queryConfig(appId, clusterName, namespace,
178:         dataCenter, "-1", clientIp, null, request, response);
179:     if (apolloConfig == null || apolloConfig.getConfigurations() == null) {
180:       return null;
181:     }
182:     String result = null;
183:     switch (outputFormat) {
184:       case PROPERTIES:
185:         Properties properties = new Properties();
186:         properties.putAll(apolloConfig.getConfigurations());
187:         result = PropertiesUtil.toString(properties);
188:         break;
189:       case JSON:
190:         result = GSON.toJson(apolloConfig.getConfigurations());
191:         break;
192:     }
193:     return result;
194:   }
195:   String assembleCacheKey(ConfigFileOutputFormat outputFormat, String appId, String clusterName,
196:                           String namespace,
197:                           String dataCenter) {
198:     List<String> keyParts =
199:         Lists.newArrayList(outputFormat.getValue(), appId, clusterName, namespace);
200:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter)) {
201:       keyParts.add(dataCenter);
202:     }
203:     return STRING_JOINER.join(keyParts);
204:   }
205:   @Override
206:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
207:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
208:     String content = message.getMessage();
209:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(content)) {
210:       return;
211:     }
212:     if (!watchedKeys2CacheKey.containsKey(content)) {
213:       return;
214:     }
215:     List<String> cacheKeys = new ArrayList<>(watchedKeys2CacheKey.get(content));
216:     for (String cacheKey : cacheKeys) {
217:       logger.debug("invalidate cache key: {}", cacheKey);
218:       localCache.invalidate(cacheKey);
219:     }
220:   }
221:   enum ConfigFileOutputFormat {
222:     PROPERTIES("properties"), JSON("json");
223:     private String value;
224:     ConfigFileOutputFormat(String value) {
225:       this.value = value;
226:     }
227:     public String getValue() {
228:       return value;
229:     }
230:   }
231:   private String tryToGetClientIp(HttpServletRequest request) {
232:     String forwardedFor = request.getHeader("X-FORWARDED-FOR");
233:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(forwardedFor)) {
234:       return X_FORWARDED_FOR_SPLITTER.splitToList(forwardedFor).get(0);
235:     }
236:     return request.getRemoteAddr();
237:   }
238: }

 46:       final WatchKeysUtil watchKeysUtil,
 47:       final ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache releaseMessageService,
 48:       final EntityManagerUtil entityManagerUtil,
 49:       final NamespaceUtil namespaceUtil) {

 51:     this.releaseMessageService = releaseMessageService;
 52:     this.entityManagerUtil = entityManagerUtil;
 53:     this.namespaceUtil = namespaceUtil;
 54:   }
 55:   @GetMapping
 56:   public DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<ApolloConfigNotification>> pollNotification(
 57:       @RequestParam(value = "appId") String appId,
 58:       @RequestParam(value = "cluster") String cluster,
 59:       @RequestParam(value = "namespace", defaultValue = ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION) String namespace,
 60:       @RequestParam(value = "dataCenter", required = false) String dataCenter,
 61:       @RequestParam(value = "notificationId", defaultValue = "-1") long notificationId,
 62:       @RequestParam(value = "ip", required = false) String clientIp) {
 63:     namespace = namespaceUtil.filterNamespaceName(namespace);
 64:     Set<String> watchedKeys = watchKeysUtil.assembleAllWatchKeys(appId, cluster, namespace, dataCenter);
 65:     DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<ApolloConfigNotification>> deferredResult =
 66:         new DeferredResult<>(TIMEOUT, NOT_MODIFIED_RESPONSE);
 67:     ReleaseMessage latest = releaseMessageService.findLatestReleaseMessageForMessages(watchedKeys);
 68:     entityManagerUtil.closeEntityManager();
 69:     if (latest != null && latest.getId() != notificationId) {
 70:       deferredResult.setResult(new ResponseEntity<>(
 71:           new ApolloConfigNotification(namespace, latest.getId()), HttpStatus.OK));
 72:     } else {
 73:       for (String key : watchedKeys) {
 74:         this.deferredResults.put(key, deferredResult);
 75:       }
 76:       deferredResult
 77:           .onTimeout(() -> logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.TimeOutKeys"));
 78:       deferredResult.onCompletion(() -> {
 79:         for (String key : watchedKeys) {
 80:           deferredResults.remove(key, deferredResult);
 81:         }
 82:         logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.CompletedKeys");
 83:       });
 84:       logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.RegisteredKeys");
 85:       logger.debug("Listening {} from appId: {}, cluster: {}, namespace: {}, datacenter: {}",
 86:           watchedKeys, appId, cluster, namespace, dataCenter);
 87:     }
 88:     return deferredResult;
 89:   }
 90:   @Override
 91:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
 92:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
 93:     String content = message.getMessage();
 94:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.LongPoll.Messages", content);
 95:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(content)) {
 96:       return;
 97:     }
 98:     List<String> keys = STRING_SPLITTER.splitToList(content);
 99:     if (keys.size() != 3) {
100:       logger.error("message format invalid - {}", content);
101:       return;
102:     }
103:     ResponseEntity<ApolloConfigNotification> notification =
104:         new ResponseEntity<>(
105:             new ApolloConfigNotification(keys.get(2), message.getId()), HttpStatus.OK);
106:     if (!deferredResults.containsKey(content)) {
107:       return;
108:     }
109:     List<DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<ApolloConfigNotification>>> results =
110:         Lists.newArrayList(deferredResults.get(content));
111:     logger.debug("Notify {} clients for key {}", results.size(), content);
112:     for (DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<ApolloConfigNotification>> result : results) {
113:       result.setResult(notification);
114:     }
115:     logger.debug("Notification completed");
116:   }
117:   private void logWatchedKeys(Set<String> watchedKeys, String eventName) {
118:     for (String watchedKey : watchedKeys) {
119:       Tracer.logEvent(eventName, watchedKey);
120:     }
121:   }

 82:   @GetMapping
 83:   public DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>> pollNotification(
 84:       @RequestParam(value = "appId") String appId,
 85:       @RequestParam(value = "cluster") String cluster,
 86:       @RequestParam(value = "notifications") String notificationsAsString,
 87:       @RequestParam(value = "dataCenter", required = false) String dataCenter,
 88:       @RequestParam(value = "ip", required = false) String clientIp) {
 89:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> notifications = null;
 90:     try {
 91:       notifications =
 92:           gson.fromJson(notificationsAsString, notificationsTypeReference);
 93:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 94:       Tracer.logError(ex);
 95:     }
 96:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(notifications)) {
 97:       throw new BadRequestException("Invalid format of notifications: " + notificationsAsString);
 98:     }
 99:     Map<String, ApolloConfigNotification> filteredNotifications = filterNotifications(appId, notifications);
100:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(filteredNotifications)) {
101:       throw new BadRequestException("Invalid format of notifications: " + notificationsAsString);
102:     }
103:     DeferredResultWrapper deferredResultWrapper = new DeferredResultWrapper(bizConfig.longPollingTimeoutInMilli());
104:     Set<String> namespaces = Sets.newHashSetWithExpectedSize(filteredNotifications.size());
105:     Map<String, Long> clientSideNotifications = Maps.newHashMapWithExpectedSize(filteredNotifications.size());
106:     for (Map.Entry<String, ApolloConfigNotification> notificationEntry : filteredNotifications.entrySet()) {
107:       String normalizedNamespace = notificationEntry.getKey();
108:       ApolloConfigNotification notification = notificationEntry.getValue();
109:       namespaces.add(normalizedNamespace);
110:       clientSideNotifications.put(normalizedNamespace, notification.getNotificationId());
111:       if (!Objects.equals(notification.getNamespaceName(), normalizedNamespace)) {
112:         deferredResultWrapper.recordNamespaceNameNormalizedResult(notification.getNamespaceName(), normalizedNamespace);
113:       }
114:     }
115:     Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap =
116:         watchKeysUtil.assembleAllWatchKeys(appId, cluster, namespaces, dataCenter);
117:     Set<String> watchedKeys = Sets.newHashSet(watchedKeysMap.values());
118:     deferredResultWrapper
119:           .onTimeout(() -> logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.TimeOutKeys"));
120:     deferredResultWrapper.onCompletion(() -> {
121:       for (String key : watchedKeys) {
122:         deferredResults.remove(key, deferredResultWrapper);
123:       }
124:       logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.CompletedKeys");
125:     });
126:     for (String key : watchedKeys) {
127:       this.deferredResults.put(key, deferredResultWrapper);
128:     }
129:     logWatchedKeys(watchedKeys, "Apollo.LongPoll.RegisteredKeys");
130:     logger.debug("Listening {} from appId: {}, cluster: {}, namespace: {}, datacenter: {}",
131:         watchedKeys, appId, cluster, namespaces, dataCenter);
132:     List<ReleaseMessage> latestReleaseMessages =
133:         releaseMessageService.findLatestReleaseMessagesGroupByMessages(watchedKeys);
134:     entityManagerUtil.closeEntityManager();
135:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> newNotifications =
136:         getApolloConfigNotifications(namespaces, clientSideNotifications, watchedKeysMap,
137:             latestReleaseMessages);
138:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(newNotifications)) {
139:       deferredResultWrapper.setResult(newNotifications);
140:     }
141:     return deferredResultWrapper.getResult();
142:   }
143:   private Map<String, ApolloConfigNotification> filterNotifications(String appId,
144:                                                                     List<ApolloConfigNotification> notifications) {
145:     Map<String, ApolloConfigNotification> filteredNotifications = Maps.newHashMap();
146:     for (ApolloConfigNotification notification : notifications) {
147:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(notification.getNamespaceName())) {
148:         continue;
149:       }
150:       String originalNamespace = namespaceUtil.filterNamespaceName(notification.getNamespaceName());
151:       notification.setNamespaceName(originalNamespace);
152:       String normalizedNamespace = namespaceUtil.normalizeNamespace(appId, originalNamespace);
153:       if (filteredNotifications.containsKey(normalizedNamespace) &&
154:           filteredNotifications.get(normalizedNamespace).getNotificationId() < notification.getNotificationId()) {
155:         continue;
156:       }
157:       filteredNotifications.put(normalizedNamespace, notification);
158:     }
159:     return filteredNotifications;
160:   }
161:   private List<ApolloConfigNotification> getApolloConfigNotifications(Set<String> namespaces,
162:                                                                       Map<String, Long> clientSideNotifications,
163:                                                                       Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap,
164:                                                                       List<ReleaseMessage> latestReleaseMessages) {
165:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> newNotifications = Lists.newArrayList();
166:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(latestReleaseMessages)) {
167:       Map<String, Long> latestNotifications = Maps.newHashMap();
168:       for (ReleaseMessage releaseMessage : latestReleaseMessages) {
169:         latestNotifications.put(releaseMessage.getMessage(), releaseMessage.getId());
170:       }
171:       for (String namespace : namespaces) {
172:         long clientSideId = clientSideNotifications.get(namespace);
173:         long latestId = ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER;
174:         Collection<String> namespaceWatchedKeys = watchedKeysMap.get(namespace);
175:         for (String namespaceWatchedKey : namespaceWatchedKeys) {
176:           long namespaceNotificationId =
177:               latestNotifications.getOrDefault(namespaceWatchedKey, ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER);
178:           if (namespaceNotificationId > latestId) {
179:             latestId = namespaceNotificationId;
180:           }
181:         }
182:         if (latestId > clientSideId) {
183:           ApolloConfigNotification notification = new ApolloConfigNotification(namespace, latestId);
184:           namespaceWatchedKeys.stream().filter(latestNotifications::containsKey).forEach(namespaceWatchedKey ->
185:               notification.addMessage(namespaceWatchedKey, latestNotifications.get(namespaceWatchedKey)));
186:           newNotifications.add(notification);
187:         }
188:       }
189:     }
190:     return newNotifications;
191:   }
192:   @Override
193:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
194:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
195:     String content = message.getMessage();
196:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.LongPoll.Messages", content);
197:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(content)) {
198:       return;
199:     }
200:     String changedNamespace = retrieveNamespaceFromReleaseMessage.apply(content);
201:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(changedNamespace)) {
202:       logger.error("message format invalid - {}", content);
203:       return;
204:     }
205:     if (!deferredResults.containsKey(content)) {
206:       return;
207:     }
208:     List<DeferredResultWrapper> results = Lists.newArrayList(deferredResults.get(content));
209:     ApolloConfigNotification configNotification = new ApolloConfigNotification(changedNamespace, message.getId());
210:     configNotification.addMessage(content, message.getId());
211:     if (results.size() > bizConfig.releaseMessageNotificationBatch()) {
212:       largeNotificationBatchExecutorService.submit(() -> {
213:         logger.debug("Async notify {} clients for key {} with batch {}", results.size(), content,
214:             bizConfig.releaseMessageNotificationBatch());
215:         for (int i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {
216:           if (i > 0 && i % bizConfig.releaseMessageNotificationBatch() == 0) {
217:             try {
218:               TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.sleep(bizConfig.releaseMessageNotificationBatchIntervalInMilli());
219:             } catch (InterruptedException e) {
220:             }
221:           }
222:           logger.debug("Async notify {}", results.get(i));
223:           results.get(i).setResult(configNotification);
224:         }
225:       });
226:       return;
227:     }
228:     logger.debug("Notify {} clients for key {}", results.size(), content);
229:     for (DeferredResultWrapper result : results) {
230:       result.setResult(configNotification);
231:     }
232:     logger.debug("Notification completed");
233:   }
234:   private static final Function<String, String> retrieveNamespaceFromReleaseMessage =
235:       releaseMessage -> {
236:         if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(releaseMessage)) {
237:           return null;
238:         }
239:         List<String> keys = STRING_SPLITTER.splitToList(releaseMessage);
240:         if (keys.size() != 3) {
241:           logger.error("message format invalid - {}", releaseMessage);
242:           return null;
243:         }
244:         return keys.get(2);
245:       };
246:   private void logWatchedKeys(Set<String> watchedKeys, String eventName) {
247:     for (String watchedKey : watchedKeys) {
248:       Tracer.logEvent(eventName, watchedKey);
249:     }
250:   }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.filter;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.util.AccessKeyUtil;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.signature.Signature;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 5: import com.google.common.net.HttpHeaders;
 6: import java.io.IOException;
 7: import java.util.List;
 8: import java.util.Objects;
 9: import javax.servlet.Filter;
10: import javax.servlet.FilterChain;
11: import javax.servlet.FilterConfig;
12: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
13: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;
14: import javax.servlet.ServletResponse;
15: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
16: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
17: import org.slf4j.Logger;
18: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
19: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
20: public class ClientAuthenticationFilter implements Filter {
21:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ClientAuthenticationFilter.class);
22:   private static final Long TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL = 60 * 1000L;
23:   private final AccessKeyUtil accessKeyUtil;
24:   public ClientAuthenticationFilter(AccessKeyUtil accessKeyUtil) {
25:     this.accessKeyUtil = accessKeyUtil;
26:   }
27:   @Override
28:   public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {
29:   }
30:   @Override
31:   public void doFilter(ServletRequest req, ServletResponse resp, FilterChain chain)
32:       throws IOException, ServletException {
33:     HttpServletRequest request = (HttpServletRequest) req;
34:     HttpServletResponse response = (HttpServletResponse) resp;
35:     String appId = accessKeyUtil.extractAppIdFromRequest(request);
36:     if (StringUtils.isBlank(appId)) {
37:       response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST, "InvalidAppId");
38:       return;
39:     }
40:     List<String> availableSecrets = accessKeyUtil.findAvailableSecret(appId);
41:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(availableSecrets)) {
42:       String timestamp = request.getHeader(Signature.HTTP_HEADER_TIMESTAMP);
43:       String authorization = request.getHeader(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);
44:       if (!checkTimestamp(timestamp)) {
45:         logger.warn("Invalid timestamp. appId={},timestamp={}", appId, timestamp);
46:         response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED, "RequestTimeTooSkewed");
47:         return;
48:       }
49:       String uri = request.getRequestURI();
50:       String query = request.getQueryString();
51:       if (!checkAuthorization(authorization, availableSecrets, timestamp, uri, query)) {
52:         logger.warn("Invalid authorization. appId={},authorization={}", appId, authorization);
53:         response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED, "Unauthorized");
54:         return;
55:       }
56:     }
57:     chain.doFilter(request, response);
58:   }
59:   @Override
60:   public void destroy() {
61:   }
62:   private boolean checkTimestamp(String timestamp) {
63:     long requestTimeMillis = 0L;
64:     try {
65:       requestTimeMillis = Long.parseLong(timestamp);
66:     } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
67:     }
68:     long x = System.currentTimeMillis() - requestTimeMillis;
69:     return x >= -TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL && x <= TIMESTAMP_INTERVAL;
70:   }
71:   private boolean checkAuthorization(String authorization, List<String> availableSecrets,
72:       String timestamp, String path, String query) {
73:     String signature = null;
74:     if (authorization != null) {
75:       String[] split = authorization.split(":");
76:       if (split.length > 1) {
77:         signature = split[1];
78:       }
79:     }
80:     for (String secret : availableSecrets) {
81:       String availableSignature = accessKeyUtil.buildSignature(path, query, timestamp, secret);
82:       if (Objects.equals(signature, availableSignature)) {
83:         return true;
84:       }
85:     }
86:     return false;
87:   }
88: }

 30: @Service

 49:   private void initialize() {

 52:     lastTimeScanned = new Date(0L);

 54:         .arrayListValues().build();

 56:     accessKeyIdCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
