 58:   public List<String> getAvailableSecrets(String appId) {
 59:     List<AccessKey> accessKeys = accessKeyCache.get(appId);
 60:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(accessKeys)) {
 61:       return Collections.emptyList();
 62:     }
 63:     return accessKeys.stream()
 64:         .filter(AccessKey::isEnabled)
 65:         .map(AccessKey::getSecret)
 66:         .collect(Collectors.toList());
 67:   }
 68:   @Override
 69:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
 70:     populateDataBaseInterval();
 71:     scanNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys();
 72:     scheduledExecutorService.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::scanNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys,
 73:         scanInterval, scanInterval, scanIntervalTimeUnit);
 74:     scheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::rebuildAccessKeyCache,
 75:         rebuildInterval, rebuildInterval, rebuildIntervalTimeUnit);
 76:   }
 77:   private void scanNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys() {
 78:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.AccessKeyServiceWithCache",
 79:         "scanNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys");
 80:     try {
 81:       loadNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys();
 82:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 83:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 84:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
 85:       logger.error("Load new/updated app access keys failed", ex);
 86:     } finally {
 87:       transaction.complete();
 88:     }
 89:   }
 90:   private void rebuildAccessKeyCache() {
 91:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.AccessKeyServiceWithCache",
 92:         "rebuildCache");
 93:     try {
 94:       deleteAccessKeyCache();
 95:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 96:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 97:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
 98:       logger.error("Rebuild cache failed", ex);
 99:     } finally {
100:       transaction.complete();
101:     }
102:   }
103:   private void loadNewAndUpdatedAccessKeys() {
104:     boolean hasMore = true;
105:     while (hasMore && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
106:       List<AccessKey> accessKeys = accessKeyRepository
107:           .findFirst500ByDataChangeLastModifiedTimeGreaterThanOrderByDataChangeLastModifiedTimeAsc(lastTimeScanned);
108:       if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(accessKeys)) {
109:         break;
110:       }
111:       int scanned = accessKeys.size();
112:       mergeAccessKeys(accessKeys);
113:       logger.info("Loaded {} new/updated Accesskey from startTime {}", scanned, lastTimeScanned);
114:       hasMore = scanned == 500;
115:       lastTimeScanned = accessKeys.get(scanned - 1).getDataChangeLastModifiedTime();
116:       if (hasMore) {
117:         List<AccessKey> lastModifiedTimeAccessKeys = accessKeyRepository.findByDataChangeLastModifiedTime(lastTimeScanned);
118:         mergeAccessKeys(lastModifiedTimeAccessKeys);
119:         logger.info("Loaded {} new/updated Accesskey at lastModifiedTime {}", scanned, lastTimeScanned);
120:       }
121:     }
122:   }
123:   private void mergeAccessKeys(List<AccessKey> accessKeys) {
124:     for (AccessKey accessKey : accessKeys) {
125:       AccessKey thatInCache = accessKeyIdCache.get(accessKey.getId());
126:       accessKeyIdCache.put(accessKey.getId(), accessKey);
127:       accessKeyCache.put(accessKey.getAppId(), accessKey);
128:       if (thatInCache != null && accessKey.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime()
129:           .after(thatInCache.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime())) {
130:         accessKeyCache.remove(accessKey.getAppId(), thatInCache);
131:         logger.info("Found Accesskey changes, old: {}, new: {}", thatInCache, accessKey);
132:       }
133:     }
134:   }
135:   private void deleteAccessKeyCache() {
136:     List<Long> ids = Lists.newArrayList(accessKeyIdCache.keySet());
137:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(ids)) {
138:       return;
139:     }
140:     List<List<Long>> partitionIds = Lists.partition(ids, 500);
141:     for (List<Long> toRebuildIds : partitionIds) {
142:       Iterable<AccessKey> accessKeys = accessKeyRepository.findAllById(toRebuildIds);
143:       Set<Long> foundIds = Sets.newHashSet();
144:       for (AccessKey accessKey : accessKeys) {
145:         foundIds.add(accessKey.getId());
146:       }
147:       SetView<Long> deletedIds = Sets.difference(Sets.newHashSet(toRebuildIds), foundIds);
148:       handleDeletedAccessKeys(deletedIds);
149:     }
150:   }
151:   private void handleDeletedAccessKeys(Set<Long> deletedIds) {
152:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(deletedIds)) {
153:       return;
154:     }
155:     for (Long deletedId : deletedIds) {
156:       AccessKey deleted = accessKeyIdCache.remove(deletedId);
157:       if (deleted == null) {
158:         continue;
159:       }
160:       accessKeyCache.remove(deleted.getAppId(), deleted);
161:       logger.info("Found AccessKey deleted, {}", deleted);
162:     }
163:   }
164:   private void populateDataBaseInterval() {
165:     scanInterval = bizConfig.accessKeyCacheScanInterval();
166:     scanIntervalTimeUnit = bizConfig.accessKeyCacheScanIntervalTimeUnit();
167:     rebuildInterval = bizConfig.accessKeyCacheRebuildInterval();
168:     rebuildIntervalTimeUnit = bizConfig.accessKeyCacheRebuildIntervalTimeUnit();
169:   }
170: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.service;

 29: @Service
 30: public class AppNamespaceServiceWithCache implements InitializingBean {
 31:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AppNamespaceServiceWithCache.class);
 32:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR)
 33:       .skipNulls();
 34:   private final AppNamespaceRepository appNamespaceRepository;
 35:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
 36:   private int scanInterval;
 37:   private TimeUnit scanIntervalTimeUnit;
 38:   private int rebuildInterval;
 39:   private TimeUnit rebuildIntervalTimeUnit;
 40:   private ScheduledExecutorService scheduledExecutorService;
 41:   private long maxIdScanned;
 42:   private CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper<AppNamespace> publicAppNamespaceCache;
 43:   private CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper<AppNamespace> appNamespaceCache;
 44:   private Map<Long, AppNamespace> appNamespaceIdCache;
 45:   public AppNamespaceServiceWithCache(
 46:       final AppNamespaceRepository appNamespaceRepository,
 47:       final BizConfig bizConfig) {
 48:     this.appNamespaceRepository = appNamespaceRepository;
 49:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
 50:     initialize();
 51:   }
 52:   private void initialize() {
 53:     maxIdScanned = 0;
 54:     publicAppNamespaceCache = new CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper<>(Maps.newConcurrentMap());
 55:     appNamespaceCache = new CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper<>(Maps.newConcurrentMap());
 56:     appNamespaceIdCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 57:     scheduledExecutorService = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory
 58:         .create("AppNamespaceServiceWithCache", true));
 59:   }
 60:   public AppNamespace findByAppIdAndNamespace(String appId, String namespaceName) {
 61:     Preconditions.checkArgument(!StringUtils.isContainEmpty(appId, namespaceName), "appId and namespaceName must not be empty");
 62:     return appNamespaceCache.get(STRING_JOINER.join(appId, namespaceName));
 63:   }
 64:   public List<AppNamespace> findByAppIdAndNamespaces(String appId, Set<String> namespaceNames) {
 65:     Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(appId), "appId must not be null");
 66:     if (namespaceNames == null || namespaceNames.isEmpty()) {
 67:       return Collections.emptyList();
 68:     }
 69:     List<AppNamespace> result = Lists.newArrayList();
 70:     for (String namespaceName : namespaceNames) {
 71:       AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceCache.get(STRING_JOINER.join(appId, namespaceName));
 72:       if (appNamespace != null) {
 73:         result.add(appNamespace);
 74:       }
 75:     }
 76:     return result;
 77:   }
 78:   public AppNamespace findPublicNamespaceByName(String namespaceName) {
 79:     Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(namespaceName), "namespaceName must not be empty");
 80:     return publicAppNamespaceCache.get(namespaceName);
 81:   }
 82:   public List<AppNamespace> findPublicNamespacesByNames(Set<String> namespaceNames) {
 83:     if (namespaceNames == null || namespaceNames.isEmpty()) {
 84:       return Collections.emptyList();
 85:     }
 86:     List<AppNamespace> result = Lists.newArrayList();
 87:     for (String namespaceName : namespaceNames) {
 88:       AppNamespace appNamespace = publicAppNamespaceCache.get(namespaceName);
 89:       if (appNamespace != null) {
 90:         result.add(appNamespace);
 91:       }
 92:     }
 93:     return result;
 94:   }
 95:   @Override
 96:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
 97:     populateDataBaseInterval();
 98:     scanNewAppNamespaces();
 99:     scheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
100:       Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.AppNamespaceServiceWithCache",
101:           "rebuildCache");
102:       try {
103:         this.updateAndDeleteCache();
104:         transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
105:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
106:         transaction.setStatus(ex);
107:         logger.error("Rebuild cache failed", ex);
108:       } finally {
109:         transaction.complete();
110:       }
111:     }, rebuildInterval, rebuildInterval, rebuildIntervalTimeUnit);
112:     scheduledExecutorService.scheduleWithFixedDelay(this::scanNewAppNamespaces, scanInterval,
113:         scanInterval, scanIntervalTimeUnit);
114:   }
115:   private void scanNewAppNamespaces() {
116:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.AppNamespaceServiceWithCache",
117:         "scanNewAppNamespaces");
118:     try {
119:       this.loadNewAppNamespaces();
120:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
121:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
122:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
123:       logger.error("Load new app namespaces failed", ex);
124:     } finally {
125:       transaction.complete();
126:     }
127:   }
128:   private void loadNewAppNamespaces() {
129:     boolean hasMore = true;
130:     while (hasMore && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
131:       List<AppNamespace> appNamespaces = appNamespaceRepository
132:           .findFirst500ByIdGreaterThanOrderByIdAsc(maxIdScanned);
133:       if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(appNamespaces)) {
134:         break;
135:       }
136:       mergeAppNamespaces(appNamespaces);
137:       int scanned = appNamespaces.size();
138:       maxIdScanned = appNamespaces.get(scanned - 1).getId();
139:       hasMore = scanned == 500;
140:       logger.info("Loaded {} new app namespaces with startId {}", scanned, maxIdScanned);
141:     }
142:   }
143:   private void mergeAppNamespaces(List<AppNamespace> appNamespaces) {
144:     for (AppNamespace appNamespace : appNamespaces) {
145:       appNamespaceCache.put(assembleAppNamespaceKey(appNamespace), appNamespace);
146:       appNamespaceIdCache.put(appNamespace.getId(), appNamespace);
147:       if (appNamespace.isPublic()) {
148:         publicAppNamespaceCache.put(appNamespace.getName(), appNamespace);
149:       }
150:     }
151:   }
152:   private void updateAndDeleteCache() {
153:     List<Long> ids = Lists.newArrayList(appNamespaceIdCache.keySet());
154:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(ids)) {
155:       return;
156:     }
157:     List<List<Long>> partitionIds = Lists.partition(ids, 500);
158:     for (List<Long> toRebuild : partitionIds) {
159:       Iterable<AppNamespace> appNamespaces = appNamespaceRepository.findAllById(toRebuild);
160:       if (appNamespaces == null) {
161:         continue;
162:       }
163:       Set<Long> foundIds = handleUpdatedAppNamespaces(appNamespaces);
164:       handleDeletedAppNamespaces(Sets.difference(Sets.newHashSet(toRebuild), foundIds));
165:     }
166:   }
167:   private Set<Long> handleUpdatedAppNamespaces(Iterable<AppNamespace> appNamespaces) {
168:     Set<Long> foundIds = Sets.newHashSet();
169:     for (AppNamespace appNamespace : appNamespaces) {
170:       foundIds.add(appNamespace.getId());
171:       AppNamespace thatInCache = appNamespaceIdCache.get(appNamespace.getId());
172:       if (thatInCache != null && appNamespace.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime().after(thatInCache
173:           .getDataChangeLastModifiedTime())) {
174:         appNamespaceIdCache.put(appNamespace.getId(), appNamespace);
175:         String oldKey = assembleAppNamespaceKey(thatInCache);
176:         String newKey = assembleAppNamespaceKey(appNamespace);
177:         appNamespaceCache.put(newKey, appNamespace);
178:         if (!newKey.equals(oldKey)) {
179:           appNamespaceCache.remove(oldKey);
180:         }
181:         if (appNamespace.isPublic()) {
182:           publicAppNamespaceCache.put(appNamespace.getName(), appNamespace);
183:           if (!appNamespace.getName().equals(thatInCache.getName()) && thatInCache.isPublic()) {
184:             publicAppNamespaceCache.remove(thatInCache.getName());
185:           }
186:         } else if (thatInCache.isPublic()) {
187:           publicAppNamespaceCache.remove(thatInCache.getName());
188:         }
189:         logger.info("Found AppNamespace changes, old: {}, new: {}", thatInCache, appNamespace);
190:       }
191:     }
192:     return foundIds;
193:   }
194:   private void handleDeletedAppNamespaces(Set<Long> deletedIds) {
195:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(deletedIds)) {
196:       return;
197:     }
198:     for (Long deletedId : deletedIds) {
199:       AppNamespace deleted = appNamespaceIdCache.remove(deletedId);
200:       if (deleted == null) {
201:         continue;
202:       }
203:       appNamespaceCache.remove(assembleAppNamespaceKey(deleted));
204:       if (deleted.isPublic()) {
205:         AppNamespace publicAppNamespace = publicAppNamespaceCache.get(deleted.getName());
206:         if (publicAppNamespace == deleted) {
207:           publicAppNamespaceCache.remove(deleted.getName());
208:         }
209:       }
210:       logger.info("Found AppNamespace deleted, {}", deleted);
211:     }
212:   }
213:   private String assembleAppNamespaceKey(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
214:     return STRING_JOINER.join(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName());
215:   }
216:   private void populateDataBaseInterval() {
217:     scanInterval = bizConfig.appNamespaceCacheScanInterval();
218:     scanIntervalTimeUnit = bizConfig.appNamespaceCacheScanIntervalTimeUnit();
219:     rebuildInterval = bizConfig.appNamespaceCacheRebuildInterval();
220:     rebuildIntervalTimeUnit = bizConfig.appNamespaceCacheRebuildIntervalTimeUnit();
221:   }
222:   private void reset() throws Exception {
223:     scheduledExecutorService.shutdownNow();
224:     initialize();
225:     afterPropertiesSet();
226:   }
227: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.service.config;

12:   @Override
13:   public Release loadConfig(String clientAppId, String clientIp, String configAppId, String configClusterName,
14:       String configNamespace, String dataCenter, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages) {
15:     if (!Objects.equals(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAME_DEFAULT, configClusterName)) {
16:       Release clusterRelease = findRelease(clientAppId, clientIp, configAppId, configClusterName, configNamespace,
17:           clientMessages);
18:       if (!Objects.isNull(clusterRelease)) {
19:         return clusterRelease;
20:       }
21:     }
22:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter) && !Objects.equals(dataCenter, configClusterName)) {
23:       Release dataCenterRelease = findRelease(clientAppId, clientIp, configAppId, dataCenter, configNamespace,
24:           clientMessages);
25:       if (!Objects.isNull(dataCenterRelease)) {
26:         return dataCenterRelease;
27:       }
28:     }
29:     return findRelease(clientAppId, clientIp, configAppId, ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAME_DEFAULT, configNamespace,
30:         clientMessages);
31:   }
32:   private Release findRelease(String clientAppId, String clientIp, String configAppId, String configClusterName,
33:       String configNamespace, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages) {
34:     Long grayReleaseId = grayReleaseRulesHolder.findReleaseIdFromGrayReleaseRule(clientAppId, clientIp, configAppId,
35:         configClusterName, configNamespace);
36:     Release release = null;
37:     if (grayReleaseId != null) {
38:       release = findActiveOne(grayReleaseId, clientMessages);
39:     }
40:     if (release == null) {
41:       release = findLatestActiveRelease(configAppId, configClusterName, configNamespace, clientMessages);
42:     }
43:     return release;
44:   }
45:   protected abstract Release findActiveOne(long id, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages);
46:   protected abstract Release findLatestActiveRelease(String configAppId, String configClusterName,
47:       String configNamespaceName, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages);
48: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.service.config;
  2: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
  3: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
  4: import com.google.common.cache.CacheBuilder;
  5: import com.google.common.cache.CacheLoader;
  6: import com.google.common.cache.LoadingCache;
  7: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.Release;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.entity.ReleaseMessage;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.message.Topics;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.ReleaseMessageService;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.service.ReleaseService;
 13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.utils.ReleaseMessageKeyGenerator;
 14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ConfigConsts;
 15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ApolloNotificationMessages;

 17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
 18: import java.util.Optional;
 19: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 20: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 21: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 22: import java.util.List;
 23: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 24: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 25: public class ConfigServiceWithCache extends AbstractConfigService {
 26:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigServiceWithCache.class);
 27:   private static final long DEFAULT_EXPIRED_AFTER_ACCESS_IN_MINUTES = 60;
 28:   private static final String TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_INVALIDATE = "ConfigCache.Invalidate";
 29:   private static final String TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_LOAD = "ConfigCache.LoadFromDB";
 30:   private static final String TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_LOAD_ID = "ConfigCache.LoadFromDBById";
 31:   private static final String TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_GET = "ConfigCache.Get";
 32:   private static final String TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_GET_ID = "ConfigCache.GetById";
 33:   private static final Splitter STRING_SPLITTER =
 34:       Splitter.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR).omitEmptyStrings();
 35:   @Autowired
 36:   private ReleaseService releaseService;
 37:   @Autowired
 38:   private ReleaseMessageService releaseMessageService;
 39:   private LoadingCache<String, ConfigCacheEntry> configCache;
 40:   private LoadingCache<Long, Optional<Release>> configIdCache;
 41:   private ConfigCacheEntry nullConfigCacheEntry;
 42:   public ConfigServiceWithCache() {
 43:     nullConfigCacheEntry = new ConfigCacheEntry(ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER, null);
 44:   }
 45:   @PostConstruct
 46:   void initialize() {
 47:     configCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder()
 48:         .expireAfterAccess(DEFAULT_EXPIRED_AFTER_ACCESS_IN_MINUTES, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
 49:         .build(new CacheLoader<String, ConfigCacheEntry>() {
 50:           @Override
 51:           public ConfigCacheEntry load(String key) throws Exception {
 52:             List<String> namespaceInfo = STRING_SPLITTER.splitToList(key);
 53:             if (namespaceInfo.size() != 3) {
 54:               Tracer.logError(
 55:                   new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("Invalid cache load key %s", key)));
 56:               return nullConfigCacheEntry;
 57:             }
 58:             Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction(TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_LOAD, key);
 59:             try {
 60:               ReleaseMessage latestReleaseMessage = releaseMessageService.findLatestReleaseMessageForMessages(Lists
 61:                   .newArrayList(key));
 62:               Release latestRelease = releaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(namespaceInfo.get(0), namespaceInfo.get(1),
 63:                   namespaceInfo.get(2));
 64:               transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 65:               long notificationId = latestReleaseMessage == null ? ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER : latestReleaseMessage
 66:                   .getId();
 67:               if (notificationId == ConfigConsts.NOTIFICATION_ID_PLACEHOLDER && latestRelease == null) {
 68:                 return nullConfigCacheEntry;
 69:               }
 70:               return new ConfigCacheEntry(notificationId, latestRelease);
 71:             } catch (Throwable ex) {
 72:               transaction.setStatus(ex);
 73:               throw ex;
 74:             } finally {
 75:               transaction.complete();
 76:             }
 77:           }
 78:         });
 79:     configIdCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder()
 80:         .expireAfterAccess(DEFAULT_EXPIRED_AFTER_ACCESS_IN_MINUTES, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
 81:         .build(new CacheLoader<Long, Optional<Release>>() {
 82:           @Override
 83:           public Optional<Release> load(Long key) throws Exception {
 84:             Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction(TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_LOAD_ID, String.valueOf(key));
 85:             try {
 86:               Release release = releaseService.findActiveOne(key);
 87:               transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 88:               return Optional.ofNullable(release);
 89:             } catch (Throwable ex) {
 90:               transaction.setStatus(ex);
 91:               throw ex;
 92:             } finally {
 93:               transaction.complete();
 94:             }
 95:           }
 96:         });
 97:   }
 98:   @Override
 99:   protected Release findActiveOne(long id, ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages) {
100:     Tracer.logEvent(TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_GET_ID, String.valueOf(id));
101:     return configIdCache.getUnchecked(id).orElse(null);
102:   }
103:   @Override
104:   protected Release findLatestActiveRelease(String appId, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
105:                                             ApolloNotificationMessages clientMessages) {
106:     String key = ReleaseMessageKeyGenerator.generate(appId, clusterName, namespaceName);
107:     Tracer.logEvent(TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_GET, key);
108:     ConfigCacheEntry cacheEntry = configCache.getUnchecked(key);
109:     if (clientMessages != null && clientMessages.has(key) &&
110:         clientMessages.get(key) > cacheEntry.getNotificationId()) {
111:       invalidate(key);
112:       cacheEntry = configCache.getUnchecked(key);
113:     }
114:     return cacheEntry.getRelease();
115:   }
116:   private void invalidate(String key) {
117:     configCache.invalidate(key);
118:     Tracer.logEvent(TRACER_EVENT_CACHE_INVALIDATE, key);
119:   }
120:   @Override
121:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
122:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
123:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(message.getMessage())) {
124:       return;
125:     }
126:     try {
127:       invalidate(message.getMessage());
128:       configCache.getUnchecked(message.getMessage());
129:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
130:     }
131:   }
132:   private static class ConfigCacheEntry {
133:     private final long notificationId;
134:     private final Release release;
135:     public ConfigCacheEntry(long notificationId, Release release) {
136:       this.notificationId = notificationId;
137:       this.release = release;
138:     }
139:     public long getNotificationId() {
140:       return notificationId;
141:     }
142:     public Release getRelease() {
143:       return release;
144:     }
145:   }
146: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.service;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;

 10: import com.google.common.base.Strings;

 13: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 14: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

 25: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
 26: @Service
 27: public class ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache implements ReleaseMessageListener, InitializingBean {
 28:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache
 29:       .class);
 30:   private final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository;
 31:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
 32:   private int scanInterval;
 33:   private TimeUnit scanIntervalTimeUnit;
 34:   private volatile long maxIdScanned;
 35:   private ConcurrentMap<String, ReleaseMessage> releaseMessageCache;
 36:   private AtomicBoolean doScan;
 37:   private ExecutorService executorService;
 38:   public ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache(
 39:       final ReleaseMessageRepository releaseMessageRepository,
 40:       final BizConfig bizConfig) {
 41:     this.releaseMessageRepository = releaseMessageRepository;
 42:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
 43:     initialize();
 44:   }
 45:   private void initialize() {
 46:     releaseMessageCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 47:     doScan = new AtomicBoolean(true);
 48:     executorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(ApolloThreadFactory
 49:         .create("ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache", true));
 50:   }
 51:   public ReleaseMessage findLatestReleaseMessageForMessages(Set<String> messages) {
 52:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(messages)) {
 53:       return null;
 54:     }
 55:     long maxReleaseMessageId = 0;
 56:     ReleaseMessage result = null;
 57:     for (String message : messages) {
 58:       ReleaseMessage releaseMessage = releaseMessageCache.get(message);
 59:       if (releaseMessage != null && releaseMessage.getId() > maxReleaseMessageId) {
 60:         maxReleaseMessageId = releaseMessage.getId();
 61:         result = releaseMessage;
 62:       }
 63:     }
 64:     return result;
 65:   }
 66:   public List<ReleaseMessage> findLatestReleaseMessagesGroupByMessages(Set<String> messages) {
 67:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(messages)) {
 68:       return Collections.emptyList();
 69:     }
 70:     List<ReleaseMessage> releaseMessages = Lists.newArrayList();
 71:     for (String message : messages) {
 72:       ReleaseMessage releaseMessage = releaseMessageCache.get(message);
 73:       if (releaseMessage != null) {
 74:         releaseMessages.add(releaseMessage);
 75:       }
 76:     }
 77:     return releaseMessages;
 78:   }
 79:   @Override
 80:   public void handleMessage(ReleaseMessage message, String channel) {
 81:     doScan.set(false);
 82:     logger.info("message received - channel: {}, message: {}", channel, message);
 83:     String content = message.getMessage();
 84:     Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.ReleaseMessageService.UpdateCache", String.valueOf(message.getId()));
 85:     if (!Topics.APOLLO_RELEASE_TOPIC.equals(channel) || Strings.isNullOrEmpty(content)) {
 86:       return;
 87:     }
 88:     long gap = message.getId() - maxIdScanned;
 89:     if (gap == 1) {
 90:       mergeReleaseMessage(message);
 91:     } else if (gap > 1) {
 92:       loadReleaseMessages(maxIdScanned);
 93:     }
 94:   }
 95:   @Override
 96:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
 97:     populateDataBaseInterval();
 98:     loadReleaseMessages(0);
 99:     executorService.submit(() -> {
100:       while (doScan.get() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
101:         Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.ReleaseMessageServiceWithCache",
102:             "scanNewReleaseMessages");
103:         try {
104:           loadReleaseMessages(maxIdScanned);
105:           transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
106:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
107:           transaction.setStatus(ex);
108:           logger.error("Scan new release messages failed", ex);
109:         } finally {
110:           transaction.complete();
111:         }
112:         try {
113:           scanIntervalTimeUnit.sleep(scanInterval);
114:         } catch (InterruptedException e) {
115:         }
116:       }
117:     });
118:   }
119:   private synchronized void mergeReleaseMessage(ReleaseMessage releaseMessage) {
120:     ReleaseMessage old = releaseMessageCache.get(releaseMessage.getMessage());
121:     if (old == null || releaseMessage.getId() > old.getId()) {
122:       releaseMessageCache.put(releaseMessage.getMessage(), releaseMessage);
123:       maxIdScanned = releaseMessage.getId();
124:     }
125:   }
126:   private void loadReleaseMessages(long startId) {
127:     boolean hasMore = true;
128:     while (hasMore && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
129:       List<ReleaseMessage> releaseMessages = releaseMessageRepository
130:           .findFirst500ByIdGreaterThanOrderByIdAsc(startId);
131:       if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(releaseMessages)) {
132:         break;
133:       }
134:       releaseMessages.forEach(this::mergeReleaseMessage);
135:       int scanned = releaseMessages.size();
136:       startId = releaseMessages.get(scanned - 1).getId();
137:       hasMore = scanned == 500;
138:       logger.info("Loaded {} release messages with startId {}", scanned, startId);
139:     }
140:   }
141:   private void populateDataBaseInterval() {
142:     scanInterval = bizConfig.releaseMessageCacheScanInterval();
143:     scanIntervalTimeUnit = bizConfig.releaseMessageCacheScanIntervalTimeUnit();
144:   }
145:   private void reset() throws Exception {
146:     executorService.shutdownNow();
147:     initialize();
148:     afterPropertiesSet();
149:   }
150: }

23:   public String extractAppIdFromRequest(HttpServletRequest request) {
24:     String appId = null;
25:     String servletPath = request.getServletPath();
26:     if (StringUtils.startsWith(servletPath, URL_CONFIGS_PREFIX)) {
27:       appId = StringUtils.substringBetween(servletPath, URL_CONFIGS_PREFIX, URL_SEPARATOR);
28:     } else if (StringUtils.startsWith(servletPath, URL_CONFIGFILES_JSON_PREFIX)) {
29:       appId = StringUtils.substringBetween(servletPath, URL_CONFIGFILES_JSON_PREFIX, URL_SEPARATOR);
30:     } else if (StringUtils.startsWith(servletPath, URL_CONFIGFILES_PREFIX)) {
31:       appId = StringUtils.substringBetween(servletPath, URL_CONFIGFILES_PREFIX, URL_SEPARATOR);
32:     } else if (StringUtils.startsWith(servletPath, URL_NOTIFICATIONS_PREFIX)) {
33:       appId = request.getParameter("appId");
34:     }
35:     return appId;
36:   }
37:   public String buildSignature(String path, String query, String timestampString, String secret) {
38:     String pathWithQuery = path;
39:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(query)) {
40:       pathWithQuery += "?" + query;
41:     }
42:     return Signature.signature(timestampString, pathWithQuery, secret);
43:   }

 25: @Service
 26: public class InstanceConfigAuditUtil implements InitializingBean {
 27:   private static final int INSTANCE_CONFIG_AUDIT_MAX_SIZE = 10000;
 28:   private static final int INSTANCE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE = 50000;
 29:   private static final int INSTANCE_CONFIG_CACHE_MAX_SIZE = 50000;
 30:   private static final long OFFER_TIME_LAST_MODIFIED_TIME_THRESHOLD_IN_MILLI = TimeUnit.MINUTES.toMillis(10);
 31:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR);
 32:   private final ExecutorService auditExecutorService;
 33:   private final AtomicBoolean auditStopped;
 34:   private BlockingQueue<InstanceConfigAuditModel> audits = Queues.newLinkedBlockingQueue
 35:       (INSTANCE_CONFIG_AUDIT_MAX_SIZE);
 36:   private Cache<String, Long> instanceCache;
 37:   private Cache<String, String> instanceConfigReleaseKeyCache;
 38:   private final InstanceService instanceService;
 39:   public InstanceConfigAuditUtil(final InstanceService instanceService) {
 40:     this.instanceService = instanceService;
 41:     auditExecutorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(
 42:         ApolloThreadFactory.create("InstanceConfigAuditUtil", true));
 43:     auditStopped = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 44:     instanceCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder().expireAfterAccess(1, TimeUnit.HOURS)
 45:         .maximumSize(INSTANCE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE).build();
 46:     instanceConfigReleaseKeyCache = CacheBuilder.newBuilder().expireAfterWrite(1, TimeUnit.DAYS)
 47:         .maximumSize(INSTANCE_CONFIG_CACHE_MAX_SIZE).build();
 48:   }
 49:   public boolean audit(String appId, String clusterName, String dataCenter, String
 50:       ip, String configAppId, String configClusterName, String configNamespace, String releaseKey) {
 51:     return this.audits.offer(new InstanceConfigAuditModel(appId, clusterName, dataCenter, ip,
 52:         configAppId, configClusterName, configNamespace, releaseKey));
 53:   }
 54:   void doAudit(InstanceConfigAuditModel auditModel) {
 55:     String instanceCacheKey = assembleInstanceKey(auditModel.getAppId(), auditModel
 56:         .getClusterName(), auditModel.getIp(), auditModel.getDataCenter());
 57:     Long instanceId = instanceCache.getIfPresent(instanceCacheKey);
 58:     if (instanceId == null) {
 59:       instanceId = prepareInstanceId(auditModel);
 60:       instanceCache.put(instanceCacheKey, instanceId);
 61:     }
 62:     String instanceConfigCacheKey = assembleInstanceConfigKey(instanceId, auditModel
 63:         .getConfigAppId(), auditModel.getConfigNamespace());
 64:     String cacheReleaseKey = instanceConfigReleaseKeyCache.getIfPresent(instanceConfigCacheKey);
 65:     if (cacheReleaseKey != null && Objects.equals(cacheReleaseKey, auditModel.getReleaseKey())) {
 66:       return;
 67:     }
 68:     instanceConfigReleaseKeyCache.put(instanceConfigCacheKey, auditModel.getReleaseKey());
 69:     InstanceConfig instanceConfig = instanceService.findInstanceConfig(instanceId, auditModel
 70:         .getConfigAppId(), auditModel.getConfigNamespace());
 71:     if (instanceConfig != null) {
 72:       if (!Objects.equals(instanceConfig.getReleaseKey(), auditModel.getReleaseKey())) {
 73:         instanceConfig.setConfigClusterName(auditModel.getConfigClusterName());
 74:         instanceConfig.setReleaseKey(auditModel.getReleaseKey());
 75:         instanceConfig.setReleaseDeliveryTime(auditModel.getOfferTime());
 76:       } else if (offerTimeAndLastModifiedTimeCloseEnough(auditModel.getOfferTime(),
 77:           instanceConfig.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime())) {
 78:         return;
 79:       }
 80:       instanceConfig.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(auditModel.getOfferTime());
 81:       instanceService.updateInstanceConfig(instanceConfig);
 82:       return;
 83:     }
 84:     instanceConfig = new InstanceConfig();
 85:     instanceConfig.setInstanceId(instanceId);
 86:     instanceConfig.setConfigAppId(auditModel.getConfigAppId());
 87:     instanceConfig.setConfigClusterName(auditModel.getConfigClusterName());
 88:     instanceConfig.setConfigNamespaceName(auditModel.getConfigNamespace());
 89:     instanceConfig.setReleaseKey(auditModel.getReleaseKey());
 90:     instanceConfig.setReleaseDeliveryTime(auditModel.getOfferTime());
 91:     instanceConfig.setDataChangeCreatedTime(auditModel.getOfferTime());
 92:     try {
 93:       instanceService.createInstanceConfig(instanceConfig);
 94:     } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException ex) {
 95:     }
 96:   }
 97:   private boolean offerTimeAndLastModifiedTimeCloseEnough(Date offerTime, Date lastModifiedTime) {
 98:     return (offerTime.getTime() - lastModifiedTime.getTime()) <
 99:         OFFER_TIME_LAST_MODIFIED_TIME_THRESHOLD_IN_MILLI;
100:   }
101:   private long prepareInstanceId(InstanceConfigAuditModel auditModel) {
102:     Instance instance = instanceService.findInstance(auditModel.getAppId(), auditModel
103:         .getClusterName(), auditModel.getDataCenter(), auditModel.getIp());
104:     if (instance != null) {
105:       return instance.getId();
106:     }
107:     instance = new Instance();
108:     instance.setAppId(auditModel.getAppId());
109:     instance.setClusterName(auditModel.getClusterName());
110:     instance.setDataCenter(auditModel.getDataCenter());
111:     instance.setIp(auditModel.getIp());
112:     try {
113:       return instanceService.createInstance(instance).getId();
114:     } catch (DataIntegrityViolationException ex) {
115:       return instanceService.findInstance(instance.getAppId(), instance.getClusterName(),
116:           instance.getDataCenter(), instance.getIp()).getId();
117:     }
118:   }
119:   @Override
120:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
121:     auditExecutorService.submit(() -> {
122:       while (!auditStopped.get() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
123:         try {
124:           InstanceConfigAuditModel model = audits.poll();
125:           if (model == null) {
126:             TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1);
127:             continue;
128:           }
129:           doAudit(model);
130:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
131:           Tracer.logError(ex);
132:         }
133:       }
134:     });
135:   }
136:   private String assembleInstanceKey(String appId, String cluster, String ip, String datacenter) {
137:     List<String> keyParts = Lists.newArrayList(appId, cluster, ip);
138:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(datacenter)) {
139:       keyParts.add(datacenter);
140:     }
141:     return STRING_JOINER.join(keyParts);
142:   }
143:   private String assembleInstanceConfigKey(long instanceId, String configAppId, String configNamespace) {
144:     return STRING_JOINER.join(instanceId, configAppId, configNamespace);
145:   }

11:   public String filterNamespaceName(String namespaceName) {
12:     if (namespaceName.toLowerCase().endsWith(".properties")) {
13:       int dotIndex = namespaceName.lastIndexOf(".");
14:       return namespaceName.substring(0, dotIndex);
15:     }
16:     return namespaceName;
17:   }
18:   public String normalizeNamespace(String appId, String namespaceName) {
19:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceServiceWithCache.findByAppIdAndNamespace(appId, namespaceName);
20:     if (appNamespace != null) {
21:       return appNamespace.getName();
22:     }
23:     appNamespace = appNamespaceServiceWithCache.findPublicNamespaceByName(namespaceName);
24:     if (appNamespace != null) {
25:       return appNamespace.getName();
26:     }
27:     return namespaceName;
28:   }

16: @Component
17: public class WatchKeysUtil {
18:   private static final Joiner STRING_JOINER = Joiner.on(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR);
19:   private final AppNamespaceServiceWithCache appNamespaceService;
20:   public WatchKeysUtil(final AppNamespaceServiceWithCache appNamespaceService) {
21:     this.appNamespaceService = appNamespaceService;
22:   }
23:   public Set<String> assembleAllWatchKeys(String appId, String clusterName, String namespace,
24:                                           String dataCenter) {
25:     Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap =
26:         assembleAllWatchKeys(appId, clusterName, Sets.newHashSet(namespace), dataCenter);
27:     return Sets.newHashSet(watchedKeysMap.get(namespace));
28:   }
29:   public Multimap<String, String> assembleAllWatchKeys(String appId, String clusterName,
30:                                                        Set<String> namespaces,
31:                                                        String dataCenter) {
32:     Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap =
33:         assembleWatchKeys(appId, clusterName, namespaces, dataCenter);
34:     if (!(namespaces.size() == 1 && namespaces.contains(ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION))) {
35:       Set<String> namespacesBelongToAppId = namespacesBelongToAppId(appId, namespaces);
36:       Set<String> publicNamespaces = Sets.difference(namespaces, namespacesBelongToAppId);
37:       if (!publicNamespaces.isEmpty()) {
38:         watchedKeysMap
39:             .putAll(findPublicConfigWatchKeys(appId, clusterName, publicNamespaces, dataCenter));
40:       }
41:     }
42:     return watchedKeysMap;
43:   }
44:   private Multimap<String, String> findPublicConfigWatchKeys(String applicationId,
45:                                                              String clusterName,
46:                                                              Set<String> namespaces,
47:                                                              String dataCenter) {
48:     Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap = HashMultimap.create();
49:     List<AppNamespace> appNamespaces = appNamespaceService.findPublicNamespacesByNames(namespaces);
50:     for (AppNamespace appNamespace : appNamespaces) {
51:       if (Objects.equals(applicationId, appNamespace.getAppId())) {
52:         continue;
53:       }
54:       String publicConfigAppId = appNamespace.getAppId();
55:       watchedKeysMap.putAll(appNamespace.getName(),
56:           assembleWatchKeys(publicConfigAppId, clusterName, appNamespace.getName(), dataCenter));
57:     }
58:     return watchedKeysMap;
59:   }
60:   private String assembleKey(String appId, String cluster, String namespace) {
61:     return STRING_JOINER.join(appId, cluster, namespace);
62:   }
63:   private Set<String> assembleWatchKeys(String appId, String clusterName, String namespace,
64:                                         String dataCenter) {
65:     if (ConfigConsts.NO_APPID_PLACEHOLDER.equalsIgnoreCase(appId)) {
66:       return Collections.emptySet();
67:     }
68:     Set<String> watchedKeys = Sets.newHashSet();
69:     if (!Objects.equals(ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAME_DEFAULT, clusterName)) {
70:       watchedKeys.add(assembleKey(appId, clusterName, namespace));
71:     }
72:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataCenter) && !Objects.equals(dataCenter, clusterName)) {
73:       watchedKeys.add(assembleKey(appId, dataCenter, namespace));
74:     }
75:     watchedKeys.add(assembleKey(appId, ConfigConsts.CLUSTER_NAME_DEFAULT, namespace));
76:     return watchedKeys;
77:   }
78:   private Multimap<String, String> assembleWatchKeys(String appId, String clusterName,
79:                                                      Set<String> namespaces,
80:                                                      String dataCenter) {
81:     Multimap<String, String> watchedKeysMap = HashMultimap.create();
82:     for (String namespace : namespaces) {
83:       watchedKeysMap
84:           .putAll(namespace, assembleWatchKeys(appId, clusterName, namespace, dataCenter));
85:     }
86:     return watchedKeysMap;
87:   }
88:   private Set<String> namespacesBelongToAppId(String appId, Set<String> namespaces) {
89:     if (ConfigConsts.NO_APPID_PLACEHOLDER.equalsIgnoreCase(appId)) {
90:       return Collections.emptySet();
91:     }
92:     List<AppNamespace> appNamespaces =
93:         appNamespaceService.findByAppIdAndNamespaces(appId, namespaces);
94:     if (appNamespaces == null || appNamespaces.isEmpty()) {
95:       return Collections.emptySet();
96:     }
97:     return appNamespaces.stream().map(AppNamespace::getName).collect(Collectors.toSet());
98:   }
99: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.wrapper;
 2: import java.util.Map;
 3: public class CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper<T> {
 4:   private final Map<String, T> delegate;
 5:   public CaseInsensitiveMapWrapper(Map<String, T> delegate) {
 6:     this.delegate = delegate;
 7:   }
 8:   public T get(String key) {
 9:     return delegate.get(key.toLowerCase());
10:   }
11:   public T put(String key, T value) {
12:     return delegate.put(key.toLowerCase(), value);
13:   }
14:   public T remove(String key) {
15:     return delegate.remove(key.toLowerCase());
16:   }
17: }

File: apollo-configservice/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/configservice/wrapper/DeferredResultWrapper.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.configservice.wrapper;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ApolloConfigNotification;
 5: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
 6: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
 7: import org.springframework.lang.NonNull;
 8: import org.springframework.web.context.request.async.DeferredResult;
 9: import java.util.List;
10: import java.util.Map;
11: public class DeferredResultWrapper implements Comparable<DeferredResultWrapper> {
12:   private static final ResponseEntity<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>
13:       NOT_MODIFIED_RESPONSE_LIST = new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.NOT_MODIFIED);
14:   private Map<String, String> normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName;
15:   private DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>> result;
16:   public DeferredResultWrapper(long timeoutInMilli) {
17:     result = new DeferredResult<>(timeoutInMilli, NOT_MODIFIED_RESPONSE_LIST);
18:   }
19:   public void recordNamespaceNameNormalizedResult(String originalNamespaceName, String normalizedNamespaceName) {
20:     if (normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName == null) {
21:       normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName = Maps.newHashMap();
22:     }
23:     normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName.put(normalizedNamespaceName, originalNamespaceName);
24:   }
25:   public void onTimeout(Runnable timeoutCallback) {
26:     result.onTimeout(timeoutCallback);
27:   }
28:   public void onCompletion(Runnable completionCallback) {
29:     result.onCompletion(completionCallback);
30:   }
31:   public void setResult(ApolloConfigNotification notification) {
32:     setResult(Lists.newArrayList(notification));
33:   }
34:   public void setResult(List<ApolloConfigNotification> notifications) {
35:     if (normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName != null) {
36:       notifications.stream().filter(notification -> normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName.containsKey
37:           (notification.getNamespaceName())).forEach(notification -> notification.setNamespaceName(
38:               normalizedNamespaceNameToOriginalNamespaceName.get(notification.getNamespaceName())));
39:     }
40:     result.setResult(new ResponseEntity<>(notifications, HttpStatus.OK));
41:   }
42:   public DeferredResult<ResponseEntity<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>> getResult() {
43:     return result;
44:   }
45:   @Override
46:   public int compareTo(@NonNull DeferredResultWrapper deferredResultWrapper) {
47:     return Integer.compare(this.hashCode(), deferredResultWrapper.hashCode());
48:   }
49: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.metaservice.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ServiceDTO;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 4: import org.springframework.cloud.client.ServiceInstance;
 5: import org.springframework.cloud.consul.discovery.ConsulDiscoveryClient;
 6: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
 7: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 8: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 9: import java.util.List;
10: @Service
11: @Profile({"consul-discovery"})
12: public class ConsulDiscoveryService implements DiscoveryService {
13:     private final ConsulDiscoveryClient discoveryClient;
14:     public ConsulDiscoveryService(ConsulDiscoveryClient discoveryClient) {
15:         this.discoveryClient = discoveryClient;
16:     }
17:     @Override
18:     public List<ServiceDTO> getServiceInstances(String serviceId) {
19:         List<ServiceInstance> instances = discoveryClient.getInstances(serviceId);
20:         List<ServiceDTO> serviceDTOList = Lists.newLinkedList();
21:         if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(instances)) {
22:             instances.forEach(instance -> {
23:                 ServiceDTO serviceDTO = this.toServiceDTO(instance, serviceId);
24:                 serviceDTOList.add(serviceDTO);
25:             });
26:         }
27:         return serviceDTOList;
28:     }
29:     private ServiceDTO toServiceDTO(ServiceInstance instance, String appName) {
30:         ServiceDTO service = new ServiceDTO();
31:         service.setAppName(appName);
32:         service.setInstanceId(instance.getInstanceId());
33:         String homePageUrl = "http://" + instance.getHost() + ":" + instance.getPort() + "/";
34:         service.setHomepageUrl(homePageUrl);
35:         return service;
36:     }
37: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.metaservice.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.condition.ConditionalOnMissingProfile;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ServiceDTO;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 5: import com.netflix.appinfo.InstanceInfo;
 6: import com.netflix.discovery.EurekaClient;
 7: import com.netflix.discovery.shared.Application;
 8: import java.util.Collections;
 9: import java.util.List;
10: import java.util.function.Function;
11: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
12: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
13: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
14: @Service
15: @ConditionalOnMissingProfile({"kubernetes", "nacos-discovery", "consul-discovery"})
16: public class DefaultDiscoveryService implements DiscoveryService {
17:   private final EurekaClient eurekaClient;
18:   public DefaultDiscoveryService(final EurekaClient eurekaClient) {
19:     this.eurekaClient = eurekaClient;
20:   }
21:   @Override
22:   public List<ServiceDTO> getServiceInstances(String serviceId) {
23:     Application application = eurekaClient.getApplication(serviceId);
24:     if (application == null || CollectionUtils.isEmpty(application.getInstances())) {
25:       Tracer.logEvent("Apollo.Discovery.NotFound", serviceId);
26:       return Collections.emptyList();
27:     }
28:     return application.getInstances().stream().map(instanceInfoToServiceDTOFunc)
29:         .collect(Collectors.toList());
30:   }
31:   private static final Function<InstanceInfo, ServiceDTO> instanceInfoToServiceDTOFunc = instance -> {
32:     ServiceDTO service = new ServiceDTO();
33:     service.setAppName(instance.getAppName());
34:     service.setInstanceId(instance.getInstanceId());
35:     service.setHomepageUrl(instance.getHomePageUrl());
36:     return service;
37:   };
38: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.metaservice.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.biz.config.BizConfig;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ServiceNameConsts;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ServiceDTO;
 5: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
 6: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 7: import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMap;
 8: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 9: import java.util.Collections;
10: import java.util.List;
11: import java.util.Map;
12: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
13: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
14: @Service
15: @Profile({"kubernetes"})
16: public class KubernetesDiscoveryService implements DiscoveryService {
17:   private static final Splitter COMMA_SPLITTER = Splitter.on(",").omitEmptyStrings().trimResults();
18:   private static final Map<String, String> SERVICE_ID_TO_CONFIG_NAME = ImmutableMap
19:       .of(ServiceNameConsts.APOLLO_CONFIGSERVICE, "apollo.config-service.url",
20:           ServiceNameConsts.APOLLO_ADMINSERVICE, "apollo.admin-service.url");
21:   private final BizConfig bizConfig;
22:   public KubernetesDiscoveryService(final BizConfig bizConfig) {
23:     this.bizConfig = bizConfig;
24:   }
25:   @Override
26:   public List<ServiceDTO> getServiceInstances(String serviceId) {
27:     String configName = SERVICE_ID_TO_CONFIG_NAME.get(serviceId);
28:     if (configName == null) {
29:       return Collections.emptyList();
30:     }
31:     return assembleServiceDTO(serviceId, bizConfig.getValue(configName));
32:   }
33:   private List<ServiceDTO> assembleServiceDTO(String serviceId, String directUrl) {
34:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(directUrl)) {
35:       return Collections.emptyList();
36:     }
37:     List<ServiceDTO> serviceDTOList = Lists.newLinkedList();
38:     COMMA_SPLITTER.split(directUrl).forEach(url -> {
39:       ServiceDTO service = new ServiceDTO();
40:       service.setAppName(serviceId);
41:       service.setInstanceId(String.format("%s:%s", serviceId, url));
42:       service.setHomepageUrl(url);
43:       serviceDTOList.add(service);
44:     });
45:     return serviceDTOList;
46:   }
47: }

15:   }
16:   public Long get(String key) {
17:     return this.details.get(key);
18:   }
19:   public boolean has(String key) {
20:     return this.details.containsKey(key);
21:   }
22:   public boolean isEmpty() {
23:     return this.details.isEmpty();
24:   }
25:   public Map<String, Long> getDetails() {
26:     return details;
27:   }
28:   public void setDetails(Map<String, Long> details) {
29:     this.details = details;
30:   }
31:   public void mergeFrom(ApolloNotificationMessages source) {
32:     if (source == null) {
33:       return;
34:     }
35:     for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : source.getDetails().entrySet()) {
36:       if (this.has(entry.getKey()) &&
37:           this.get(entry.getKey()) >= entry.getValue()) {
38:         continue;
39:       }
40:       this.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
41:     }
42:   }
43:   public ApolloNotificationMessages clone() {
44:     return new ApolloNotificationMessages(ImmutableMap.copyOf(this.details));
45:   }
46: }

 3: public enum ConfigFileFormat {

 5:   private String value;
 6:   ConfigFileFormat(String value) {
 7:     this.value = value;

12:   public static ConfigFileFormat fromString(String value) {
13:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(value)) {
14:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("value can not be empty");
15:     }
16:     switch (value.toLowerCase()) {
17:       case "properties":
18:         return Properties;
19:       case "xml":
20:         return XML;
21:       case "json":
22:         return JSON;
23:       case "yml":
24:         return YML;
25:       case "yaml":
26:         return YAML;
27:       case "txt":
28:         return TXT;
29:     }
30:     throw new IllegalArgumentException(value + " can not map enum");
31:   }

33:     try {
34:       fromString(value);
35:       return true;
36:     } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
37:       return false;
38:     }
39:   }
40:   public static boolean isPropertiesCompatible(ConfigFileFormat format) {

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.internals;

 9: public class LegacyMetaServerProvider implements MetaServerProvider {
10:   public static final int ORDER = MetaServerProvider.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE - 1;
11:   private static final Map<Env, String> domains = new HashMap<>();
12:   public LegacyMetaServerProvider() {
13:     initialize();
14:   }
15:   private void initialize() {
16:     Properties prop = new Properties();
17:     prop = ResourceUtils.readConfigFile("apollo-env.properties", prop);
18:     domains.put(Env.LOCAL, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "local_meta", "local.meta"));
19:     domains.put(Env.DEV, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "dev_meta", "dev.meta"));
20:     domains.put(Env.FAT, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "fat_meta", "fat.meta"));
21:     domains.put(Env.UAT, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "uat_meta", "uat.meta"));
22:     domains.put(Env.LPT, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "lpt_meta", "lpt.meta"));
23:     domains.put(Env.PRO, getMetaServerAddress(prop, "pro_meta", "pro.meta"));
24:   }
25:   private String getMetaServerAddress(Properties prop, String sourceName, String propName) {
26:     String metaAddress = System.getProperty(sourceName);
27:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(metaAddress)) {
28:       metaAddress = System.getenv(sourceName.toUpperCase());
29:     }
30:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(metaAddress)) {
31:       metaAddress = prop.getProperty(propName);
32:     }
33:     return metaAddress;
34:   }
35:   @Override
36:   public String getMetaServerAddress(Env targetEnv) {
37:     String metaServerAddress = domains.get(targetEnv);
38:     return metaServerAddress == null ? null : metaServerAddress.trim();
39:   }
40:   @Override

================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.Env;
  3: import java.util.Collections;
  4: import java.util.Comparator;
  5: import java.util.Iterator;
  6: import java.util.List;
  7: import java.util.Map;
  8: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
  9: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 10: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 11: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
 12: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 13: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.spi.MetaServerProvider;
 15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.NetUtil;
 17: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 18: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
 19: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.ServiceBootstrap;
 20: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 21: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 22: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 23: public class MetaDomainConsts {
 24:   public static final String DEFAULT_META_URL = "http://apollo.meta";
 25:   private static final Map<Env, String> metaServerAddressCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 26:   private static volatile List<MetaServerProvider> metaServerProviders = null;
 27:   private static final long REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND = 60;
 28:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MetaDomainConsts.class);
 29:   private static final Map<String, String> selectedMetaServerAddressCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 30:   private static final AtomicBoolean periodicRefreshStarted = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 31:   private static final Object LOCK = new Object();
 32:   public static String getDomain(Env env) {
 33:     String metaServerAddress = getMetaServerAddress(env);
 34:     if (metaServerAddress.contains(",")) {
 35:       return selectMetaServerAddress(metaServerAddress);
 36:     }
 37:     return metaServerAddress;
 38:   }
 39:   public static String getMetaServerAddress(Env env) {
 40:     if (!metaServerAddressCache.containsKey(env)) {
 41:       initMetaServerAddress(env);
 42:     }
 43:     return metaServerAddressCache.get(env);
 44:   }
 45:   private static void initMetaServerAddress(Env env) {
 46:     if (metaServerProviders == null) {
 47:       synchronized (LOCK) {
 48:         if (metaServerProviders == null) {
 49:           metaServerProviders = initMetaServerProviders();
 50:         }
 51:       }
 52:     }
 53:     String metaAddress = null;
 54:     for (MetaServerProvider provider : metaServerProviders) {
 55:       metaAddress = provider.getMetaServerAddress(env);
 56:       if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(metaAddress)) {
 57:         logger.info("Located meta server address {} for env {} from {}", metaAddress, env,
 58:             provider.getClass().getName());
 59:         break;
 60:       }
 61:     }
 62:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(metaAddress)) {
 63:       metaAddress = DEFAULT_META_URL;
 64:       logger.warn(
 65:           "Meta server address fallback to {} for env {}, because it is not available in all MetaServerProviders",
 66:           metaAddress, env);
 67:     }
 68:     metaServerAddressCache.put(env, metaAddress.trim());
 69:   }
 70:   private static List<MetaServerProvider> initMetaServerProviders() {
 71:     Iterator<MetaServerProvider> metaServerProviderIterator = ServiceBootstrap.loadAll(MetaServerProvider.class);
 72:     List<MetaServerProvider> metaServerProviders = Lists.newArrayList(metaServerProviderIterator);
 73:     Collections.sort(metaServerProviders, new Comparator<MetaServerProvider>() {
 74:       @Override
 75:       public int compare(MetaServerProvider o1, MetaServerProvider o2) {
 76:         return Integer.compare(o1.getOrder(), o2.getOrder());
 77:       }
 78:     });
 79:     return metaServerProviders;
 80:   }
 81:   private static String selectMetaServerAddress(String metaServerAddresses) {
 82:     String metaAddressSelected = selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses);
 83:     if (metaAddressSelected == null) {
 84:       if (periodicRefreshStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
 85:         schedulePeriodicRefresh();
 86:       }
 87:       updateMetaServerAddresses(metaServerAddresses);
 88:       metaAddressSelected = selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses);
 89:     }
 90:     return metaAddressSelected;
 91:   }
 92:   private static void updateMetaServerAddresses(String metaServerAddresses) {
 93:     logger.debug("Selecting meta server address for: {}", metaServerAddresses);
 94:     Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.MetaService", "refreshMetaServerAddress");
 95:     transaction.addData("Url", metaServerAddresses);
 96:     try {
 97:       List<String> metaServers = Lists.newArrayList(metaServerAddresses.split(","));
 98:       Collections.shuffle(metaServers);
 99:       boolean serverAvailable = false;
100:       for (String address : metaServers) {
101:         address = address.trim();
102:         if (NetUtil.pingUrl(address + "/services/config")) {
103:           selectedMetaServerAddressCache.put(metaServerAddresses, address);
104:           serverAvailable = true;
105:           logger.debug("Selected meta server address {} for {}", address, metaServerAddresses);
106:           break;
107:         }
108:       }
109:       if (!selectedMetaServerAddressCache.containsKey(metaServerAddresses)) {
110:         selectedMetaServerAddressCache.put(metaServerAddresses, metaServers.get(0).trim());
111:       }
112:       if (!serverAvailable) {
113:         logger.warn("Could not find available meta server for configured meta server addresses: {}, fallback to: {}",
114:             metaServerAddresses, selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses));
115:       }
116:       transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
117:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
118:       transaction.setStatus(ex);
119:       throw ex;
120:     } finally {
121:       transaction.complete();
122:     }
123:   }
124:   private static void schedulePeriodicRefresh() {
125:     ScheduledExecutorService scheduledExecutorService =
126:         Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory.create("MetaServiceLocator", true));
127:     scheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(new Runnable() {
128:       @Override
129:       public void run() {
130:         try {
131:           for (String metaServerAddresses : selectedMetaServerAddressCache.keySet()) {
132:             updateMetaServerAddresses(metaServerAddresses);
133:           }
134:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
135:           logger.warn(String.format("Refreshing meta server address failed, will retry in %d seconds",
136:               REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND), ex);
137:         }
138:       }
139:     }, REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND, REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
140:   }
141: }

File: apollo-core/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/core/schedule/ExponentialSchedulePolicy.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.schedule;
 2: public class ExponentialSchedulePolicy implements SchedulePolicy {
 3:   private final long delayTimeLowerBound;
 4:   private final long delayTimeUpperBound;
 5:   private long lastDelayTime;
 6:   public ExponentialSchedulePolicy(long delayTimeLowerBound, long delayTimeUpperBound) {
 7:     this.delayTimeLowerBound = delayTimeLowerBound;
 8:     this.delayTimeUpperBound = delayTimeUpperBound;
 9:   }
10:   @Override
11:   public long fail() {
12:     long delayTime = lastDelayTime;
13:     if (delayTime == 0) {
14:       delayTime = delayTimeLowerBound;
15:     } else {
16:       delayTime = Math.min(lastDelayTime << 1, delayTimeUpperBound);
17:     }
18:     lastDelayTime = delayTime;
19:     return delayTime;
20:   }
21:   @Override
22:   public void success() {
23:     lastDelayTime = 0;
24:   }
25: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.signature;
 2: import com.google.common.io.BaseEncoding;
 3: import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
 4: import java.security.InvalidKeyException;
 5: import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
 6: import javax.crypto.Mac;
 7: import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
 8: public class HmacSha1Utils {
 9:   private static final String ALGORITHM_NAME = "HmacSHA1";
10:   private static final String ENCODING = "UTF-8";
11:   public static String signString(String stringToSign, String accessKeySecret) {
12:     try {
13:       Mac mac = Mac.getInstance(ALGORITHM_NAME);
14:       mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(
15:           accessKeySecret.getBytes(ENCODING),
16:           ALGORITHM_NAME
17:       ));
18:       byte[] signData = mac.doFinal(stringToSign.getBytes(ENCODING));
19:       return BaseEncoding.base64().encode(signData);
20:     } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException | UnsupportedEncodingException | InvalidKeyException e) {
21:       throw new IllegalArgumentException(e.toString());
22:     }
23:   }
24: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.signature;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 3: import com.google.common.net.HttpHeaders;
 4: import java.net.MalformedURLException;
 5: import java.net.URL;
 6: import java.util.Map;
 7: public class Signature {
 8:   private static final String AUTHORIZATION_FORMAT = "Apollo %s:%s";
 9:   private static final String DELIMITER = "\n";
10:   public static final String HTTP_HEADER_TIMESTAMP = "Timestamp";
11:   public static String signature(String timestamp, String pathWithQuery, String secret) {
12:     String stringToSign = timestamp + DELIMITER + pathWithQuery;
13:     return HmacSha1Utils.signString(stringToSign, secret);
14:   }
15:   public static Map<String, String> buildHttpHeaders(String url, String appId, String secret) {
16:     long currentTimeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis();
17:     String timestamp = String.valueOf(currentTimeMillis);
18:     String pathWithQuery = url2PathWithQuery(url);
19:     String signature = signature(timestamp, pathWithQuery, secret);
20:     Map<String, String> headers = Maps.newHashMap();
21:     headers.put(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, String.format(AUTHORIZATION_FORMAT, appId, signature));
22:     headers.put(HTTP_HEADER_TIMESTAMP, timestamp);
23:     return headers;
24:   }
25:   private static String url2PathWithQuery(String urlString) {
26:     try {
27:       URL url = new URL(urlString);
28:       String path = url.getPath();
29:       String query = url.getQuery();
30:       String pathWithQuery = path;
31:       if (query != null && query.length() > 0) {
32:         pathWithQuery += "?" + query;
33:       }
34:       return pathWithQuery;
35:     } catch (MalformedURLException e) {
36:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid url pattern: " + urlString, e);
37:     }
38:   }
39: }

10: public class ApolloThreadFactory implements ThreadFactory {
11:   private static Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApolloThreadFactory.class);
12:   private final AtomicLong threadNumber = new AtomicLong(1);
13:   private final String namePrefix;
14:   private final boolean daemon;
15:   private static final ThreadGroup threadGroup = new ThreadGroup("Apollo");
16:   public static ThreadGroup getThreadGroup() {
17:     return threadGroup;
18:   }
19:   public static ThreadFactory create(String namePrefix, boolean daemon) {
20:     return new ApolloThreadFactory(namePrefix, daemon);
21:   }
22:   public static boolean waitAllShutdown(int timeoutInMillis) {
23:     ThreadGroup group = getThreadGroup();
24:     Thread[] activeThreads = new Thread[group.activeCount()];
25:     group.enumerate(activeThreads);
26:     Set<Thread> alives = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(activeThreads));
27:     Set<Thread> dies = new HashSet<>();
28:     log.info("Current ACTIVE thread count is: {}", alives.size());
29:     long expire = System.currentTimeMillis() + timeoutInMillis;
30:     while (System.currentTimeMillis() < expire) {
31:       classify(alives, dies, new ClassifyStandard<Thread>() {
32:         @Override
33:         public boolean satisfy(Thread thread) {
34:           return !thread.isAlive() || thread.isInterrupted() || thread.isDaemon();
35:         }
36:       });
37:       if (alives.size() > 0) {
38:         log.info("Alive apollo threads: {}", alives);
39:         try {
40:           TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(2);
41:         } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
42:         }
43:       } else {
44:         log.info("All apollo threads are shutdown.");
45:         return true;
46:       }
47:     }
48:     log.warn("Some apollo threads are still alive but expire time has reached, alive threads: {}",
49:         alives);
50:     return false;
51:   }
52:   private interface ClassifyStandard<T> {
53:     boolean satisfy(T thread);
54:   }
55:   private static <T> void classify(Set<T> src, Set<T> des, ClassifyStandard<T> standard) {
56:     Set<T> set = new HashSet<>();
57:     for (T t : src) {
58:       if (standard.satisfy(t)) {
59:         set.add(t);
60:       }
61:     }
62:     src.removeAll(set);
63:     des.addAll(set);
64:   }
65:   private ApolloThreadFactory(String namePrefix, boolean daemon) {
66:     this.namePrefix = namePrefix;
67:     this.daemon = daemon;
68:   }
69:   public Thread newThread(Runnable runnable) {
70:     Thread thread = new Thread(threadGroup, runnable,
71:         threadGroup.getName() + "-" + namePrefix + "-" + threadNumber.getAndIncrement());
72:     thread.setDaemon(daemon);
73:     if (thread.getPriority() != Thread.NORM_PRIORITY) {
74:       thread.setPriority(Thread.NORM_PRIORITY);
75:     }
76:     return thread;
77:   }
78: }

 7: public class ClassLoaderUtil {
 8:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ClassLoaderUtil.class);
 9:   private static ClassLoader loader = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
10:   private static String classPath = "";
11:   static {
12:     if (loader == null) {
13:       logger.warn("Using system class loader");
14:       loader = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader();
15:     }
16:     try {
17:       URL url = loader.getResource("");
18:       // get class path
19:       if (url != null) {
20:         classPath = url.getPath();
21:         classPath = URLDecoder.decode(classPath, "utf-8");
22:       }
23:       if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(classPath) || classPath.contains(".jar!")) {
24:         classPath = System.getProperty("user.dir");
25:       }
26:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
27:       classPath = System.getProperty("user.dir");
28:       logger.warn("Failed to locate class path, fallback to user.dir: {}", classPath, ex);
29:     }
30:   }
31:   public static ClassLoader getLoader() {
32:     return loader;
33:   }
34:   public static String getClassPath() {
35:     return classPath;
36:   }
37:   public static boolean isClassPresent(String className) {
38:     try {
39:       Class.forName(className);
40:       return true;
41:     } catch (ClassNotFoundException ex) {
42:       return false;
43:     }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils;
 2: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 3: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 4: import java.net.NetworkInterface;

 6: import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
 7: import java.security.SecureRandom;
 8: import java.util.Enumeration;
 9: public class MachineUtil {
10:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MachineUtil.class);
11:   private static final int MACHINE_IDENTIFIER = createMachineIdentifier();
12:   public static int getMachineIdentifier() {
13:     return MACHINE_IDENTIFIER;
14:   }
15:   private static int createMachineIdentifier() {
16:     int machinePiece;
17:     try {
18:       StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
19:       Enumeration<NetworkInterface> e = NetworkInterface.getNetworkInterfaces();
20:       if (e != null){
21:         while (e.hasMoreElements()) {
22:           NetworkInterface ni = e.nextElement();
23:           sb.append(ni.toString());
24:           byte[] mac = ni.getHardwareAddress();
25:           if (mac != null) {
26:             ByteBuffer bb = ByteBuffer.wrap(mac);
27:             try {
28:               sb.append(bb.getChar());
29:               sb.append(bb.getChar());
30:               sb.append(bb.getChar());
31:             } catch (BufferUnderflowException shortHardwareAddressException) {
32:             }
33:           }
34:         }
35:       }
36:       machinePiece = sb.toString().hashCode();
37:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
38:       machinePiece = (new SecureRandom().nextInt());
39:       logger.warn(
40:           "Failed to get machine identifier from network interface, using random number instead",
41:           ex);
42:     }
43:     return machinePiece;
44:   }
45: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils;
 2: import com.google.common.io.CharStreams;
 3: import java.io.IOException;
 4: import java.io.InputStream;
 5: import java.io.InputStreamReader;
 6: import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
 7: import java.net.URL;
 8: import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
 9: public class NetUtil {
10:   private static final int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS = 5000;
11:   public static boolean pingUrl(String address) {
12:     try {
13:       URL urlObj = new URL(address);
14:       HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) urlObj.openConnection();
15:       connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
16:       connection.setUseCaches(false);
17:       connection.setConnectTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS);
18:       connection.setReadTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS);
19:       int statusCode = connection.getResponseCode();
20:       cleanUpConnection(connection);
21:       return (200 <= statusCode && statusCode <= 399);
22:     } catch (Throwable ignore) {
23:     }
24:     return false;
25:   }
26:   private static void cleanUpConnection(HttpURLConnection conn) {
27:     InputStreamReader isr = null;
28:     InputStreamReader esr = null;
29:     try {
30:       isr = new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
31:       CharStreams.toString(isr);
32:     } catch (IOException e) {
33:       InputStream errorStream = conn.getErrorStream();
34:       if (errorStream != null) {
35:         esr = new InputStreamReader(errorStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
36:         try {
37:           CharStreams.toString(esr);
38:         } catch (IOException ioe) {
39:         }
40:       }
41:     } finally {
42:       if (isr != null) {
43:         try {
44:           isr.close();
45:         } catch (IOException ex) {
46:         }
47:       }
48:       if (esr != null) {
49:         try {
50:           esr.close();
51:         } catch (IOException ex) {
52:         }
53:       }
54:     }
55:   }
56: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils;

 6:   public static String toString(Properties properties) throws IOException {
 7:     StringWriter writer = new StringWriter();
 8:     properties.store(writer, null);
 9:     StringBuffer stringBuffer = writer.getBuffer();
10:     filterPropertiesComment(stringBuffer);
11:     return stringBuffer.toString();
12:   }
13:   static boolean filterPropertiesComment(StringBuffer stringBuffer) {
14:     if (stringBuffer.charAt(0) != '#') {
15:       return false;
16:     }
17:     int commentLineIndex = stringBuffer.indexOf("\n");
18:     if (commentLineIndex == -1) {
19:       return false;
20:     }
21:     stringBuffer.delete(0, commentLineIndex + 1);
22:     return true;
23:   }
24: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils;
 2: import java.net.URL;
 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 5: import java.io.File;
 6: import java.io.FileInputStream;
 7: import java.io.IOException;
 8: import java.io.InputStream;
 9: import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
10: import java.nio.file.Paths;
11: import java.util.Properties;
12: public class ResourceUtils {
13:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResourceUtils.class);
14:   private static final String[] DEFAULT_FILE_SEARCH_LOCATIONS = new String[]{"./config/", "./"};
15:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
16:   public static Properties readConfigFile(String configPath, Properties defaults) {
17:     Properties props = new Properties();
18:     if (defaults != null) {
19:       props.putAll(defaults);
20:     }
21:     InputStream in = loadConfigFileFromDefaultSearchLocations(configPath);
22:     try {
23:       if (in != null) {
24:         props.load(in);
25:       }
26:     } catch (IOException ex) {
27:       logger.warn("Reading config failed: {}", ex.getMessage());
28:     } finally {
29:       if (in != null) {
30:         try {
31:           in.close();
32:         } catch (IOException ex) {
33:           logger.warn("Close config failed: {}", ex.getMessage());
34:         }
35:       }
36:     }
37:     if (logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
38:       StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
39:       for (String propertyName : props.stringPropertyNames()) {
40:         sb.append(propertyName).append('=').append(props.getProperty(propertyName)).append('\n');
41:       }
42:       if (sb.length() > 0) {
43:         logger.debug("Reading properties: \n" + sb.toString());
44:       } else {
45:         logger.warn("No available properties: {}", configPath);
46:       }
47:     }
48:     return props;
49:   }
50:   private static InputStream loadConfigFileFromDefaultSearchLocations(String configPath) {
51:     try {
52:       for (String searchLocation : DEFAULT_FILE_SEARCH_LOCATIONS) {
53:         File candidate = Paths.get(searchLocation, configPath).toFile();
54:         if (candidate.exists() && candidate.isFile() && candidate.canRead()) {
55:           logger.debug("Reading config from resource {}", candidate.getAbsolutePath());
56:           return new FileInputStream(candidate);
57:         }
58:       }
59:       URL url = ClassLoaderUtil.getLoader().getResource(configPath);
60:       if (url != null) {
61:         InputStream in = getResourceAsStream(url);
62:         if (in != null) {
63:           logger.debug("Reading config from resource {}", url.getPath());
64:           return in;
65:         }
66:       }
67:       File candidate = new File(System.getProperty("user.dir"), configPath);
68:       if (candidate.exists() && candidate.isFile() && candidate.canRead()) {
69:         logger.debug("Reading config from resource {}", candidate.getAbsolutePath());
70:         return new FileInputStream(candidate);
71:       }
72:     } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
73:     }
74:     return null;
75:   }
76:   private static InputStream getResourceAsStream(URL url) {
77:     try {
78:       return url != null ? url.openStream() : null;
79:     } catch (IOException e) {
80:       return null;
81:     }
82:   }
83: }
