  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils;
  2: import java.util.Collection;
  3: import java.util.Iterator;
  4: public class StringUtils {
  5:   public static final String EMPTY = "";
  6:   /**
  7:    * <p>
  8:    * Checks if a String is empty ("") or null.
  9:    * </p>
 10:    *
 11:    * <pre>
 12:    * StringUtils.isEmpty(null)      = true
 13:    * StringUtils.isEmpty("")        = true
 14:    * StringUtils.isEmpty(" ")       = false
 15:    * StringUtils.isEmpty("bob")     = false
 16:    * StringUtils.isEmpty("  bob  ") = false
 17:    * </pre>
 18:    *
 19:    * <p>
 20:    * NOTE: This method changed in Lang version 2.0. It no longer trims the String. That functionality is available in isBlank().
 21:    * </p>
 22:    *
 23:    * @param str the String to check, may be null
 24:    * @return <code>true</code> if the String is empty or null
 25:    */
 26:   public static boolean isEmpty(String str) {
 27:     return str == null || str.length() == 0;
 28:   }
 29:   public static boolean isContainEmpty(String... args){
 30:     if (args == null){
 31:       return false;
 32:     }
 33:     for (String arg: args){
 34:       if (arg == null || "".equals(arg)){
 35:         return true;
 36:       }
 37:     }
 38:     return false;
 39:   }
 40:   /**
 41:    * <p>
 42:    * Checks if a String is whitespace, empty ("") or null.
 43:    * </p>
 44:    *
 45:    * <pre>
 46:    * StringUtils.isBlank(null)      = true
 47:    * StringUtils.isBlank("")        = true
 48:    * StringUtils.isBlank(" ")       = true
 49:    * StringUtils.isBlank("bob")     = false
 50:    * StringUtils.isBlank("  bob  ") = false
 51:    * </pre>
 52:    *
 53:    * @param str the String to check, may be null
 54:    * @return <code>true</code> if the String is null, empty or whitespace
 55:    */
 56:   public static boolean isBlank(String str) {
 57:     int strLen;
 58:     if (str == null || (strLen = str.length()) == 0) {
 59:       return true;
 60:     }
 61:     for (int i = 0; i < strLen; i++) {
 62:       if (!Character.isWhitespace(str.charAt(i))) {
 63:         return false;
 64:       }
 65:     }
 66:     return true;
 67:   }
 68:   public static String trimToNull(String str) {
 69:     String ts = trim(str);
 70:     return isEmpty(ts) ? null : ts;
 71:   }
 72:   public static String trimToEmpty(String str) {
 73:     return str == null ? EMPTY : str.trim();
 74:   }
 75:   public static String trim(String str) {
 76:     return str == null ? null : str.trim();
 77:   }
 78:   public static boolean equals(String str1, String str2) {
 79:     return str1 == null ? str2 == null : str1.equals(str2);
 80:   }
 81:   public static boolean equalsIgnoreCase(String str1, String str2) {
 82:     return str1 == null ? str2 == null : str1.equalsIgnoreCase(str2);
 83:   }
 84:   public static boolean startsWith(String str, String prefix) {
 85:     return startsWith(str, prefix, false);
 86:   }
 87:   private static boolean startsWith(String str, String prefix, boolean ignoreCase) {
 88:     if (str == null || prefix == null) {
 89:       return str == null && prefix == null;
 90:     }
 91:     if (prefix.length() > str.length()) {
 92:       return false;
 93:     }
 94:     return str.regionMatches(ignoreCase, 0, prefix, 0, prefix.length());
 95:   }
 96:   public static boolean startsWithIgnoreCase(String str, String prefix) {
 97:     return startsWith(str, prefix, true);
 98:   }
 99:   public static boolean isNumeric(String str) {
100:     if (str == null) {
101:       return false;
102:     }
103:     int sz = str.length();
104:     for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
105:       if (!Character.isDigit(str.charAt(i))) {
106:         return false;
107:       }
108:     }
109:     return true;
110:   }
111:   public interface StringFormatter<T> {
112:     String format(T obj);
113:   }
114:   public static <T> String join(Collection<T> collection, String separator) {
115:     return join(collection, separator, new StringFormatter<T>() {
116:       @Override
117:       public String format(T obj) {
118:         return obj.toString();
119:       }
120:     });
121:   }
122:   public static <T> String join(Collection<T> collection, String separator,
123:                                 StringFormatter<T> formatter) {
124:     Iterator<T> iterator = collection.iterator();
125:     if (iterator == null) {
126:       return null;
127:     }
128:     if (!iterator.hasNext()) {
129:       return EMPTY;
130:     }
131:     T first = iterator.next();
132:     if (!iterator.hasNext()) {
133:       return first == null ? "" : formatter.format(first);
134:     }
135:     StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder(256);
136:     if (first != null) {
137:       buf.append(formatter.format(first));
138:     }
139:     while (iterator.hasNext()) {
140:       buf.append(separator);
141:       T obj = iterator.next();
142:       if (obj != null) {
143:         buf.append(formatter.format(obj));
144:       }
145:     }
146:     return buf.toString();
147:   }
148: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals;
 2: import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
 3: import java.util.Map;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.provider.DefaultApplicationProvider;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.provider.DefaultNetworkProvider;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.provider.DefaultServerProvider;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.spi.ProviderManager;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.spi.provider.Provider;
 9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
11: public class DefaultProviderManager implements ProviderManager {
12:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultProviderManager.class);
13:   private Map<Class<? extends Provider>, Provider> m_providers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
14:   public DefaultProviderManager() {
15:     Provider applicationProvider = new DefaultApplicationProvider();
16:     applicationProvider.initialize();
17:     register(applicationProvider);
18:     Provider networkProvider = new DefaultNetworkProvider();
19:     networkProvider.initialize();
20:     register(networkProvider);
21:     Provider serverProvider = new DefaultServerProvider();
22:     serverProvider.initialize();
23:     register(serverProvider);
24:   }
25:   public synchronized void register(Provider provider) {
26:     m_providers.put(provider.getType(), provider);
27:   }
28:   @Override
29:   @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
30:   public <T extends Provider> T provider(Class<T> clazz) {
31:     Provider provider = m_providers.get(clazz);
32:     if (provider != null) {
33:       return (T) provider;
34:     }
35:     logger.error("No provider [{}] found in DefaultProviderManager, please make sure it is registered in DefaultProviderManager ",
36:         clazz.getName());
37:     return (T) NullProviderManager.provider;
38:   }
39:   @Override
40:   public String getProperty(String name, String defaultValue) {
41:     for (Provider provider : m_providers.values()) {
42:       String value = provider.getProperty(name, null);
43:       if (value != null) {
44:         return value;
45:       }
46:     }
47:     return defaultValue;
48:   }
49:   @Override
50:   public String toString() {
51:     StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(512);
52:     if (null != m_providers) {
53:       for (Map.Entry<Class<? extends Provider>, Provider> entry : m_providers.entrySet()) {
54:         sb.append(entry.getValue()).append("\n");
55:       }
56:     }
57:     sb.append("(DefaultProviderManager)").append("\n");
58:     return sb.toString();
59:   }
60: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.io;
  2: import static com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals.io.IOUtils.EOF;
  3: import java.io.IOException;
  4: import java.io.InputStream;
  5: import java.util.Arrays;
  6: import java.util.Comparator;
  7: import java.util.List;
  8: public class BOMInputStream extends ProxyInputStream {
  9:   private final boolean include;
 10:   private final List<ByteOrderMark> boms;
 11:   private ByteOrderMark byteOrderMark;
 12:   private int[] firstBytes;
 13:   private int fbLength;
 14:   private int fbIndex;
 15:   private int markFbIndex;
 16:   private boolean markedAtStart;
 17:   public BOMInputStream(final InputStream delegate) {
 18:     this(delegate, false, ByteOrderMark.UTF_8);
 19:   }
 20:   public BOMInputStream(final InputStream delegate, final boolean include) {
 21:     this(delegate, include, ByteOrderMark.UTF_8);
 22:   }
 23:   public BOMInputStream(final InputStream delegate, final ByteOrderMark... boms) {
 24:     this(delegate, false, boms);
 25:   }
 26:   private static final Comparator<ByteOrderMark> ByteOrderMarkLengthComparator = new Comparator<ByteOrderMark>() {
 27:     public int compare(final ByteOrderMark bom1, final ByteOrderMark bom2) {
 28:       final int len1 = bom1.length();
 29:       final int len2 = bom2.length();
 30:       if (len1 > len2) {
 31:         return EOF;
 32:       }
 33:       if (len2 > len1) {
 34:         return 1;
 35:       }
 36:       return 0;
 37:     }
 38:   };
 39:   public BOMInputStream(final InputStream delegate, final boolean include, final ByteOrderMark... boms) {
 40:     super(delegate);
 41:     if (boms == null || boms.length == 0) {
 42:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("No BOMs specified");
 43:     }
 44:     this.include = include;
 45:     Arrays.sort(boms, ByteOrderMarkLengthComparator);
 46:     this.boms = Arrays.asList(boms);
 47:   }
 48:   public boolean hasBOM() throws IOException {
 49:     return getBOM() != null;
 50:   }
 51:   public boolean hasBOM(final ByteOrderMark bom) throws IOException {
 52:     if (!boms.contains(bom)) {
 53:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Stream not configure to detect " + bom);
 54:     }
 55:     getBOM();
 56:     return byteOrderMark != null && byteOrderMark.equals(bom);
 57:   }
 58:   public ByteOrderMark getBOM() throws IOException {
 59:     if (firstBytes == null) {
 60:       fbLength = 0;
 61:       final int maxBomSize = boms.get(0).length();
 62:       firstBytes = new int[maxBomSize];
 63:       for (int i = 0; i < firstBytes.length; i++) {
 64:         firstBytes[i] = in.read();
 65:         fbLength++;
 66:         if (firstBytes[i] < 0) {
 67:           break;
 68:         }
 69:       }
 70:       byteOrderMark = find();
 71:       if (byteOrderMark != null) {
 72:         if (!include) {
 73:           if (byteOrderMark.length() < firstBytes.length) {
 74:             fbIndex = byteOrderMark.length();
 75:           } else {
 76:             fbLength = 0;
 77:           }
 78:         }
 79:       }
 80:     }
 81:     return byteOrderMark;
 82:   }
 83:   public String getBOMCharsetName() throws IOException {
 84:     getBOM();
 85:     return byteOrderMark == null ? null : byteOrderMark.getCharsetName();
 86:   }
 87:   private int readFirstBytes() throws IOException {
 88:     getBOM();
 89:     return fbIndex < fbLength ? firstBytes[fbIndex++] : EOF;
 90:   }
 91:   private ByteOrderMark find() {
 92:     for (final ByteOrderMark bom : boms) {
 93:       if (matches(bom)) {
 94:         return bom;
 95:       }
 96:     }
 97:     return null;
 98:   }
 99:   private boolean matches(final ByteOrderMark bom) {
100:     for (int i = 0; i < bom.length(); i++) {
101:       if (bom.get(i) != firstBytes[i]) {
102:         return false;
103:       }
104:     }
105:     return true;
106:   }
107:   @Override
108:   public int read() throws IOException {
109:     final int b = readFirstBytes();
110:     return b >= 0 ? b : in.read();
111:   }
112:   @Override
113:   public int read(final byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException {
114:     int firstCount = 0;
115:     int b = 0;
116:     while (len > 0 && b >= 0) {
117:       b = readFirstBytes();
118:       if (b >= 0) {
119:         buf[off++] = (byte) (b & 0xFF);
120:         len--;
121:         firstCount++;
122:       }
123:     }
124:     final int secondCount = in.read(buf, off, len);
125:     return secondCount < 0 ? firstCount > 0 ? firstCount : EOF : firstCount + secondCount;
126:   }
127:   @Override
128:   public int read(final byte[] buf) throws IOException {
129:     return read(buf, 0, buf.length);
130:   }
131:   @Override
132:   public synchronized void mark(final int readlimit) {
133:     markFbIndex = fbIndex;
134:     markedAtStart = firstBytes == null;
135:     in.mark(readlimit);
136:   }
137:   @Override
138:   public synchronized void reset() throws IOException {
139:     fbIndex = markFbIndex;
140:     if (markedAtStart) {
141:       firstBytes = null;
142:     }
143:     in.reset();
144:   }
145:   @Override
146:   public long skip(long n) throws IOException {
147:     int skipped = 0;
148:     while ((n > skipped) && (readFirstBytes() >= 0)) {
149:       skipped++;
150:     }
151:     return in.skip(n - skipped) + skipped;
152:   }
153: }

10:   public static final char UTF_BOM = '\uFEFF';

12:   private final int[] bytes;
13:   public ByteOrderMark(final String charsetName, final int... bytes) {
14:     if (charsetName == null || charsetName.isEmpty()) {
15:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("No charsetName specified");

18:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("No bytes specified");
19:     }

23:   }

26:   }

28:     return bytes.length;
29:   }

32:   }
33:   public byte[] getBytes() {
34:     final byte[] copy = new byte[bytes.length];
35:     for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
36:       copy[i] = (byte) bytes[i];
37:     }
38:     return copy;
39:   }
40:   @Override

42:     if (!(obj instanceof ByteOrderMark)) {
43:       return false;
44:     }
45:     final ByteOrderMark bom = (ByteOrderMark) obj;
46:     if (bytes.length != bom.length()) {
47:       return false;
48:     }
49:     for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
50:       if (bytes[i] != bom.get(i)) {
51:         return false;
52:       }
53:     }
54:     return true;
55:   }
56:   @Override

58:     int hashCode = getClass().hashCode();

60:       hashCode += b;
61:     }

 4: import java.io.IOException;
 5: import java.io.InputStream;
 6: public abstract class ProxyInputStream extends FilterInputStream {
 7:   public ProxyInputStream(final InputStream proxy) {
 8:     super(proxy);
 9:   }
10:   @Override
11:   public int read() throws IOException {
12:     try {
13:       beforeRead(1);
14:       final int b = in.read();
15:       afterRead(b != EOF ? 1 : EOF);
16:       return b;
17:     } catch (final IOException e) {
18:       handleIOException(e);
19:       return EOF;
20:     }
21:   }
22:   @Override
23:   public int read(final byte[] bts) throws IOException {
24:     try {
25:       beforeRead(bts != null ? bts.length : 0);
26:       final int n = in.read(bts);
27:       afterRead(n);
28:       return n;
29:     } catch (final IOException e) {
30:       handleIOException(e);
31:       return EOF;
32:     }
33:   }
34:   @Override
35:   public int read(final byte[] bts, final int off, final int len) throws IOException {
36:     try {
37:       beforeRead(len);
38:       final int n = in.read(bts, off, len);
39:       afterRead(n);
40:       return n;
41:     } catch (final IOException e) {
42:       handleIOException(e);
43:       return EOF;
44:     }
45:   }
46:   @Override
47:   public long skip(final long ln) throws IOException {
48:     try {
49:       return in.skip(ln);
50:     } catch (final IOException e) {
51:       handleIOException(e);
52:       return 0;
53:     }
54:   }
55:   @Override
56:   public int available() throws IOException {
57:     try {
58:       return super.available();
59:     } catch (final IOException e) {
60:       handleIOException(e);
61:       return 0;
62:     }
63:   }
64:   @Override
65:   public void close() throws IOException {
66:     try {
67:       in.close();
68:     } catch (final IOException e) {
69:       handleIOException(e);
70:     }
71:   }
72:   @Override
73:   public synchronized void mark(final int readlimit) {
74:     in.mark(readlimit);
75:   }
76:   @Override
77:   public synchronized void reset() throws IOException {
78:     try {
79:       in.reset();
80:     } catch (final IOException e) {
81:       handleIOException(e);
82:     }
83:   }
84:   @Override
85:   public boolean markSupported() {
86:     return in.markSupported();
87:   }
88:   protected void beforeRead(final int n) throws IOException {
89:   }
90:   protected void afterRead(final int n) throws IOException {
91:   }
92:   protected void handleIOException(final IOException e) throws IOException {
93:     throw e;
94:   }
95: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals;
  2: import java.net.Inet4Address;
  3: import java.net.InetAddress;
  4: import java.net.NetworkInterface;
  5: import java.net.SocketException;
  6: import java.net.UnknownHostException;
  7: import java.util.ArrayList;
  8: import java.util.Collections;
  9: import java.util.Comparator;
 10: import java.util.Enumeration;
 11: import java.util.List;
 12: public enum NetworkInterfaceManager {
 13:   INSTANCE;
 14:   private InetAddress m_local;
 15:   private InetAddress m_localHost;
 16:   NetworkInterfaceManager() {
 17:     load();
 18:   }
 19:   public InetAddress findValidateIp(List<InetAddress> addresses) {
 20:     InetAddress local = null;
 21:     int maxWeight = -1;
 22:     for (InetAddress address : addresses) {
 23:       if (address instanceof Inet4Address) {
 24:         int weight = 0;
 25:         if (address.isSiteLocalAddress()) {
 26:           weight += 8;
 27:         }
 28:         if (address.isLinkLocalAddress()) {
 29:           weight += 4;
 30:         }
 31:         if (address.isLoopbackAddress()) {
 32:           weight += 2;
 33:         }
 34:         if (weight > maxWeight) {
 35:           maxWeight = weight;
 36:           local = address;
 37:         }
 38:       }
 39:     }
 40:     return local;
 41:   }
 42:   public String getLocalHostAddress() {
 43:     return m_local.getHostAddress();
 44:   }
 45:   public String getLocalHostName() {
 46:     try {
 47:       if (null == m_localHost) {
 48:         m_localHost = InetAddress.getLocalHost();
 49:       }
 50:       return m_localHost.getHostName();
 51:     } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
 52:       return m_local.getHostName();
 53:     }
 54:   }
 55:   private String getProperty(String name) {
 56:     String value = null;
 57:     value = System.getProperty(name);
 58:     if (value == null) {
 59:       value = System.getenv(name);
 60:     }
 61:     return value;
 62:   }
 63:   private void load() {
 64:     String ip = getProperty("host.ip");
 65:     if (ip != null) {
 66:       try {
 67:         m_local = InetAddress.getByName(ip);
 68:         return;
 69:       } catch (Exception e) {
 70:         System.err.println(e);
 71:       }
 72:     }
 73:     try {
 74:       Enumeration<NetworkInterface> interfaces = NetworkInterface.getNetworkInterfaces();
 75:       List<NetworkInterface> nis = interfaces == null ? Collections.<NetworkInterface>emptyList()
 76:           : Collections.list(interfaces);
 77:       Collections.sort(nis, new Comparator<NetworkInterface>() {
 78:         @Override
 79:         public int compare(NetworkInterface nis1, NetworkInterface nis2) {
 80:           return Integer.compare(nis1.getIndex(), nis2.getIndex());
 81:         }
 82:       });
 83:       List<InetAddress> addresses = new ArrayList<>();
 84:       InetAddress local = null;
 85:       try {
 86:         for (NetworkInterface ni : nis) {
 87:           if (ni.isUp() && !ni.isLoopback()) {
 88:             addresses.addAll(Collections.list(ni.getInetAddresses()));
 89:           }
 90:         }
 91:         local = findValidateIp(addresses);
 92:       } catch (Exception e) {
 93:       }
 94:       if (local != null) {
 95:         m_local = local;
 96:         return;
 97:       }
 98:     } catch (SocketException e) {
 99:     }
100:     m_local = InetAddress.getLoopbackAddress();
101:   }
102: }

File: apollo-core/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/foundation/internals/ServiceBootstrap.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.foundation.internals;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.spi.Ordered;
 3: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 4: import java.util.Collections;
 5: import java.util.Comparator;
 6: import java.util.Iterator;
 7: import java.util.List;
 8: import java.util.ServiceLoader;
 9: public class ServiceBootstrap {
10:   public static <S> S loadFirst(Class<S> clazz) {
11:     Iterator<S> iterator = loadAll(clazz);
12:     if (!iterator.hasNext()) {
13:       throw new IllegalStateException(String.format(
14:           "No implementation defined in /META-INF/services/%s, please check whether the file exists and has the right implementation class!",
15:           clazz.getName()));
16:     }
17:     return iterator.next();
18:   }
19:   public static <S> Iterator<S> loadAll(Class<S> clazz) {
20:     ServiceLoader<S> loader = ServiceLoader.load(clazz);
21:     return loader.iterator();
22:   }
23:   public static <S extends Ordered> List<S> loadAllOrdered(Class<S> clazz) {
24:     Iterator<S> iterator = loadAll(clazz);
25:     List<S> candidates = Lists.newArrayList(iterator);
26:     Collections.sort(candidates, new Comparator<S>() {
27:       @Override
28:       public int compare(S o1, S o2) {
29:         return Integer.compare(o1.getOrder(), o2.getOrder());
30:       }
31:     });
32:     return candidates;
33:   }
34:   public static <S extends Ordered> S loadPrimary(Class<S> clazz) {
35:     List<S> candidates = loadAllOrdered(clazz);
36:     if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
37:       throw new IllegalStateException(String.format(
38:           "No implementation defined in /META-INF/services/%s, please check whether the file exists and has the right implementation class!",
39:           clazz.getName()));
40:     }

File: apollo-demo/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/demo/api/ApolloConfigDemo.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.demo.api;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.YamlConfigFile;
  3: import com.google.common.base.Charsets;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Config;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigChangeListener;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigFile;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigFileChangeListener;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.ConfigService;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.ConfigFileFormat;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChange;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigChangeEvent;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.model.ConfigFileChangeEvent;
 13: import com.ctrip.framework.foundation.Foundation;
 14: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 15: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 16: import java.io.BufferedReader;
 17: import java.io.IOException;
 18: import java.io.InputStreamReader;
 19: public class ApolloConfigDemo {
 20:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApolloConfigDemo.class);
 21:   private String DEFAULT_VALUE = "undefined";
 22:   private Config config;
 23:   private Config yamlConfig;
 24:   private Config publicConfig;
 25:   private ConfigFile applicationConfigFile;
 26:   private ConfigFile xmlConfigFile;
 27:   private YamlConfigFile yamlConfigFile;
 28:   public ApolloConfigDemo() {
 29:     ConfigChangeListener changeListener = new ConfigChangeListener() {
 30:       @Override
 31:       public void onChange(ConfigChangeEvent changeEvent) {
 32:         logger.info("Changes for namespace {}", changeEvent.getNamespace());
 33:         for (String key : changeEvent.changedKeys()) {
 34:           ConfigChange change = changeEvent.getChange(key);
 35:           logger.info("Change - key: {}, oldValue: {}, newValue: {}, changeType: {}",
 36:               change.getPropertyName(), change.getOldValue(), change.getNewValue(),
 37:               change.getChangeType());
 38:         }
 39:       }
 40:     };
 41:     config = ConfigService.getAppConfig();
 42:     config.addChangeListener(changeListener);
 43:     yamlConfig = ConfigService.getConfig("application.yaml");
 44:     yamlConfig.addChangeListener(changeListener);
 45:     publicConfig = ConfigService.getConfig("TEST1.apollo");
 46:     publicConfig.addChangeListener(changeListener);
 47:     applicationConfigFile = ConfigService.getConfigFile("application", ConfigFileFormat.Properties);
 48:     xmlConfigFile = ConfigService.getConfigFile("datasources", ConfigFileFormat.XML);
 49:     xmlConfigFile.addChangeListener(new ConfigFileChangeListener() {
 50:       @Override
 51:       public void onChange(ConfigFileChangeEvent changeEvent) {
 52:         logger.info(changeEvent.toString());
 53:       }
 54:     });
 55:     yamlConfigFile = (YamlConfigFile) ConfigService.getConfigFile("application", ConfigFileFormat.YAML);
 56:   }
 57:   private String getConfig(String key) {
 58:     String result = config.getProperty(key, DEFAULT_VALUE);
 59:     if (DEFAULT_VALUE.equals(result)) {
 60:       result = publicConfig.getProperty(key, DEFAULT_VALUE);
 61:     }
 62:     if (DEFAULT_VALUE.equals(result)) {
 63:       result = yamlConfig.getProperty(key, DEFAULT_VALUE);
 64:     }
 65:     logger.info(String.format("Loading key : %s with value: %s", key, result));
 66:     return result;
 67:   }
 68:   private void print(String namespace) {
 69:     switch (namespace) {
 70:       case "application":
 71:         print(applicationConfigFile);
 72:         return;
 73:       case "xml":
 74:         print(xmlConfigFile);
 75:         return;
 76:       case "yaml":
 77:         printYaml(yamlConfigFile);
 78:         return;
 79:     }
 80:   }
 81:   private void print(ConfigFile configFile) {
 82:     if (!configFile.hasContent()) {
 83:       System.out.println("No config file content found for " + configFile.getNamespace());
 84:       return;
 85:     }
 86:     System.out.println("=== Config File Content for " + configFile.getNamespace() + " is as follows: ");
 87:     System.out.println(configFile.getContent());
 88:   }
 89:   private void printYaml(YamlConfigFile configFile) {
 90:     System.out.println("=== Properties for " + configFile.getNamespace() + " is as follows: ");
 91:     System.out.println(configFile.asProperties());
 92:   }
 93:   private void printEnvInfo() {
 94:     String message = String.format("AppId: %s, Env: %s, DC: %s, IP: %s", Foundation.app()
 95:         .getAppId(), Foundation.server().getEnvType(), Foundation.server().getDataCenter(),
 96:         Foundation.net().getHostAddress());
 97:     System.out.println(message);
 98:   }
 99:   public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
100:     ApolloConfigDemo apolloConfigDemo = new ApolloConfigDemo();
101:     apolloConfigDemo.printEnvInfo();
102:     System.out.println(
103:         "Apollo Config Demo. Please input key to get the value.");
104:     while (true) {
105:       System.out.print("> ");
106:       String input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in, Charsets.UTF_8)).readLine();
107:       if (input == null || input.length() == 0) {
108:         continue;
109:       }
110:       input = input.trim();
111:       try {
112:         if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("application")) {
113:           apolloConfigDemo.print("application");
114:           continue;
115:         }
116:         if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("xml")) {
117:           apolloConfigDemo.print("xml");
118:           continue;
119:         }
120:         if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("yaml") || input.equalsIgnoreCase("yml")) {
121:           apolloConfigDemo.print("yaml");
122:           continue;
123:         }
124:         if (input.equalsIgnoreCase("quit")) {
125:           System.exit(0);
126:         }
127:         apolloConfigDemo.getConfig(input);
128:       } catch (Throwable ex) {
129:         logger.error("some error occurred", ex);
130:       }
131:     }
132:   }
133: }

File: apollo-mockserver/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/mockserver/EmbeddedApollo.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.mockserver;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.build.ApolloInjector;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ApolloConfig;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ApolloConfigNotification;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ResourceUtils;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.internals.ConfigServiceLocator;
  7: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
  8: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
  9: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 10: import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken;
 11: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 12: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 13: import java.util.ArrayList;
 14: import java.util.List;
 15: import java.util.Map;
 16: import java.util.Properties;
 17: import java.util.Set;
 18: import okhttp3.mockwebserver.Dispatcher;
 19: import okhttp3.mockwebserver.MockResponse;
 20: import okhttp3.mockwebserver.MockWebServer;
 21: import okhttp3.mockwebserver.RecordedRequest;
 22: import org.junit.rules.ExternalResource;
 23: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 24: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 25: public class EmbeddedApollo extends ExternalResource {
 26:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EmbeddedApollo.class);
 27:   private static final Type notificationType = new TypeToken<List<ApolloConfigNotification>>() {
 28:   }.getType();
 29:   private static Method CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR_CLEAR;
 30:   private static ConfigServiceLocator CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR;
 31:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 32:   private final Map<String, Map<String, String>> addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 33:   private final Map<String, Set<String>> deletedKeysOfNamespace = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 34:   private MockWebServer server;
 35:   static {
 36:     try {
 37:       System.setProperty("apollo.longPollingInitialDelayInMills", "0");
 38:       CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR = ApolloInjector.getInstance(ConfigServiceLocator.class);
 39:       CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR_CLEAR = ConfigServiceLocator.class.getDeclaredMethod("initConfigServices");
 40:       CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR_CLEAR.setAccessible(true);
 41:     } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
 42:       e.printStackTrace();
 43:     }
 44:   }
 45:   @Override
 46:   protected void before() throws Throwable {
 47:     clear();
 48:     server = new MockWebServer();
 49:     final Dispatcher dispatcher = new Dispatcher() {
 50:       @Override
 51:       public MockResponse dispatch(RecordedRequest request) throws InterruptedException {
 52:         if (request.getPath().startsWith("/notifications/v2")) {
 53:           String notifications = request.getRequestUrl().queryParameter("notifications");
 54:           return new MockResponse().setResponseCode(200).setBody(mockLongPollBody(notifications));
 55:         }
 56:         if (request.getPath().startsWith("/configs")) {
 57:           List<String> pathSegments = request.getRequestUrl().pathSegments();
 58:           String appId = pathSegments.get(1);
 59:           String cluster = pathSegments.get(2);
 60:           String namespace = pathSegments.get(3);
 61:           return new MockResponse().setResponseCode(200).setBody(loadConfigFor(namespace));
 62:         }
 63:         return new MockResponse().setResponseCode(404);
 64:       }
 65:     };
 66:     server.setDispatcher(dispatcher);
 67:     server.start();
 68:     mockConfigServiceUrl("http://localhost:" + server.getPort());
 69:     super.before();
 70:   }
 71:   @Override
 72:   protected void after() {
 73:     try {
 74:       clear();
 75:       server.close();
 76:     } catch (Exception e) {
 77:       logger.error("stop apollo server error", e);
 78:     }
 79:   }
 80:   private void clear() throws Exception {
 81:     resetOverriddenProperties();
 82:   }
 83:   private void mockConfigServiceUrl(String url) throws Exception {
 84:     System.setProperty("apollo.configService", url);
 85:     CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR_CLEAR.invoke(CONFIG_SERVICE_LOCATOR);
 86:   }
 87:   private String loadConfigFor(String namespace) {
 88:     String filename = String.format("mockdata-%s.properties", namespace);
 89:     final Properties prop = ResourceUtils.readConfigFile(filename, new Properties());
 90:     Map<String, String> configurations = Maps.newHashMap();
 91:     for (String propertyName : prop.stringPropertyNames()) {
 92:       configurations.put(propertyName, prop.getProperty(propertyName));
 93:     }
 94:     ApolloConfig apolloConfig = new ApolloConfig("someAppId", "someCluster", namespace, "someReleaseKey");
 95:     Map<String, String> mergedConfigurations = mergeOverriddenProperties(namespace, configurations);
 96:     apolloConfig.setConfigurations(mergedConfigurations);
 97:     return GSON.toJson(apolloConfig);
 98:   }
 99:   private String mockLongPollBody(String notificationsStr) {
100:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> oldNotifications = GSON.fromJson(notificationsStr, notificationType);
101:     List<ApolloConfigNotification> newNotifications = new ArrayList<>();
102:     for (ApolloConfigNotification notification : oldNotifications) {
103:       newNotifications
104:           .add(new ApolloConfigNotification(notification.getNamespaceName(), notification.getNotificationId() + 1));
105:     }
106:     return GSON.toJson(newNotifications);
107:   }
108:   private Map<String, String> mergeOverriddenProperties(String namespace, Map<String, String> configurations) {
109:     if (addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.containsKey(namespace)) {
110:       configurations.putAll(addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.get(namespace));
111:     }
112:     if (deletedKeysOfNamespace.containsKey(namespace)) {
113:       for (String k : deletedKeysOfNamespace.get(namespace)) {
114:         configurations.remove(k);
115:       }
116:     }
117:     return configurations;
118:   }
119:   public void addOrModifyProperty(String namespace, String someKey, String someValue) {
120:     if (addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.containsKey(namespace)) {
121:       addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.get(namespace).put(someKey, someValue);
122:     } else {
123:       Map<String, String> m = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
124:       m.put(someKey, someValue);
125:       addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.put(namespace, m);
126:     }
127:   }
128:   public void deleteProperty(String namespace, String someKey) {
129:     if (deletedKeysOfNamespace.containsKey(namespace)) {
130:       deletedKeysOfNamespace.get(namespace).add(someKey);
131:     } else {
132:       Set<String> m = Sets.newConcurrentHashSet();
133:       m.add(someKey);
134:       deletedKeysOfNamespace.put(namespace, m);
135:     }
136:   }
137:   public void resetOverriddenProperties() {
138:     addedOrModifiedPropertiesOfNamespace.clear();
139:     deletedKeysOfNamespace.clear();
140:   }
141: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.client;

 17: import com.google.common.base.Preconditions;
 18: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 19: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 20: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 21: import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
 22: import org.apache.http.client.config.RequestConfig;
 23: import org.apache.http.impl.client.CloseableHttpClient;
 24: import org.apache.http.impl.client.HttpClients;
 25: import org.apache.http.message.BasicHeader;
 26: import java.util.List;
 27: public class ApolloOpenApiClient {
 28:   private final String portalUrl;
 29:   private final String token;
 30:   private final AppOpenApiService appService;
 31:   private final ItemOpenApiService itemService;
 32:   private final ReleaseOpenApiService releaseService;
 33:   private final NamespaceOpenApiService namespaceService;
 34:   private final ClusterOpenApiService clusterService;
 35:   private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setDateFormat(ApolloOpenApiConstants.JSON_DATE_FORMAT).create();
 36:   private ApolloOpenApiClient(String portalUrl, String token, RequestConfig requestConfig) {
 37:     this.portalUrl = portalUrl;
 38:     this.token = token;
 39:     CloseableHttpClient client = HttpClients.custom().setDefaultRequestConfig(requestConfig)
 40:         .setDefaultHeaders(Lists.newArrayList(new BasicHeader("Authorization", token))).build();
 41:     String baseUrl = this.portalUrl + ApolloOpenApiConstants.OPEN_API_V1_PREFIX;
 42:     appService = new AppOpenApiService(client, baseUrl, GSON);
 43:     clusterService = new ClusterOpenApiService(client, baseUrl, GSON);
 44:     namespaceService = new NamespaceOpenApiService(client, baseUrl, GSON);
 45:     itemService = new ItemOpenApiService(client, baseUrl, GSON);
 46:     releaseService = new ReleaseOpenApiService(client, baseUrl, GSON);
 47:   }
 48:   public List<OpenEnvClusterDTO> getEnvClusterInfo(String appId) {
 49:     return appService.getEnvClusterInfo(appId);
 50:   }
 51:   public List<OpenAppDTO> getAllApps() {
 52:     return appService.getAppsInfo(null);
 53:   }
 54:   public List<OpenAppDTO> getAppsByIds(List<String> appIds) {
 55:     return appService.getAppsInfo(appIds);
 56:   }
 57:   public List<OpenNamespaceDTO> getNamespaces(String appId, String env, String clusterName) {
 58:     return namespaceService.getNamespaces(appId, env, clusterName);
 59:   }
 60:   public OpenClusterDTO getCluster(String appId, String env, String clusterName) {
 61:     return clusterService.getCluster(appId, env, clusterName);
 62:   }

 64:     return clusterService.createCluster(env, openClusterDTO);
 65:   }

 67:     return namespaceService.getNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
 68:   }
 69:   public OpenAppNamespaceDTO createAppNamespace(OpenAppNamespaceDTO appNamespaceDTO) {
 70:     return namespaceService.createAppNamespace(appNamespaceDTO);
 71:   }
 72:   public OpenNamespaceLockDTO getNamespaceLock(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
 73:     return namespaceService.getNamespaceLock(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
 74:   }
 75:   public OpenItemDTO getItem(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, String key) {
 76:     return itemService.getItem(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, key);
 77:   }
 78:   public OpenItemDTO createItem(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 79:       OpenItemDTO itemDTO) {
 80:     return itemService.createItem(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, itemDTO);
 81:   }
 82:   public void updateItem(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, OpenItemDTO itemDTO) {
 83:     itemService.updateItem(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, itemDTO);
 84:   }
 85:   public void createOrUpdateItem(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, OpenItemDTO itemDTO) {
 86:     itemService.createOrUpdateItem(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, itemDTO);
 87:   }
 88:   public void removeItem(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, String key,
 89:       String operator) {
 90:     itemService.removeItem(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, key, operator);
 91:   }
 92:   public OpenReleaseDTO publishNamespace(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 93:       NamespaceReleaseDTO releaseDTO) {
 94:     return releaseService.publishNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, releaseDTO);
 95:   }
 96:   public OpenReleaseDTO getLatestActiveRelease(String appId, String env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
 97:     return releaseService.getLatestActiveRelease(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
 98:   }
 99:   public void rollbackRelease(String env, long releaseId, String operator) {
100:     releaseService.rollbackRelease(env, releaseId, operator);
101:   }
102:   public String getPortalUrl() {
103:     return portalUrl;
104:   }
105:   public String getToken() {
106:     return token;
107:   }
108:   public static ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder newBuilder() {
109:     return new ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder();
110:   }
111:   public static class ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder {
112:     private String portalUrl;
113:     private String token;
114:     private int connectTimeout = -1;
115:     private int readTimeout = -1;
116:     public ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder withPortalUrl(String portalUrl) {
117:       this.portalUrl = portalUrl;
118:       return this;
119:     }
120:     public ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder withToken(String token) {
121:       this.token = token;
122:       return this;
123:     }
124:     public ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder withConnectTimeout(int connectTimeout) {
125:       this.connectTimeout = connectTimeout;
126:       return this;
127:     }
128:     public ApolloOpenApiClientBuilder withReadTimeout(int readTimeout) {
129:       this.readTimeout = readTimeout;
130:       return this;
131:     }
132:     public ApolloOpenApiClient build() {
133:       Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(portalUrl), "Portal url should not be null or empty!");
134:       Preconditions.checkArgument(portalUrl.startsWith("http://") || portalUrl.startsWith("https://"), "Portal url should start with http:// or https://" );
135:       Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(token), "Token should not be null or empty!");
136:       if (connectTimeout < 0) {
137:         connectTimeout = ApolloOpenApiConstants.DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT;
138:       }
139:       if (readTimeout < 0) {
140:         readTimeout = ApolloOpenApiConstants.DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT;
141:       }
142:       RequestConfig requestConfig = RequestConfig.custom().setConnectTimeout(connectTimeout)
143:           .setSocketTimeout(readTimeout).build();
144:       return new ApolloOpenApiClient(portalUrl, token, requestConfig);
145:     }
146:   }
147: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.client.exception;
 2: public class ApolloOpenApiException extends RuntimeException {
 3:   private int status;
 4:   public ApolloOpenApiException(int status, String reason, String message) {
 5:     super(String.format("Request to apollo open api failed, status code: %d, reason: %s, message: %s", status, reason,
 6:         message));
 7:     this.status = status;

File: apollo-openapi/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/openapi/client/service/AbstractOpenApiService.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.client.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.client.exception.ApolloOpenApiException;
 3: import com.google.common.base.Preconditions;
 4: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 5: import com.google.common.escape.Escaper;
 6: import com.google.common.net.UrlEscapers;
 7: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 8: import java.io.IOException;
 9: import org.apache.http.HttpResponse;
10: import org.apache.http.StatusLine;
11: import org.apache.http.client.methods.CloseableHttpResponse;
12: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpDelete;
13: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpEntityEnclosingRequestBase;
14: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpGet;
15: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpPost;
16: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpPut;
17: import org.apache.http.client.methods.HttpUriRequest;
18: import org.apache.http.entity.ContentType;
19: import org.apache.http.entity.StringEntity;
20: import org.apache.http.impl.client.CloseableHttpClient;
21: import org.apache.http.util.EntityUtils;
22: abstract class AbstractOpenApiService {
23:   private static final Escaper pathEscaper = UrlEscapers.urlPathSegmentEscaper();
24:   private static final Escaper queryParamEscaper = UrlEscapers.urlFormParameterEscaper();
25:   private final String baseUrl;
26:   protected final CloseableHttpClient client;
27:   protected final Gson gson;
28:   AbstractOpenApiService(CloseableHttpClient client, String baseUrl, Gson gson) {
29:     this.client = client;
30:     this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
31:     this.gson = gson;
32:   }
33:   protected CloseableHttpResponse get(String path) throws IOException {
34:     HttpGet get = new HttpGet(String.format("%s/%s", baseUrl, path));
35:     return execute(get);
36:   }
37:   protected CloseableHttpResponse post(String path, Object entity) throws IOException {
38:     HttpPost post = new HttpPost(String.format("%s/%s", baseUrl, path));
39:     return execute(post, entity);
40:   }
41:   protected CloseableHttpResponse put(String path, Object entity) throws IOException {
42:     HttpPut put = new HttpPut(String.format("%s/%s", baseUrl, path));
43:     return execute(put, entity);
44:   }
45:   protected CloseableHttpResponse delete(String path) throws IOException {
46:     HttpDelete delete = new HttpDelete(String.format("%s/%s", baseUrl, path));
47:     return execute(delete);
48:   }
49:   protected String escapePath(String path) {
50:     return pathEscaper.escape(path);
51:   }
52:   protected String escapeParam(String param) {
53:     return queryParamEscaper.escape(param);
54:   }
55:   private CloseableHttpResponse execute(HttpEntityEnclosingRequestBase requestBase, Object entity) throws IOException {
56:     requestBase.setEntity(new StringEntity(gson.toJson(entity), ContentType.APPLICATION_JSON));
57:     return execute(requestBase);
58:   }
59:   private CloseableHttpResponse execute(HttpUriRequest request) throws IOException {
60:     CloseableHttpResponse response = client.execute(request);
61:     checkHttpResponseStatus(response);
62:     return response;
63:   }
64:   private void checkHttpResponseStatus(HttpResponse response) {
65:     if (response.getStatusLine().getStatusCode() == 200) {
66:       return;
67:     }
68:     StatusLine status = response.getStatusLine();
69:     String message = "";
70:     try {
71:       message = EntityUtils.toString(response.getEntity());
72:     } catch (IOException e) {
73:       //ignore
74:     }
75:     throw new ApolloOpenApiException(status.getStatusCode(), status.getReasonPhrase(), message);
76:   }
77:   protected void checkNotEmpty(String value, String name) {
78:     Preconditions.checkArgument(!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(value), name + " should not be null or empty");
79:   }
80: }

62:       throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Rollback release: %s in env: %s failed", releaseId, env), ex);
63:     }
64:   }
65: }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/openapi/auth/ConsumerPermissionValidator.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.auth;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.service.ConsumerRolePermissionService;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.util.ConsumerAuthUtil;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.constant.PermissionType;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.util.RoleUtils;
 6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 7: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 8: @Component
 9: public class ConsumerPermissionValidator {
10:   private final ConsumerRolePermissionService permissionService;
11:   private final ConsumerAuthUtil consumerAuthUtil;
12:   public ConsumerPermissionValidator(final ConsumerRolePermissionService permissionService,
13:       final ConsumerAuthUtil consumerAuthUtil) {
14:     this.permissionService = permissionService;
15:     this.consumerAuthUtil = consumerAuthUtil;
16:   }
17:   public boolean hasModifyNamespacePermission(HttpServletRequest request, String appId,
18:       String namespaceName, String env) {
19:     if (hasCreateNamespacePermission(request, appId)) {
20:       return true;
21:     }
22:     return permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
23:         PermissionType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE, RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName))
24:         || permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
25:             PermissionType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE,
26:             RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName, env));
27:   }
28:   public boolean hasReleaseNamespacePermission(HttpServletRequest request, String appId,
29:       String namespaceName, String env) {
30:     if (hasCreateNamespacePermission(request, appId)) {
31:       return true;
32:     }
33:     return permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
34:         PermissionType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE, RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName))
35:         || permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
36:             PermissionType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE,
37:             RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName, env));
38:   }
39:   public boolean hasCreateNamespacePermission(HttpServletRequest request, String appId) {
40:     return permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
41:         PermissionType.CREATE_NAMESPACE, appId);
42:   }
43:   public boolean hasCreateClusterPermission(HttpServletRequest request, String appId) {
44:     return permissionService.consumerHasPermission(consumerAuthUtil.retrieveConsumerId(request),
45:         PermissionType.CREATE_CLUSTER, appId);
46:   }
47: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity;

 3: import java.util.Date;
 4: import javax.persistence.Column;
 5: import javax.persistence.Entity;
 6: import javax.persistence.GeneratedValue;

 8: import javax.persistence.Id;
 9: import javax.persistence.PrePersist;
10: import javax.persistence.Table;
11: @Entity
12: @Table(name = "ConsumerAudit")
13: public class ConsumerAudit {
14:   @Id
15:   @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
16:   @Column(name = "Id")
17:   private long id;
18:   @Column(name = "ConsumerId", nullable = false)
19:   private long consumerId;
20:   @Column(name = "Uri", nullable = false)
21:   private String uri;
22:   @Column(name = "Method", nullable = false)
23:   private String method;
24:   @Column(name = "DataChange_CreatedTime")
25:   private Date dataChangeCreatedTime;
26:   @Column(name = "DataChange_LastTime")
27:   private Date dataChangeLastModifiedTime;
28:   @PrePersist
29:   protected void prePersist() {
30:     if (this.dataChangeCreatedTime == null) {
31:       this.dataChangeCreatedTime = new Date();
32:     }
33:     if (this.dataChangeLastModifiedTime == null) {
34:       dataChangeLastModifiedTime = this.dataChangeCreatedTime;
35:     }
36:   }
37:   public long getId() {
38:     return id;
39:   }
40:   public void setId(long id) {
41:     this.id = id;
42:   }
43:   public long getConsumerId() {
44:     return consumerId;
45:   }
46:   public void setConsumerId(long consumerId) {
47:     this.consumerId = consumerId;
48:   }

50:     return uri;
51:   }

53:     this.uri = uri;
54:   }
55:   public String getMethod() {
56:     return method;
57:   }

59:     this.method = method;
60:   }

63:   }

65:     this.dataChangeCreatedTime = dataChangeCreatedTime;
66:   }
67:   public Date getDataChangeLastModifiedTime() {
68:     return dataChangeLastModifiedTime;
69:   }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/openapi/filter/ConsumerAuthenticationFilter.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.filter;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.util.ConsumerAuditUtil;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.util.ConsumerAuthUtil;
 4: import java.io.IOException;
 5: import javax.servlet.Filter;
 6: import javax.servlet.FilterChain;
 7: import javax.servlet.FilterConfig;
 8: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 9: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;
10: import javax.servlet.ServletResponse;
11: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
12: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
13: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
14: public class ConsumerAuthenticationFilter implements Filter {
15:   private ConsumerAuthUtil consumerAuthUtil;
16:   private ConsumerAuditUtil consumerAuditUtil;
17:   public ConsumerAuthenticationFilter(ConsumerAuthUtil consumerAuthUtil, ConsumerAuditUtil consumerAuditUtil) {
18:     this.consumerAuthUtil = consumerAuthUtil;
19:     this.consumerAuditUtil = consumerAuditUtil;
20:   }
21:   @Override
22:   public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {
23:   }
24:   @Override
25:   public void doFilter(ServletRequest req, ServletResponse resp, FilterChain chain) throws
26:       IOException, ServletException {
27:     HttpServletRequest request = (HttpServletRequest) req;
28:     HttpServletResponse response = (HttpServletResponse) resp;
29:     String token = request.getHeader(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION);
30:     Long consumerId = consumerAuthUtil.getConsumerId(token);
31:     if (consumerId == null) {
32:       response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED, "Unauthorized");
33:       return;
34:     }
35:     consumerAuthUtil.storeConsumerId(request, consumerId);
36:     consumerAuditUtil.audit(request, consumerId);
37:     chain.doFilter(req, resp);
38:   }
39:   @Override
40:   public void destroy() {
41:   }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity.ConsumerRole;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.repository.ConsumerRoleRepository;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.po.Permission;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.po.RolePermission;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.repository.PermissionRepository;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.repository.RolePermissionRepository;
 8: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 9: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
10: import java.util.List;
11: import java.util.Set;
12: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
13: @Service
14: public class ConsumerRolePermissionService {
15:   private final PermissionRepository permissionRepository;
16:   private final ConsumerRoleRepository consumerRoleRepository;
17:   private final RolePermissionRepository rolePermissionRepository;
18:   public ConsumerRolePermissionService(
19:       final PermissionRepository permissionRepository,
20:       final ConsumerRoleRepository consumerRoleRepository,
21:       final RolePermissionRepository rolePermissionRepository) {
22:     this.permissionRepository = permissionRepository;
23:     this.consumerRoleRepository = consumerRoleRepository;
24:     this.rolePermissionRepository = rolePermissionRepository;
25:   }
26:   public boolean consumerHasPermission(long consumerId, String permissionType, String targetId) {
27:     Permission permission =
28:         permissionRepository.findTopByPermissionTypeAndTargetId(permissionType, targetId);
29:     if (permission == null) {
30:       return false;
31:     }
32:     List<ConsumerRole> consumerRoles = consumerRoleRepository.findByConsumerId(consumerId);
33:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(consumerRoles)) {
34:       return false;
35:     }
36:     Set<Long> roleIds =
37:         consumerRoles.stream().map(ConsumerRole::getRoleId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
38:     List<RolePermission> rolePermissions = rolePermissionRepository.findByRoleIdIn(roleIds);
39:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(rolePermissions)) {
40:       return false;
41:     }
42:     for (RolePermission rolePermission : rolePermissions) {
43:       if (rolePermission.getPermissionId() == permission.getId()) {
44:         return true;
45:       }
46:     }
47:     return false;
48:   }
49: }

 59:   public Consumer createConsumer(Consumer consumer) {
 60:     String appId = consumer.getAppId();
 61:     Consumer managedConsumer = consumerRepository.findByAppId(appId);
 62:     if (managedConsumer != null) {
 63:       throw new BadRequestException("Consumer already exist");
 64:     }
 65:     String ownerName = consumer.getOwnerName();

 81:   }

 89:   public Long getConsumerIdByToken(String token) {
 90:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(token)) {
 91:       return null;
 92:     }
 93:     ConsumerToken consumerToken = consumerTokenRepository.findTopByTokenAndExpiresAfter(token,
 94:                                                                                         new Date());
 95:     return consumerToken == null ? null : consumerToken.getConsumerId();
 96:   }
 97:   public Consumer getConsumerByConsumerId(long consumerId) {
 98:     return consumerRepository.findById(consumerId).orElse(null);

100:   public List<ConsumerRole> assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(String token, String appId, String namespaceName) {
101:     return assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(token, appId, namespaceName, null);
102:   }
103:   @Transactional
104:   public List<ConsumerRole> assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(String token, String appId, String namespaceName, String env) {
105:     Long consumerId = getConsumerIdByToken(token);
106:     if (consumerId == null) {
107:       throw new BadRequestException("Token is Illegal");
108:     }
109:     Role namespaceModifyRole =
110:         rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(RoleUtils.buildModifyNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, env));
111:     Role namespaceReleaseRole =
112:         rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(RoleUtils.buildReleaseNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, env));
113:     if (namespaceModifyRole == null || namespaceReleaseRole == null) {
114:       throw new BadRequestException("Namespace's role does not exist. Please check whether namespace has created.");
115:     }
116:     long namespaceModifyRoleId = namespaceModifyRole.getId();
117:     long namespaceReleaseRoleId = namespaceReleaseRole.getId();
118:     ConsumerRole managedModifyRole = consumerRoleRepository.findByConsumerIdAndRoleId(consumerId, namespaceModifyRoleId);
119:     ConsumerRole managedReleaseRole = consumerRoleRepository.findByConsumerIdAndRoleId(consumerId, namespaceReleaseRoleId);
120:     if (managedModifyRole != null && managedReleaseRole != null) {
121:       return Arrays.asList(managedModifyRole, managedReleaseRole);
122:     }
123:     String operator = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
124:     ConsumerRole namespaceModifyConsumerRole = createConsumerRole(consumerId, namespaceModifyRoleId, operator);
125:     ConsumerRole namespaceReleaseConsumerRole = createConsumerRole(consumerId, namespaceReleaseRoleId, operator);
126:     ConsumerRole createdModifyConsumerRole = consumerRoleRepository.save(namespaceModifyConsumerRole);
127:     ConsumerRole createdReleaseConsumerRole = consumerRoleRepository.save(namespaceReleaseConsumerRole);
128:     return Arrays.asList(createdModifyConsumerRole, createdReleaseConsumerRole);
129:   }
130:   @Transactional
131:   public ConsumerRole assignAppRoleToConsumer(String token, String appId) {
132:     Long consumerId = getConsumerIdByToken(token);
133:     if (consumerId == null) {
134:       throw new BadRequestException("Token is Illegal");
135:     }
136:     Role masterRole = rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(RoleUtils.buildAppMasterRoleName(appId));
137:     if (masterRole == null) {
138:       throw new BadRequestException("App's role does not exist. Please check whether app has created.");
139:     }
140:     long roleId = masterRole.getId();
141:     ConsumerRole managedModifyRole = consumerRoleRepository.findByConsumerIdAndRoleId(consumerId, roleId);
142:     if (managedModifyRole != null) {
143:       return managedModifyRole;
144:     }
145:     String operator = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
146:     ConsumerRole consumerRole = createConsumerRole(consumerId, roleId, operator);
147:     return consumerRoleRepository.save(consumerRole);
148:   }
149:   @Transactional
150:   public void createConsumerAudits(Iterable<ConsumerAudit> consumerAudits) {
151:     consumerAuditRepository.saveAll(consumerAudits);
152:   }
153:   @Transactional
154:   public ConsumerToken createConsumerToken(ConsumerToken entity) {
155:     entity.setId(0);
156:     return consumerTokenRepository.save(entity);
157:   }
158:   private ConsumerToken generateConsumerToken(Consumer consumer, Date expires) {
159:     long consumerId = consumer.getId();
160:     String createdBy = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
161:     Date createdTime = new Date();
162:     ConsumerToken consumerToken = new ConsumerToken();
163:     consumerToken.setConsumerId(consumerId);
164:     consumerToken.setExpires(expires);
165:     consumerToken.setDataChangeCreatedBy(createdBy);
166:     consumerToken.setDataChangeCreatedTime(createdTime);
167:     consumerToken.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(createdBy);
168:     consumerToken.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(createdTime);
169:     generateAndEnrichToken(consumer, consumerToken);
170:     return consumerToken;
171:   }
172:   void generateAndEnrichToken(Consumer consumer, ConsumerToken consumerToken) {
173:     Preconditions.checkArgument(consumer != null);
174:     if (consumerToken.getDataChangeCreatedTime() == null) {
175:       consumerToken.setDataChangeCreatedTime(new Date());
176:     }
177:     consumerToken.setToken(generateToken(consumer.getAppId(), consumerToken
178:         .getDataChangeCreatedTime(), portalConfig.consumerTokenSalt()));
179:   }
180:   String generateToken(String consumerAppId, Date generationTime, String
181:       consumerTokenSalt) {
182:     return Hashing.sha1().hashString(KEY_JOINER.join(consumerAppId, TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.format
183:         (generationTime), consumerTokenSalt), Charsets.UTF_8).toString();
184:   }
185:     ConsumerRole createConsumerRole(Long consumerId, Long roleId, String operator) {
186:     ConsumerRole consumerRole = new ConsumerRole();
187:     consumerRole.setConsumerId(consumerId);
188:     consumerRole.setRoleId(roleId);
189:     consumerRole.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
190:     consumerRole.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
191:     return consumerRole;
192:   }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.util;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity.ConsumerAudit;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.service.ConsumerService;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 6: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 7: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 8: import com.google.common.collect.Queues;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean;
10: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
11: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
12: import java.util.Date;
13: import java.util.List;
14: import java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue;
15: import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
16: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
17: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
18: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
19: @Service
20: public class ConsumerAuditUtil implements InitializingBean {
21:   private static final int CONSUMER_AUDIT_MAX_SIZE = 10000;
22:   private BlockingQueue<ConsumerAudit> audits = Queues.newLinkedBlockingQueue(CONSUMER_AUDIT_MAX_SIZE);
23:   private final ExecutorService auditExecutorService;
24:   private final AtomicBoolean auditStopped;
25:   private int BATCH_SIZE = 100;
26:   private long BATCH_TIMEOUT = 5;
27:   private TimeUnit BATCH_TIMEUNIT = TimeUnit.SECONDS;
28:   private final ConsumerService consumerService;
29:   public ConsumerAuditUtil(final ConsumerService consumerService) {
30:     this.consumerService = consumerService;
31:     auditExecutorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(
32:         ApolloThreadFactory.create("ConsumerAuditUtil", true));
33:     auditStopped = new AtomicBoolean(false);
34:   }
35:   public boolean audit(HttpServletRequest request, long consumerId) {
36:     if ("GET".equalsIgnoreCase(request.getMethod())) {
37:       return true;
38:     }
39:     String uri = request.getRequestURI();
40:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(request.getQueryString())) {
41:       uri += "?" + request.getQueryString();
42:     }
43:     ConsumerAudit consumerAudit = new ConsumerAudit();
44:     Date now = new Date();
45:     consumerAudit.setConsumerId(consumerId);
46:     consumerAudit.setUri(uri);
47:     consumerAudit.setMethod(request.getMethod());
48:     consumerAudit.setDataChangeCreatedTime(now);
49:     consumerAudit.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(now);
50:     return this.audits.offer(consumerAudit);
51:   }
52:   @Override
53:   public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception {
54:     auditExecutorService.submit(() -> {
55:       while (!auditStopped.get() && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
56:         List<ConsumerAudit> toAudit = Lists.newArrayList();
57:         try {
58:           Queues.drain(audits, toAudit, BATCH_SIZE, BATCH_TIMEOUT, BATCH_TIMEUNIT);
59:           if (!toAudit.isEmpty()) {
60:             consumerService.createConsumerAudits(toAudit);
61:           }
62:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
63:           Tracer.logError(ex);
64:         }
65:       }
66:     });
67:   }
68:   public void stopAudit() {
69:     auditStopped.set(true);
70:   }
71: }

101:   }
102:   public static GrayReleaseRuleDTO transformToGrayReleaseRuleDTO(
103:       OpenGrayReleaseRuleDTO openGrayReleaseRuleDTO) {
104:     Preconditions.checkArgument(openGrayReleaseRuleDTO != null);
105:     String appId = openGrayReleaseRuleDTO.getAppId();
106:     String branchName = openGrayReleaseRuleDTO.getBranchName();
107:     String clusterName = openGrayReleaseRuleDTO.getClusterName();
108:     String namespaceName = openGrayReleaseRuleDTO.getNamespaceName();
109:     GrayReleaseRuleDTO grayReleaseRuleDTO =
110:         new GrayReleaseRuleDTO(appId, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName);
111:     Set<OpenGrayReleaseRuleItemDTO> openGrayReleaseRuleItemDTOSet =
112:         openGrayReleaseRuleDTO.getRuleItems();
113:     openGrayReleaseRuleItemDTOSet.forEach(openGrayReleaseRuleItemDTO -> {
114:       String clientAppId = openGrayReleaseRuleItemDTO.getClientAppId();
115:       Set<String> clientIpList = openGrayReleaseRuleItemDTO.getClientIpList();
116:       GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO ruleItem = new GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO(clientAppId, clientIpList);
117:       grayReleaseRuleDTO.addRuleItem(ruleItem);
118:     });
119:     return grayReleaseRuleDTO;
120:   }
121:   public static List<OpenAppDTO> transformFromApps(final List<App> apps) {
122:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(apps)) {
123:       return Collections.emptyList();
124:     }
125:     return apps.stream().map(OpenApiBeanUtils::transformFromApp).collect(Collectors.toList());
126:   }
127:   public static OpenAppDTO transformFromApp(final App app) {
128:     Preconditions.checkArgument(app != null);
129:     return BeanUtils.transform(OpenAppDTO.class, app);
130:   }
131:   public static OpenClusterDTO transformFromClusterDTO(ClusterDTO Cluster) {
132:     Preconditions.checkArgument(Cluster != null);
133:     return BeanUtils.transform(OpenClusterDTO.class, Cluster);
134:   }
135:   public static ClusterDTO transformToClusterDTO(OpenClusterDTO openClusterDTO) {
136:     Preconditions.checkArgument(openClusterDTO != null);
137:     return BeanUtils.transform(ClusterDTO.class, openClusterDTO);
138:   }

 35:   private final ApplicationEventPublisher publisher;
 36:   private final UserService userService;
 37:   public NamespaceController(
 38:       final NamespaceLockService namespaceLockService,
 39:       final NamespaceService namespaceService,
 40:       final AppNamespaceService appNamespaceService,
 41:       final ApplicationEventPublisher publisher,
 42:       final UserService userService) {
 43:     this.namespaceLockService = namespaceLockService;
 44:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 45:     this.appNamespaceService = appNamespaceService;
 46:     this.publisher = publisher;
 47:     this.userService = userService;
 48:   }
 49:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@consumerPermissionValidator.hasCreateNamespacePermission(#request, #appId)")
 50:   @PostMapping(value = "/openapi/v1/apps/{appId}/appnamespaces")
 51:   public OpenAppNamespaceDTO createNamespace(@PathVariable String appId,
 52:                                              @RequestBody OpenAppNamespaceDTO appNamespaceDTO,
 53:                                              HttpServletRequest request) {
 54:     if (!Objects.equals(appId, appNamespaceDTO.getAppId())) {
 55:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("AppId not equal. AppId in path = %s, AppId in payload = %s", appId,
 56:                                                   appNamespaceDTO.getAppId()));
 57:     }
 58:     RequestPrecondition.checkArgumentsNotEmpty(appNamespaceDTO.getAppId(), appNamespaceDTO.getName(),
 59:                                                appNamespaceDTO.getFormat(), appNamespaceDTO.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
 60:     if (!InputValidator.isValidAppNamespace(appNamespaceDTO.getName())) {
 61:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Invalid Namespace format: %s",
 62:                                                   InputValidator.INVALID_CLUSTER_NAMESPACE_MESSAGE + " & "
 63:                                                   + InputValidator.INVALID_NAMESPACE_NAMESPACE_MESSAGE));
 64:     }
 65:     if (!ConfigFileFormat.isValidFormat(appNamespaceDTO.getFormat())) {
 66:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Invalid namespace format. format = %s", appNamespaceDTO.getFormat()));
 67:     }
 68:     String operator = appNamespaceDTO.getDataChangeCreatedBy();
 69:     if (userService.findByUserId(operator) == null) {
 70:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Illegal user. user = %s", operator));
 71:     }
 72:     AppNamespace appNamespace = OpenApiBeanUtils.transformToAppNamespace(appNamespaceDTO);
 73:     AppNamespace createdAppNamespace = appNamespaceService.createAppNamespaceInLocal(appNamespace, appNamespaceDTO.isAppendNamespacePrefix());
 74:     publisher.publishEvent(new AppNamespaceCreationEvent(createdAppNamespace));
 75:     return OpenApiBeanUtils.transformToOpenAppNamespaceDTO(createdAppNamespace);
 76:   }
 77:   @GetMapping(value = "/openapi/v1/envs/{env}/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces")
 78:   public List<OpenNamespaceDTO> findNamespaces(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env,
 79:                                                @PathVariable String clusterName) {
 80:     return OpenApiBeanUtils
 81:         .batchTransformFromNamespaceBOs(namespaceService.findNamespaceBOs(appId, Env
 82:             .valueOf(env), clusterName));
 83:   }
 84:   @GetMapping(value = "/openapi/v1/envs/{env}/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName:.+}")
 85:   public OpenNamespaceDTO loadNamespace(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env,
 86:                                         @PathVariable String clusterName, @PathVariable String
 87:                                             namespaceName) {
 88:     NamespaceBO namespaceBO = namespaceService.loadNamespaceBO(appId, Env.valueOf
 89:         (env), clusterName, namespaceName);
 90:     if (namespaceBO == null) {
 91:       return null;
 92:     }
 93:     return OpenApiBeanUtils.transformFromNamespaceBO(namespaceBO);
 94:   }
 95:   @GetMapping(value = "/openapi/v1/envs/{env}/apps/{appId}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/lock")
 96:   public OpenNamespaceLockDTO getNamespaceLock(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env,
 97:                                                @PathVariable String clusterName, @PathVariable
 98:                                                    String namespaceName) {
 99:     NamespaceDTO namespace = namespaceService.loadNamespaceBaseInfo(appId, Env
100:         .valueOf(env), clusterName, namespaceName);
101:     NamespaceLockDTO lockDTO = namespaceLockService.getNamespaceLock(appId, Env
102:         .valueOf(env), clusterName, namespaceName);
103:     return OpenApiBeanUtils.transformFromNamespaceLockDTO(namespace.getNamespaceName(), lockDTO);

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.PortalMetaDomainService;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ServiceDTO;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
  7: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
  8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
  9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 10: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.http.HttpMessageConverters;
 11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 12: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 13: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
 14: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 15: import java.util.Arrays;
 16: import java.util.Collections;
 17: import java.util.List;
 18: import java.util.Map;
 19: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
 20: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 21: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 22: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 23: @Component
 24: public class AdminServiceAddressLocator {
 25:   private static final long NORMAL_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 5 * 60 * 1000;
 26:   private static final long OFFLINE_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 10 * 1000;
 27:   private static final int RETRY_TIMES = 3;
 28:   private static final String ADMIN_SERVICE_URL_PATH = "/services/admin";
 29:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AdminServiceAddressLocator.class);
 30:   private ScheduledExecutorService refreshServiceAddressService;
 31:   private RestTemplate restTemplate;
 32:   private List<Env> allEnvs;
 33:   private Map<Env, List<ServiceDTO>> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 34:   private final PortalSettings portalSettings;
 35:   private final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory;
 36:   private final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService;
 37:   public AdminServiceAddressLocator(
 38:       final HttpMessageConverters httpMessageConverters,
 39:       final PortalSettings portalSettings,
 40:       final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory,
 41:       final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService
 42:   ) {
 43:     this.portalSettings = portalSettings;
 44:     this.restTemplateFactory = restTemplateFactory;
 45:     this.portalMetaDomainService = portalMetaDomainService;
 46:   }
 47:   @PostConstruct
 48:   public void init() {
 49:     allEnvs = portalSettings.getAllEnvs();
 50:     restTemplate = restTemplateFactory.getObject();
 51:     refreshServiceAddressService =
 52:         Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory.create("ServiceLocator", true));
 53:     refreshServiceAddressService.schedule(new RefreshAdminServerAddressTask(), 1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 54:   }
 55:   public List<ServiceDTO> getServiceList(Env env) {
 56:     List<ServiceDTO> services = cache.get(env);
 57:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(services)) {
 58:       return Collections.emptyList();
 59:     }
 60:     List<ServiceDTO> randomConfigServices = Lists.newArrayList(services);
 61:     Collections.shuffle(randomConfigServices);
 62:     return randomConfigServices;
 63:   }
 64:   private class RefreshAdminServerAddressTask implements Runnable {
 65:     @Override
 66:     public void run() {
 67:       boolean refreshSuccess = true;
 68:       for (Env env : allEnvs) {
 69:         boolean currentEnvRefreshResult = refreshServerAddressCache(env);
 70:         refreshSuccess = refreshSuccess && currentEnvRefreshResult;
 71:       }
 72:       if (refreshSuccess) {
 73:         refreshServiceAddressService
 74:             .schedule(new RefreshAdminServerAddressTask(), NORMAL_REFRESH_INTERVAL, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 75:       } else {
 76:         refreshServiceAddressService
 77:             .schedule(new RefreshAdminServerAddressTask(), OFFLINE_REFRESH_INTERVAL, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 78:       }
 79:     }
 80:   }
 81:   private boolean refreshServerAddressCache(Env env) {
 82:     for (int i = 0; i < RETRY_TIMES; i++) {
 83:       try {
 84:         ServiceDTO[] services = getAdminServerAddress(env);
 85:         if (services == null || services.length == 0) {
 86:           continue;
 87:         }
 88:         cache.put(env, Arrays.asList(services));
 89:         return true;
 90:       } catch (Throwable e) {
 91:         logger.error(String.format("Get admin server address from meta server failed. env: %s, meta server address:%s",
 92:                                    env, portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env)), e);
 93:         Tracer
 94:             .logError(String.format("Get admin server address from meta server failed. env: %s, meta server address:%s",
 95:                                     env, portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env)), e);
 96:       }
 97:     }
 98:     return false;
 99:   }
100:   private ServiceDTO[] getAdminServerAddress(Env env) {
101:     String domainName = portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env);
102:     String url = domainName + ADMIN_SERVICE_URL_PATH;
103:     return restTemplate.getForObject(url, ServiceDTO[].class);
104:   }
105: }

 6: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
 7: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
 8: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 9: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.ReleaseHistoryBO;
11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
12: @Component
13: public class ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier {
14:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier.class);
15:   private final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory;
16:   private RestTemplate restTemplate;
17:   public ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier(RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory) {
18:     this.restTemplateFactory = restTemplateFactory;
19:   }
20:   @PostConstruct
21:   public void init() {
22:     restTemplate = restTemplateFactory.getObject();
23:   }
24:   public void notify(String[] webHookUrls, Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
25:     if (webHookUrls == null) {
26:       return;
27:     }
28:     for (String webHookUrl : webHookUrls) {
29:       HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
30:       headers.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_UTF8);
31:       HttpEntity entity = new HttpEntity(releaseHistory, headers);
32:       String url = webHookUrl + "?env={env}";
33:       try {
34:         restTemplate.postForObject(url, entity, String.class, env);
35:       } catch (Exception e) {
36:         logger.error("Notify webHook server failed, env: {}, webHook server url:{}", env, url, e);
37:       }
38:     }
39:   }
40: }

 82:   private String renderReleaseBasicInfo(String template, Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
 83:     String renderResult = template;
 84:     Map<String, Object> operationContext = releaseHistory.getOperationContext();
 85:     boolean isEmergencyPublish = operationContext.containsKey(ReleaseOperationContext.IS_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH) &&
 86:                                  (boolean) operationContext.get(ReleaseOperationContext.IS_EMERGENCY_PUBLISH);
 87:     if (isEmergencyPublish) {
