107:   private String renderDiffModule(String bodyTemplate, Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
108:     String appId = releaseHistory.getAppId();
109:     String namespaceName = releaseHistory.getNamespaceName();
110:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
111:     if (appNamespace == null) {
112:       appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findPublicAppNamespace(namespaceName);
113:     }
114:     //don't show diff content if namespace's format is file
115:     if (appNamespace == null ||
116:             !appNamespace.getFormat().equals(ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue())) {
117:       return bodyTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_DIFF_MODULE, "<br><h4>变更内容请点击链接到Apollo上查看</h4>");
118:     }
119:     ReleaseCompareResult result = getReleaseCompareResult(env, releaseHistory);
120:     if (!result.hasContent()) {
121:       return bodyTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_DIFF_MODULE, "<br><h4>无配置变更</h4>");
122:     }
123:     List<Change> changes = result.getChanges();
124:     StringBuilder changesHtmlBuilder = new StringBuilder();
125:     for (Change change : changes) {
126:       String key = change.getEntity().getFirstEntity().getKey();
127:       String oldValue = change.getEntity().getFirstEntity().getValue();
128:       String newValue = change.getEntity().getSecondEntity().getValue();
129:       newValue = newValue == null ? "" : newValue;
130:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("<tr>");
131:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("<td width=\"10%\">").append(change.getType().toString()).append("</td>");
132:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("<td width=\"20%\">").append(cutOffString(key)).append("</td>");
133:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("<td width=\"35%\">").append(cutOffString(oldValue)).append("</td>");
134:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("<td width=\"35%\">").append(cutOffString(newValue)).append("</td>");
135:       changesHtmlBuilder.append("</tr>");
136:     }
137:     String diffContent = Matcher.quoteReplacement(changesHtmlBuilder.toString());
138:     String diffModuleTemplate = getDiffModuleTemplate();
139:     String diffModuleRenderResult = diffModuleTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_FIELD_DIFF_CONTENT, diffContent);
140:     return bodyTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_DIFF_MODULE, diffModuleRenderResult);
141:   }
142:   private ReleaseCompareResult getReleaseCompareResult(Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
143:     if (releaseHistory.getOperation() == ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE
144:             && releaseHistory.getPreviousReleaseId() == 0) {
145:       ReleaseDTO masterLatestActiveRelease = releaseService.loadLatestRelease(
146:               releaseHistory.getAppId(), env, releaseHistory.getClusterName(), releaseHistory.getNamespaceName());
147:       ReleaseDTO branchLatestActiveRelease = releaseService.findReleaseById(env, releaseHistory.getReleaseId());
148:       return releaseService.compare(masterLatestActiveRelease, branchLatestActiveRelease);
149:     }
150:     return releaseService.compare(env, releaseHistory.getPreviousReleaseId(), releaseHistory.getReleaseId());
151:   }
152:   private List<String> recipients(String appId, String namespaceName, String env) {
153:     Set<UserInfo> modifyRoleUsers =
154:             rolePermissionService
155:                     .queryUsersWithRole(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE));
156:     Set<UserInfo> envModifyRoleUsers =
157:         rolePermissionService
158:             .queryUsersWithRole(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE, env));
159:     Set<UserInfo> releaseRoleUsers =
160:             rolePermissionService
161:                     .queryUsersWithRole(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE));
162:     Set<UserInfo> envReleaseRoleUsers =
163:         rolePermissionService
164:             .queryUsersWithRole(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE, env));
165:     Set<UserInfo> owners = rolePermissionService.queryUsersWithRole(RoleUtils.buildAppMasterRoleName(appId));
166:     Set<String> userIds = new HashSet<>(modifyRoleUsers.size() + releaseRoleUsers.size() + owners.size());
167:     for (UserInfo userInfo : modifyRoleUsers) {
168:       userIds.add(userInfo.getUserId());
169:     }
170:     for (UserInfo userInfo : envModifyRoleUsers) {
171:       userIds.add(userInfo.getUserId());
172:     }
173:     for (UserInfo userInfo : releaseRoleUsers) {
174:       userIds.add(userInfo.getUserId());
175:     }
176:     for (UserInfo userInfo : envReleaseRoleUsers) {
177:       userIds.add(userInfo.getUserId());
178:     }
179:     for (UserInfo userInfo : owners) {
180:       userIds.add(userInfo.getUserId());
181:     }
182:     List<UserInfo> userInfos = userService.findByUserIds(Lists.newArrayList(userIds));
183:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(userInfos)) {
184:       return Collections.emptyList();
185:     }
186:     List<String> recipients = new ArrayList<>(userInfos.size());
187:     for (UserInfo userInfo : userInfos) {
188:       recipients.add(userInfo.getEmail());
189:     }
190:     return recipients;
191:   }
192:   protected String getApolloPortalAddress() {
193:     return portalConfig.portalAddress();
194:   }
195:   private String cutOffString(String source) {
196:     if (source.length() > VALUE_MAX_LENGTH) {
197:       return source.substring(0, VALUE_MAX_LENGTH) + "...";
198:     }
199:     return source;
200:   }

16:   private static final String EMAIL_SUBJECT = "[Apollo] 灰度发布";
17:   private Gson gson = new Gson();
18:   private Joiner IP_JOINER = Joiner.on(", ");
19:   @Override
20:   protected String subject() {
21:     return EMAIL_SUBJECT;
22:   }
23:   @Override
24:   public String emailContent(Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {

26:     return renderGrayReleaseRuleContent(result, releaseHistory);

28:   @Override
29:   protected String getTemplateFramework() {

33:   protected String getDiffModuleTemplate() {

36:   private String renderGrayReleaseRuleContent(String bodyTemplate, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
37:     Map<String, Object> context = releaseHistory.getOperationContext();
38:     Object rules = context.get("rules");
39:     List<GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO>
40:             ruleItems = rules == null ?
41:             null : gson.fromJson(rules.toString(), GsonType.RULE_ITEMS);
42:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(ruleItems)) {
43:       return bodyTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_GRAY_RULES_MODULE, "<br><h4>无灰度规则</h4>");
44:     }
45:     StringBuilder rulesHtmlBuilder = new StringBuilder();
46:     for (GrayReleaseRuleItemDTO ruleItem : ruleItems) {
47:       String clientAppId = ruleItem.getClientAppId();
48:       Set<String> ips = ruleItem.getClientIpList();
49:       rulesHtmlBuilder.append("<b>AppId:&nbsp;</b>")
50:               .append(clientAppId)
51:               .append("&nbsp;&nbsp; <b>IP:&nbsp;</b>");
52:       IP_JOINER.appendTo(rulesHtmlBuilder, ips);
53:     }
54:     String grayRulesModuleContent = portalConfig.emailGrayRulesModuleTemplate().replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_GRAY_RULES_CONTENT,
55:             Matcher.quoteReplacement(rulesHtmlBuilder.toString()));
56:     return bodyTemplate.replaceAll(EMAIL_CONTENT_GRAY_RULES_MODULE, Matcher.quoteReplacement(grayRulesModuleContent));
57:   }
58: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils.BeanUtils;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 7: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 8: import java.util.LinkedList;
 9: import java.util.List;
10: import java.util.Map;
11: import java.util.Objects;
12: @Component
13: public class ItemsComparator {
14:   public ItemChangeSets compareIgnoreBlankAndCommentItem(long baseNamespaceId, List<ItemDTO> baseItems, List<ItemDTO> targetItems){
15:     List<ItemDTO> filteredSourceItems = filterBlankAndCommentItem(baseItems);
16:     List<ItemDTO> filteredTargetItems = filterBlankAndCommentItem(targetItems);
17:     Map<String, ItemDTO> sourceItemMap = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", filteredSourceItems);
18:     Map<String, ItemDTO> targetItemMap = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", filteredTargetItems);
19:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = new ItemChangeSets();
20:     for (ItemDTO item: targetItems){
21:       String key = item.getKey();
22:       ItemDTO sourceItem = sourceItemMap.get(key);
23:       if (sourceItem == null){
24:         ItemDTO copiedItem = copyItem(item);
25:         copiedItem.setNamespaceId(baseNamespaceId);
26:         changeSets.addCreateItem(copiedItem);
27:       }else if (!Objects.equals(sourceItem.getValue(), item.getValue())){
28:         sourceItem.setValue(item.getValue());
29:         sourceItem.setComment(item.getComment());
30:         changeSets.addUpdateItem(sourceItem);
31:       }
32:     }
33:     for (ItemDTO item: baseItems){
34:       String key = item.getKey();
35:       ItemDTO targetItem = targetItemMap.get(key);
36:       if(targetItem == null){
37:         changeSets.addDeleteItem(item);
38:       }
39:     }
40:     return changeSets;
41:   }
42:   private List<ItemDTO> filterBlankAndCommentItem(List<ItemDTO> items){
43:     List<ItemDTO> result = new LinkedList<>();
44:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(items)){
45:       return result;
46:     }
47:     for (ItemDTO item: items){
48:       if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(item.getKey())){
49:         result.add(item);
50:       }
51:     }
52:     return result;
53:   }
54:   private ItemDTO copyItem(ItemDTO sourceItem){
55:     ItemDTO copiedItem = new ItemDTO();
56:     copiedItem.setKey(sourceItem.getKey());
57:     copiedItem.setValue(sourceItem.getValue());
58:     copiedItem.setComment(sourceItem.getComment());
59:     return copiedItem;
60:   }
61: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.PortalMetaDomainService;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;

  8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  9: import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.Health;
 10: import org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext;
 11: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 12: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 13: import java.util.ArrayList;
 14: import java.util.HashMap;
 15: import java.util.LinkedList;
 16: import java.util.List;
 17: import java.util.Map;
 18: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
 19: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 20: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 21: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 22: @Component
 23: public class PortalSettings {
 24:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PortalSettings.class);
 25:   private static final int HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL = 10 * 1000;
 26:   private final ApplicationContext applicationContext;
 27:   private final PortalConfig portalConfig;
 28:   private final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService;
 29:   private List<Env> allEnvs = new ArrayList<>();
 30:   private Map<Env, Boolean> envStatusMark = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 31:   public PortalSettings(
 32:           final ApplicationContext applicationContext,
 33:           final PortalConfig portalConfig,
 34:           final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService
 35:   ) {
 36:     this.applicationContext = applicationContext;
 37:     this.portalConfig = portalConfig;
 38:     this.portalMetaDomainService = portalMetaDomainService;
 39:   }
 40:   @PostConstruct
 41:   private void postConstruct() {
 42:     allEnvs = portalConfig.portalSupportedEnvs();
 43:     for (Env env : allEnvs) {
 44:       envStatusMark.put(env, true);
 45:     }
 46:     ScheduledExecutorService
 47:         healthCheckService =
 48:         Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory.create("EnvHealthChecker", true));
 49:     healthCheckService
 50:         .scheduleWithFixedDelay(new HealthCheckTask(applicationContext), 1000, HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL,
 51:                                 TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 52:   }
 53:   public List<Env> getAllEnvs() {
 54:     return allEnvs;
 55:   }
 56:   public List<Env> getActiveEnvs() {
 57:     List<Env> activeEnvs = new LinkedList<>();
 58:     for (Env env : allEnvs) {
 59:       if (envStatusMark.get(env)) {
 60:         activeEnvs.add(env);
 61:       }
 62:     }
 63:     return activeEnvs;
 64:   }
 65:   public boolean isEnvActive(Env env) {
 66:     Boolean mark = envStatusMark.get(env);
 67:     return mark != null && mark;
 68:   }
 69:   private class HealthCheckTask implements Runnable {
 70:     private static final int ENV_DOWN_THRESHOLD = 2;
 71:     private Map<Env, Integer> healthCheckFailedCounter = new HashMap<>();
 72:     private AdminServiceAPI.HealthAPI healthAPI;
 73:     public HealthCheckTask(ApplicationContext context) {
 74:       healthAPI = context.getBean(AdminServiceAPI.HealthAPI.class);
 75:       for (Env env : allEnvs) {
 76:         healthCheckFailedCounter.put(env, 0);
 77:       }
 78:     }
 79:     public void run() {
 80:       for (Env env : allEnvs) {
 81:         try {
 82:           if (isUp(env)) {
 83:             if (!envStatusMark.get(env)) {
 84:               envStatusMark.put(env, true);
 85:               healthCheckFailedCounter.put(env, 0);
 86:               logger.info("Env revived because env health check success. env: {}", env);
 87:             }
 88:           } else {
 89:             logger.error("Env health check failed, maybe because of admin server down. env: {}, meta server address: {}", env,
 90:                     portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env));
 91:             handleEnvDown(env);
 92:           }
 93:         } catch (Exception e) {
 94:           logger.error("Env health check failed, maybe because of meta server down "
 95:                        + "or configure wrong meta server address. env: {}, meta server address: {}", env,
 96:                   portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env), e);
 97:           handleEnvDown(env);
 98:         }
 99:       }
100:     }
101:     private boolean isUp(Env env) {
102:       Health health = healthAPI.health(env);
103:       return "UP".equals(health.getStatus().getCode());
104:     }
105:     private void handleEnvDown(Env env) {
106:       int failedTimes = healthCheckFailedCounter.get(env);
107:       healthCheckFailedCounter.put(env, ++failedTimes);
108:       if (!envStatusMark.get(env)) {
109:         logger.error("Env is down. env: {}, failed times: {}, meta server address: {}", env, failedTimes,
110:                 portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env));
111:       } else {
112:         if (failedTimes >= ENV_DOWN_THRESHOLD) {
113:           envStatusMark.put(env, false);
114:           logger.error("Env is down because health check failed for {} times, "
115:                        + "which equals to down threshold. env: {}, meta server address: {}", ENV_DOWN_THRESHOLD, env,
116:                   portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env));
117:         } else {
118:           logger.error(
119:               "Env health check failed for {} times which less than down threshold. down threshold:{}, env: {}, meta server address: {}",
120:               failedTimes, ENV_DOWN_THRESHOLD, env, portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env));
121:         }
122:       }
123:     }
124:   }
125: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.ServiceException;

 10: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 11: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 12: import com.google.gson.Gson;
 13: import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken;
 14: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 15: import java.net.SocketTimeoutException;
 16: import java.util.List;
 17: import java.util.Map;
 18: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 19: import org.apache.http.conn.ConnectTimeoutException;

 32: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
 33: import org.springframework.web.util.DefaultUriBuilderFactory;
 34: import org.springframework.web.util.UriTemplateHandler;
 35: @Component
 36: public class RetryableRestTemplate {
 37:   private Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RetryableRestTemplate.class);
 38:   private UriTemplateHandler uriTemplateHandler = new DefaultUriBuilderFactory();
 39:   private static final Gson GSON = new Gson();
 40:   private static final Type ACCESS_TOKENS = new TypeToken<Map<String, String>>(){}.getType();
 41:   private RestTemplate restTemplate;
 42:   private final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory;
 43:   private final AdminServiceAddressLocator adminServiceAddressLocator;
 44:   private final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService;
 45:   private final PortalConfig portalConfig;
 46:   private volatile String lastAdminServiceAccessTokens;
 47:   private volatile Map<Env, String> adminServiceAccessTokenMap;
 48:   public RetryableRestTemplate(
 49:       final @Lazy RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory,
 50:       final @Lazy AdminServiceAddressLocator adminServiceAddressLocator,
 51:       final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService,
 52:       final PortalConfig portalConfig
 53:   ) {
 54:     this.restTemplateFactory = restTemplateFactory;
 55:     this.adminServiceAddressLocator = adminServiceAddressLocator;
 56:     this.portalMetaDomainService = portalMetaDomainService;
 57:     this.portalConfig = portalConfig;
 58:   }
 59:   @PostConstruct
 60:   private void postConstruct() {
 61:     restTemplate = restTemplateFactory.getObject();
 62:   }
 63:   public <T> T get(Env env, String path, Class<T> responseType, Object... urlVariables)
 64:       throws RestClientException {
 65:     return execute(HttpMethod.GET, env, path, null, responseType, urlVariables);
 66:   }
 67:   public <T> ResponseEntity<T> get(Env env, String path, ParameterizedTypeReference<T> reference,
 68:                                    Object... uriVariables)
 69:       throws RestClientException {
 70:     return exchangeGet(env, path, reference, uriVariables);
 71:   }
 72:   public <T> T post(Env env, String path, Object request, Class<T> responseType, Object... uriVariables)
 73:       throws RestClientException {
 74:     return execute(HttpMethod.POST, env, path, request, responseType, uriVariables);
 75:   }
 76:   public void put(Env env, String path, Object request, Object... urlVariables) throws RestClientException {
 77:     execute(HttpMethod.PUT, env, path, request, null, urlVariables);
 78:   }
 79:   public void delete(Env env, String path, Object... urlVariables) throws RestClientException {
 80:     execute(HttpMethod.DELETE, env, path, null, null, urlVariables);
 81:   }
 82:   private <T> T execute(HttpMethod method, Env env, String path, Object request, Class<T> responseType,
 83:                         Object... uriVariables) {
 84:     if (path.startsWith("/")) {
 85:       path = path.substring(1);
 86:     }
 87:     String uri = uriTemplateHandler.expand(path, uriVariables).getPath();
 88:     Transaction ct = Tracer.newTransaction("AdminAPI", uri);
 89:     ct.addData("Env", env);
 90:     List<ServiceDTO> services = getAdminServices(env, ct);
 91:     HttpHeaders extraHeaders = assembleExtraHeaders(env);
 92:     for (ServiceDTO serviceDTO : services) {
 93:       try {
 94:         T result = doExecute(method, extraHeaders, serviceDTO, path, request, responseType, uriVariables);
 95:         ct.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
 96:         ct.complete();
 97:         return result;
 98:       } catch (Throwable t) {
 99:         logger.error("Http request failed, uri: {}, method: {}", uri, method, t);
100:         Tracer.logError(t);
101:         if (canRetry(t, method)) {
102:           Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.API_RETRY, uri);
103:         } else {
104:           ct.setStatus(t);
105:           ct.complete();
106:           throw t;
107:         }
108:       }
109:     }
110:     ServiceException e =
111:         new ServiceException(String.format("Admin servers are unresponsive. meta server address: %s, admin servers: %s",
112:                 portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env), services));
113:     ct.setStatus(e);
114:     ct.complete();
115:     throw e;
116:   }
117:   private <T> ResponseEntity<T> exchangeGet(Env env, String path, ParameterizedTypeReference<T> reference,
118:                                             Object... uriVariables) {
119:     if (path.startsWith("/")) {
120:       path = path.substring(1);
121:     }
122:     String uri = uriTemplateHandler.expand(path, uriVariables).getPath();
123:     Transaction ct = Tracer.newTransaction("AdminAPI", uri);
124:     ct.addData("Env", env);
125:     List<ServiceDTO> services = getAdminServices(env, ct);
126:     HttpEntity<Void> entity = new HttpEntity<>(assembleExtraHeaders(env));
127:     for (ServiceDTO serviceDTO : services) {
128:       try {
129:         ResponseEntity<T> result =
130:             restTemplate.exchange(parseHost(serviceDTO) + path, HttpMethod.GET, entity, reference, uriVariables);
131:         ct.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
132:         ct.complete();
133:         return result;
134:       } catch (Throwable t) {
135:         logger.error("Http request failed, uri: {}, method: {}", uri, HttpMethod.GET, t);
136:         Tracer.logError(t);
137:         if (canRetry(t, HttpMethod.GET)) {
138:           Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.API_RETRY, uri);
139:         } else {
140:           ct.setStatus(t);
141:           ct.complete();
142:           throw t;
143:         }
144:       }
145:     }
146:     ServiceException e =
147:         new ServiceException(String.format("Admin servers are unresponsive. meta server address: %s, admin servers: %s",
148:                 portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env), services));
149:     ct.setStatus(e);
150:     ct.complete();
151:     throw e;
152:   }
153:   private HttpHeaders assembleExtraHeaders(Env env) {
154:     String adminServiceAccessToken = getAdminServiceAccessToken(env);
155:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(adminServiceAccessToken)) {
156:       HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
157:       headers.add(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, adminServiceAccessToken);
158:       return headers;
159:     }
160:     return null;
161:   }
162:   private List<ServiceDTO> getAdminServices(Env env, Transaction ct) {
163:     List<ServiceDTO> services = adminServiceAddressLocator.getServiceList(env);
164:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(services)) {
165:       ServiceException e = new ServiceException(String.format("No available admin server."
166:                                                               + " Maybe because of meta server down or all admin server down. "
167:                                                               + "Meta server address: %s",
168:               portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env)));
169:       ct.setStatus(e);
170:       ct.complete();
171:       throw e;
172:     }
173:     return services;
174:   }
175:   private String getAdminServiceAccessToken(Env env) {
176:     String accessTokens = portalConfig.getAdminServiceAccessTokens();
177:     if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(accessTokens)) {
178:       return null;
179:     }
180:     if (!accessTokens.equals(lastAdminServiceAccessTokens)) {
181:       synchronized (this) {
182:         adminServiceAccessTokenMap = parseAdminServiceAccessTokens(accessTokens);
183:         lastAdminServiceAccessTokens = accessTokens;
184:       }
185:     }
186:     return adminServiceAccessTokenMap.get(env);
187:   }
188:   private Map<Env, String> parseAdminServiceAccessTokens(String accessTokens) {
189:     Map<Env, String> tokenMap = Maps.newHashMap();
190:     try {
191:       Map<String, String> map = GSON.fromJson(accessTokens, ACCESS_TOKENS);
192:       map.forEach((env, token) -> {
193:         if (Env.exists(env)) {
194:           tokenMap.put(Env.valueOf(env), token);
195:         }
196:       });
197:     } catch (Exception e) {
198:       logger.error("Wrong format of admin service access tokens: {}", accessTokens, e);
199:     }
200:     return tokenMap;
201:   }
202:   private <T> T doExecute(HttpMethod method, HttpHeaders extraHeaders, ServiceDTO service, String path, Object request,
203:                           Class<T> responseType, Object... uriVariables) {
204:     T result = null;
205:     switch (method) {
206:       case GET:
207:       case POST:
208:       case PUT:
209:       case DELETE:
210:         HttpEntity entity;
211:         if (request instanceof HttpEntity) {
212:           entity = (HttpEntity) request;
213:           if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(extraHeaders)) {
214:             HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
215:             headers.addAll(entity.getHeaders());
216:             headers.addAll(extraHeaders);
217:             entity = new HttpEntity<>(entity.getBody(), headers);
218:           }
219:         } else {
220:           entity = new HttpEntity<>(request, extraHeaders);
221:         }
222:         result = restTemplate
223:             .exchange(parseHost(service) + path, method, entity, responseType, uriVariables)
224:             .getBody();
225:         break;
226:       default:
227:         throw new UnsupportedOperationException(String.format("unsupported http method(method=%s)", method));
228:     }
229:     return result;
230:   }
231:   private String parseHost(ServiceDTO serviceAddress) {
232:     return serviceAddress.getHomepageUrl() + "/";
233:   }
234:   private boolean canRetry(Throwable e, HttpMethod method) {
235:     Throwable nestedException = e.getCause();
236:     if (method == HttpMethod.GET) {
237:       return nestedException instanceof SocketTimeoutException
238:              || nestedException instanceof HttpHostConnectException
239:              || nestedException instanceof ConnectTimeoutException;
240:     }
241:     return nestedException instanceof HttpHostConnectException
242:            || nestedException instanceof ConnectTimeoutException;
243:   }
244: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.txtresolver;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;

 6: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 7: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 8: import java.util.List;
 9: @Component("fileTextResolver")
10: public class FileTextResolver implements ConfigTextResolver {
11:   @Override
12:   public ItemChangeSets resolve(long namespaceId, String configText, List<ItemDTO> baseItems) {
13:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = new ItemChangeSets();
14:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(baseItems) && StringUtils.isEmpty(configText)) {
15:       return changeSets;
16:     }
17:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(baseItems)) {
18:       changeSets.addCreateItem(createItem(namespaceId, 0, configText));
19:     } else {
20:       ItemDTO beforeItem = baseItems.get(0);
21:       if (!configText.equals(beforeItem.getValue())) {
22:         changeSets.addUpdateItem(createItem(namespaceId, beforeItem.getId(), configText));
23:       }
24:     }
25:     return changeSets;
26:   }
27:   private ItemDTO createItem(long namespaceId, long itemId, String value) {
28:     ItemDTO item = new ItemDTO();
29:     item.setId(itemId);
30:     item.setNamespaceId(namespaceId);
31:     item.setValue(value);
32:     item.setLineNum(1);
33:     item.setKey(ConfigConsts.CONFIG_FILE_CONTENT_KEY);
34:     return item;
35:   }
36: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.txtresolver;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemChangeSets;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.ItemDTO;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.utils.BeanUtils;
  6: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
  7: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
  8: import javax.validation.constraints.NotNull;
  9: import java.util.HashMap;
 10: import java.util.HashSet;
 11: import java.util.List;
 12: import java.util.Map;
 13: import java.util.Set;
 14: @Component("propertyResolver")
 15: public class PropertyResolver implements ConfigTextResolver {
 16:   private static final String KV_SEPARATOR = "=";
 17:   private static final String ITEM_SEPARATOR = "\n";
 18:   @Override
 19:   public ItemChangeSets resolve(long namespaceId, String configText, List<ItemDTO> baseItems) {
 20:     Map<Integer, ItemDTO> oldLineNumMapItem = BeanUtils.mapByKey("lineNum", baseItems);
 21:     Map<String, ItemDTO> oldKeyMapItem = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", baseItems);
 22:     oldKeyMapItem.remove("");
 23:     String[] newItems = configText.split(ITEM_SEPARATOR);
 24:     Set<String> repeatKeys = new HashSet<>();
 25:     if (isHasRepeatKey(newItems, repeatKeys)) {
 26:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Config text has repeated keys: %s, please check your input.", repeatKeys.toString()));
 27:     }
 28:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = new ItemChangeSets();
 29:     Map<Integer, String> newLineNumMapItem = new HashMap<>();//use for delete blank and comment item
 30:     int lineCounter = 1;
 31:     for (String newItem : newItems) {
 32:       newItem = newItem.trim();
 33:       newLineNumMapItem.put(lineCounter, newItem);
 34:       ItemDTO oldItemByLine = oldLineNumMapItem.get(lineCounter);
 35:       //comment item
 36:       if (isCommentItem(newItem)) {
 37:         handleCommentLine(namespaceId, oldItemByLine, newItem, lineCounter, changeSets);
 38:         //blank item
 39:       } else if (isBlankItem(newItem)) {
 40:         handleBlankLine(namespaceId, oldItemByLine, lineCounter, changeSets);
 41:         //normal item
 42:       } else {
 43:         handleNormalLine(namespaceId, oldKeyMapItem, newItem, lineCounter, changeSets);
 44:       }
 45:       lineCounter++;
 46:     }
 47:     deleteCommentAndBlankItem(oldLineNumMapItem, newLineNumMapItem, changeSets);
 48:     deleteNormalKVItem(oldKeyMapItem, changeSets);
 49:     return changeSets;
 50:   }
 51:   private boolean isHasRepeatKey(String[] newItems, @NotNull Set<String> repeatKeys) {
 52:     Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
 53:     int lineCounter = 1;
 54:     for (String item : newItems) {
 55:       if (!isCommentItem(item) && !isBlankItem(item)) {
 56:         String[] kv = parseKeyValueFromItem(item);
 57:         if (kv != null) {
 58:           String key = kv[0].toLowerCase();
 59:           if(!keys.add(key)){
 60:             repeatKeys.add(key);
 61:           }
 62:         } else {
 63:           throw new BadRequestException("line:" + lineCounter + " key value must separate by '='");
 64:         }
 65:       }
 66:       lineCounter++;
 67:     }
 68:     return !repeatKeys.isEmpty();
 69:   }
 70:   private String[] parseKeyValueFromItem(String item) {
 71:     int kvSeparator = item.indexOf(KV_SEPARATOR);
 72:     if (kvSeparator == -1) {
 73:       return null;
 74:     }
 75:     String[] kv = new String[2];
 76:     kv[0] = item.substring(0, kvSeparator).trim();
 77:     kv[1] = item.substring(kvSeparator + 1).trim();
 78:     return kv;
 79:   }
 80:   private void handleCommentLine(Long namespaceId, ItemDTO oldItemByLine, String newItem, int lineCounter, ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
 81:     String oldComment = oldItemByLine == null ? "" : oldItemByLine.getComment();
 82:     //create comment. implement update comment by delete old comment and create new comment
 83:     if (!(isCommentItem(oldItemByLine) && newItem.equals(oldComment))) {
 84:       changeSets.addCreateItem(buildCommentItem(0L, namespaceId, newItem, lineCounter));
 85:     }
 86:   }
 87:   private void handleBlankLine(Long namespaceId, ItemDTO oldItem, int lineCounter, ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
 88:     if (!isBlankItem(oldItem)) {
 89:       changeSets.addCreateItem(buildBlankItem(0L, namespaceId, lineCounter));
 90:     }
 91:   }
 92:   private void handleNormalLine(Long namespaceId, Map<String, ItemDTO> keyMapOldItem, String newItem,
 93:                                 int lineCounter, ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
 94:     String[] kv = parseKeyValueFromItem(newItem);
 95:     if (kv == null) {
 96:       throw new BadRequestException("line:" + lineCounter + " key value must separate by '='");
 97:     }
 98:     String newKey = kv[0];
 99:     String newValue = kv[1].replace("\\n", "\n");
100:     ItemDTO oldItem = keyMapOldItem.get(newKey);
101:     if (oldItem == null) {
102:       changeSets.addCreateItem(buildNormalItem(0L, namespaceId, newKey, newValue, "", lineCounter));
103:     } else if (!newValue.equals(oldItem.getValue()) || lineCounter != oldItem.getLineNum()) {//update item
104:       changeSets.addUpdateItem(
105:           buildNormalItem(oldItem.getId(), namespaceId, newKey, newValue, oldItem.getComment(),
106:               lineCounter));
107:     }
108:     keyMapOldItem.remove(newKey);
109:   }
110:   private boolean isCommentItem(ItemDTO item) {
111:     return item != null && "".equals(item.getKey())
112:         && (item.getComment().startsWith("#") || item.getComment().startsWith("!"));
113:   }
114:   private boolean isCommentItem(String line) {
115:     return line != null && (line.startsWith("#") || line.startsWith("!"));
116:   }
117:   private boolean isBlankItem(ItemDTO item) {
118:     return item != null && "".equals(item.getKey()) && "".equals(item.getComment());
119:   }
120:   private boolean isBlankItem(String line) {
121:     return  Strings.nullToEmpty(line).trim().isEmpty();
122:   }
123:   private void deleteNormalKVItem(Map<String, ItemDTO> baseKeyMapItem, ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
124:     //surplus item is to be deleted
125:     for (Map.Entry<String, ItemDTO> entry : baseKeyMapItem.entrySet()) {
126:       changeSets.addDeleteItem(entry.getValue());
127:     }
128:   }
129:   private void deleteCommentAndBlankItem(Map<Integer, ItemDTO> oldLineNumMapItem,
130:                                          Map<Integer, String> newLineNumMapItem,
131:                                          ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
132:     for (Map.Entry<Integer, ItemDTO> entry : oldLineNumMapItem.entrySet()) {
133:       int lineNum = entry.getKey();
134:       ItemDTO oldItem = entry.getValue();
135:       String newItem = newLineNumMapItem.get(lineNum);
136:       //1. old is blank by now is not
137:       //2.old is comment by now is not exist or modified
138:       if ((isBlankItem(oldItem) && !isBlankItem(newItem))
139:           || isCommentItem(oldItem) && (newItem == null || !newItem.equals(oldItem.getComment()))) {
140:         changeSets.addDeleteItem(oldItem);
141:       }
142:     }
143:   }
144:   private ItemDTO buildCommentItem(Long id, Long namespaceId, String comment, int lineNum) {
145:     return buildNormalItem(id, namespaceId, "", "", comment, lineNum);
146:   }
147:   private ItemDTO buildBlankItem(Long id, Long namespaceId, int lineNum) {
148:     return buildNormalItem(id, namespaceId, "", "", "", lineNum);
149:   }
150:   private ItemDTO buildNormalItem(Long id, Long namespaceId, String key, String value, String comment, int lineNum) {
151:     ItemDTO item = new ItemDTO(key, value, comment, lineNum);
152:     item.setId(id);
153:     item.setNamespaceId(namespaceId);
154:     return item;
155:   }
156: }

 73:   @GetMapping("/search/by-appid-or-name")

 81:   @GetMapping("/by-owner")
 82:   public List<App> findAppsByOwner(@RequestParam("owner") String owner, Pageable page) {
 83:     Set<String> appIds = Sets.newHashSet();
 84:     List<Role> userRoles = rolePermissionService.findUserRoles(owner);
 85:     for (Role role : userRoles) {
 86:       String appId = RoleUtils.extractAppIdFromRoleName(role.getRoleName());
 87:       if (appId != null) {
 88:         appIds.add(appId);
 89:       }
 90:     }
 91:     return appService.findByAppIds(appIds, page);
 92:   }
 93:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.hasCreateApplicationPermission()")

 99:     Set<String> admins = appModel.getAdmins();

151:     for (Env env : portalSettings.getActiveEnvs()) {
152:       try {
153:         appService.load(env, appId);
154:       } catch (Exception e) {
155:         if (e instanceof HttpClientErrorException &&
156:             ((HttpClientErrorException) e).getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) {
157:           response.addResponseEntity(RichResponseEntity.ok(env.toString()));
158:         } else {

160:               String.format("load appId:%s from env %s error.", appId,

18: import org.slf4j.Logger;
19: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
20: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy;
21: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
22: import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
23: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
24: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
25: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
26: @RestController
27: public class ConfigsExportController {
28:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigsExportController.class);
29:   private final ConfigsExportService configsExportService;
30:   private final NamespaceService namespaceService;
31:   public ConfigsExportController(
32:       final ConfigsExportService configsExportService,
33:       final @Lazy NamespaceService namespaceService
34:   ) {
35:     this.configsExportService = configsExportService;
36:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
37:   }
38:   @PreAuthorize(value = "!@permissionValidator.shouldHideConfigToCurrentUser(#appId, #env, #namespaceName)")
39:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items/export")
40:   public void exportItems(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env,
41:       @PathVariable String clusterName, @PathVariable String namespaceName,
42:       HttpServletResponse res) {
43:     List<String> fileNameSplit = Splitter.on(".").splitToList(namespaceName);
44:     String fileName = fileNameSplit.size() <= 1 ? Joiner.on(".")
45:         .join(namespaceName, ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue()) : namespaceName;
46:     NamespaceBO namespaceBO = namespaceService.loadNamespaceBO(appId, Env.valueOf
47:         (env), clusterName, namespaceName);
48:     res.setHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, "attachment;filename=" + fileName);
49:     final String configFileContent = NamespaceBOUtils.convert2configFileContent(namespaceBO);
50:     try {
51:       res.getOutputStream().write(configFileContent.getBytes());
52:     } catch (Exception e) {
53:       throw new ServiceException("export items failed:{}", e);
54:     }
55:   }
56:   @GetMapping("/export")
57:   public void exportAll(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
58:     final String filename = "apollo_config_export_" + DateFormatUtils.format(new Date(), "yyyy_MMdd_HH_mm_ss") + ".zip";
59:     logger.info("Download configs, remote addr [{}], remote host [{}]. Filename is [{}]", request.getRemoteAddr(), request.getRemoteHost(), filename);
60:     response.setHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, "attachment;filename=" + filename);
61:     try (OutputStream outputStream = response.getOutputStream()) {
62:       configsExportService.exportAllTo(outputStream);
63:     }
64:   }
65: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.controller;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.dto.NamespaceDTO;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity.Consumer;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity.ConsumerRole;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.entity.ConsumerToken;
 8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.openapi.service.ConsumerService;
 9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
10: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
11: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
12: import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
13: import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
14: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
16: import java.util.*;
17: @RestController
18: public class ConsumerController {
19:   private static final Date DEFAULT_EXPIRES = new GregorianCalendar(2099, Calendar.JANUARY, 1).getTime();
20:   private final ConsumerService consumerService;
21:   public ConsumerController(final ConsumerService consumerService) {
22:     this.consumerService = consumerService;
23:   }
24:   @Transactional
25:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
26:   @PostMapping(value = "/consumers")
27:   public ConsumerToken createConsumer(@RequestBody Consumer consumer,
28:                                       @RequestParam(value = "expires", required = false)
29:                                       @DateTimeFormat(pattern = "yyyyMMddHHmmss") Date
30:                                           expires) {
31:     if (StringUtils.isContainEmpty(consumer.getAppId(), consumer.getName(),
32:                                    consumer.getOwnerName(), consumer.getOrgId())) {
33:       throw new BadRequestException("Params(appId、name、ownerName、orgId) can not be empty.");
34:     }
35:     Consumer createdConsumer = consumerService.createConsumer(consumer);
36:     if (Objects.isNull(expires)) {
37:       expires = DEFAULT_EXPIRES;
38:     }
39:     return consumerService.generateAndSaveConsumerToken(createdConsumer, expires);
40:   }
41:   @GetMapping(value = "/consumers/by-appId")
42:   public ConsumerToken getConsumerTokenByAppId(@RequestParam String appId) {
43:     return consumerService.getConsumerTokenByAppId(appId);
44:   }
45:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
46:   @PostMapping(value = "/consumers/{token}/assign-role")
47:   public List<ConsumerRole> assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(@PathVariable String token,
48:                                                           @RequestParam String type,
49:                                                           @RequestParam(required = false) String envs,
50:                                                           @RequestBody NamespaceDTO namespace) {
51:     String appId = namespace.getAppId();
52:     String namespaceName = namespace.getNamespaceName();
53:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(appId)) {
54:       throw new BadRequestException("Params(AppId) can not be empty.");
55:     }
56:     if (Objects.equals("AppRole", type)) {
57:       return Collections.singletonList(consumerService.assignAppRoleToConsumer(token, appId));
58:     }
59:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(namespaceName)) {
60:       throw new BadRequestException("Params(NamespaceName) can not be empty.");
61:     }
62:     if (null != envs){
63:       String[] envArray = envs.split(",");
64:       List<String> envList = Lists.newArrayList();
65:       for (String env : envArray) {
66:         if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(env)) {
67:           continue;
68:         }
69:         if (Env.UNKNOWN.equals(Env.transformEnv(env))) {
70:           throw new BadRequestException(String.format("env: %s is illegal", env));
71:         }
72:         envList.add(env);
73:       }
74:       List<ConsumerRole> consumeRoles = new ArrayList<>();
75:       for (String env : envList) {
76:         consumeRoles.addAll(consumerService.assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(token, appId, namespaceName, env));
77:       }
78:       return consumeRoles;
79:     }
80:     return consumerService.assignNamespaceRoleToConsumer(token, appId, namespaceName);
81:   }
82: }

122:   }
123:   @GetMapping("/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/branches/{branchName}/items")
124:   public List<ItemDTO> findBranchItems(@PathVariable("appId") String appId, @PathVariable String env,
125:                                        @PathVariable("clusterName") String clusterName,
126:                                        @PathVariable("namespaceName") String namespaceName,
127:                                        @PathVariable("branchName") String branchName) {
128:     return findItems(appId, env, branchName, namespaceName, "lastModifiedTime");
129:   }
130:   @PostMapping(value = "/namespaces/{namespaceName}/diff", consumes = {"application/json"})
131:   public List<ItemDiffs> diff(@RequestBody NamespaceSyncModel model) {
132:     checkModel(!model.isInvalid());
133:     List<ItemDiffs> itemDiffs = configService.compare(model.getSyncToNamespaces(), model.getSyncItems());
134:     for (ItemDiffs diff : itemDiffs) {
135:       NamespaceIdentifier namespace = diff.getNamespace();
136:       if (namespace == null) {
137:         continue;
138:       }
139:       if (permissionValidator
140:           .shouldHideConfigToCurrentUser(namespace.getAppId(), namespace.getEnv().name(), namespace.getNamespaceName())) {
141:         diff.setDiffs(new ItemChangeSets());
142:         diff.setExtInfo("You are not this project's administrator, nor you have edit or release permission for the namespace in environment: " + namespace.getEnv());
143:       }
144:     }
145:     return itemDiffs;
146:   }
147:   @PutMapping(value = "/apps/{appId}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/items", consumes = {"application/json"})
148:   public ResponseEntity<Void> update(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String namespaceName,
149:                                      @RequestBody NamespaceSyncModel model) {
150:     checkModel(!model.isInvalid());
151:     boolean hasPermission = permissionValidator.hasModifyNamespacePermission(appId, namespaceName);
152:     Env envNoPermission = null;
153:     if (!hasPermission) {
154:       hasPermission = true;
155:       for (NamespaceIdentifier namespaceIdentifier : model.getSyncToNamespaces()) {
156:         hasPermission &= permissionValidator.hasModifyNamespacePermission(namespaceIdentifier.getAppId(), namespaceIdentifier.getNamespaceName(), namespaceIdentifier.getEnv().toString());
157:         if (!hasPermission) {
158:           envNoPermission = namespaceIdentifier.getEnv();
159:           break;
160:         }
161:       }
162:     }
163:     if (hasPermission) {
164:       configService.syncItems(model.getSyncToNamespaces(), model.getSyncItems());
165:       return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.OK).build();
166:     }
167:     throw new AccessDeniedException(String.format("You don't have the permission to modify environment: %s", envNoPermission));
168:   }
169:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.hasModifyNamespacePermission(#appId, #namespaceName, #env)")
170:   @PostMapping(value = "/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/syntax-check", consumes = {
171:       "application/json"})
172:   public ResponseEntity<Void> syntaxCheckText(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env,
173:       @PathVariable String clusterName, @PathVariable String namespaceName, @RequestBody NamespaceTextModel model) {
174:     doSyntaxCheck(model);
175:     return ResponseEntity.ok().build();

178:   @PutMapping("/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/revoke-items")
179:   public void revokeItems(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env, @PathVariable String clusterName,
180:       @PathVariable String namespaceName) {
181:     configService.revokeItem(appId, Env.valueOf(env), clusterName, namespaceName);
182:   }
183:   void doSyntaxCheck(NamespaceTextModel model) {
184:     if (StringUtils.isBlank(model.getConfigText())) {
185:       return;
186:     }
187:     if (model.getFormat() != ConfigFileFormat.YAML && model.getFormat() != ConfigFileFormat.YML) {
188:       return;
189:     }
190:     TypeLimitedYamlPropertiesFactoryBean yamlPropertiesFactoryBean = new TypeLimitedYamlPropertiesFactoryBean();
191:     yamlPropertiesFactoryBean.setResources(new ByteArrayResource(model.getConfigText().getBytes()));
192:     yamlPropertiesFactoryBean.getObject();
193:   }
194:   private boolean isValidItem(ItemDTO item) {
195:     return Objects.nonNull(item) && !StringUtils.isContainEmpty(item.getKey());
196:   }
197:   private static class TypeLimitedYamlPropertiesFactoryBean extends YamlPropertiesFactoryBean {
198:     @Override
199:     protected Yaml createYaml() {
200:       LoaderOptions loaderOptions = new LoaderOptions();
201:       loaderOptions.setAllowDuplicateKeys(false);
202:       return new Yaml(new SafeConstructor(), new Representer(),
203:           new DumperOptions(), loaderOptions);
204:     }
205:   }
206: }

189:   @PostMapping("/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/missing-namespaces")
190:   public ResponseEntity<Void> createMissingNamespaces(@PathVariable String appId, @PathVariable String env, @PathVariable String clusterName) {
191:     Set<String> missingNamespaces = findMissingNamespaceNames(appId, env, clusterName);
192:     for (String missingNamespace : missingNamespaces) {
193:       namespaceAPI.createMissingAppNamespace(Env.valueOf(env), findAppNamespace(appId, missingNamespace));
194:     }
195:     return ResponseEntity.ok().build();
196:   }
197:   private Set<String> findMissingNamespaceNames(String appId, String env, String clusterName) {
198:     List<AppNamespaceDTO> configDbAppNamespaces = namespaceAPI.getAppNamespaces(appId, Env.valueOf(env));
199:     List<NamespaceDTO> configDbNamespaces = namespaceService.findNamespaces(appId, Env.valueOf(env), clusterName);
200:     List<AppNamespace> portalDbAppNamespaces = appNamespaceService.findByAppId(appId);
201:     Set<String> configDbAppNamespaceNames = configDbAppNamespaces.stream().map(AppNamespaceDTO::getName)
202:             .collect(Collectors.toSet());
203:     Set<String> configDbNamespaceNames = configDbNamespaces.stream().map(NamespaceDTO::getNamespaceName)
204:         .collect(Collectors.toSet());
205:     Set<String> portalDbAllAppNamespaceNames = Sets.newHashSet();
206:     Set<String> portalDbPrivateAppNamespaceNames = Sets.newHashSet();
207:     for (AppNamespace appNamespace : portalDbAppNamespaces) {
208:       portalDbAllAppNamespaceNames.add(appNamespace.getName());
209:       if (!appNamespace.isPublic()) {
210:         portalDbPrivateAppNamespaceNames.add(appNamespace.getName());
211:       }
212:     }
213:     Set<String> missingAppNamespaceNames = Sets.difference(portalDbAllAppNamespaceNames, configDbAppNamespaceNames);
214:     Set<String> missingNamespaceNames = Sets.difference(portalDbPrivateAppNamespaceNames, configDbNamespaceNames);
215:     return Sets.union(missingAppNamespaceNames, missingNamespaceNames);
216:   }

112:                                          @Valid @Positive(message = "size should be positive number") @RequestParam(defaultValue = "5") int size) {
113:     if (permissionValidator.shouldHideConfigToCurrentUser(appId, env, namespaceName)) {
114:       return Collections.emptyList();
115:     }
116:     return releaseService.findAllReleases(appId, Env.valueOf(env), clusterName, namespaceName, page, size);
117:   }
118:   @GetMapping(value = "/apps/{appId}/envs/{env}/clusters/{clusterName}/namespaces/{namespaceName}/releases/active")
119:   public List<ReleaseDTO> findActiveReleases(@PathVariable String appId,
120:                                              @PathVariable String env,
121:                                              @PathVariable String clusterName,
122:                                              @PathVariable String namespaceName,
123:                                              @Valid @PositiveOrZero(message = "page should be positive or 0") @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
124:                                              @Valid @Positive(message = "size should be positive number") @RequestParam(defaultValue = "5") int size) {
125:     if (permissionValidator.shouldHideConfigToCurrentUser(appId, env, namespaceName)) {
126:       return Collections.emptyList();
127:     }
128:     return releaseService.findActiveReleases(appId, Env.valueOf(env), clusterName, namespaceName, page, size);
129:   }
130:   @GetMapping(value = "/envs/{env}/releases/compare")
131:   public ReleaseCompareResult compareRelease(@PathVariable String env,
132:                                              @RequestParam long baseReleaseId,
133:                                              @RequestParam long toCompareReleaseId) {
134:     return releaseService.compare(Env.valueOf(env), baseReleaseId, toCompareReleaseId);
135:   }
136:   @PutMapping(path = "/envs/{env}/releases/{releaseId}/rollback")
137:   public void rollback(@PathVariable String env,
138:                        @PathVariable long releaseId,
139:                        @RequestParam(defaultValue = "-1") long toReleaseId) {
140:     ReleaseDTO release = releaseService.findReleaseById(Env.valueOf(env), releaseId);
141:     if (release == null) {
142:       throw new NotFoundException("release not found");
143:     }
144:     if (!permissionValidator.hasReleaseNamespacePermission(release.getAppId(), release.getNamespaceName(), env)) {
145:       throw new AccessDeniedException("Access is denied");
146:     }
147:     if (toReleaseId > -1) {
148:       releaseService.rollbackTo(Env.valueOf(env), releaseId, toReleaseId, userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
149:     } else {
150:       releaseService.rollback(Env.valueOf(env), releaseId, userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
151:     }
152:     ConfigPublishEvent event = ConfigPublishEvent.instance();
153:     event.withAppId(release.getAppId())
154:         .withCluster(release.getClusterName())
155:         .withNamespace(release.getNamespaceName())
156:         .withPreviousReleaseId(releaseId)
157:         .setRollbackEvent(true)
158:         .setEnv(Env.valueOf(env));
159:     publisher.publishEvent(event);
160:   }
161: }

22:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
23:   @PostMapping("/server/config")
24:   public ServerConfig createOrUpdate(@Valid @RequestBody ServerConfig serverConfig) {
25:     String modifiedBy = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
26:     ServerConfig storedConfig = serverConfigRepository.findByKey(serverConfig.getKey());
27:     if (Objects.isNull(storedConfig)) {
28:       serverConfig.setDataChangeCreatedBy(modifiedBy);
29:       serverConfig.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(modifiedBy);
30:       serverConfig.setId(0L);
31:       return serverConfigRepository.save(serverConfig);
32:     }
33:     BeanUtils.copyEntityProperties(serverConfig, storedConfig);
34:     storedConfig.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(modifiedBy);
35:     return serverConfigRepository.save(storedConfig);
36:   }
37:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
38:   @GetMapping("/server/config/{key:.+}")
39:   public ServerConfig loadServerConfig(@PathVariable String key) {
40:     return serverConfigRepository.findByKey(key);

42: }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/controller/SystemInfoController.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.controller;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.Apollo;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.PortalMetaDomainService;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.dto.ServiceDTO;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.PortalSettings;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.RestTemplateFactory;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.vo.EnvironmentInfo;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.vo.SystemInfo;
 10: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 11: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 12: import org.springframework.boot.actuate.health.Health;
 13: import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
 14: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
 15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
 16: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;
 17: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
 18: import org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate;
 19: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 20: import java.util.List;
 21: @RestController
 22: @RequestMapping("/system-info")
 23: public class SystemInfoController {
 24:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SystemInfoController.class);
 25:   private static final String CONFIG_SERVICE_URL_PATH = "/services/config";
 26:   private static final String ADMIN_SERVICE_URL_PATH = "/services/admin";
 27:   private RestTemplate restTemplate;
 28:   private final PortalSettings portalSettings;
 29:   private final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory;
 30:   private final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService;
 31:   public SystemInfoController(
 32:       final PortalSettings portalSettings,
 33:       final RestTemplateFactory restTemplateFactory,
 34:       final PortalMetaDomainService portalMetaDomainService
 35:   ) {
 36:     this.portalSettings = portalSettings;
 37:     this.restTemplateFactory = restTemplateFactory;
 38:     this.portalMetaDomainService = portalMetaDomainService;
 39:   }
 40:   @PostConstruct
 41:   private void init() {
 42:     restTemplate = restTemplateFactory.getObject();
 43:   }
 44:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
 45:   @GetMapping
 46:   public SystemInfo getSystemInfo() {
 47:     SystemInfo systemInfo = new SystemInfo();
 48:     String version = Apollo.VERSION;
 49:     if (isValidVersion(version)) {
 50:       systemInfo.setVersion(version);
 51:     }
 52:     List<Env> allEnvList = portalSettings.getAllEnvs();
 53:     for (Env env : allEnvList) {
 54:       EnvironmentInfo environmentInfo = adaptEnv2EnvironmentInfo(env);
 55:       systemInfo.addEnvironment(environmentInfo);
 56:     }
 57:     return systemInfo;
 58:   }
 59:   @PreAuthorize(value = "@permissionValidator.isSuperAdmin()")
 60:   @GetMapping(value = "/health")
 61:   public Health checkHealth(@RequestParam String instanceId) {
 62:     List<Env> allEnvs = portalSettings.getAllEnvs();
 63:     ServiceDTO service = null;
 64:     for (final Env env : allEnvs) {
 65:       EnvironmentInfo envInfo = adaptEnv2EnvironmentInfo(env);
 66:       if (envInfo.getAdminServices() != null) {
 67:         for (final ServiceDTO s : envInfo.getAdminServices()) {
 68:           if (instanceId.equals(s.getInstanceId())) {
 69:             service = s;
 70:             break;
 71:           }
 72:         }
 73:       }
 74:       if (envInfo.getConfigServices() != null) {
 75:         for (final ServiceDTO s : envInfo.getConfigServices()) {
 76:           if (instanceId.equals(s.getInstanceId())) {
 77:             service = s;
 78:             break;
 79:           }
 80:         }
 81:       }
 82:     }
 83:     if (service == null) {
 84:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("No such instance of instanceId: " + instanceId);
 85:     }
 86:     return restTemplate.getForObject(service.getHomepageUrl() + "/health", Health.class);
 87:   }
 88:   private EnvironmentInfo adaptEnv2EnvironmentInfo(final Env env) {
 89:     EnvironmentInfo environmentInfo = new EnvironmentInfo();
 90:     String metaServerAddresses = portalMetaDomainService.getMetaServerAddress(env);
 91:     environmentInfo.setEnv(env);
 92:     environmentInfo.setActive(portalSettings.isEnvActive(env));
 93:     environmentInfo.setMetaServerAddress(metaServerAddresses);
 94:     String selectedMetaServerAddress = portalMetaDomainService.getDomain(env);
 95:     try {
 96:       environmentInfo.setConfigServices(getServerAddress(selectedMetaServerAddress, CONFIG_SERVICE_URL_PATH));
 97:       environmentInfo.setAdminServices(getServerAddress(selectedMetaServerAddress, ADMIN_SERVICE_URL_PATH));
 98:     } catch (Throwable ex) {
 99:       String errorMessage = "Loading config/admin services from meta server: " + selectedMetaServerAddress + " failed!";
100:       logger.error(errorMessage, ex);
101:       environmentInfo.setErrorMessage(errorMessage + " Exception: " + ex.getMessage());
102:     }
103:     return environmentInfo;
104:   }
105:   private ServiceDTO[] getServerAddress(String metaServerAddress, String path) {
106:     String url = metaServerAddress + path;
107:     return restTemplate.getForObject(url, ServiceDTO[].class);
108:   }
109:   private boolean isValidVersion(String version) {
110:     return !version.equals("java-null");
111:   }
112: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment;

 6: class DatabasePortalMetaServerProvider implements PortalMetaServerProvider {

 8:   private final PortalConfig portalConfig;

================
File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/environment/DefaultPortalMetaServerProvider.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment;
 2: import static com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env.transformToEnvMap;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ResourceUtils;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.util.KeyValueUtils;
 5: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7: import java.util.Map;
 8: import java.util.Properties;
 9: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
10: class DefaultPortalMetaServerProvider implements PortalMetaServerProvider {
11:     private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultPortalMetaServerProvider.class);
12:     private static final String APOLLO_ENV_PROPERTIES_FILE_PATH = "apollo-env.properties";
13:     private volatile Map<Env, String> domains;
14:     DefaultPortalMetaServerProvider() {
15:       reload();
16:     }
17:     @Override
18:     public String getMetaServerAddress(Env targetEnv) {
19:         String metaServerAddress = domains.get(targetEnv);
20:         return metaServerAddress == null ? null : metaServerAddress.trim();
21:     }
22:     @Override
23:     public boolean exists(Env targetEnv) {
24:         return domains.containsKey(targetEnv);
25:     }
26:     @Override
27:     public void reload() {
28:         domains = initializeDomains();
29:         logger.info("Loaded meta server addresses from system property, os environment and properties file: {}", domains);
30:     }
31:     private Map<Env, String> initializeDomains() {
32:         Map<Env, String> map = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
33:         map.putAll(getDomainsFromPropertiesFile());
34:         map.putAll(getDomainsFromOSEnvironment());
35:         map.putAll(getDomainsFromSystemProperty());
36:         return map;
37:     }
38:     private Map<Env, String> getDomainsFromSystemProperty() {
39:         Map<String, String> metaServerAddressesFromSystemProperty = KeyValueUtils.filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(System.getProperties(), "_meta");
40:         metaServerAddressesFromSystemProperty = KeyValueUtils.removeKeySuffix(metaServerAddressesFromSystemProperty, "_meta".length());
41:         return transformToEnvMap(metaServerAddressesFromSystemProperty);
42:     }
43:     private Map<Env, String> getDomainsFromOSEnvironment() {
44:         Map<String, String> metaServerAddressesFromOSEnvironment = KeyValueUtils.filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(System.getenv(), "_meta");
45:         metaServerAddressesFromOSEnvironment = KeyValueUtils.removeKeySuffix(metaServerAddressesFromOSEnvironment, "_meta".length());
46:         return transformToEnvMap(metaServerAddressesFromOSEnvironment);
47:     }
48:     private Map<Env, String> getDomainsFromPropertiesFile() {
49:         Properties properties = new Properties();
50:         properties = ResourceUtils.readConfigFile(APOLLO_ENV_PROPERTIES_FILE_PATH, properties);
51:         Map<String, String> metaServerAddressesFromPropertiesFile = KeyValueUtils.filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(properties, ".meta");
52:         metaServerAddressesFromPropertiesFile = KeyValueUtils.removeKeySuffix(metaServerAddressesFromPropertiesFile, ".meta".length());
53:         return transformToEnvMap(metaServerAddressesFromPropertiesFile);
54:     }
55: }

================
File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/environment/Env.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
  3: import com.google.common.base.Preconditions;
  4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
  5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  6: import java.util.Map;
  7: import java.util.Objects;
  8: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
  9: public class Env {
 10:     private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Env.class);
 11:     private final String name;
 12:     private static final Map<String, Env> STRING_ENV_MAP = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 13:     public static final Env LOCAL = addEnvironment("LOCAL");
 14:     public static final Env DEV = addEnvironment("DEV");
 15:     public static final Env FWS = addEnvironment("FWS");
 16:     public static final Env FAT = addEnvironment("FAT");
 17:     public static final Env UAT = addEnvironment("UAT");
 18:     public static final Env LPT = addEnvironment("LPT");
 19:     public static final Env PRO = addEnvironment("PRO");
 20:     public static final Env TOOLS = addEnvironment("TOOLS");
 21:     public static final Env UNKNOWN = addEnvironment("UNKNOWN");
 22:     private Env(String name) {
 23:         this.name = name;
 24:     }
 25:     private static String getWellFormName(String environmentName) {
 26:         return environmentName.trim().toUpperCase();
 27:     }
 28:     public static Env transformEnv(String envName) {
 29:         if(Env.exists(envName)) {
 30:             return Env.valueOf(envName);
 31:         }
 32:         if (StringUtils.isBlank(envName)) {
 33:             return Env.UNKNOWN;
 34:         }
 35:         switch (envName.trim().toUpperCase()) {
 36:             case "LPT":
 37:                 return Env.LPT;
 38:             case "FAT":
 39:             case "FWS":
 40:                 return Env.FAT;
 41:             case "UAT":
 42:                 return Env.UAT;
 43:             case "PRO":
 44:             case "PROD":
 45:                 return Env.PRO;
 46:             case "DEV":
 47:                 return Env.DEV;
 48:             case "LOCAL":
 49:                 return Env.LOCAL;
 50:             case "TOOLS":
 51:                 return Env.TOOLS;
 52:             default:
 53:                 return Env.UNKNOWN;
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56:     public static boolean exists(String name) {
 57:         name = getWellFormName(name);
 58:         return STRING_ENV_MAP.containsKey(name);
 59:     }
 60:     public static Env addEnvironment(String name) {
 61:         if (StringUtils.isBlank(name)) {
 62:             throw new RuntimeException("Cannot add a blank environment: " + "[" + name + "]");
 63:         }
 64:         name = getWellFormName(name);
 65:         if(STRING_ENV_MAP.containsKey(name)) {
 66:             logger.debug("{} already exists.", name);
 67:         } else {
 68:             STRING_ENV_MAP.put(name, new Env(name));
 69:         }
 70:         return STRING_ENV_MAP.get(name);
 71:     }
 72:     public static Env valueOf(String name) {
 73:         name = getWellFormName(name);
 74:         if(exists(name)) {
 75:             return STRING_ENV_MAP.get(name);
 76:         } else {
 77:             throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " not exist");
 78:         }
 79:     }
 80:     @Deprecated
 81:     public static Env fromString(String env) {
 82:         Env environment = transformEnv(env);
 83:         Preconditions.checkArgument(environment != UNKNOWN, String.format("Env %s is invalid", env));
 84:         return environment;
 85:     }
 86:     @Override
 87:     public boolean equals(Object o) {
 88:         if (this == o) return true;
 89:         if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
 90:         Env env = (Env) o;
 91:         if(getName().equals(env.getName())) {
 92:             throw new RuntimeException(getName() + " is same environment name, but their Env not same");
 93:         } else {
 94:             return false;
 95:         }
 96:     }
 97:     @Override
 98:     public int hashCode() {
 99:         return Objects.hash(getName());
100:     }
101:     @Override
102:     public String toString() {
103:         return name;
104:     }
105:     @Deprecated
106:     public String name() {
107:         return name;
108:     }
109:     public String getName() {
110:         return name;
111:     }
112:     static Map<Env, String> transformToEnvMap(Map<String, String> metaServerAddresses) {
113:         Map<Env, String> map = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
114:         for(Map.Entry<String, String> entry : metaServerAddresses.entrySet()) {
115:             Env env = Env.addEnvironment(entry.getKey());
116:             String value = entry.getValue();
117:             map.put(env, value);
118:         }
119:         return map;
120:     }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/environment/PortalMetaDomainService.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.NetUtil;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.config.PortalConfig;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.spi.Transaction;
  7: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
  8: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
  9: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 10: import java.util.ArrayList;
 11: import java.util.Collection;
 12: import java.util.Collections;
 13: import java.util.List;
 14: import java.util.Map;
 15: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 16: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 17: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 18: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
 19: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 20: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 21: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 22: @Service
 23: public class PortalMetaDomainService {
 24:     private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PortalMetaDomainService.class);
 25:     private static final long REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND = 60;
 26:     static final String DEFAULT_META_URL = "http://apollo.meta";
 27:     private final Map<Env, String> metaServerAddressCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 28:     private final List<PortalMetaServerProvider> portalMetaServerProviders = new ArrayList<>();
 29:     private final Map<String, String> selectedMetaServerAddressCache = Maps.newConcurrentMap();
 30:     private final AtomicBoolean periodicRefreshStarted = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 31:     PortalMetaDomainService(final PortalConfig portalConfig) {
 32:         portalMetaServerProviders.add(new DatabasePortalMetaServerProvider(portalConfig));
 33:         portalMetaServerProviders.add(new DefaultPortalMetaServerProvider());
 34:     }
 35:     public String getDomain(Env env) {
 36:         String metaServerAddress = getMetaServerAddress(env);
 37:         if (metaServerAddress.contains(",")) {
 38:             return selectMetaServerAddress(metaServerAddress);
 39:         }
 40:         return metaServerAddress;
 41:     }
 42:     public String getMetaServerAddress(Env env) {
 43:         if (!metaServerAddressCache.containsKey(env)) {
 44:             metaServerAddressCache
 45:                 .put(env, getMetaServerAddressCacheValue(portalMetaServerProviders, env)
 46:             );
 47:         }
 48:         return metaServerAddressCache.get(env);
 49:     }
 50:     private String getMetaServerAddressCacheValue(
 51:         Collection<PortalMetaServerProvider> providers, Env env) {
 52:         String metaAddress = null;
 53:         for(PortalMetaServerProvider portalMetaServerProvider : providers) {
 54:             if(portalMetaServerProvider.exists(env)) {
 55:                 metaAddress = portalMetaServerProvider.getMetaServerAddress(env);
 56:                 logger.info("Located meta server address [{}] for env [{}]", metaAddress, env);
 57:                 break;
 58:             }
 59:         }
 60:         if (Strings.isNullOrEmpty(metaAddress)) {
 61:             metaAddress = DEFAULT_META_URL;
 62:             logger.warn(
 63:                     "Meta server address fallback to [{}] for env [{}], because it is not available in MetaServerProvider",
 64:                     metaAddress, env);
 65:         }
 66:         return metaAddress.trim();
 67:     }
 68:     public void reload() {
 69:         for(PortalMetaServerProvider portalMetaServerProvider : portalMetaServerProviders) {
 70:             portalMetaServerProvider.reload();
 71:         }
 72:         metaServerAddressCache.clear();
 73:     }
 74:     private String selectMetaServerAddress(String metaServerAddresses) {
 75:         String metaAddressSelected = selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses);
 76:         if (metaAddressSelected == null) {
 77:             if (periodicRefreshStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
 78:                 schedulePeriodicRefresh();
 79:             }
 80:             updateMetaServerAddresses(metaServerAddresses);
 81:             metaAddressSelected = selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses);
 82:         }
 83:         return metaAddressSelected;
 84:     }
 85:     private void updateMetaServerAddresses(String metaServerAddresses) {
 86:         logger.debug("Selecting meta server address for: {}", metaServerAddresses);
 87:         Transaction transaction = Tracer.newTransaction("Apollo.MetaService", "refreshMetaServerAddress");
 88:         transaction.addData("Url", metaServerAddresses);
 89:         try {
 90:             List<String> metaServers = Lists.newArrayList(metaServerAddresses.split(","));
 91:             Collections.shuffle(metaServers);
 92:             boolean serverAvailable = false;
 93:             for (String address : metaServers) {
 94:                 address = address.trim();
 95:                 if (NetUtil.pingUrl(address + "/services/config")) {
 96:                     selectedMetaServerAddressCache.put(metaServerAddresses, address);
 97:                     serverAvailable = true;
 98:                     logger.debug("Selected meta server address {} for {}", address, metaServerAddresses);
 99:                     break;
100:                 }
101:             }
102:             if (!selectedMetaServerAddressCache.containsKey(metaServerAddresses)) {
103:                 selectedMetaServerAddressCache.put(metaServerAddresses, metaServers.get(0).trim());
104:             }
105:             if (!serverAvailable) {
106:                 logger.warn("Could not find available meta server for configured meta server addresses: {}, fallback to: {}",
107:                         metaServerAddresses, selectedMetaServerAddressCache.get(metaServerAddresses));
108:             }
109:             transaction.setStatus(Transaction.SUCCESS);
110:         } catch (Throwable ex) {
111:             transaction.setStatus(ex);
112:             throw ex;
113:         } finally {
114:             transaction.complete();
115:         }
116:     }
117:     private void schedulePeriodicRefresh() {
118:         ScheduledExecutorService scheduledExecutorService =
119:                 Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1, ApolloThreadFactory.create("MetaServiceLocator", true));
120:         scheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(new Runnable() {
121:             @Override
122:             public void run() {
123:                 try {
124:                     for (String metaServerAddresses : selectedMetaServerAddressCache.keySet()) {
125:                         updateMetaServerAddresses(metaServerAddresses);
126:                     }
127:                 } catch (Throwable ex) {
128:                     logger.warn(String.format("Refreshing meta server address failed, will retry in %d seconds",
129:                             REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND), ex);
130:                 }
131:             }
132:         }, REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND, REFRESH_INTERVAL_IN_SECOND, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
133:     }
134: }
