  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.listener;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.constants.ReleaseOperation;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.ApolloThreadFactory;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.config.PortalConfig;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.emailbuilder.GrayPublishEmailBuilder;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.emailbuilder.MergeEmailBuilder;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.emailbuilder.NormalPublishEmailBuilder;
 10: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.emailbuilder.RollbackEmailBuilder;
 11: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.Email;
 12: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.ReleaseHistoryBO;
 13: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.service.ReleaseHistoryService;
 14: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.EmailService;
 15: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.MQService;
 16: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 17: import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
 18: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
 19: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
 20: import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
 21: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 22: @Component
 23: public class ConfigPublishListener {
 24:   private final ReleaseHistoryService releaseHistoryService;
 25:   private final EmailService emailService;
 26:   private final NormalPublishEmailBuilder normalPublishEmailBuilder;
 27:   private final GrayPublishEmailBuilder grayPublishEmailBuilder;
 28:   private final RollbackEmailBuilder rollbackEmailBuilder;
 29:   private final MergeEmailBuilder mergeEmailBuilder;
 30:   private final PortalConfig portalConfig;
 31:   private final MQService mqService;
 32:   private final ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier configReleaseWebhookNotifier;
 33:   private ExecutorService executorService;
 34:   public ConfigPublishListener(
 35:       final ReleaseHistoryService releaseHistoryService,
 36:       final EmailService emailService,
 37:       final NormalPublishEmailBuilder normalPublishEmailBuilder,
 38:       final GrayPublishEmailBuilder grayPublishEmailBuilder,
 39:       final RollbackEmailBuilder rollbackEmailBuilder,
 40:       final MergeEmailBuilder mergeEmailBuilder,
 41:       final PortalConfig portalConfig,
 42:       final MQService mqService,
 43:       final ConfigReleaseWebhookNotifier configReleaseWebhookNotifier) {
 44:     this.releaseHistoryService = releaseHistoryService;
 45:     this.emailService = emailService;
 46:     this.normalPublishEmailBuilder = normalPublishEmailBuilder;
 47:     this.grayPublishEmailBuilder = grayPublishEmailBuilder;
 48:     this.rollbackEmailBuilder = rollbackEmailBuilder;
 49:     this.mergeEmailBuilder = mergeEmailBuilder;
 50:     this.portalConfig = portalConfig;
 51:     this.mqService = mqService;
 52:     this.configReleaseWebhookNotifier = configReleaseWebhookNotifier;
 53:   }
 54:   @PostConstruct
 55:   public void init() {
 56:     executorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(ApolloThreadFactory.create("ConfigPublishNotify", true));
 57:   }
 58:   @EventListener
 59:   public void onConfigPublish(ConfigPublishEvent event) {
 60:     executorService.submit(new ConfigPublishNotifyTask(event.getConfigPublishInfo()));
 61:   }
 62:   private class ConfigPublishNotifyTask implements Runnable {
 63:     private ConfigPublishEvent.ConfigPublishInfo publishInfo;
 64:     ConfigPublishNotifyTask(ConfigPublishEvent.ConfigPublishInfo publishInfo) {
 65:       this.publishInfo = publishInfo;
 66:     }
 67:     @Override
 68:     public void run() {
 69:       ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory = getReleaseHistory();
 70:       if (releaseHistory == null) {
 71:         Tracer.logError("Load release history failed", null);
 72:         return;
 73:       }
 74:       this.sendPublishWebHook(releaseHistory);
 75:       sendPublishEmail(releaseHistory);
 76:       sendPublishMsg(releaseHistory);
 77:     }
 78:     private ReleaseHistoryBO getReleaseHistory() {
 79:       Env env = publishInfo.getEnv();
 80:       int operation = publishInfo.isMergeEvent() ? ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE_MERGE_TO_MASTER :
 81:                       publishInfo.isRollbackEvent() ? ReleaseOperation.ROLLBACK :
 82:                       publishInfo.isNormalPublishEvent() ? ReleaseOperation.NORMAL_RELEASE :
 83:                       publishInfo.isGrayPublishEvent() ? ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE : -1;
 84:       if (operation == -1) {
 85:         return null;
 86:       }
 87:       if (publishInfo.isRollbackEvent()) {
 88:         return releaseHistoryService
 89:             .findLatestByPreviousReleaseIdAndOperation(env, publishInfo.getPreviousReleaseId(), operation);
 90:       }
 91:       return releaseHistoryService.findLatestByReleaseIdAndOperation(env, publishInfo.getReleaseId(), operation);
 92:     }
 93:     private void sendPublishWebHook(ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
 94:       Env env = publishInfo.getEnv();
 95:       String[] webHookUrls = portalConfig.webHookUrls();
 96:       if (!portalConfig.webHookSupportedEnvs().contains(env) || webHookUrls == null) {
 97:         return;
 98:       }
 99:       configReleaseWebhookNotifier.notify(webHookUrls, env, releaseHistory);
100:     }
101:     private void sendPublishEmail(ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
102:       Env env = publishInfo.getEnv();
103:       if (!portalConfig.emailSupportedEnvs().contains(env)) {
104:         return;
105:       }
106:       int realOperation = releaseHistory.getOperation();
107:       Email email = null;
108:       try {
109:         email = buildEmail(env, releaseHistory, realOperation);
110:       } catch (Throwable e) {
111:         Tracer.logError("build email failed.", e);
112:       }
113:       if (email != null) {
114:         emailService.send(email);
115:       }
116:     }
117:     private void sendPublishMsg(ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory) {
118:       mqService.sendPublishMsg(publishInfo.getEnv(), releaseHistory);
119:     }
120:     private Email buildEmail(Env env, ReleaseHistoryBO releaseHistory, int operation) {
121:       switch (operation) {
122:         case ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE: {
123:           return grayPublishEmailBuilder.build(env, releaseHistory);
124:         }
125:         case ReleaseOperation.NORMAL_RELEASE: {
126:           return normalPublishEmailBuilder.build(env, releaseHistory);
127:         }
128:         case ReleaseOperation.ROLLBACK: {
129:           return rollbackEmailBuilder.build(env, releaseHistory);
130:         }
131:         case ReleaseOperation.GRAY_RELEASE_MERGE_TO_MASTER: {
132:           return mergeEmailBuilder.build(env, releaseHistory);
133:         }
134:         default:
135:           return null;
136:       }
137:     }
138:   }
139: }

================
File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/service/AppNamespaceService.java
================
  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.service;
  2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.entity.App;
  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.entity.AppNamespace;
  4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
  5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.ConfigConsts;
  6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.ConfigFileFormat;
  7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
  8: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.repository.AppNamespaceRepository;
  9: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.UserInfoHolder;
 10: import com.google.common.base.Joiner;
 11: import com.google.common.collect.Sets;
 12: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy;
 13: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 14: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
 15: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
 16: import java.util.List;
 17: import java.util.Objects;
 18: import java.util.Set;
 19: @Service
 20: public class AppNamespaceService {
 21:   private static final int PRIVATE_APP_NAMESPACE_NOTIFICATION_COUNT = 5;
 22:   private static final Joiner APP_NAMESPACE_JOINER = Joiner.on(",").skipNulls();
 23:   private final UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder;
 24:   private final AppNamespaceRepository appNamespaceRepository;
 25:   private final RoleInitializationService roleInitializationService;
 26:   private final AppService appService;
 27:   private final RolePermissionService rolePermissionService;
 28:   public AppNamespaceService(
 29:       final UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder,
 30:       final AppNamespaceRepository appNamespaceRepository,
 31:       final RoleInitializationService roleInitializationService,
 32:       final @Lazy AppService appService,
 33:       final RolePermissionService rolePermissionService) {
 34:     this.userInfoHolder = userInfoHolder;
 35:     this.appNamespaceRepository = appNamespaceRepository;
 36:     this.roleInitializationService = roleInitializationService;
 37:     this.appService = appService;
 38:     this.rolePermissionService = rolePermissionService;
 39:   }
 40:   public List<AppNamespace> findPublicAppNamespaces() {
 41:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByIsPublicTrue();
 42:   }
 43:   public AppNamespace findPublicAppNamespace(String namespaceName) {
 44:     List<AppNamespace> appNamespaces = appNamespaceRepository.findByNameAndIsPublic(namespaceName, true);
 45:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(appNamespaces)) {
 46:       return null;
 47:     }
 48:     return appNamespaces.get(0);
 49:   }
 50:   private List<AppNamespace> findAllPrivateAppNamespaces(String namespaceName) {
 51:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByNameAndIsPublic(namespaceName, false);
 52:   }
 53:   public AppNamespace findByAppIdAndName(String appId, String namespaceName) {
 54:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
 55:   }
 56:   public List<AppNamespace> findByAppId(String appId) {
 57:     return appNamespaceRepository.findByAppId(appId);
 58:   }
 59:   @Transactional
 60:   public void createDefaultAppNamespace(String appId) {
 61:     if (!isAppNamespaceNameUnique(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION)) {
 62:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("App already has application namespace. AppId = %s", appId));
 63:     }
 64:     AppNamespace appNs = new AppNamespace();
 65:     appNs.setAppId(appId);
 66:     appNs.setName(ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION);
 67:     appNs.setComment("default app namespace");
 68:     appNs.setFormat(ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue());
 69:     String userId = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
 70:     appNs.setDataChangeCreatedBy(userId);
 71:     appNs.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(userId);
 72:     appNamespaceRepository.save(appNs);
 73:   }
 74:   public boolean isAppNamespaceNameUnique(String appId, String namespaceName) {
 75:     Objects.requireNonNull(appId, "AppId must not be null");
 76:     Objects.requireNonNull(namespaceName, "Namespace must not be null");
 77:     return Objects.isNull(appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName));
 78:   }
 79:   public AppNamespace createAppNamespaceInLocal(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
 80:     return createAppNamespaceInLocal(appNamespace, true);
 81:   }
 82:   @Transactional
 83:   public AppNamespace createAppNamespaceInLocal(AppNamespace appNamespace, boolean appendNamespacePrefix) {
 84:     String appId = appNamespace.getAppId();
 85:     App app = appService.load(appId);
 86:     if (app == null) {
 87:       throw new BadRequestException("App not exist. AppId = " + appId);
 88:     }
 89:     if (appNamespace.isPublic()) {
 90:       appNamespace.setFormat(ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue());
 91:     }
 92:     StringBuilder appNamespaceName = new StringBuilder();
 93:     appNamespaceName
 94:         .append(appNamespace.isPublic() && appendNamespacePrefix ? app.getOrgId() + "." : "")
 95:         .append(appNamespace.getName())
 96:         .append(appNamespace.formatAsEnum() == ConfigFileFormat.Properties ? "" : "." + appNamespace.getFormat());
 97:     appNamespace.setName(appNamespaceName.toString());
 98:     if (appNamespace.getComment() == null) {
 99:       appNamespace.setComment("");
100:     }
101:     if (!ConfigFileFormat.isValidFormat(appNamespace.getFormat())) {
102:      throw new BadRequestException("Invalid namespace format. format must be properties、json、yaml、yml、xml");
103:     }
104:     String operator = appNamespace.getDataChangeCreatedBy();
105:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(operator)) {
106:       operator = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
107:       appNamespace.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
108:     }
109:     appNamespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
110:     if (appNamespace.isPublic()) {
111:       checkAppNamespaceGlobalUniqueness(appNamespace);
112:     } else {
113:       if (appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName()) != null) {
114:         throw new BadRequestException("Private AppNamespace " + appNamespace.getName() + " already exists!");
115:       }
116:       checkPublicAppNamespaceGlobalUniqueness(appNamespace);
117:     }
118:     AppNamespace createdAppNamespace = appNamespaceRepository.save(appNamespace);
119:     roleInitializationService.initNamespaceRoles(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName(), operator);
120:     roleInitializationService.initNamespaceEnvRoles(appNamespace.getAppId(), appNamespace.getName(), operator);
121:     return createdAppNamespace;
122:   }
123:   private void checkAppNamespaceGlobalUniqueness(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
124:     checkPublicAppNamespaceGlobalUniqueness(appNamespace);
125:     List<AppNamespace> privateAppNamespaces = findAllPrivateAppNamespaces(appNamespace.getName());
126:     if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(privateAppNamespaces)) {
127:       Set<String> appIds = Sets.newHashSet();
128:       for (AppNamespace ans : privateAppNamespaces) {
129:         appIds.add(ans.getAppId());
130:         if (appIds.size() == PRIVATE_APP_NAMESPACE_NOTIFICATION_COUNT) {
131:           break;
132:         }
133:       }
134:       throw new BadRequestException(
135:           "Public AppNamespace " + appNamespace.getName() + " already exists as private AppNamespace in appId: "
136:               + APP_NAMESPACE_JOINER.join(appIds) + ", etc. Please select another name!");
137:     }
138:   }
139:   private void checkPublicAppNamespaceGlobalUniqueness(AppNamespace appNamespace) {
140:     AppNamespace publicAppNamespace = findPublicAppNamespace(appNamespace.getName());
141:     if (publicAppNamespace != null) {
142:       throw new BadRequestException("AppNamespace " + appNamespace.getName() + " already exists as public namespace in appId: " + publicAppNamespace.getAppId() + "!");
143:     }
144:   }
145:   @Transactional
146:   public AppNamespace deleteAppNamespace(String appId, String namespaceName) {
147:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceRepository.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
148:     if (appNamespace == null) {
149:       throw new BadRequestException(
150:           String.format("AppNamespace not exists. AppId = %s, NamespaceName = %s", appId, namespaceName));
151:     }
152:     String operator = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
153:     appNamespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
154:     appNamespaceRepository.delete(appId, namespaceName, operator);
155:     rolePermissionService.deleteRolePermissionsByAppIdAndNamespace(appId, namespaceName, operator);
156:     return appNamespace;
157:   }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.service;

  3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.entity.App;

 25: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 26: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy;
 27: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
 28: @Service
 29: public class ConfigsExportService {
 30:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConfigsExportService.class);
 31:   private final AppService appService;
 32:   private final ClusterService clusterService;
 33:   private final NamespaceService namespaceService;
 34:   private final PortalSettings portalSettings;
 35:   private final PermissionValidator permissionValidator;
 36:   public ConfigsExportService(
 37:       AppService appService,
 38:       ClusterService clusterService,
 39:       final @Lazy NamespaceService namespaceService,
 40:       PortalSettings portalSettings,
 41:       PermissionValidator permissionValidator) {
 42:     this.appService = appService;
 43:     this.clusterService = clusterService;
 44:     this.namespaceService = namespaceService;
 45:     this.portalSettings = portalSettings;
 46:     this.permissionValidator = permissionValidator;
 47:   }
 48:   private static void writeAsZipOutputStream(
 49:       Stream<ConfigBO> configBOStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
 50:     try (final ZipOutputStream zipOutputStream = new ZipOutputStream(outputStream)) {
 51:       final Consumer<ConfigBO> configBOConsumer =
 52:           configBO -> {
 53:             try {
 54:               synchronized (zipOutputStream) {
 55:                 write2ZipOutputStream(zipOutputStream, configBO);
 56:               }
 57:             } catch (IOException e) {
 58:               logger.error("Write error. {}", configBO);
 59:               throw new IllegalStateException(e);
 60:             }
 61:           };
 62:       configBOStream.forEach(configBOConsumer);
 63:     }
 64:   }
 65:   private static ZipOutputStream write2ZipOutputStream(
 66:       final ZipOutputStream zipOutputStream, final ConfigBO configBO) throws IOException {
 67:     final Env env = configBO.getEnv();
 68:     final String ownerName = configBO.getOwnerName();
 69:     final String appId = configBO.getAppId();
 70:     final String clusterName = configBO.getClusterName();
 71:     final String namespace = configBO.getNamespace();
 72:     final String configFileContent = configBO.getConfigFileContent();
 73:     final ConfigFileFormat configFileFormat = configBO.getFormat();
 74:     final String configFilename =
 75:         ConfigFileUtils.toFilename(appId, clusterName, namespace, configFileFormat);
 76:     final String filePath = ConfigFileUtils.toFilePath(ownerName, appId, env, configFilename);
 77:     final ZipEntry zipEntry = new ZipEntry(filePath);
 78:     try {
 79:       zipOutputStream.putNextEntry(zipEntry);
 80:       zipOutputStream.write(configFileContent.getBytes());
 81:       zipOutputStream.closeEntry();
 82:     } catch (IOException e) {
 83:       logger.error("config export failed. {}", configBO);
 84:       throw new IOException("config export failed", e);
 85:     }
 86:     return zipOutputStream;
 87:   }
 88:   private Stream<ConfigBO> makeStreamBy(
 89:       final Env env, final String ownerName, final String appId, final String clusterName) {
 90:     final List<NamespaceBO> namespaceBOS =
 91:         namespaceService.findNamespaceBOs(appId, env, clusterName);
 92:     final Function<NamespaceBO, ConfigBO> function =
 93:         namespaceBO -> new ConfigBO(env, ownerName, appId, clusterName, namespaceBO);
 94:     return namespaceBOS.parallelStream().map(function);
 95:   }
 96:   private Stream<ConfigBO> makeStreamBy(final Env env, final String ownerName, final String appId) {
 97:     final List<ClusterDTO> clusterDTOS = clusterService.findClusters(env, appId);
 98:     final Function<ClusterDTO, Stream<ConfigBO>> function =
 99:         clusterDTO -> this.makeStreamBy(env, ownerName, appId, clusterDTO.getName());
100:     return clusterDTOS.parallelStream().flatMap(function);
101:   }
102:   private Stream<ConfigBO> makeStreamBy(final Env env, final List<App> apps) {
103:     final Function<App, Stream<ConfigBO>> function =
104:         app -> this.makeStreamBy(env, app.getOwnerName(), app.getAppId());
105:     return apps.parallelStream().flatMap(function);
106:   }
107:   private Stream<ConfigBO> makeStreamBy(final Collection<Env> envs) {
108:     final List<App> apps = appService.findAll();
109:     final Predicate<App> isAppAdmin =
110:         app -> {
111:           try {
112:             return permissionValidator.isAppAdmin(app.getAppId());
113:           } catch (Exception e) {
114:             logger.error("app = {}", app);
115:             logger.error(app.getAppId());
116:           }
117:           return false;
118:         };
119:     final List<App> appsExistPermission =
120:         apps.stream().filter(isAppAdmin).collect(Collectors.toList());
121:     return envs.parallelStream().flatMap(env -> this.makeStreamBy(env, appsExistPermission));
122:   }
123:   public void exportAllTo(OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
124:     final List<Env> activeEnvs = portalSettings.getActiveEnvs();
125:     final Stream<ConfigBO> configBOStream = this.makeStreamBy(activeEnvs);
126:     writeAsZipOutputStream(configBOStream, outputStream);
127:   }
128: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.service;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.UserInfo;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.po.Favorite;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.repository.FavoriteRepository;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.UserInfoHolder;
 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.UserService;
 8: import java.util.Collections;
 9: import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
10: import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
11: import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
12: import java.util.Arrays;
13: import java.util.List;
14: import java.util.Objects;
15: @Service
16: public class FavoriteService {
17:   public static final long POSITION_DEFAULT = 10000;
18:   private final UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder;
19:   private final FavoriteRepository favoriteRepository;
20:   private final UserService userService;
21:   public FavoriteService(
22:       final UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder,
23:       final FavoriteRepository favoriteRepository,
24:       final UserService userService) {
25:     this.userInfoHolder = userInfoHolder;
26:     this.favoriteRepository = favoriteRepository;
27:     this.userService = userService;
28:   }
29:   public Favorite addFavorite(Favorite favorite) {
30:     UserInfo user = userService.findByUserId(favorite.getUserId());
31:     if (user == null) {
32:       throw new BadRequestException("user not exist");
33:     }
34:     UserInfo loginUser = userInfoHolder.getUser();
35:     if (!loginUser.equals(user)) {
36:       throw new BadRequestException("add favorite fail. "
37:                                     + "because favorite's user is not current login user.");
38:     }
39:     Favorite checkedFavorite = favoriteRepository.findByUserIdAndAppId(loginUser.getUserId(), favorite.getAppId());
40:     if (checkedFavorite != null) {
41:       return checkedFavorite;
42:     }
43:     favorite.setPosition(POSITION_DEFAULT);
44:     favorite.setDataChangeCreatedBy(user.getUserId());
45:     favorite.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(user.getUserId());
46:     return favoriteRepository.save(favorite);
47:   }
48:   public List<Favorite> search(String userId, String appId, Pageable page) {
49:     boolean isUserIdEmpty = StringUtils.isEmpty(userId);
50:     boolean isAppIdEmpty = StringUtils.isEmpty(appId);
51:     if (isAppIdEmpty && isUserIdEmpty) {
52:       throw new BadRequestException("user id and app id can't be empty at the same time");
53:     }
54:     if (!isUserIdEmpty) {
55:       UserInfo loginUser = userInfoHolder.getUser();
56:       if (!Objects.equals(loginUser.getUserId(), userId)) {
57:         userId = loginUser.getUserId();
58:       }
59:     }
60:     if (isAppIdEmpty && !isUserIdEmpty) {
61:       return favoriteRepository.findByUserIdOrderByPositionAscDataChangeCreatedTimeAsc(userId, page);
62:     }
63:     if (!isAppIdEmpty && isUserIdEmpty) {
64:       return favoriteRepository.findByAppIdOrderByPositionAscDataChangeCreatedTimeAsc(appId, page);
65:     }
66:     return Collections.singletonList(favoriteRepository.findByUserIdAndAppId(userId, appId));
67:   }
68:   public void deleteFavorite(long favoriteId) {
69:     Favorite favorite = favoriteRepository.findById(favoriteId).orElse(null);
70:     checkUserOperatePermission(favorite);
71:     favoriteRepository.delete(favorite);
72:   }
73:   public void adjustFavoriteToFirst(long favoriteId) {
74:     Favorite favorite = favoriteRepository.findById(favoriteId).orElse(null);
75:     checkUserOperatePermission(favorite);
76:     String userId = favorite.getUserId();
77:     Favorite firstFavorite = favoriteRepository.findFirstByUserIdOrderByPositionAscDataChangeCreatedTimeAsc(userId);
78:     long minPosition = firstFavorite.getPosition();
79:     favorite.setPosition(minPosition - 1);
80:     favoriteRepository.save(favorite);
81:   }
82:   private void checkUserOperatePermission(Favorite favorite) {
83:     if (favorite == null) {
84:       throw new BadRequestException("favorite not exist");
85:     }
86:     if (!Objects.equals(userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId(), favorite.getUserId())) {
87:       throw new BadRequestException("can not operate other person's favorite");
88:     }
89:   }
90:   public void batchDeleteByAppId(String appId, String operator) {
91:     favoriteRepository.batchDeleteByAppId(appId, operator);
92:   }
93: }

 57:   public void updateConfigItemByText(NamespaceTextModel model) {
 58:     String appId = model.getAppId();
 59:     Env env = model.getEnv();
 60:     String clusterName = model.getClusterName();
 61:     String namespaceName = model.getNamespaceName();
 62:     NamespaceDTO namespace = namespaceAPI.loadNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
 63:     if (namespace == null) {
 64:       throw new BadRequestException(
 65:           "namespace:" + namespaceName + " not exist in env:" + env + ", cluster:" + clusterName);
 66:     }
 67:     long namespaceId = namespace.getId();
 68:     String configText = model.getConfigText();
 69:     ConfigTextResolver resolver =
 70:         model.getFormat() == ConfigFileFormat.Properties ? propertyResolver : fileTextResolver;
 71:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = resolver.resolve(namespaceId, configText,
 72:         itemAPI.findItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
 73:     if (changeSets.isEmpty()) {
 74:       return;

 77:     updateItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSets);
 78:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE_BY_TEXT,
 79:         String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
 80:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE, String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));

118:   public void syncItems(List<NamespaceIdentifier> comparedNamespaces, List<ItemDTO> sourceItems) {
119:     List<ItemDiffs> itemDiffs = compare(comparedNamespaces, sourceItems);
120:     for (ItemDiffs itemDiff : itemDiffs) {
121:       NamespaceIdentifier namespaceIdentifier = itemDiff.getNamespace();
122:       ItemChangeSets changeSets = itemDiff.getDiffs();
123:       changeSets.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
124:       String appId = namespaceIdentifier.getAppId();
125:       Env env = namespaceIdentifier.getEnv();
126:       String clusterName = namespaceIdentifier.getClusterName();
127:       String namespaceName = namespaceIdentifier.getNamespaceName();
128:       itemAPI.updateItemsByChangeSet(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSets);
129:       Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.SYNC_NAMESPACE, String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
130:     }

132:   public void revokeItem(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
133:     NamespaceDTO namespace = namespaceAPI.loadNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
134:     if (namespace == null) {
135:       throw new BadRequestException(
136:           "namespace:" + namespaceName + " not exist in env:" + env + ", cluster:" + clusterName);
137:     }
138:     long namespaceId = namespace.getId();
139:     Map<String, String> releaseItemDTOs = new HashMap<>();
140:     ReleaseDTO latestRelease = releaseAPI.loadLatestRelease(appId,env,clusterName,namespaceName);
141:     if (latestRelease != null) {
142:       releaseItemDTOs = GSON.fromJson(latestRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
143:     }
144:     List<ItemDTO> baseItems = itemAPI.findItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
145:     Map<String, ItemDTO> oldKeyMapItem = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", baseItems);
146:     Map<String, ItemDTO> deletedItemDTOs = new HashMap<>();
147:     findDeletedItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName).forEach(item -> {
148:       deletedItemDTOs.put(item.getKey(),item);
149:     });
150:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = new ItemChangeSets();
151:     AtomicInteger lineNum = new AtomicInteger(1);
152:     releaseItemDTOs.forEach((key,value) -> {
153:       ItemDTO oldItem = oldKeyMapItem.get(key);
154:       if (oldItem == null) {
155:         ItemDTO deletedItemDto = deletedItemDTOs.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ItemDTO());
156:         changeSets.addCreateItem(buildNormalItem(0L, namespaceId,key,value,deletedItemDto.getComment(),lineNum.get()));
157:       } else if (!oldItem.getValue().equals(value) || lineNum.get() != oldItem
158:           .getLineNum()) {
159:         changeSets.addUpdateItem(buildNormalItem(oldItem.getId(), namespaceId, key,
160:             value, oldItem.getComment(), lineNum.get()));
161:       }
162:       oldKeyMapItem.remove(key);
163:       lineNum.set(lineNum.get() + 1);
164:     });
165:     oldKeyMapItem.forEach((key, value) -> changeSets.addDeleteItem(oldKeyMapItem.get(key)));
166:     changeSets.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
167:     updateItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, changeSets);
168:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE_BY_TEXT,
169:         String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
170:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE, String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
171:   }
172:   public List<ItemDiffs> compare(List<NamespaceIdentifier> comparedNamespaces, List<ItemDTO> sourceItems) {
173:     List<ItemDiffs> result = new LinkedList<>();
174:     for (NamespaceIdentifier namespace : comparedNamespaces) {
175:       ItemDiffs itemDiffs = new ItemDiffs(namespace);
176:       try {
177:         itemDiffs.setDiffs(parseChangeSets(namespace, sourceItems));
178:       } catch (BadRequestException e) {
179:         itemDiffs.setDiffs(new ItemChangeSets());
180:         itemDiffs.setExtInfo("该集群下没有名为 " + namespace.getNamespaceName() + " 的namespace");
181:       }
182:       result.add(itemDiffs);
183:     }
184:     return result;
185:   }
186:   private long getNamespaceId(NamespaceIdentifier namespaceIdentifier) {
187:     String appId = namespaceIdentifier.getAppId();
188:     String clusterName = namespaceIdentifier.getClusterName();
189:     String namespaceName = namespaceIdentifier.getNamespaceName();
190:     Env env = namespaceIdentifier.getEnv();
191:     NamespaceDTO namespaceDTO = null;
192:     try {
193:       namespaceDTO = namespaceAPI.loadNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
194:     } catch (HttpClientErrorException e) {
195:       if (e.getStatusCode() == HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) {
196:         throw new BadRequestException(String.format(
197:             "namespace not exist. appId:%s, env:%s, clusterName:%s, namespaceName:%s", appId, env, clusterName,
198:             namespaceName));
199:       }
200:       throw e;
201:     }
202:     return namespaceDTO.getId();
203:   }
204:   private ItemChangeSets parseChangeSets(NamespaceIdentifier namespace, List<ItemDTO> sourceItems) {
205:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = new ItemChangeSets();
206:     List<ItemDTO>
207:         targetItems =
208:         itemAPI.findItems(namespace.getAppId(), namespace.getEnv(),
209:             namespace.getClusterName(), namespace.getNamespaceName());
210:     long namespaceId = getNamespaceId(namespace);
211:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(targetItems)) {
212:       int lineNum = 1;
213:       for (ItemDTO sourceItem : sourceItems) {
214:         changeSets.addCreateItem(buildItem(namespaceId, lineNum++, sourceItem));
215:       }
216:     } else {
217:       Map<String, ItemDTO> targetItemMap = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", targetItems);
218:       String key, sourceValue, sourceComment;
219:       ItemDTO targetItem = null;
220:       int maxLineNum = targetItems.size();
221:       for (ItemDTO sourceItem : sourceItems) {
222:         key = sourceItem.getKey();
223:         sourceValue = sourceItem.getValue();
224:         sourceComment = sourceItem.getComment();
225:         targetItem = targetItemMap.get(key);
226:         if (targetItem == null) {
227:           changeSets.addCreateItem(buildItem(namespaceId, ++maxLineNum, sourceItem));
228:         } else if (isModified(sourceValue, targetItem.getValue(), sourceComment,
229:             targetItem.getComment())) {
230:           targetItem.setValue(sourceValue);
231:           targetItem.setComment(sourceComment);
232:           changeSets.addUpdateItem(targetItem);
233:         }
234:       }
235:     }
236:     return changeSets;
237:   }
238:   private ItemDTO buildItem(long namespaceId, int lineNum, ItemDTO sourceItem) {
239:     ItemDTO createdItem = new ItemDTO();
240:     BeanUtils.copyEntityProperties(sourceItem, createdItem);
241:     createdItem.setLineNum(lineNum);
242:     createdItem.setNamespaceId(namespaceId);
243:     return createdItem;
244:   }
245:   private ItemDTO buildNormalItem(Long id, Long namespaceId, String key, String value, String comment, int lineNum) {
246:     ItemDTO item = new ItemDTO(key, value, comment, lineNum);
247:     item.setId(id);
248:     item.setNamespaceId(namespaceId);
249:     return item;
250:   }
251:   private boolean isModified(String sourceValue, String targetValue, String sourceComment, String targetComment) {
252:     if (!sourceValue.equals(targetValue)) {
253:       return true;
254:     }
255:     if (sourceComment == null) {
256:       return !StringUtils.isEmpty(targetComment);
257:     }
258:     if (targetComment != null) {
259:       return !sourceComment.equals(targetComment);
260:     }
261:     return false;
262:   }
263: }

 83:                           String branchName, String title, String comment,

 87:   }
 88:   public ReleaseDTO merge(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
 89:                           String branchName, String title, String comment,
 90:                           boolean isEmergencyPublish, boolean deleteBranch, String operator) {
 91:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = calculateBranchChangeSet(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, branchName, operator);
 92:     ReleaseDTO mergedResult =
 93:             releaseService.updateAndPublish(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, title, comment,
 94:                     branchName, isEmergencyPublish, deleteBranch, changeSets);
 95:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.MERGE_GRAY_RELEASE,
 96:             String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName));
 97:     return mergedResult;
 98:   }
 99:   private ItemChangeSets calculateBranchChangeSet(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName,
100:                                                   String branchName, String operator) {
101:     NamespaceBO parentNamespace = namespaceService.loadNamespaceBO(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
102:     if (parentNamespace == null) {
103:       throw new BadRequestException("base namespace not existed");
104:     }
105:     if (parentNamespace.getItemModifiedCnt() > 0) {
106:       throw new BadRequestException("Merge operation failed. Because master has modified items");
107:     }
108:     List<ItemDTO> masterItems = itemService.findItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
109:     List<ItemDTO> branchItems = itemService.findItems(appId, env, branchName, namespaceName);
110:     ItemChangeSets changeSets = itemsComparator.compareIgnoreBlankAndCommentItem(parentNamespace.getBaseInfo().getId(),
111:                                                                                  masterItems, branchItems);
112:     changeSets.setDeleteItems(Collections.emptyList());
113:     changeSets.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
114:     return changeSets;
115:   }
116:   public NamespaceDTO findBranchBaseInfo(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
117:     return namespaceBranchAPI.findBranch(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
118:   }
119:   public NamespaceBO findBranch(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
120:     NamespaceDTO namespaceDTO = findBranchBaseInfo(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
121:     if (namespaceDTO == null) {
122:       return null;
123:     }
124:     return namespaceService.loadNamespaceBO(appId, env, namespaceDTO.getClusterName(), namespaceName);
125:   }
126: }

 67:   public NamespaceDTO createNamespace(Env env, NamespaceDTO namespace) {
 68:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(namespace.getDataChangeCreatedBy())) {
 69:       namespace.setDataChangeCreatedBy(userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
 70:     }
 71:     namespace.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId());
 72:     NamespaceDTO createdNamespace = namespaceAPI.createNamespace(env, namespace);
 73:     Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.CREATE_NAMESPACE,
 74:         String.format("%s+%s+%s+%s", namespace.getAppId(), env, namespace.getClusterName(),
 75:             namespace.getNamespaceName()));
 76:     return createdNamespace;
 77:   }
 78:   @Transactional
 79:   public void deleteNamespace(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
 80:     AppNamespace appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
 81:     if (namespaceHasInstances(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName)) {
 82:       throw new BadRequestException(
 83:           "Can not delete namespace because namespace has active instances");
 84:     }
 85:     NamespaceDTO childNamespace = branchService
 86:         .findBranchBaseInfo(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
 87:     if (childNamespace != null &&
 88:         namespaceHasInstances(appId, env, childNamespace.getClusterName(), namespaceName)) {
 89:       throw new BadRequestException(
 90:           "Can not delete namespace because namespace's branch has active instances");
 91:     }
 92:     if (appNamespace != null && appNamespace.isPublic() && publicAppNamespaceHasAssociatedNamespace(
 93:         namespaceName, env)) {
 94:       throw new BadRequestException(
 95:           "Can not delete public namespace which has associated namespaces");
 96:     }
 97:     String operator = userInfoHolder.getUser().getUserId();
 98:     namespaceAPI.deleteNamespace(env, appId, clusterName, namespaceName, operator);
 99:   }
100:   public NamespaceDTO loadNamespaceBaseInfo(String appId, Env env, String clusterName,
101:       String namespaceName) {
102:     NamespaceDTO namespace = namespaceAPI.loadNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
103:     if (namespace == null) {
104:       throw new BadRequestException(String.format("Namespace: %s not exist.", namespaceName));
105:     }
106:     return namespace;
107:   }
108:   public List<NamespaceBO> findNamespaceBOs(String appId, Env env, String clusterName) {
109:     List<NamespaceDTO> namespaces = namespaceAPI.findNamespaceByCluster(appId, env, clusterName);
110:     if (namespaces == null || namespaces.size() == 0) {
111:       throw new BadRequestException("namespaces not exist");
112:     }
113:     List<NamespaceBO> namespaceBOs = new LinkedList<>();
114:     for (NamespaceDTO namespace : namespaces) {
115:       NamespaceBO namespaceBO;
116:       try {
117:         namespaceBO = transformNamespace2BO(env, namespace);
118:         namespaceBOs.add(namespaceBO);
119:       } catch (Exception e) {
120:         logger.error("parse namespace error. app id:{}, env:{}, clusterName:{}, namespace:{}",
121:             appId, env, clusterName, namespace.getNamespaceName(), e);
122:         throw e;
123:       }
124:     }
125:     return namespaceBOs;
126:   }
127:   public List<NamespaceDTO> findNamespaces(String appId, Env env, String clusterName) {

129:   }

131:       int page,

134:   }
135:   public NamespaceBO loadNamespaceBO(String appId, Env env, String clusterName,
136:       String namespaceName) {
137:     NamespaceDTO namespace = namespaceAPI.loadNamespace(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
138:     if (namespace == null) {
139:       throw new BadRequestException("namespaces not exist");
140:     }
141:     return transformNamespace2BO(env, namespace);

146:   }
147:   public boolean publicAppNamespaceHasAssociatedNamespace(String publicNamespaceName, Env env) {

149:   }

153:         namespaceAPI

156:   }
157:   public Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> getNamespacesPublishInfo(String appId) {
158:     Map<String, Map<String, Boolean>> result = Maps.newHashMap();
159:     Set<Env> envs = portalConfig.publishTipsSupportedEnvs();
160:     for (Env env : envs) {
161:       if (portalSettings.isEnvActive(env)) {
162:         result.put(env.toString(), namespaceAPI.getNamespacePublishInfo(env, appId));
163:       }
164:     }
165:     return result;
166:   }
167:   private NamespaceBO transformNamespace2BO(Env env, NamespaceDTO namespace) {
168:     NamespaceBO namespaceBO = new NamespaceBO();
169:     namespaceBO.setBaseInfo(namespace);
170:     String appId = namespace.getAppId();
171:     String clusterName = namespace.getClusterName();
172:     String namespaceName = namespace.getNamespaceName();
173:     fillAppNamespaceProperties(namespaceBO);
174:     List<ItemBO> itemBOs = new LinkedList<>();
175:     namespaceBO.setItems(itemBOs);
176:     ReleaseDTO latestRelease;
177:     Map<String, String> releaseItems = new HashMap<>();
178:     Map<String, ItemDTO> deletedItemDTOs = new HashMap<>();
179:     latestRelease = releaseService.loadLatestRelease(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
180:     if (latestRelease != null) {
181:       releaseItems = GSON.fromJson(latestRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
182:     }
183:     List<ItemDTO> items = itemService.findItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
184:     int modifiedItemCnt = 0;
185:     for (ItemDTO itemDTO : items) {
186:       ItemBO itemBO = transformItem2BO(itemDTO, releaseItems);
187:       if (itemBO.isModified()) {
188:         modifiedItemCnt++;
189:       }
190:       itemBOs.add(itemBO);
191:     }
192:     itemService.findDeletedItems(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName).forEach(item -> {
193:       deletedItemDTOs.put(item.getKey(),item);
194:     });
195:     List<ItemBO> deletedItems = parseDeletedItems(items, releaseItems, deletedItemDTOs);
196:     itemBOs.addAll(deletedItems);
197:     modifiedItemCnt += deletedItems.size();
198:     namespaceBO.setItemModifiedCnt(modifiedItemCnt);
199:     return namespaceBO;
200:   }
201:   private void fillAppNamespaceProperties(NamespaceBO namespace) {
202:     final NamespaceDTO namespaceDTO = namespace.getBaseInfo();
203:     final String appId = namespaceDTO.getAppId();
204:     final String clusterName = namespaceDTO.getClusterName();
205:     final String namespaceName = namespaceDTO.getNamespaceName();
206:     AppNamespace appNamespace =
207:         appNamespaceService
208:             .findByAppIdAndName(appId, namespaceName);
209:     if (appNamespace == null) {
210:       appNamespace = appNamespaceService.findPublicAppNamespace(namespaceName);
211:     }
212:     final String format;
213:     final boolean isPublic;
214:     if (appNamespace == null) {
215:       logger.warn("Dirty data, cannot find appNamespace by namespaceName [{}], appId = {}, cluster = {}, set it format to {}, make public", namespaceName, appId, clusterName, ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue());
216:       format = ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue();
217:       isPublic = true;
218:     } else {
219:       format = appNamespace.getFormat();
220:       isPublic = appNamespace.isPublic();
221:       namespace.setParentAppId(appNamespace.getAppId());
222:       namespace.setComment(appNamespace.getComment());
223:     }
224:     namespace.setFormat(format);
225:     namespace.setPublic(isPublic);
226:   }
227:   private List<ItemBO> parseDeletedItems(List<ItemDTO> newItems, Map<String, String> releaseItems, Map<String, ItemDTO> deletedItemDTOs) {
228:     Map<String, ItemDTO> newItemMap = BeanUtils.mapByKey("key", newItems);
229:     List<ItemBO> deletedItems = new LinkedList<>();
230:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : releaseItems.entrySet()) {
231:       String key = entry.getKey();
232:       if (newItemMap.get(key) == null) {
233:         ItemBO deletedItem = new ItemBO();
234:         deletedItem.setDeleted(true);
235:         ItemDTO deletedItemDto = deletedItemDTOs.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ItemDTO());
236:         deletedItemDto.setKey(key);
237:         String oldValue = entry.getValue();
238:         deletedItem.setItem(deletedItemDto);
239:         deletedItemDto.setValue(oldValue);
240:         deletedItem.setModified(true);
241:         deletedItem.setOldValue(oldValue);
242:         deletedItem.setNewValue("");
243:         deletedItems.add(deletedItem);
244:       }
245:     }
246:     return deletedItems;
247:   }
248:   private ItemBO transformItem2BO(ItemDTO itemDTO, Map<String, String> releaseItems) {
249:     String key = itemDTO.getKey();
250:     ItemBO itemBO = new ItemBO();
251:     itemBO.setItem(itemDTO);
252:     String newValue = itemDTO.getValue();
253:     String oldValue = releaseItems.get(key);
254:     //new item or modified
255:     if (!StringUtils.isEmpty(key) && (!newValue.equals(oldValue))) {
256:       itemBO.setModified(true);
257:       itemBO.setOldValue(oldValue == null ? "" : oldValue);
258:       itemBO.setNewValue(newValue);
259:     }
260:     return itemBO;
261:   }
262:   public void assignNamespaceRoleToOperator(String appId, String namespaceName, String operator) {
263:     rolePermissionService
264:         .assignRoleToUsers(
265:             RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE),
266:             Sets.newHashSet(operator), operator);
267:     rolePermissionService
268:         .assignRoleToUsers(
269:             RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, RoleType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE),
270:             Sets.newHashSet(operator), operator);
271:   }
272: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.service;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Maps;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.config.RefreshablePropertySource;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.po.ServerConfig;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.repository.ServerConfigRepository;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 9: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
10: import java.util.Map;
11: import java.util.Objects;
12: @Component
13: public class PortalDBPropertySource extends RefreshablePropertySource {
14:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PortalDBPropertySource.class);
15:   @Autowired
16:   private ServerConfigRepository serverConfigRepository;
17:   public PortalDBPropertySource(String name, Map<String, Object> source) {
18:     super(name, source);
19:   }
20:   public PortalDBPropertySource() {
21:     super("DBConfig", Maps.newConcurrentMap());
22:   }
23:   @Override
24:   protected void refresh() {
25:     Iterable<ServerConfig> dbConfigs = serverConfigRepository.findAll();
26:     for (ServerConfig config: dbConfigs) {
27:       String key = config.getKey();
28:       Object value = config.getValue();
29:       if (this.source.isEmpty()) {
30:         logger.info("Load config from DB : {} = {}", key, value);
31:       } else if (!Objects.equals(this.source.get(key), value)) {
32:         logger.info("Load config from DB : {} = {}. Old value = {}", key,
33:                     value, this.source.get(key));
34:       }
35:       this.source.put(key, value);
36:     }
37:   }
38: }

 21: @Service

 25:   private final ReleaseService releaseService;
 26:   public ReleaseHistoryService(final AdminServiceAPI.ReleaseHistoryAPI releaseHistoryAPI, final ReleaseService releaseService) {
 27:     this.releaseHistoryAPI = releaseHistoryAPI;
 28:     this.releaseService = releaseService;
 29:   }
 30:   public ReleaseHistoryBO findLatestByReleaseIdAndOperation(Env env, long releaseId, int operation){
 31:     PageDTO<ReleaseHistoryDTO> pageDTO = releaseHistoryAPI.findByReleaseIdAndOperation(env, releaseId, operation, 0, 1);
 32:     if (pageDTO != null && pageDTO.hasContent()){
 33:       ReleaseHistoryDTO releaseHistory = pageDTO.getContent().get(0);
 34:       ReleaseDTO release = releaseService.findReleaseById(env, releaseHistory.getReleaseId());
 35:       return transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(releaseHistory, release);
 36:     }
 37:     return null;
 38:   }
 39:   public ReleaseHistoryBO findLatestByPreviousReleaseIdAndOperation(Env env, long previousReleaseId, int operation){
 40:     PageDTO<ReleaseHistoryDTO> pageDTO = releaseHistoryAPI.findByPreviousReleaseIdAndOperation(env, previousReleaseId, operation, 0, 1);
 41:     if (pageDTO != null && pageDTO.hasContent()){
 42:       ReleaseHistoryDTO releaseHistory = pageDTO.getContent().get(0);
 43:       ReleaseDTO release = releaseService.findReleaseById(env, releaseHistory.getReleaseId());
 44:       return transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(releaseHistory, release);
 45:     }
 46:     return null;
 47:   }
 48:   public List<ReleaseHistoryBO> findNamespaceReleaseHistory(String appId, Env env, String clusterName,
 49:                                                             String namespaceName, int page, int size) {
 50:     PageDTO<ReleaseHistoryDTO> result = releaseHistoryAPI.findReleaseHistoriesByNamespace(appId, env, clusterName,
 51:                                                                                           namespaceName, page, size);
 52:     if (result == null || !result.hasContent()) {
 53:       return Collections.emptyList();
 54:     }
 55:     List<ReleaseHistoryDTO> content = result.getContent();
 56:     Set<Long> releaseIds = new HashSet<>();
 57:     for (ReleaseHistoryDTO releaseHistoryDTO : content) {
 58:       long releaseId = releaseHistoryDTO.getReleaseId();
 59:       if (releaseId != 0) {
 60:         releaseIds.add(releaseId);
 61:       }
 62:     }
 63:     List<ReleaseDTO> releases = releaseService.findReleaseByIds(env, releaseIds);
 64:     return transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(content, releases);
 65:   }
 66:   private List<ReleaseHistoryBO> transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(List<ReleaseHistoryDTO> source,
 67:                                                                List<ReleaseDTO> releases) {
 68:     Map<Long, ReleaseDTO> releasesMap = BeanUtils.mapByKey("id", releases);
 69:     List<ReleaseHistoryBO> bos = new ArrayList<>(source.size());
 70:     for (ReleaseHistoryDTO dto : source) {
 71:       ReleaseDTO release = releasesMap.get(dto.getReleaseId());
 72:       bos.add(transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(dto, release));
 73:     }
 74:     return bos;
 75:   }
 76:   private ReleaseHistoryBO transformReleaseHistoryDTO2BO(ReleaseHistoryDTO dto, ReleaseDTO release){
 77:     ReleaseHistoryBO bo = new ReleaseHistoryBO();
 78:     bo.setId(dto.getId());
 79:     bo.setAppId(dto.getAppId());
 80:     bo.setClusterName(dto.getClusterName());
 81:     bo.setNamespaceName(dto.getNamespaceName());
 82:     bo.setBranchName(dto.getBranchName());
 83:     bo.setReleaseId(dto.getReleaseId());
 84:     bo.setPreviousReleaseId(dto.getPreviousReleaseId());
 85:     bo.setOperator(dto.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
 86:     bo.setOperation(dto.getOperation());
 87:     Date releaseTime = dto.getDataChangeLastModifiedTime();
 88:     bo.setReleaseTime(releaseTime);
 89:     bo.setReleaseTimeFormatted(RelativeDateFormat.format(releaseTime));
 90:     bo.setOperationContext(dto.getOperationContext());
 91:     setReleaseInfoToReleaseHistoryBO(bo, release);
 92:     return bo;
 93:   }
 94:   private void setReleaseInfoToReleaseHistoryBO(ReleaseHistoryBO bo, ReleaseDTO release) {
 95:     if (release != null) {
 96:       bo.setReleaseTitle(release.getName());
 97:       bo.setReleaseComment(release.getComment());
 98:       bo.setReleaseAbandoned(release.isAbandoned());
 99:       Map<String, String> configuration = GSON.fromJson(release.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
100:       List<EntityPair<String>> items = new ArrayList<>(configuration.size());
101:       for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : configuration.entrySet()) {
102:         EntityPair<String> entityPair = new EntityPair<>(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
103:         items.add(entityPair);
104:       }
105:       bo.setConfiguration(items);
106:     } else {
107:       bo.setReleaseTitle("no release information");
108:       bo.setConfiguration(null);
109:     }
110:   }
111: }

 66:   public ReleaseDTO updateAndPublish(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName,

 68:                                      boolean isEmergencyPublish, boolean deleteBranch, ItemChangeSets changeSets) {
 69:     return releaseAPI.updateAndPublish(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, releaseTitle, releaseComment, branchName,
 70:                                        isEmergencyPublish, deleteBranch, changeSets);
 71:   }
 72:   public List<ReleaseBO> findAllReleases(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, int page,
 73:                                          int size) {
 74:     List<ReleaseDTO> releaseDTOs = releaseAPI.findAllReleases(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, page, size);
 75:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(releaseDTOs)) {
 76:       return Collections.emptyList();
 77:     }
 78:     List<ReleaseBO> releases = new LinkedList<>();
 79:     for (ReleaseDTO releaseDTO : releaseDTOs) {
 80:       ReleaseBO release = new ReleaseBO();
 81:       release.setBaseInfo(releaseDTO);
 82:       Set<KVEntity> kvEntities = new LinkedHashSet<>();
 83:       Map<String, String> configurations = GSON.fromJson(releaseDTO.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
 84:       Set<Map.Entry<String, String>> entries = configurations.entrySet();
 85:       for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : entries) {
 86:         kvEntities.add(new KVEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()));
 87:       }
 88:       release.setItems(kvEntities);
 89:       releaseDTO.setConfigurations("");
 90:       releases.add(release);
 91:     }
 92:     return releases;
 93:   }
 94:   public List<ReleaseDTO> findActiveReleases(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName, int page,
 95:                                              int size) {
 96:     return releaseAPI.findActiveReleases(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName, page, size);
 97:   }
 98:   public ReleaseDTO findReleaseById(Env env, long releaseId) {
 99:     Set<Long> releaseIds = new HashSet<>(1);
100:     releaseIds.add(releaseId);
101:     List<ReleaseDTO> releases = findReleaseByIds(env, releaseIds);
102:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(releases)) {
103:       return null;
104:     }
105:     return releases.get(0);
106:   }
107:   public List<ReleaseDTO> findReleaseByIds(Env env, Set<Long> releaseIds) {
108:     return releaseAPI.findReleaseByIds(env, releaseIds);
109:   }
110:   public ReleaseDTO loadLatestRelease(String appId, Env env, String clusterName, String namespaceName) {
111:     return releaseAPI.loadLatestRelease(appId, env, clusterName, namespaceName);
112:   }
113:   public void rollback(Env env, long releaseId, String operator) {
114:     releaseAPI.rollback(env, releaseId, operator);
115:   }
116:   public void rollbackTo(Env env, long releaseId, long toReleaseId, String operator) {
117:     releaseAPI.rollbackTo(env, releaseId, toReleaseId, operator);
118:   }
119:   public ReleaseCompareResult compare(Env env, long baseReleaseId, long toCompareReleaseId) {
120:     ReleaseDTO baseRelease = null;
121:     ReleaseDTO toCompareRelease = null;
122:     if (baseReleaseId != 0) {
123:       baseRelease = releaseAPI.loadRelease(env, baseReleaseId);
124:     }
125:     if (toCompareReleaseId != 0) {
126:       toCompareRelease = releaseAPI.loadRelease(env, toCompareReleaseId);
127:     }
128:     return compare(baseRelease, toCompareRelease);
129:   }
130:   public ReleaseCompareResult compare(ReleaseDTO baseRelease, ReleaseDTO toCompareRelease) {
131:     Map<String, String> baseReleaseConfiguration = baseRelease == null ? new HashMap<>() :
132:                                                    GSON.fromJson(baseRelease.getConfigurations(), GsonType.CONFIG);
133:     Map<String, String> toCompareReleaseConfiguration = toCompareRelease == null ? new HashMap<>() :
134:                                                         GSON.fromJson(toCompareRelease.getConfigurations(),
135:                                                                       GsonType.CONFIG);
136:     ReleaseCompareResult compareResult = new ReleaseCompareResult();
137:     //added and modified in firstRelease
138:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : baseReleaseConfiguration.entrySet()) {
139:       String key = entry.getKey();
140:       String firstValue = entry.getValue();
141:       String secondValue = toCompareReleaseConfiguration.get(key);
142:       //added
143:       if (secondValue == null) {
144:         compareResult.addEntityPair(ChangeType.DELETED, new KVEntity(key, firstValue),
145:                                     new KVEntity(key, null));
146:       } else if (!Objects.equal(firstValue, secondValue)) {
147:         compareResult.addEntityPair(ChangeType.MODIFIED, new KVEntity(key, firstValue),
148:                                     new KVEntity(key, secondValue));
149:       }
150:     }
151:     //deleted in firstRelease
152:     for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : toCompareReleaseConfiguration.entrySet()) {
153:       String key = entry.getKey();
154:       String value = entry.getValue();
155:       if (baseReleaseConfiguration.get(key) == null) {
156:         compareResult
157:             .addEntityPair(ChangeType.ADDED, new KVEntity(key, ""), new KVEntity(key, value));
158:       }
159:     }
160:     return compareResult;
161:   }
162: }

31:     try {

33:       setSendCode = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setSendCode", String.class);
34:       setBodyTemplateID = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setBodyTemplateID", Integer.class);

39:       setIsBodyHtml = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setIsBodyHtml", Boolean.class);
40:       setCharset = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setCharset", String.class);
41:       setExpiredTime = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setExpiredTime", Calendar.class);
42:       setAppID = sendEmailRequestClazz.getMethod("setAppID", Integer.class);

46:     }

48:   public Object buildEmailRequest(Email email) throws Exception {
49:     Object emailRequest = createBasicEmailRequest();
50:     setSender.invoke(emailRequest, email.getSenderEmailAddress());
51:     setSubject.invoke(emailRequest, email.getSubject());
52:     String emailBodyBuilder = "<entry><content><![CDATA[<!DOCTYPE html>" +
53:             email.getBody() +
54:             "]]></content></entry>";

61:     setSendCode.invoke(request, portalConfig.sendCode());
62:     setBodyTemplateID.invoke(request, portalConfig.templateId());
63:     setIsBodyHtml.invoke(request, true);
64:     setCharset.invoke(request, "UTF-8");
65:     setExpiredTime.invoke(request, calExpiredTime());
66:     setAppID.invoke(request, portalConfig.appId());
67:     return request;
68:   }

11: public class CtripEmailService implements EmailService {
12:   private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CtripEmailService.class);
13:   private Object emailServiceClient;
14:   private Method sendEmailAsync;
15:   private Method sendEmail;
16:   @Autowired
17:   private CtripEmailRequestBuilder emailRequestBuilder;
18:   @Autowired
19:   private PortalConfig portalConfig;
20:   @PostConstruct
21:   public void init() {
22:     try {
23:       initServiceClientConfig();
24:       Class emailServiceClientClazz =
25:               Class.forName("com.ctrip.framework.apolloctripservice.emailservice.EmailServiceClient");
26:       Method getInstanceMethod = emailServiceClientClazz.getMethod("getInstance");
27:       emailServiceClient = getInstanceMethod.invoke(null);
28:       Class sendEmailRequestClazz =
29:               Class.forName("com.ctrip.framework.apolloctripservice.emailservice.SendEmailRequest");
30:       sendEmailAsync = emailServiceClientClazz.getMethod("sendEmailAsync", sendEmailRequestClazz);
31:       sendEmail = emailServiceClientClazz.getMethod("sendEmail", sendEmailRequestClazz);
32:     } catch (Throwable e) {

34:       Tracer.logError("init ctrip email service failed", e);
35:     }

39:     Object serviceClientConfig = serviceClientConfigClazz.newInstance();
40:     Method setFxConfigServiceUrlMethod = serviceClientConfigClazz.getMethod("setFxConfigServiceUrl", String.class);
41:     setFxConfigServiceUrlMethod.invoke(serviceClientConfig, portalConfig.soaServerAddress());
42:     Class serviceClientBaseClazz = Class.forName("com.ctriposs.baiji.rpc.client.ServiceClientBase");
43:     Method initializeMethod = serviceClientBaseClazz.getMethod("initialize", serviceClientConfigClazz);
44:     initializeMethod.invoke(null, serviceClientConfig);
45:   }
46:   @Override
47:   public void send(Email email) {
48:     try {
49:       Object emailRequest = emailRequestBuilder.buildEmailRequest(email);
50:       Object sendResponse = portalConfig.isSendEmailAsync() ?
51:               sendEmailAsync.invoke(emailServiceClient, emailRequest) :
52:               sendEmail.invoke(emailServiceClient, emailRequest);
53:       logger.info("Email server response: " + sendResponse);
54:     } catch (Throwable e) {
55:       logger.error("send email failed", e);
56:       Tracer.logError("send email failed", e);

 8: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

10: public class CtripLogoutHandler implements LogoutHandler {
11:   @Autowired
12:   private PortalConfig portalConfig;
13:   @Override
14:   public void logout(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) {
15:     HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
16:     if (session != null) {
17:       session.invalidate();
18:     }
19:     Cookie cookie = new Cookie("memCacheAssertionID", null);
20:     cookie.setMaxAge(0);
21:     cookie.setPath(request.getContextPath() + "/");
22:     response.addCookie(cookie);
23:     String casServerUrl = portalConfig.casServerUrlPrefix();
24:     String serverName = portalConfig.portalServerName();
25:     try {
26:       response.sendRedirect(casServerUrl + "/logout?service=" + serverName);
27:     } catch (IOException e) {
28:       throw new RuntimeException(e);
29:     }
30:   }
31: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.ctrip;

 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.UserInfo;
 4: import java.lang.reflect.Method;
 5: public class CtripUserInfoHolder implements UserInfoHolder {
 6:   private Object assertionHolder;
 7:   private Method getAssertion;
 8:   public CtripUserInfoHolder() {
 9:     Class clazz = null;
10:     try {
11:       clazz = Class.forName("org.jasig.cas.client.util.AssertionHolder");
12:       assertionHolder = clazz.newInstance();
13:       getAssertion = assertionHolder.getClass().getMethod("getAssertion");
14:     } catch (Exception e) {
15:       throw new RuntimeException("init AssertionHolder fail", e);
16:     }
17:   }
18:   @Override
19:   public UserInfo getUser() {
20:     try {
21:       Object assertion = getAssertion.invoke(assertionHolder);
22:       Method getPrincipal = assertion.getClass().getMethod("getPrincipal");
23:       Object principal = getPrincipal.invoke(assertion);
24:       Method getName = principal.getClass().getMethod("getName");
25:       String name = (String) getName.invoke(principal);
26:       UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
27:       userInfo.setUserId(name);
28:       return userInfo;
29:     } catch (Exception e) {
30:       throw new RuntimeException("get user info from assertion holder error", e);
31:     }
32:   }
33: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.ctrip.filters;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.constant.TracerEventType;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.UserInfo;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.UserInfoHolder;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 6: import com.google.common.base.Strings;
 7: import javax.servlet.*;
 8: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 9: import java.io.IOException;
10: public class UserAccessFilter implements Filter {
11:   private static final String STATIC_RESOURCE_REGEX = ".*\\.(js|html|htm|png|css|woff2)$";
12:   private UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder;
13:   public UserAccessFilter(UserInfoHolder userInfoHolder) {
14:     this.userInfoHolder = userInfoHolder;
15:   }
16:   @Override
17:   public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {
18:   }
19:   @Override
20:   public void doFilter(ServletRequest request, ServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
21:       throws IOException, ServletException {
22:     String requestUri = ((HttpServletRequest) request).getRequestURI();
23:     try {
24:       if (!isOpenAPIRequest(requestUri) && !isStaticResource(requestUri)) {
25:         UserInfo userInfo = userInfoHolder.getUser();
26:         if (userInfo != null) {
27:           Tracer.logEvent(TracerEventType.USER_ACCESS, userInfo.getUserId());
28:         }
29:       }
30:     } catch (Throwable e) {
31:       Tracer.logError("Record user access info error.", e);
32:     }
33:     chain.doFilter(request, response);
34:   }
35:   @Override
36:   public void destroy() {
37:   }
38:   private boolean isOpenAPIRequest(String uri) {
39:     return !Strings.isNullOrEmpty(uri) && uri.startsWith("/openapi");
40:   }
41:   private boolean isStaticResource(String uri) {
42:     return !Strings.isNullOrEmpty(uri) && uri.matches(STATIC_RESOURCE_REGEX);
43:   }
44: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.defaultimpl;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.component.config.PortalConfig;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.Email;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.EmailService;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.tracer.Tracer;
 6: import com.sun.mail.smtp.SMTPTransport;
 7: import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
 8: import java.io.IOException;
 9: import java.io.InputStream;
10: import java.io.OutputStream;
11: import java.util.Properties;
12: import javax.activation.DataHandler;
13: import javax.activation.DataSource;
14: import javax.annotation.Resource;
15: import javax.mail.Message;
16: import javax.mail.Session;
17: import javax.mail.internet.InternetAddress;
18: import javax.mail.internet.MimeMessage;
19: import org.slf4j.Logger;
20: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
21: public class DefaultEmailService implements EmailService {
22:   private final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DefaultEmailService.class);
23:   @Resource
24:   private PortalConfig portalConfig;
25:   @Override
26:   public void send(Email email) {
27:     if (!portalConfig.isEmailEnabled()) {
28:       return;
29:     }
30:     SMTPTransport t = null;
31:     try {
32:       Properties prop = System.getProperties();
33:       Session session = Session.getInstance(prop, null);
34:       Message msg = new MimeMessage(session);
35:       msg.setFrom(new InternetAddress(email.getSenderEmailAddress()));
36:       msg.setRecipients(Message.RecipientType.TO, InternetAddress.parse(email.getRecipientsString(), false));
37:       msg.setSubject(email.getSubject());
38:       msg.setDataHandler(new DataHandler(new HTMLDataSource(email.getBody())));
39:       String host = portalConfig.emailConfigHost();
40:       String user = portalConfig.emailConfigUser();
41:       String password = portalConfig.emailConfigPassword();
42:       t = (SMTPTransport) session.getTransport("smtp");
43:       t.connect(host, user, password);
44:       msg.saveChanges();
45:       t.sendMessage(msg, msg.getAllRecipients());
46:       logger.debug("email response: {}", t.getLastServerResponse());
47:     } catch (Exception e) {
48:       logger.error("send email failed.", e);
49:       Tracer.logError("send email failed.", e);
50:     } finally {
51:       if (t != null) {
52:         try {
53:           t.close();
54:         } catch (Exception e) {
55:         }
56:       }
57:     }
58:   }
59:   static class HTMLDataSource implements DataSource {
60:     private String html;
61:     HTMLDataSource(String htmlString) {
62:       html = htmlString;
63:     }
64:     @Override
65:     public InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException {
66:       if (html == null) {
67:         throw new IOException("html message is null!");
68:       }
69:       return new ByteArrayInputStream(html.getBytes());
70:     }
71:     @Override
72:     public OutputStream getOutputStream() throws IOException {
73:       throw new IOException("This DataHandler cannot write HTML");
74:     }
75:     @Override
76:     public String getContentType() {
77:       return "text/html";
78:     }
79:     @Override
80:     public String getName() {
81:       return "HTMLDataSource";
82:     }
83:   }
84: }

 24: public class DefaultRoleInitializationService implements RoleInitializationService {

 27:   @Autowired
 28:   private PortalConfig portalConfig;
 29:   @Autowired
 30:   private PermissionRepository permissionRepository;
 31:   @Transactional
 32:   public void initAppRoles(App app) {
 33:     String appId = app.getAppId();
 34:     String appMasterRoleName = RoleUtils.buildAppMasterRoleName(appId);
 35:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(appMasterRoleName) != null) {
 36:       return;
 37:     }
 38:     String operator = app.getDataChangeCreatedBy();
 39:     createAppMasterRole(appId, operator);
 40:     createManageAppMasterRole(appId, operator);
 41:     rolePermissionService
 42:         .assignRoleToUsers(RoleUtils.buildAppMasterRoleName(appId), Sets.newHashSet(app.getOwnerName()),
 43:             operator);
 44:     initNamespaceRoles(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION, operator);
 45:     initNamespaceEnvRoles(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION, operator);
 46:     rolePermissionService.assignRoleToUsers(
 47:         RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION, RoleType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE),
 48:         Sets.newHashSet(operator), operator);
 49:     rolePermissionService.assignRoleToUsers(
 50:         RoleUtils.buildNamespaceRoleName(appId, ConfigConsts.NAMESPACE_APPLICATION, RoleType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE),
 51:         Sets.newHashSet(operator), operator);
 52:   }
 53:   @Transactional
 54:   public void initNamespaceRoles(String appId, String namespaceName, String operator) {
 55:     String modifyNamespaceRoleName = RoleUtils.buildModifyNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName);
 56:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(modifyNamespaceRoleName) == null) {
 57:       createNamespaceRole(appId, namespaceName, PermissionType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE,
 58:           modifyNamespaceRoleName, operator);
 59:     }
 60:     String releaseNamespaceRoleName = RoleUtils.buildReleaseNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName);
 61:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(releaseNamespaceRoleName) == null) {
 62:       createNamespaceRole(appId, namespaceName, PermissionType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE,
 63:           releaseNamespaceRoleName, operator);
 64:     }
 65:   }
 66:   @Transactional
 67:   public void initNamespaceEnvRoles(String appId, String namespaceName, String operator) {
 68:     List<Env> portalEnvs = portalConfig.portalSupportedEnvs();
 69:     for (Env env : portalEnvs) {
 70:       initNamespaceSpecificEnvRoles(appId, namespaceName, env.toString(), operator);
 71:     }
 72:   }
 73:   @Transactional
 74:   public void initNamespaceSpecificEnvRoles(String appId, String namespaceName, String env, String operator) {
 75:     String modifyNamespaceEnvRoleName = RoleUtils.buildModifyNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, env);
 76:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(modifyNamespaceEnvRoleName) == null) {
 77:       createNamespaceEnvRole(appId, namespaceName, PermissionType.MODIFY_NAMESPACE, env,
 78:           modifyNamespaceEnvRoleName, operator);
 79:     }
 80:     String releaseNamespaceEnvRoleName = RoleUtils.buildReleaseNamespaceRoleName(appId, namespaceName, env);
 81:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(releaseNamespaceEnvRoleName) == null) {
 82:       createNamespaceEnvRole(appId, namespaceName, PermissionType.RELEASE_NAMESPACE, env,
 83:           releaseNamespaceEnvRoleName, operator);
 84:     }
 85:   }
 86:   @Transactional
 87:   public void initCreateAppRole() {
 88:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(SystemRoleManagerService.CREATE_APPLICATION_ROLE_NAME) != null) {
 89:       return;
 90:     }
 91:     Permission createAppPermission = permissionRepository.findTopByPermissionTypeAndTargetId(PermissionType.CREATE_APPLICATION, SystemRoleManagerService.SYSTEM_PERMISSION_TARGET_ID);
 92:     if (createAppPermission == null) {
 93:       createAppPermission = createPermission(SystemRoleManagerService.SYSTEM_PERMISSION_TARGET_ID, PermissionType.CREATE_APPLICATION, "apollo");
 94:       rolePermissionService.createPermission(createAppPermission);
 95:     }
 96:     Role createAppRole = createRole(SystemRoleManagerService.CREATE_APPLICATION_ROLE_NAME, "apollo");
 97:     rolePermissionService.createRoleWithPermissions(createAppRole, Sets.newHashSet(createAppPermission.getId()));
 98:   }
 99:   @Transactional
100:   private void createManageAppMasterRole(String appId, String operator) {
101:     Permission permission = createPermission(appId, PermissionType.MANAGE_APP_MASTER, operator);
102:     rolePermissionService.createPermission(permission);
103:     Role role = createRole(RoleUtils.buildAppRoleName(appId, PermissionType.MANAGE_APP_MASTER), operator);
104:     Set<Long> permissionIds = new HashSet<>();
105:     permissionIds.add(permission.getId());
106:     rolePermissionService.createRoleWithPermissions(role, permissionIds);
107:   }
108:   @Transactional
109:   public void initManageAppMasterRole(String appId, String operator) {
110:     String manageAppMasterRoleName = RoleUtils.buildAppRoleName(appId, PermissionType.MANAGE_APP_MASTER);
111:     if (rolePermissionService.findRoleByRoleName(manageAppMasterRoleName) != null) {
112:       return;
113:     }
114:     synchronized (DefaultRoleInitializationService.class) {
115:       createManageAppMasterRole(appId, operator);
116:     }
117:   }
118:   private void createAppMasterRole(String appId, String operator) {
119:     Set<Permission> appPermissions =
120:         Stream.of(PermissionType.CREATE_CLUSTER, PermissionType.CREATE_NAMESPACE, PermissionType.ASSIGN_ROLE)
121:             .map(permissionType -> createPermission(appId, permissionType, operator)).collect(Collectors.toSet());
122:     Set<Permission> createdAppPermissions = rolePermissionService.createPermissions(appPermissions);
123:     Set<Long>
124:         appPermissionIds =
125:         createdAppPermissions.stream().map(BaseEntity::getId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
126:     Role appMasterRole = createRole(RoleUtils.buildAppMasterRoleName(appId), operator);
127:     rolePermissionService.createRoleWithPermissions(appMasterRole, appPermissionIds);
128:   }
129:   private Permission createPermission(String targetId, String permissionType, String operator) {
130:     Permission permission = new Permission();
131:     permission.setPermissionType(permissionType);
132:     permission.setTargetId(targetId);
133:     permission.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
134:     permission.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
135:     return permission;
136:   }
137:   private Role createRole(String roleName, String operator) {
138:     Role role = new Role();
139:     role.setRoleName(roleName);
140:     role.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operator);
141:     role.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operator);
142:     return role;
143:   }
144:   private void createNamespaceRole(String appId, String namespaceName, String permissionType,
145:                                    String roleName, String operator) {
146:     Permission permission =
147:         createPermission(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName), permissionType, operator);
148:     Permission createdPermission = rolePermissionService.createPermission(permission);
149:     Role role = createRole(roleName, operator);
150:     rolePermissionService
151:         .createRoleWithPermissions(role, Sets.newHashSet(createdPermission.getId()));
152:   }
153:   private void createNamespaceEnvRole(String appId, String namespaceName, String permissionType, String env,
154:                                       String roleName, String operator) {
155:     Permission permission =
156:         createPermission(RoleUtils.buildNamespaceTargetId(appId, namespaceName, env), permissionType, operator);

 43:     public Role createRoleWithPermissions(Role role, Set<Long> permissionIds) {
 44:         Role current = findRoleByRoleName(role.getRoleName());
 45:         Preconditions.checkState(current == null, "Role %s already exists!", role.getRoleName());
 46:         Role createdRole = roleRepository.save(role);
 47:         if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(permissionIds)) {
 48:             Iterable<RolePermission> rolePermissions = permissionIds.stream().map(permissionId -> {
 49:                 RolePermission rolePermission = new RolePermission();
 50:                 rolePermission.setRoleId(createdRole.getId());
 51:                 rolePermission.setPermissionId(permissionId);
 52:                 rolePermission.setDataChangeCreatedBy(createdRole.getDataChangeCreatedBy());
 53:                 rolePermission.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(createdRole.getDataChangeLastModifiedBy());
 54:                 return rolePermission;
 55:             }).collect(Collectors.toList());
 56:             rolePermissionRepository.saveAll(rolePermissions);
 57:         }
 58:         return createdRole;
