 60:     @Transactional
 61:     public Set<String> assignRoleToUsers(String roleName, Set<String> userIds,
 62:                                          String operatorUserId) {
 63:         Role role = findRoleByRoleName(roleName);
 64:         Preconditions.checkState(role != null, "Role %s doesn't exist!", roleName);
 65:         List<UserRole> existedUserRoles =
 66:                 userRoleRepository.findByUserIdInAndRoleId(userIds, role.getId());
 67:         Set<String> existedUserIds =
 68:             existedUserRoles.stream().map(UserRole::getUserId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
 69:         Set<String> toAssignUserIds = Sets.difference(userIds, existedUserIds);
 70:         Iterable<UserRole> toCreate = toAssignUserIds.stream().map(userId -> {
 71:             UserRole userRole = new UserRole();
 72:             userRole.setRoleId(role.getId());
 73:             userRole.setUserId(userId);
 74:             userRole.setDataChangeCreatedBy(operatorUserId);
 75:             userRole.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operatorUserId);
 76:             return userRole;
 77:         }).collect(Collectors.toList());
 78:         userRoleRepository.saveAll(toCreate);
 79:         return toAssignUserIds;
 80:     }
 81:     @Transactional
 82:     public void removeRoleFromUsers(String roleName, Set<String> userIds, String operatorUserId) {
 83:         Role role = findRoleByRoleName(roleName);
 84:         Preconditions.checkState(role != null, "Role %s doesn't exist!", roleName);
 85:         List<UserRole> existedUserRoles =
 86:                 userRoleRepository.findByUserIdInAndRoleId(userIds, role.getId());
 87:         for (UserRole userRole : existedUserRoles) {
 88:             userRole.setDeleted(true);
 89:             userRole.setDataChangeLastModifiedTime(new Date());
 90:             userRole.setDataChangeLastModifiedBy(operatorUserId);
 91:         }
 92:         userRoleRepository.saveAll(existedUserRoles);
 93:     }
 94:     public Set<UserInfo> queryUsersWithRole(String roleName) {
 95:         Role role = findRoleByRoleName(roleName);
 96:         if (role == null) {
 97:             return Collections.emptySet();
 98:         }
 99:         List<UserRole> userRoles = userRoleRepository.findByRoleId(role.getId());
100:         Set<UserInfo> users = userRoles.stream().map(userRole -> {
101:             UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
102:             userInfo.setUserId(userRole.getUserId());
103:             return userInfo;
104:         }).collect(Collectors.toSet());
105:         return users;
106:     }
107:     public Role findRoleByRoleName(String roleName) {
108:         return roleRepository.findTopByRoleName(roleName);
109:     }
110:     public boolean userHasPermission(String userId, String permissionType, String targetId) {
111:         Permission permission =
112:                 permissionRepository.findTopByPermissionTypeAndTargetId(permissionType, targetId);
113:         if (permission == null) {
114:             return false;
115:         }
116:         if (isSuperAdmin(userId)) {
117:             return true;
118:         }
119:         List<UserRole> userRoles = userRoleRepository.findByUserId(userId);
120:         if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(userRoles)) {
121:             return false;
122:         }
123:         Set<Long> roleIds =
124:             userRoles.stream().map(UserRole::getRoleId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
125:         List<RolePermission> rolePermissions = rolePermissionRepository.findByRoleIdIn(roleIds);
126:         if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(rolePermissions)) {
127:             return false;
128:         }
129:         for (RolePermission rolePermission : rolePermissions) {
130:             if (rolePermission.getPermissionId() == permission.getId()) {
131:                 return true;
132:             }
133:         }
134:         return false;
135:     }
136:     @Override
137:     public List<Role> findUserRoles(String userId) {
138:         List<UserRole> userRoles = userRoleRepository.findByUserId(userId);
139:         if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(userRoles)) {
140:             return Collections.emptyList();
141:         }
142:         Set<Long> roleIds = userRoles.stream().map(UserRole::getRoleId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
143:         return Lists.newLinkedList(roleRepository.findAllById(roleIds));

145:     public boolean isSuperAdmin(String userId) {

153:                 permissionRepository.findTopByPermissionTypeAndTargetId(permissionType, targetId);
154:         Preconditions.checkState(current == null,

156:         return permissionRepository.save(permission);

158:     @Transactional
159:     public Set<Permission> createPermissions(Set<Permission> permissions) {
160:         Multimap<String, String> targetIdPermissionTypes = HashMultimap.create();
161:         for (Permission permission : permissions) {
162:             targetIdPermissionTypes.put(permission.getTargetId(), permission.getPermissionType());
163:         }
164:         for (String targetId : targetIdPermissionTypes.keySet()) {
165:             Collection<String> permissionTypes = targetIdPermissionTypes.get(targetId);
166:             List<Permission> current =
167:                     permissionRepository.findByPermissionTypeInAndTargetId(permissionTypes, targetId);
168:             Preconditions.checkState(CollectionUtils.isEmpty(current),
169:                     "Permission with permissionType %s targetId %s already exists!", permissionTypes,
170:                     targetId);
171:         }
172:         Iterable<Permission> results = permissionRepository.saveAll(permissions);
173:         return StreamSupport.stream(results.spliterator(), false).collect(Collectors.toSet());
174:     }

179:         if (!permissionIds.isEmpty()) {

197:         }

199:         if (!roleIds.isEmpty()) {

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.ldap;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.configuration.LdapExtendProperties;
 3: import org.springframework.ldap.core.DirContextOperations;

 7: import org.springframework.security.core.AuthenticationException;

 9: import org.springframework.security.ldap.authentication.LdapAuthenticationProvider;
10: import org.springframework.security.ldap.authentication.LdapAuthenticator;
11: import org.springframework.security.ldap.userdetails.LdapAuthoritiesPopulator;
12: import org.springframework.util.Assert;
13: import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
14: public class ApolloLdapAuthenticationProvider extends LdapAuthenticationProvider {
15:   private LdapExtendProperties properties;
16:   public ApolloLdapAuthenticationProvider(
17:       LdapAuthenticator authenticator,
18:       LdapAuthoritiesPopulator authoritiesPopulator) {
19:     super(authenticator, authoritiesPopulator);
20:   }
21:   public ApolloLdapAuthenticationProvider(
22:       LdapAuthenticator authenticator) {
23:     super(authenticator);
24:   }
25:   public ApolloLdapAuthenticationProvider(
26:       LdapAuthenticator authenticator,
27:       LdapAuthoritiesPopulator authoritiesPopulator,
28:       LdapExtendProperties properties) {
29:     super(authenticator, authoritiesPopulator);
30:     this.properties = properties;
31:   }
32:   public ApolloLdapAuthenticationProvider(
33:       LdapAuthenticator authenticator,
34:       LdapExtendProperties properties) {
35:     super(authenticator);
36:     this.properties = properties;
37:   }
38:   @Override
39:   public Authentication authenticate(Authentication authentication) throws AuthenticationException {
40:     Assert.isInstanceOf(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.class, authentication, this.messages
41:         .getMessage("LdapAuthenticationProvider.onlySupports",
42:             "Only UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken is supported"));
43:     UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken userToken = (UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken) authentication;
44:     String username = userToken.getName();
45:     String password = (String) authentication.getCredentials();
46:     if (this.logger.isDebugEnabled()) {
47:       this.logger.debug("Processing authentication request for user: " + username);
48:     }
49:     if (!StringUtils.hasLength(username)) {
50:       throw new BadCredentialsException(
51:           this.messages.getMessage("LdapAuthenticationProvider.emptyUsername", "Empty Username"));
52:     }
53:     if (!StringUtils.hasLength(password)) {
54:       throw new BadCredentialsException(this.messages
55:           .getMessage("AbstractLdapAuthenticationProvider.emptyPassword", "Empty Password"));
56:     }
57:     Assert.notNull(password, "Null password was supplied in authentication token");
58:     DirContextOperations userData = this.doAuthentication(userToken);
59:     String loginId = userData.getStringAttribute(properties.getMapping().getLoginId());
60:     UserDetails user = this.userDetailsContextMapper.mapUserFromContext(userData, loginId,
61:         this.loadUserAuthorities(userData, loginId, (String) authentication.getCredentials()));
62:     return this.createSuccessfulAuthentication(userToken, user);
63:   }
64: }

  1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.ldap;

 31: public class LdapUserService implements UserService {
 32:   @Autowired
 33:   private LdapProperties ldapProperties;
 34:   @Autowired
 35:   private LdapExtendProperties ldapExtendProperties;
 36:   @Value("${spring.ldap.base}")
 37:   private String base;
 38:   @Value("${ldap.mapping.objectClass}")
 39:   private String objectClassAttrName;
 40:   @Value("${ldap.mapping.loginId}")
 41:   private String loginIdAttrName;
 42:   @Value("${ldap.mapping.userDisplayName}")
 43:   private String userDisplayNameAttrName;
 44:   @Value("${ldap.mapping.email}")
 45:   private String emailAttrName;
 46:   @Value("${ldap.mapping.rdnKey:}")
 47:   private String rdnKey;
 48:   @Value("#{'${ldap.filter.memberOf:}'.split('\\|')}")
 49:   private String[] memberOf;
 50:   @Value("${ldap.group.groupBase:}")
 51:   private String groupBase;
 52:   @Value("${ldap.group.groupSearch:}")
 53:   private String groupSearch;
 54:   @Value("${ldap.group.groupMembership:}")
 55:   private String groupMembershipAttrName;
 56:   @Autowired
 57:   private LdapTemplate ldapTemplate;
 58:   private static final String MEMBER_OF_ATTR_NAME = "memberOf";
 59:   private static final String MEMBER_UID_ATTR_NAME = "memberUid";
 60:   private ContextMapper<UserInfo> ldapUserInfoMapper = (ctx) -> {
 61:     DirContextAdapter contextAdapter = (DirContextAdapter) ctx;
 62:     UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
 63:     userInfo.setUserId(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(loginIdAttrName));
 64:     userInfo.setName(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(userDisplayNameAttrName));
 65:     userInfo.setEmail(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(emailAttrName));
 66:     return userInfo;
 67:   };
 68:   private ContainerCriteria ldapQueryCriteria() {
 69:     ContainerCriteria criteria = query()
 70:         .searchScope(SearchScope.SUBTREE)
 71:         .where("objectClass").is(objectClassAttrName);
 72:     if (memberOf.length > 0 && !StringUtils.isEmpty(memberOf[0])) {
 73:       ContainerCriteria memberOfFilters = query().where(MEMBER_OF_ATTR_NAME).is(memberOf[0]);
 74:       Arrays.stream(memberOf).skip(1)
 75:           .forEach(filter -> memberOfFilters.or(MEMBER_OF_ATTR_NAME).is(filter));
 76:       criteria.and(memberOfFilters);
 77:     }
 78:     return criteria;
 79:   }
 80:   private UserInfo lookupUser(String member, List<String> userIds) {
 81:     return ldapTemplate.lookup(member, (AttributesMapper<UserInfo>) attributes -> {
 82:       UserInfo tmp = new UserInfo();
 83:       Attribute emailAttribute = attributes.get(emailAttrName);
 84:       if (emailAttribute != null && emailAttribute.get() != null) {
 85:         tmp.setEmail(emailAttribute.get().toString());
 86:       }
 87:       Attribute loginIdAttribute = attributes.get(loginIdAttrName);
 88:       if (loginIdAttribute != null && loginIdAttribute.get() != null) {
 89:         tmp.setUserId(loginIdAttribute.get().toString());
 90:       }
 91:       Attribute userDisplayNameAttribute = attributes.get(userDisplayNameAttrName);
 92:       if (userDisplayNameAttribute != null && userDisplayNameAttribute.get() != null) {
 93:         tmp.setName(userDisplayNameAttribute.get().toString());
 94:       }
 95:       if (userIds != null) {
 96:         if (userIds.stream().anyMatch(c -> c.equals(tmp.getUserId()))) {
 97:           return tmp;
 98:         }
 99:         return null;
100:       }
101:       return tmp;
102:     });
103:   }
104:   private UserInfo searchUserById(String userId) {
105:     try {
106:       return ldapTemplate.searchForObject(query().where(loginIdAttrName).is(userId),
107:           ctx -> {
108:             UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
109:             DirContextAdapter contextAdapter = (DirContextAdapter) ctx;
110:             userInfo.setEmail(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(emailAttrName));
111:             userInfo.setName(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(userDisplayNameAttrName));
112:             userInfo.setUserId(contextAdapter.getStringAttribute(loginIdAttrName));
113:             return userInfo;
114:           });
115:     } catch (EmptyResultDataAccessException ex) {
116:       return null;
117:     }
118:   }
119:   private List<UserInfo> searchUserInfoByGroup(String groupBase, String groupSearch,
120:       String keyword, List<String> userIds) {
121:     return ldapTemplate
122:         .searchForObject(groupBase, groupSearch, ctx -> {
123:             List<UserInfo> userInfos = new ArrayList<>();
124:           if (!MEMBER_UID_ATTR_NAME.equals(groupMembershipAttrName)) {
125:             String[] members = ((DirContextAdapter) ctx).getStringAttributes(groupMembershipAttrName);
126:             for (String item : members) {
127:               LdapName ldapName = LdapUtils.newLdapName(item);
128:               LdapName memberRdn = LdapUtils.removeFirst(ldapName, LdapUtils.newLdapName(base));
129:               if (keyword != null) {
130:                 String rdnValue = LdapUtils.getValue(memberRdn, rdnKey).toString();
131:                 if (rdnValue.toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
132:                   UserInfo userInfo = lookupUser(memberRdn.toString(), userIds);
133:                   userInfos.add(userInfo);
134:                 }
135:               } else {
136:                 UserInfo userInfo = lookupUser(memberRdn.toString(), userIds);
137:                 if (userInfo != null) {
138:                   userInfos.add(userInfo);
139:                 }
140:               }
141:             }
142:             return userInfos;
143:           }
144:           Set<String> memberUids = Sets.newHashSet(((DirContextAdapter) ctx)
145:               .getStringAttributes(groupMembershipAttrName));
146:           if (!CollectionUtils.isEmpty(userIds)) {
147:             memberUids = Sets.intersection(memberUids, Sets.newHashSet(userIds));
148:           }
149:           for (String memberUid : memberUids) {
150:             UserInfo userInfo = searchUserById(memberUid);
151:             if (userInfo != null) {
152:               if (keyword != null) {
153:                 if (userInfo.getUserId().toLowerCase().contains(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
154:                   userInfos.add(userInfo);
155:                 }
156:               } else {
157:                 userInfos.add(userInfo);
158:               }
159:             }
160:           }
161:           return userInfos;
162:         });
163:   }
164:   @Override
165:   public List<UserInfo> searchUsers(String keyword, int offset, int limit) {
166:     List<UserInfo> users = new ArrayList<>();
167:     if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(groupSearch)) {
168:       List<UserInfo> userListByGroup = searchUserInfoByGroup(groupBase, groupSearch, keyword,
169:           null);
170:       users.addAll(userListByGroup);
171:       return users.stream().collect(collectingAndThen(toCollection(() -> new TreeSet<>((o1, o2) -> {
172:         if (o1.getUserId().equals(o2.getUserId())) {
173:           return 0;
174:         }
175:         return -1;
176:       })), ArrayList::new));
177:     }
178:     ContainerCriteria criteria = ldapQueryCriteria();
179:     if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(keyword)) {
180:       criteria.and(query().where(loginIdAttrName).like(keyword + "*").or(userDisplayNameAttrName)
181:           .like(keyword + "*"));
182:     }
183:     users = ldapTemplate.search(criteria, ldapUserInfoMapper);
184:     return users;
185:   }
186:   @Override
187:   public UserInfo findByUserId(String userId) {
188:     if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(groupSearch)) {
189:       List<UserInfo> lists = searchUserInfoByGroup(groupBase, groupSearch, null,
190:           Collections.singletonList(userId));
191:       if (lists != null && !lists.isEmpty() && lists.get(0) != null) {
192:         return lists.get(0);
193:       }
194:       return null;
195:     }
196:     try {
197:       return ldapTemplate
198:           .searchForObject(ldapQueryCriteria().and(loginIdAttrName).is(userId), ldapUserInfoMapper);
199:     } catch (EmptyResultDataAccessException ex) {
200:       return null;
201:     }
202:   }
203:   @Override
204:   public List<UserInfo> findByUserIds(List<String> userIds) {
205:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(userIds)) {
206:       return Collections.emptyList();
207:     }
208:     if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(groupSearch)) {
209:       List<UserInfo> userListByGroup = searchUserInfoByGroup(groupBase, groupSearch, null,
210:           userIds);
211:       return userListByGroup;
212:     }
213:     ContainerCriteria criteria = query().where(loginIdAttrName).is(userIds.get(0));
214:     userIds.stream().skip(1).forEach(userId -> criteria.or(loginIdAttrName).is(userId));
215:     return ldapTemplate.search(ldapQueryCriteria().and(criteria), ldapUserInfoMapper);
216:   }
217: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.oidc;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.UserInfo;
 3: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;
 5: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7: import org.springframework.context.ApplicationListener;
 8: import org.springframework.security.authentication.event.AuthenticationSuccessEvent;
 9: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.core.oidc.user.OidcUser;
10: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt;
11: public class OidcAuthenticationSuccessEventListener implements
12:     ApplicationListener<AuthenticationSuccessEvent> {
13:   private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory
14:       .getLogger(OidcAuthenticationSuccessEventListener.class);
15:   private final OidcLocalUserService oidcLocalUserService;
16:   private final ConcurrentMap<String, String> userIdCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
17:   public OidcAuthenticationSuccessEventListener(
18:       OidcLocalUserService oidcLocalUserService) {
19:     this.oidcLocalUserService = oidcLocalUserService;
20:   }
21:   @Override
22:   public void onApplicationEvent(AuthenticationSuccessEvent event) {
23:     Object principal = event.getAuthentication().getPrincipal();
24:     if (principal instanceof OidcUser) {
25:       this.oidcUserLogin((OidcUser) principal);
26:       return;
27:     }
28:     if (principal instanceof Jwt) {
29:       this.jwtLogin((Jwt) principal);
30:       return;
31:     }
32:     log.warn("principal is neither oidcUser nor jwt, principal=[{}]", principal);
33:   }
34:   private void oidcUserLogin(OidcUser oidcUser) {
35:     if (this.contains(oidcUser.getSubject())) {
36:       return;
37:     }
38:     UserInfo newUserInfo = new UserInfo();
39:     newUserInfo.setUserId(oidcUser.getSubject());
40:     newUserInfo.setName(oidcUser.getPreferredUsername());
41:     newUserInfo.setEmail(oidcUser.getEmail());
42:     this.oidcLocalUserService.createLocalUser(newUserInfo);
43:   }
44:   private boolean contains(String userId) {
45:     if (this.userIdCache.containsKey(userId)) {
46:       return true;
47:     }
48:     UserInfo userInfo = this.oidcLocalUserService.findByUserId(userId);
49:     if (userInfo != null) {
50:       this.userIdCache.put(userId, userId);
51:       return true;
52:     }
53:     return false;
54:   }
55:   private void jwtLogin(Jwt jwt) {
56:     if (this.contains(jwt.getSubject())) {
57:       return;
58:     }
59:     UserInfo newUserInfo = new UserInfo();
60:     newUserInfo.setUserId(jwt.getSubject());
61:     this.oidcLocalUserService.createLocalUser(newUserInfo);
62:   }
63: }

20: public class OidcLocalUserService implements UserService {
21:   private final Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority> authorities = Collections
22:       .singletonList(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_USER"));
23:   private final JdbcUserDetailsManager userDetailsManager;
24:   private final UserRepository userRepository;
25:   public OidcLocalUserService(
26:       JdbcUserDetailsManager userDetailsManager,
27:       UserRepository userRepository) {
28:     this.userDetailsManager = userDetailsManager;
29:     this.userRepository = userRepository;
30:   }
31:   @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class)
32:   public void createLocalUser(UserInfo newUserInfo) {
33:     UserDetails user = new User(newUserInfo.getUserId(), "{nonsensical}" + this.nonsensicalPassword(), authorities);
34:     userDetailsManager.createUser(user);
35:     UserPO managedUser = userRepository.findByUsername(newUserInfo.getUserId());
36:     if (!StringUtils.isBlank(newUserInfo.getEmail())) {
37:       managedUser.setEmail(newUserInfo.getEmail());
38:       userRepository.save(managedUser);
39:     }
40:   }
41:   private String nonsensicalPassword() {
42:     byte[] bytes = new byte[32];
43:     ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextBytes(bytes);
44:     return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes);
45:   }
46:   @Override
47:   public List<UserInfo> searchUsers(String keyword, int offset, int limit) {
48:     List<UserPO> users;
49:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(keyword)) {
50:       users = userRepository.findFirst20ByEnabled(1);
51:     } else {
52:       users = userRepository.findByUsernameLikeAndEnabled("%" + keyword + "%", 1);
53:     }
54:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(users)) {
55:       return Collections.emptyList();
56:     }
57:     return users.stream().map(UserPO::toUserInfo)
58:         .collect(Collectors.toList());
59:   }
60:   @Override
61:   public UserInfo findByUserId(String userId) {
62:     UserPO userPO = userRepository.findByUsername(userId);
63:     return userPO == null ? null : userPO.toUserInfo();
64:   }
65:   @Override
66:   public List<UserInfo> findByUserIds(List<String> userIds) {
67:     List<UserPO> users = userRepository.findByUsernameIn(userIds);
68:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(users)) {
69:       return Collections.emptyList();
70:     }
71:     return users.stream().map(UserPO::toUserInfo)
72:         .collect(Collectors.toList());
73:   }

18:       UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
19:       OidcUser oidcUser = (OidcUser) principal;
20:       userInfo.setUserId(oidcUser.getSubject());
21:       userInfo.setName(oidcUser.getPreferredUsername());
22:       userInfo.setEmail(oidcUser.getEmail());
23:       return userInfo;
24:     }
25:     if (principal instanceof Jwt) {
26:       Jwt jwt = (Jwt) principal;
27:       UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
28:       userInfo.setUserId(jwt.getSubject());
29:       return userInfo;
30:     }
31:     log.debug("principal is neither oidcUser nor jwt, principal=[{}]", principal);
32:     if (principal instanceof OAuth2User) {
33:       UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
34:       OAuth2User oAuth2User = (OAuth2User) principal;
35:       userInfo.setUserId(oAuth2User.getName());
36:       userInfo.setName(oAuth2User.getAttribute(StandardClaimNames.PREFERRED_USERNAME));
37:       userInfo.setEmail(oAuth2User.getAttribute(StandardClaimNames.EMAIL));
38:       return userInfo;
39:     }
40:     if (principal instanceof Principal) {
41:       UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
42:       Principal userPrincipal = (Principal) principal;
43:       userInfo.setUserId(userPrincipal.getName());
44:       return userInfo;
45:     }
46:     UserInfo userInfo = new UserInfo();
47:     userInfo.setUserId(String.valueOf(principal));
48:     return userInfo;
49:   }
50: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.springsecurity;
 2: import com.google.common.collect.Lists;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.bo.UserInfo;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.entity.po.UserPO;

 7: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.spi.UserService;
 8: import java.util.Collections;
 9: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
10: import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority;
11: import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority;
12: import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User;
13: import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
14: import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
15: import org.springframework.security.provisioning.JdbcUserDetailsManager;
16: import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
17: import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils;
18: import java.util.ArrayList;
19: import java.util.List;
20: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
21: import javax.annotation.PostConstruct;
22: public class SpringSecurityUserService implements UserService {
23:   private PasswordEncoder encoder = new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
24:   private List<GrantedAuthority> authorities;
25:   @Autowired
26:   private JdbcUserDetailsManager userDetailsManager;
27:   @Autowired
28:   private UserRepository userRepository;
29:   @PostConstruct
30:   public void init() {
31:     authorities = new ArrayList<>();
32:     authorities.add(new SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_user"));
33:   }
34:   @Transactional
35:   public void createOrUpdate(UserPO user) {
36:     String username = user.getUsername();
37:     User userDetails = new User(username, encoder.encode(user.getPassword()), authorities);
38:     if (userDetailsManager.userExists(username)) {
39:       userDetailsManager.updateUser(userDetails);
40:     } else {
41:       userDetailsManager.createUser(userDetails);
42:     }
43:     UserPO managedUser = userRepository.findByUsername(username);
44:     managedUser.setEmail(user.getEmail());
45:     userRepository.save(managedUser);
46:   }
47:   @Override
48:   public List<UserInfo> searchUsers(String keyword, int offset, int limit) {
49:     List<UserPO> users;
50:     if (StringUtils.isEmpty(keyword)) {
51:       users = userRepository.findFirst20ByEnabled(1);
52:     } else {
53:       users = userRepository.findByUsernameLikeAndEnabled("%" + keyword + "%", 1);
54:     }
55:     List<UserInfo> result = Lists.newArrayList();
56:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(users)) {
57:       return result;
58:     }
59:     result.addAll(users.stream().map(UserPO::toUserInfo).collect(Collectors.toList()));
60:     return result;
61:   }
62:   @Override
63:   public UserInfo findByUserId(String userId) {
64:     UserPO userPO = userRepository.findByUsername(userId);
65:     return userPO == null ? null : userPO.toUserInfo();
66:   }
67:   @Override
68:   public List<UserInfo> findByUserIds(List<String> userIds) {
69:     List<UserPO> users = userRepository.findByUsernameIn(userIds);
70:     if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(users)) {
71:       return Collections.emptyList();
72:     }
73:     List<UserInfo> result = Lists.newArrayList();
74:     result.addAll(users.stream().map(UserPO::toUserInfo).collect(Collectors.toList()));
75:     return result;
76:   }
77: }

 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.util;
 2: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.common.exception.BadRequestException;
 3: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.enums.ConfigFileFormat;
 4: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.core.utils.StringUtils;
 5: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.controller.ConfigsImportController;
 6: import com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.environment.Env;
 7: import com.google.common.base.Splitter;
 8: import java.io.File;
 9: import java.util.List;
10: import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
11: public class ConfigFileUtils {
12:   public static void check(MultipartFile file) {
13:     checkEmpty(file);
14:     final String originalFilename = file.getOriginalFilename();
15:     checkFormat(originalFilename);
16:   }
17:   static void checkEmpty(MultipartFile file) {
18:     if (file.isEmpty()) {
19:       throw new BadRequestException("The file is empty. " + file.getOriginalFilename());
20:     }
21:   }
22:   static void checkFormat(final String originalFilename) {
23:     final List<String> fileNameSplit = Splitter.on(".").splitToList(originalFilename);
24:     if (fileNameSplit.size() <= 1) {
25:       throw new BadRequestException("The file format is invalid.");
26:     }
27:     for (String s : fileNameSplit) {
28:       if (StringUtils.isEmpty(s)) {
29:         throw new BadRequestException("The file format is invalid.");
30:       }
31:     }
32:   }
33:   static String[] getThreePart(final String originalFilename) {
34:     return originalFilename.split("[+]");
35:   }
36:   static void checkThreePart(final String originalFilename) {
37:     String[] parts = getThreePart(originalFilename);
38:     if (3 != parts.length) {
39:       throw new BadRequestException("file name [" + originalFilename + "] not valid");
40:     }
41:   }
42:   public static String getFormat(final String originalFilename) {
43:     final List<String> fileNameSplit = Splitter.on(".").splitToList(originalFilename);
44:     if (fileNameSplit.size() <= 1) {
45:       throw new BadRequestException("The file format is invalid.");
46:     }
47:     return fileNameSplit.get(fileNameSplit.size() - 1);
48:   }
49:   public static String getAppId(final String originalFilename) {
50:     checkThreePart(originalFilename);
51:     return getThreePart(originalFilename)[0];
52:   }
53:   public static String getClusterName(final String originalFilename) {
54:     checkThreePart(originalFilename);
55:     return getThreePart(originalFilename)[1];
56:   }
57:   public static String getNamespace(final String originalFilename) {
58:     checkThreePart(originalFilename);
59:     final String[] threeParts = getThreePart(originalFilename);
60:     final String suffix = threeParts[2];
61:     if (!suffix.contains(".")) {
62:       throw new BadRequestException(originalFilename + " namespace and format is invalid!");
63:     }
64:     final int lastDotIndex = suffix.lastIndexOf(".");
65:     final String namespace = suffix.substring(0, lastDotIndex);
66:     final String format = suffix.substring(lastDotIndex + 1);
67:     if (!ConfigFileFormat.isValidFormat(format)) {
68:       throw new BadRequestException(originalFilename + " format is invalid!");
69:     }
70:     ConfigFileFormat configFileFormat = ConfigFileFormat.fromString(format);
71:     if (configFileFormat.equals(ConfigFileFormat.Properties)) {
72:       return namespace;
73:     } else {
74:       return namespace + "." + format;
75:     }
76:   }
77:   public static String toFilename(
78:       final String appId,
79:       final String clusterName,
80:       final String namespace,
81:       final ConfigFileFormat configFileFormat
82:   ) {
83:     final String suffix;
84:     if (ConfigFileFormat.Properties.equals(configFileFormat)) {
85:       suffix = "." + ConfigFileFormat.Properties.getValue();
86:     } else {
87:       suffix = "";
88:     }
89:     return appId + "+" + clusterName + "+" + namespace + suffix;
90:   }
91:   public static String toFilePath(
92:       final String ownerName,
93:       final String appId,
94:       final Env env,
95:       final String configFilename
96:   ) {
97:     return String.join(File.separator, ownerName, appId, env.getName(), configFilename);
98:   }
99: }

 6:     public static Map<String, String> filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(Properties properties, String suffix) {
 7:         Map<String, String> keyValues = new HashMap<>();
 8:         for(String propertyName : properties.stringPropertyNames()) {
 9:             keyValues.put(propertyName, properties.getProperty(propertyName));
10:         }
11:         return filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(keyValues, suffix);

13:     public static Map<String, String> filterWithKeyIgnoreCaseEndsWith(Map<String, String> keyValues, String suffix) {
14:         Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
15:         for(Map.Entry<String, String> entry : keyValues.entrySet()) {
16:             String key = entry.getKey();
17:             String value = entry.getValue();
18:             if(key.toUpperCase().endsWith(suffix.toUpperCase())) {
19:                 map.put(key, value);
20:             }
21:         }
22:         return map;
23:     }
24:     public static Map<String, String> removeKeySuffix(Map<String, String> keyValues, int suffixLength) {
25:         Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
26:         for(Map.Entry<String, String> entry : keyValues.entrySet()) {
27:             String key = entry.getKey();
28:             String value = entry.getValue();
29:             String newKey = key.substring(0, key.length() - suffixLength);
30:             map.put(newKey, value);
31:         }
32:         return map;
33:     }

11: public class NamespaceBOUtils {
12:   static String convertNonProperties2configFileContent(NamespaceBO namespaceBO) {
13:     List<ItemBO> itemBOS = namespaceBO.getItems();
14:     for (ItemBO itemBO : itemBOS) {
15:       String key = itemBO.getItem().getKey();
16:       if (ConfigConsts.CONFIG_FILE_CONTENT_KEY.equals(key)) {
17:         return itemBO.getItem().getValue();
18:       }
19:     }
20:     return "";
21:   }
22:   /**
23:    * copy from old {@link ConfigsExportController}.
24:    * convert {@link NamespaceBO} to a file content.
25:    * @return content of config file
26:    * @throws IllegalStateException if convert properties to string fail
27:    */
28:   public static String convert2configFileContent(NamespaceBO namespaceBO) {
29:     // early return if it is not a properties format namespace
30:     if (!ConfigFileFormat.Properties.equals(ConfigFileFormat.fromString(namespaceBO.getFormat()))) {
31:       // it is not a properties namespace
32:       return convertNonProperties2configFileContent(namespaceBO);
33:     }
34:     // it must be a properties format namespace
35:     List<ItemBO> itemBOS = namespaceBO.getItems();
36:     // save the kev value pair
37:     Properties properties = new Properties();
38:     for (ItemBO itemBO : itemBOS) {
39:       String key = itemBO.getItem().getKey();
40:       String value = itemBO.getItem().getValue();
41:       // ignore comment, so the comment will lack
42:       properties.put(key, value);
43:     }
44:     // use a special method convert properties to string
45:     final String configFileContent;
46:     try {
47:       configFileContent = PropertiesUtil.toString(properties);
48:     } catch (IOException e) {
49:       throw new IllegalStateException("convert properties to string fail.", e);
50:     }
51:     return configFileContent;
52:   }
53: }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/java/com/ctrip/framework/apollo/portal/util/RelativeDateFormat.java
================
 1: package com.ctrip.framework.apollo.portal.util;
 2: import org.apache.commons.lang.time.FastDateFormat;
 3: import java.util.Calendar;
 4: import java.util.Date;
 5: public class RelativeDateFormat {
 6:   private static final FastDateFormat TIMESTAMP_FORMAT = FastDateFormat.getInstance("yyyy-MM-dd");
 7:   private static final long ONE_MINUTE = 60000L;
 8:   private static final long ONE_HOUR = 3600000L;
 9:   private static final long ONE_DAY = 86400000L;
10:   private static final String ONE_SECOND_AGO = " seconds ago";
11:   private static final String ONE_MINUTE_AGO = " minutes ago";
12:   private static final String ONE_HOUR_AGO = " hours ago";
13:   private static final String ONE_DAY_AGO = " days ago";
14:   private static final String ONE_MONTH_AGO = " months ago";
15:   public static String format(Date date) {
16:     if (date.after(new Date())) {
17:       return "now";
18:     }
19:     long delta = new Date().getTime() - date.getTime();
20:     if (delta < ONE_MINUTE) {
21:       long seconds = toSeconds(delta);
22:       return (seconds <= 0 ? 1 : seconds) + ONE_SECOND_AGO;
23:     }
24:     if (delta < 45L * ONE_MINUTE) {
25:       long minutes = toMinutes(delta);
26:       return (minutes <= 0 ? 1 : minutes) + ONE_MINUTE_AGO;
27:     }
28:     if (delta < 24L * ONE_HOUR) {
29:       long hours = toHours(delta);
30:       return (hours <= 0 ? 1 : hours) + ONE_HOUR_AGO;
31:     }
32:     Date lastDayBeginTime = getDateOffset(-1);
33:     if (date.after(lastDayBeginTime)) {
34:       return "yesterday";
35:     }
36:     Date lastTwoDaysBeginTime = getDateOffset(-2);
37:     if (date.after(lastTwoDaysBeginTime)) {
38:       return "the day before yesterday";
39:     }
40:     if (delta < 30L * ONE_DAY) {
41:       long days = toDays(delta);
42:       return (days <= 0 ? 1 : days) + ONE_DAY_AGO;
43:     }
44:     long months = toMonths(delta);
45:     if (months <= 3) {
46:       return (months <= 0 ? 1 : months) + ONE_MONTH_AGO;
47:     }
48:     return TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.format(date);
49:   }
50:   private static long toSeconds(long date) {
51:     return date / 1000L;
52:   }
53:   private static long toMinutes(long date) {
54:     return toSeconds(date) / 60L;
55:   }
56:   private static long toHours(long date) {
57:     return toMinutes(date) / 60L;
58:   }
59:   private static long toDays(long date) {
60:     return toHours(date) / 24L;
61:   }
62:   private static long toMonths(long date) {
63:     return toDays(date) / 30L;
64:   }
65:   public static Date getDateOffset(int offset) {
66:     Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
67:     calendar.setTime(new Date());
68:     calendar.add(Calendar.DATE, offset);
69:     return getDayBeginTime(calendar.getTime());
70:   }
71:   private static Date getDayBeginTime(Date date) {
72:     Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
73:     calendar.setTime(date);
74:     calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR, 0);
75:     calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
76:     calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
77:     calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
78:     return new Date(calendar.getTime().getTime());
79:   }
80: }

 4: 	<property name="LOG_FILE"

 6: 	<include resource="org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/file-appender.xml" />
 7: 	<include resource="org/springframework/boot/logging/logback/console-appender.xml" />
 8: 	<root level="INFO">
 9: 		<if condition='isDefined("LOG_APPENDERS")'>
10: 			<then>
11: 				<if condition='property("LOG_APPENDERS").contains("CONSOLE")'>
12: 					<then>
13: 						<appender-ref ref="CONSOLE"/>
14: 					</then>
15: 				</if>
16: 				<if condition='property("LOG_APPENDERS").contains("FILE")'>
17: 					<then>
18: 						<appender-ref ref="FILE"/>
19: 					</then>
20: 				</if>
21: 			</then>
22: 			<else>
23: 				<appender-ref ref="FILE" />
24: 				<appender-ref ref="CONSOLE" />
25: 			</else>
26: 		</if>
27: 	</root>
28: </configuration>

 1: appUtil.service('AppUtil', ['toastr', '$window', '$q', '$translate', 'prefixLocation', function (toastr, $window, $q, $translate, prefixLocation) {
 2:     function parseErrorMsg(response) {
 3:         if (response.status == -1) {
 4:             return $translate.instant('Common.LoginExpiredTips');
 5:         }
 6:         var msg = "Code:" + response.status;
 7:         if (response.data.message != null) {
 8:             msg += " Msg:" + response.data.message;
 9:         }
10:         return msg;
11:     }
12:     function parsePureErrorMsg(response) {
13:         if (response.status == -1) {
14:             return $translate.instant('Common.LoginExpiredTips');
15:         }
16:         if (response.data.message != null) {
17:             return response.data.message;
18:         }
19:         return "";
20:     }
21:     function ajax(resource, requestParams, requestBody) {
22:         var d = $q.defer();
23:         if (requestBody) {
24:             resource(requestParams, requestBody, function (result) {
25:                 d.resolve(result);
26:             },
27:                 function (result) {
28:                     d.reject(result);
29:                 });
30:         } else {
31:             resource(requestParams, function (result) {
32:                 d.resolve(result);
33:             },
34:                 function (result) {
35:                     d.reject(result);
36:                 });
37:         }
38:         return d.promise;
39:     }
40:     return {
41:         prefixPath: function(){
42:             return prefixLocation;
43:         },
44:         errorMsg: parseErrorMsg,
45:         pureErrorMsg: parsePureErrorMsg,
46:         ajax: ajax,
47:         showErrorMsg: function (response, title) {
48:             toastr.error(parseErrorMsg(response), title);
49:         },
50:         parseParams: function (query, notJumpToHomePage) {
51:             if (!query) {
52:                 //如果不传这个参数或者false则返回到首页(参数出错)
53:                 if (!notJumpToHomePage) {
54:                     $window.location.href = prefixLocation + '/index.html';
55:                 } else {
56:                     return {};
57:                 }
58:             }
59:             if (query.indexOf('/') == 0) {
60:                 query = query.substring(1, query.length);
61:             }
62:             var anchorIndex = query.indexOf('#');
63:             if (anchorIndex >= 0) {
64:                 query = query.substring(0, anchorIndex);
65:             }
66:             var params = query.split("&");
67:             var result = {};
68:             params.forEach(function (param) {
69:                 var kv = param.split("=");
70:                 result[kv[0]] = decodeURIComponent(kv[1]);
71:             });
72:             return result;
73:         },
74:         collectData: function (response) {
75:             var data = [];
76:             response.entities.forEach(function (entity) {
77:                 if (entity.code == 200) {
78:                     data.push(entity.body);
79:                 } else {
80:                     toastr.warning(entity.message);
81:                 }
82:             });
83:             return data;
84:         },
85:         showModal: function (modal) {
86:             $(modal).modal("show");
87:         },
88:         hideModal: function (modal) {
89:             $(modal).modal("hide");

 49:     function create() {
 50:         $scope.submitBtnDisabled = true;
 51:         var selectedOrg = $('#organization').select2('data')[0];
 52:         if (!selectedOrg.id) {
 53:             toastr.warning($translate.instant('Common.PleaseChooseDepartment'));
 54:             $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
 55:             return;
 56:         }
 57:         $scope.app.orgId = selectedOrg.id;
 58:         $scope.app.orgName = selectedOrg.name;
 59:         var owner = $('.ownerSelector').select2('data')[0];
 60:         if ($scope.isOpenManageAppMasterRoleLimit) {
 61:             owner = { id: $scope.currentUser.userId };
 62:         }
 63:         if (!owner) {
 64:             toastr.warning($translate.instant('Common.PleaseChooseOwner'));
 65:             $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
 66:             return;
 67:         }
 68:         $scope.app.ownerName = owner.id;
 69:         $scope.app.admins = [];
 70:         var admins = $(".adminSelector").select2('data');
 71:         if ($scope.isOpenManageAppMasterRoleLimit) {
 72:             admins = [{ id: $scope.currentUser.userId }];
 73:         }
 74:         if (admins) {
 75:             admins.forEach(function (admin) {
 76:                 $scope.app.admins.push(admin.id);
 77:             })
 78:         }
 79:         AppService.create($scope.app).then(function (result) {
 80:             toastr.success($translate.instant('Common.Created'));
 81:             setInterval(function () {
 82:                 $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
 83:                 $window.location.href = AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/config.html?#appid=' + result.appId;
 84:             }, 1000);
 85:         }, function (result) {
 86:             $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
 87:             toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('Common.CreateFailed'));
 88:         });
 89:     }
 90:     $(".J_ownerSelectorPanel").on("select2:select", ".ownerSelector", selectEventHandler);
 91:     var $adminSelectorPanel = $(".J_adminSelectorPanel");

102:     }

 53:         FavoriteService.findFavorites($scope.userId, '', $scope.favoritesPage, size)
 54:             .then(function (result) {
 55:                 $scope.favoritesPage += 1;
 56:                 $scope.hasMoreFavorites = result.length == size;
 57:                 if ($scope.favoritesPage == 1) {
 58:                     $("#app-list").removeClass("hidden");

 61:                     return;

 65:                     appIds.push(favorite.appId);

 68:                     .then(function (apps) {
 69:                         //sort
 70:                         var appIdMapApp = {};
 71:                         apps.forEach(function (app) {
 72:                             appIdMapApp[app.appId] = app;
 73:                         });
 74:                         result.forEach(function (favorite) {

 76:                             if (!app) {
 77:                                 return;
 78:                             }

 80:                             $scope.favorites.push(app);
 81:                         });
 82:                     });
 83:             })

 89:             visitedAppsObject = {};

103:                             $scope.visitedApps.push(app);
104:                         }
105:                     });
106:                 });
107:         }
108:     }

 16:             edit: false
 17:         }

 31:     function initOrganization() {
 32:         OrganizationService.find_organizations().then(function (result) {
 33:             var organizations = [];
 34:             result.forEach(function (item) {
 35:                 var org = {};
 36:                 org.id = item.orgId;
 37:                 org.text = item.orgName + '(' + item.orgId + ')';
 38:                 org.name = item.orgName;
 39:                 organizations.push(org);

 43:                 width: '100%',
 44:                 data: organizations
 45:             });
 46:             initApplication();

 48:             toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), "load organizations error");
 49:         });
 50:     }
 51:     function initPermission() {
 52:         PermissionService.has_assign_user_permission($scope.pageContext.appId)
 53:             .then(function (result) {
 54:                 $scope.hasAssignUserPermission = result.hasPermission;
 55:                 PermissionService.has_open_manage_app_master_role_limit().then(function (value) {
 56:                      if (!value.isManageAppMasterPermissionEnabled) {
 57:                         $scope.hasManageAppMasterPermission = $scope.hasAssignUserPermission;
 58:                         return;
 59:                      }
 60:                     PermissionService.has_manage_app_master_permission($scope.pageContext.appId).then(function (res) {
 61:                         $scope.hasManageAppMasterPermission = res.hasPermission && $scope.hasAssignUserPermission;
 62:                         PermissionService.has_root_permission().then(function (value) {
 63:                             $scope.hasManageAppMasterPermission = value.hasPermission || $scope.hasManageAppMasterPermission;
 64:                         });
 65:                     });
 66:                 });
 67:             });
 68:     }
 69:     function initAdmins() {
 70:         PermissionService.get_app_role_users($scope.pageContext.appId)
 71:             .then(function (result) {
 72:                 $scope.appRoleUsers = result;
 73:                 $scope.admins = [];
 74:                 $scope.appRoleUsers.masterUsers.forEach(function (user) {
 75:                     $scope.admins.push(_.escape(user.userId));
 76:                 });
 77:             });
 78:     }
 79:     function initApplication() {
 80:         AppService.load($scope.pageContext.appId).then(function (app) {
 81:             $scope.app = app;
 82:             $scope.viewApp = _.clone(app);

 84:             $('.project-setting .panel').removeClass('hidden');
 85:         })
 86:     }
 87:     function initAppForm(app) {
 88:         $orgWidget.val(app.orgId).trigger("change");
 89:         var $ownerSelector = $('.ownerSelector');
 90:         var defaultSelectedDOM = '<option value="' + _.escape(app.ownerName) + '" selected="selected">' + _.escape(app.ownerName)
 91:             + '</option>';
 92:         $ownerSelector.append(defaultSelectedDOM);
 93:         $ownerSelector.trigger('change');
 94:     }
 95:     function assignMasterRoleToUser() {
 96:         var user = $('.' + $scope.userSelectWidgetId).select2('data')[0];
 97:         if (!user) {
 98:             toastr.warning($translate.instant('App.Setting.PleaseChooseUser'));
 99:             return;
100:         }
101:         var toAssignMasterRoleUser = user.id;
102:         $scope.submitBtnDisabled = true;
103:         PermissionService.assign_master_role($scope.pageContext.appId,
104:             toAssignMasterRoleUser)
105:             .then(function (result) {
106:                 $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
107:                 toastr.success($translate.instant('App.Setting.Added'));
108:                 $scope.appRoleUsers.masterUsers.push({ userId: toAssignMasterRoleUser });
109:                 $('.' + $scope.userSelectWidgetId).select2("val", "");
110:             }, function (result) {
111:                 $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
112:                 toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('App.Setting.AddFailed'));
113:             });
114:     }
115:     function removeMasterRoleFromUser(user) {
116:         if ($scope.appRoleUsers.masterUsers.length <= 1) {
117:             $('#warning').modal('show');
118:             return;
119:         }
120:         PermissionService.remove_master_role($scope.pageContext.appId, user)
121:             .then(function (result) {
122:                 toastr.success($translate.instant('App.Setting.Deleted'));
123:                 removeUserFromList($scope.appRoleUsers.masterUsers, user);
124:             }, function (result) {
125:                 toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('App.Setting.DeleteFailed'));
126:             });
127:     }
128:     function removeUserFromList(list, user) {
129:         var index = 0;
130:         for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
131:             if (list[i].userId == user) {
132:                 index = i;
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:         }
136:         list.splice(index, 1);
137:     }
138:     function toggleEditStatus() {
139:         if ($scope.display.app.edit) {
140:             $scope.viewApp = _.clone($scope.app);
141:             initAppForm($scope.viewApp);
142:         } else {
143:         }
144:         $scope.display.app.edit = !$scope.display.app.edit;
145:     }
146:     function updateAppInfo() {
147:         $scope.submitBtnDisabled = true;
148:         var app = $scope.viewApp;
149:         var selectedOrg = $orgWidget.select2('data')[0];
150:         if (!selectedOrg.id) {
151:             toastr.warning($translate.instant('Common.PleaseChooseDepartment'));
152:             return;
153:         }
154:         app.orgId = selectedOrg.id;
155:         app.orgName = selectedOrg.name;
156:         var owner = $('.ownerSelector').select2('data')[0];
157:         if (!owner) {
158:             toastr.warning($translate.instant('Common.PleaseChooseOwner'));
159:             return;
160:         }
161:         app.ownerName = owner.id;
162:         AppService.update(app).then(function (app) {
163:             toastr.success($translate.instant('App.Setting.Modified'));
164:             initApplication();
165:             $scope.display.app.edit = false;
166:             $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
167:         }, function (result) {
168:             AppUtil.showErrorMsg(result);
169:             $scope.submitBtnDisabled = false;
170:         })
171:     }
172: }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/resources/static/scripts/directive/delete-namespace-modal-directive.js

  1: directive_module.directive('deletenamespacemodal', deleteNamespaceModalDirective);
  2: function deleteNamespaceModalDirective($window, $q, $translate, toastr, AppUtil, EventManager,
  3:     PermissionService, UserService, NamespaceService) {
  4:     return {
  5:         restrict: 'E',
  6:         templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/delete-namespace-modal.html',
  7:         transclude: true,
  8:         replace: true,
  9:         scope: {
 10:             env: '='
 11:         },
 12:         link: function (scope) {
 13:             scope.doDeleteNamespace = doDeleteNamespace;
 14:             EventManager.subscribe(EventManager.EventType.PRE_DELETE_NAMESPACE, function (context) {
 15:                 var toDeleteNamespace = context.namespace;
 16:                 scope.toDeleteNamespace = toDeleteNamespace;
 17:                 checkPermission(toDeleteNamespace).then(function () {
 18:                     if (!checkMasterInstance(toDeleteNamespace)) {
 19:                         return;
 20:                     }
 21:                     if (!checkBranchInstance(toDeleteNamespace)) {
 22:                         return;
 23:                     }
 24:                     if (!toDeleteNamespace.isPublic || toDeleteNamespace.isLinkedNamespace) {
 25:                         showDeleteNamespaceConfirmDialog();
 26:                     } else {
 27:                         checkPublicNamespace(toDeleteNamespace).then(function () {
 28:                             showDeleteNamespaceConfirmDialog();
 29:                         });
 30:                     }
 31:                 })
 32:             });
 33:             function checkPermission(namespace) {
 34:                 var d = $q.defer();
 35:                 UserService.load_user().then(function (currentUser) {
 36:                     var isAppMasterUser = false;
 37:                     PermissionService.get_app_role_users(namespace.baseInfo.appId)
 38:                         .then(function (appRoleUsers) {
 39:                             var masterUsers = [];
 40:                             appRoleUsers.masterUsers.forEach(function (user) {
 41:                                 masterUsers.push(_.escape(user.userId));
 42:                                 if (currentUser.userId == user.userId) {
 43:                                     isAppMasterUser = true;
 44:                                 }
 45:                             });
 46:                             scope.masterUsers = masterUsers;
 47:                             scope.isAppMasterUser = isAppMasterUser;
 48:                             if (!isAppMasterUser) {
 49:                                 toastr.error($translate.instant('Config.DeleteNamespaceNoPermissionFailedTips', {
 50:                                     users: scope.masterUsers.join(", ")
 51:                                 }), $translate.instant('Config.DeleteNamespaceNoPermissionFailedTitle'));
 52:                                 d.reject();
 53:                             } else {
 54:                                 d.resolve();
 55:                             }
 56:                         });
 57:                 });
 58:                 return d.promise;
 59:             }
 60:             function checkMasterInstance(namespace) {
 61:                 if (namespace.instancesCount > 0) {
 62:                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.DELETE_NAMESPACE_FAILED, {
 63:                         namespace: namespace,
 64:                         reason: 'master_instance'
 65:                     });
 66:                     return false;
 67:                 }
 68:                 return true;
 69:             }
 70:             function checkBranchInstance(namespace) {
 71:                 if (namespace.hasBranch && namespace.branch.latestReleaseInstances.total > 0) {
 72:                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.DELETE_NAMESPACE_FAILED, {
 73:                         namespace: namespace,
 74:                         reason: 'branch_instance'
 75:                     });
 76:                     return false;
 77:                 }
 78:                 return true;
 79:             }
 80:             function checkPublicNamespace(namespace) {
 81:                 var d = $q.defer();
 82:                 var publicAppId = namespace.baseInfo.appId;
 83:                 NamespaceService.getPublicAppNamespaceAllNamespaces(scope.env,
 84:                     namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 85:                     0, 20)
 86:                     .then(function (associatedNamespaces) {
 87:                         var otherAppAssociatedNamespaces = [];
 88:                         associatedNamespaces.forEach(function (associatedNamespace) {
 89:                             if (associatedNamespace.appId != publicAppId) {
 90:                                 otherAppAssociatedNamespaces.push(associatedNamespace);
 91:                             }
 92:                         });
 93:                         if (otherAppAssociatedNamespaces.length) {
 94:                             EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.DELETE_NAMESPACE_FAILED, {
 95:                                 namespace: namespace,
 96:                                 reason: 'public_namespace',
 97:                                 otherAppAssociatedNamespaces: otherAppAssociatedNamespaces
 98:                             });
 99:                             d.reject();
100:                         } else {
101:                             d.resolve();
102:                         }
103:                     });
104:                 return d.promise;
105:             }
106:             function showDeleteNamespaceConfirmDialog() {
107:                 AppUtil.showModal('#deleteNamespaceModal');
108:             }
109:             function doDeleteNamespace() {
110:                 var toDeleteNamespace = scope.toDeleteNamespace;
111:                 NamespaceService.deleteNamespace(toDeleteNamespace.baseInfo.appId, scope.env,
112:                     toDeleteNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
113:                     toDeleteNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
114:                     .then(function () {
115:                         toastr.success($translate.instant('Common.Deleted'));
116:                         setTimeout(function () {
117:                             $window.location.reload();
118:                         }, 1000);
119:                     }, function (result) {
120:                         AppUtil.showErrorMsg(result, $translate.instant('Common.DeleteFailed'));
121:                     })
122:             }
123:         }
124:     }
125: }

File: apollo-portal/src/main/resources/static/scripts/directive/diff-directive.js

 1: directive_module.directive('apollodiff',
 2:     function ($compile, $window, AppUtil) {
 3:         return {
 4:             restrict: 'E',
 5:             templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/diff.html',
 6:             transclude: true,
 7:             replace: true,
 8:             scope: {
 9:                 oldStr: '=',
10:                 newStr: '=',
11:                 apolloId: '='
12:             },
13:             link: function (scope, element, attrs) {
14:                 scope.$watch('oldStr', makeDiff);
15:                 scope.$watch('newStr', makeDiff);
16:                 function makeDiff() {
17:                     var displayArea = document.getElementById(scope.apolloId);
18:                     if (!displayArea) {
19:                         return;
20:                     }
21:                     displayArea.innerHTML = '';
22:                     var color = '',
23:                         span = null,
24:                         pre = '';
25:                     var oldStr = scope.oldStr == undefined ? '' : scope.oldStr;
26:                     var newStr = scope.newStr == undefined ? '' : scope.newStr;
27:                     var diff = JsDiff.diffLines(oldStr, newStr),
28:                         fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
29:                     diff.forEach(function (part) {
30:                         // green for additions, red for deletions
31:                         // grey for common parts
32:                         color = part.added ? 'green' :
33:                             part.removed ? 'red' : 'grey';
34:                         span = document.createElement('span');
35:                         span.style.color = color;
36:                         pre = part.added ? '+' :
37:                             part.removed ? '-' : '';
38:                         span.appendChild(document.createTextNode(pre + part.value));
39:                         fragment.appendChild(span);
40:                     });
41:                     displayArea.appendChild(fragment);
42:                 }
43:             }
44:         }
45:     });

  1: directive_module.directive('rulesmodal', rulesModalDirective);
  2: function rulesModalDirective($translate, toastr, AppUtil, EventManager, InstanceService) {
  3:     return {
  4:         restrict: 'E',
  5:         templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/gray-release-rules-modal.html',
  6:         transclude: true,
  7:         replace: true,
  8:         scope: {
  9:             appId: '=',
 10:             env: '=',
 11:             cluster: '='
 12:         },
 13:         link: function (scope) {
 14:             scope.completeEditBtnDisable = false;
 15:             scope.batchAddIPs = batchAddIPs;
 16:             scope.addRules = addRules;
 17:             scope.removeRule = removeRule;
 18:             scope.completeEditItem = completeEditItem;
 19:             scope.cancelEditItem = cancelEditItem;
 20:             scope.initSelectIps = initSelectIps;
 21:             EventManager.subscribe(EventManager.EventType.EDIT_GRAY_RELEASE_RULES,
 22:                 function (context) {
 23:                     var branch = context.branch;
 24:                     scope.branch = branch;
 25:                     if (branch.editingRuleItem.clientIpList && branch.editingRuleItem.clientIpList[0] == '*') {
 26:                         branch.editingRuleItem.ApplyToAllInstances = true;
 27:                     } else {
 28:                         branch.editingRuleItem.ApplyToAllInstances = false;
 29:                     }
 30:                     $('.rules-ip-selector').select2({
 31:                         placeholder: $translate.instant('RulesModal.ChooseInstances'),
 32:                         allowClear: true
 33:                     });
 34:                     AppUtil.showModal('#rulesModal');
 35:                 });
 36:             $('.rules-ip-selector').on('select2:select', function () {
 37:                 addRules(scope.branch);
 38:             });
 39:             function addRules(branch) {
 40:                 var newRules, selector = $('.rules-ip-selector');
 41:                 newRules = selector.select2('data');
 42:                 var parsedIPs = [];
 43:                 newRules.forEach(function (rule) {
 44:                     parsedIPs.push(rule.text);
 45:                 });
 46:                 selector.select2("val", "");
 47:                 addRuleItemIP(branch, parsedIPs);
 48:                 scope.$apply();
 49:             }
 50:             function batchAddIPs(branch, newIPs) {
 51:                 if (!newIPs) {
 52:                     return;
 53:                 }
 54:                 addRuleItemIP(branch, newIPs.split(','));
 55:             }
 56:             function addRuleItemIP(branch, newIps) {
 57:                 var oldIPs = branch.editingRuleItem.draftIpList;
 58:                 if (newIps && newIps.length > 0) {
 59:                     newIps.forEach(function (IP) {
 60:                         if (!AppUtil.checkIPV4(IP)) {
 61:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('RulesModal.ChooseInstances', { ip: IP }));
 62:                         } else if (oldIPs.indexOf(IP) < 0) {
 63:                             oldIPs.push(IP);
 64:                         }
 65:                     })
 66:                 }
 67:                 //remove IP:all
 68:                 oldIPs.forEach(function (IP, index) {
 69:                     if (IP == "*") {
 70:                         oldIPs.splice(index, 1);
 71:                     }
 72:                 });
 73:             }
 74:             function removeRule(ruleItem, IP) {
 75:                 ruleItem.draftIpList.forEach(function (existedRule, index) {
 76:                     if (existedRule == IP) {
 77:                         ruleItem.draftIpList.splice(index, 1);
 78:                     }
 79:                 })
 80:             }
 81:             function completeEditItem(branch) {
 82:                 scope.completeEditBtnDisable = true;
 83:                 if (!branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId) {
 84:                     toastr.error($translate.instant('RulesModal.GrayscaleAppIdCanNotBeNull'));
 85:                     scope.completeEditBtnDisable = false;
 86:                     return;
 87:                 }
 88:                 if (branch.editingRuleItem.isNew && branch.rules && branch.rules.ruleItems) {
 89:                     var errorRuleItem = false;
 90:                     branch.rules.ruleItems.forEach(function (ruleItem) {
 91:                         if (ruleItem.clientAppId == branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId) {
 92:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('RulesModal.AppIdExistsRule', { appId: branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId }));
 93:                             errorRuleItem = true;
 94:                         }
 95:                     });
 96:                     if (errorRuleItem) {
 97:                         scope.completeEditBtnDisable = false;
 98:                         return;
 99:                     }
100:                 }
101:                 if (!branch.editingRuleItem.ApplyToAllInstances) {
102:                     if (branch.editingRuleItem.draftIpList.length == 0) {
103:                         toastr.error($translate.instant('RulesModal.IpListCanNotBeNull'));
104:                         scope.completeEditBtnDisable = false;
105:                         return;
106:                     } else {
107:                         branch.editingRuleItem.clientIpList = branch.editingRuleItem.draftIpList;
108:                     }
109:                 } else {
110:                     branch.editingRuleItem.clientIpList = ['*'];
111:                 }
112:                 if (!branch.rules) {
113:                     branch.rules = {
114:                         appId: scope.appId,
115:                         clusterName: scope.cluster,
116:                         namespaceName: branch.baseInfo.namespaceName,
117:                         branchName: branch.baseInfo.clusterName
118:                     };
119:                 }
120:                 if (!branch.rules.ruleItems) {
121:                     branch.rules.ruleItems = [];
122:                 }
123:                 if (branch.editingRuleItem.isNew) {
124:                     branch.rules.ruleItems.push(branch.editingRuleItem);
125:                 }
126:                 branch.editingRuleItem = undefined;
127:                 scope.toAddIPs = '';
128:                 AppUtil.hideModal('#rulesModal');
129:                 EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.UPDATE_GRAY_RELEASE_RULES,
130:                     {
131:                         branch: branch
132:                     }, branch.baseInfo.namespaceName);
133:                 scope.completeEditBtnDisable = false;
134:             }
135:             function cancelEditItem(branch) {
136:                 branch.editingRuleItem.isEdit = false;
137:                 branch.editingRuleItem = undefined;
138:                 scope.toAddIPs = '';
139:                 AppUtil.hideModal('#rulesModal');
140:             }
141:             $('#rulesModal').on('shown.bs.modal', function (e) {
142:                 initSelectIps();
143:             });
144:             function initSelectIps() {
145:                 scope.selectIps = [];
146:                 if (!scope.branch.parentNamespace.isPublic ||
147:                     scope.branch.parentNamespace.isLinkedNamespace) {
148:                     scope.branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId = scope.branch.baseInfo.appId;
149:                 }
150:                 if (!scope.branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId) {
151:                     return;
152:                 }
153:                 InstanceService.findInstancesByNamespace(scope.appId,
154:                     scope.env,
155:                     scope.cluster,
156:                     scope.branch.baseInfo.namespaceName,
157:                     scope.branch.editingRuleItem.clientAppId,
158:                     0,
159:                     2000)
160:                     .then(function (result) {
161:                         scope.selectIps = result.content;
162:                     });
163:             }
164:         }
165:     }
166: }

  1: directive_module.directive('itemmodal', itemModalDirective);
  2: function itemModalDirective($translate, toastr, $sce, AppUtil, EventManager, ConfigService) {
  3:     return {
  4:         restrict: 'E',
  5:         templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/item-modal.html',
  6:         transclude: true,
  7:         replace: true,
  8:         scope: {
  9:             appId: '=',
 10:             env: '=',
 11:             cluster: '=',
 12:             toOperationNamespace: '=',
 13:             item: '='
 14:         },
 15:         link: function (scope) {
 16:             var TABLE_VIEW_OPER_TYPE = {
 17:                 CREATE: 'create',
 18:                 UPDATE: 'update'
 19:             };
 20:             scope.doItem = doItem;
 21:             scope.collectSelectedClusters = collectSelectedClusters;
 22:             scope.showHiddenChars = showHiddenChars;
 23:             $('#itemModal').on('show.bs.modal', function (e) {
 24:                 scope.showHiddenCharsContext = false;
 25:                 scope.hiddenCharCounter = 0;
 26:                 scope.valueWithHiddenChars = $sce.trustAsHtml('');
 27:             });
 28:             $("#valueEditor").textareafullscreen();
 29:             function doItem() {
 30:                 if (!scope.item.value) {
 31:                     scope.item.value = "";
 32:                 }
 33:                 if (scope.item.tableViewOperType == TABLE_VIEW_OPER_TYPE.CREATE) {
 34:                     //check key unique
 35:                     var hasRepeatKey = false;
 36:                     scope.toOperationNamespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
 37:                         if (!item.isDeleted && scope.item.key == item.item.key) {
 38:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('ItemModal.KeyExists', { key: scope.item.key }));
 39:                             hasRepeatKey = true;
 40:                         }
 41:                     });
 42:                     if (hasRepeatKey) {
 43:                         return;
 44:                     }
 45:                     scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = true;
 46:                     if (scope.toOperationNamespace.isBranch) {
 47:                         ConfigService.create_item(scope.appId,
 48:                             scope.env,
 49:                             scope.toOperationNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
 50:                             scope.toOperationNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 51:                             scope.item).then(
 52:                                 function (result) {
 53:                                     toastr.success($translate.instant('ItemModal.AddedTips'));
 54:                                     scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = false;
 55:                                     AppUtil.hideModal('#itemModal');
 56:                                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
 57:                                         {
 58:                                             namespace: scope.toOperationNamespace
 59:                                         });
 60:                                 }, function (result) {
 61:                                     toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ItemModal.AddFailed'));
 62:                                     scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = false;
 63:                                 });
 64:                     } else {
 65:                         if (selectedClusters.length == 0) {
 66:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('ItemModal.PleaseChooseCluster'));
 67:                             scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = false;
 68:                             return;
 69:                         }
 70:                         selectedClusters.forEach(function (cluster) {
 71:                             ConfigService.create_item(scope.appId,
 72:                                 cluster.env,
 73:                                 cluster.name,
 74:                                 scope.toOperationNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 75:                                 scope.item).then(
 76:                                     function (result) {
 77:                                         scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = false;
 78:                                         AppUtil.hideModal('#itemModal');
 79:                                         toastr.success(cluster.env + " , " + scope.item.key, $translate.instant('ItemModal.AddedTips'));
 80:                                         if (cluster.env == scope.env &&
 81:                                             cluster.name == scope.cluster) {
 82:                                             EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
 83:                                                 {
 84:                                                     namespace: scope.toOperationNamespace
 85:                                                 });
 86:                                         }
 87:                                     }, function (result) {
 88:                                         toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ItemModal.AddFailed'));
 89:                                         scope.item.addItemBtnDisabled = false;
 90:                                     });
 91:                         });
 92:                     }
 93:                 } else {
 94:                     if (!scope.item.comment) {
 95:                         scope.item.comment = "";
 96:                     }
 97:                     ConfigService.update_item(scope.appId,
 98:                         scope.env,
 99:                         scope.toOperationNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
100:                         scope.toOperationNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
101:                         scope.item).then(
102:                             function (result) {
103:                                 EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
104:                                     {
105:                                         namespace: scope.toOperationNamespace
106:                                     });
107:                                 AppUtil.hideModal('#itemModal');
108:                                 toastr.success($translate.instant('ItemModal.ModifiedTips'));
109:                             }, function (result) {
110:                                 toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ItemModal.ModifyFailed'));
111:                             });
112:                 }
113:             }
114:             var selectedClusters = [];
115:             function collectSelectedClusters(data) {
116:                 selectedClusters = data;
117:             }
118:             function showHiddenChars() {
119:                 var value = scope.item.value;
120:                 if (!value) {
121:                     return;
122:                 }
123:                 var hiddenCharCounter = 0, valueWithHiddenChars = _.escape(value);
124:                 for (var i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
125:                     var c = value[i];
126:                     if (isHiddenChar(c)) {
127:                         valueWithHiddenChars = valueWithHiddenChars.replace(c, viewHiddenChar);
128:                         hiddenCharCounter++;
129:                     }
130:                 }
131:                 scope.showHiddenCharsContext = true;
132:                 scope.hiddenCharCounter = hiddenCharCounter;
133:                 scope.valueWithHiddenChars = $sce.trustAsHtml(valueWithHiddenChars);
134:             }
135:             function isHiddenChar(c) {
136:                 return c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == ' ';
137:             }
138:             function viewHiddenChar(c) {
139:                 if (c == '\t') {
140:                     return '<mark>#' + $translate.instant('ItemModal.Tabs') + '#</mark>';
141:                 } else if (c == '\n') {
142:                     return '<mark>#' + $translate.instant('ItemModal.NewLine') + '#</mark>';
143:                 } else if (c == ' ') {
144:                     return '<mark>#' + $translate.instant('ItemModal.Space') + '#</mark>';
145:                 }
146:             }
147:         }
148:     }
149: }
