132:                             namespace.branch.isBranch = true;
133:                             namespace.branch.parentNamespace = namespace;
134:                             namespace.branch.viewType = namespace_view_type.TABLE;
135:                             namespace.branch.isPropertiesFormat = namespace.format == 'properties';
136:                             namespace.branch.allInstances = [];//master namespace all instances
137:                             namespace.branch.latestReleaseInstances = [];
138:                             namespace.branch.latestReleaseInstancesPage = 0;
139:                             namespace.branch.instanceViewType = namespace_instance_view_type.LATEST_RELEASE;
140:                             namespace.branch.hasLoadInstances = false;
141:                             namespace.branch.displayControl = {
142:                                 show: true
143:                             };
144:                             generateNamespaceId(namespace.branch);
145:                             initBranchItems(namespace.branch);
146:                             initRules(namespace.branch);
147:                             loadInstanceInfo(namespace.branch);
148:                             initNamespaceLock(namespace.branch);
149:                             initPermission(namespace);
150:                             initUserOperateBranchScene(namespace);
151:                         });
152:                     function initBranchItems(branch) {
153:                         branch.masterItems = [];
154:                         branch.branchItems = [];
155:                         var masterItemsMap = {};
156:                         branch.parentNamespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
157:                             if (item.item.key) {
158:                                 masterItemsMap[item.item.key] = item;
159:                             }
160:                         });
161:                         var branchItemsMap = {};
162:                         var itemModifiedCnt = 0;
163:                         branch.items.forEach(function (item) {
164:                             var key = item.item.key;
165:                             var masterItem = masterItemsMap[key];
166:                             //modify master item and set item's masterReleaseValue
167:                             if (masterItem) {
168:                                 item.masterItemExists = true;
169:                                 if (masterItem.isModified) {
170:                                     item.masterReleaseValue = masterItem.oldValue;
171:                                 } else {
172:                                     item.masterReleaseValue = masterItem.item.value;
173:                                 }
174:                             } else {//delete branch item
175:                                 item.masterItemExists = false;
176:                             }
177:                             //delete master item. ignore
178:                             if (item.isDeleted && masterItem) {
179:                                 if (item.masterReleaseValue != item.oldValue) {
180:                                     itemModifiedCnt++;
181:                                     branch.branchItems.push(item);
182:                                 }
183:                             } else {//branch's item
184:                                 branchItemsMap[key] = item;
185:                                 if (item.isModified) {
186:                                     itemModifiedCnt++;
187:                                 }
188:                                 branch.branchItems.push(item);
189:                             }
190:                         });
191:                         branch.itemModifiedCnt = itemModifiedCnt;
192:                         branch.parentNamespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
193:                             if (item.item.key) {
194:                                 if (!branchItemsMap[item.item.key]) {
195:                                     branch.masterItems.push(item);
196:                                 } else {
197:                                     item.hasBranchValue = true;
198:                                 }
199:                             }
200:                         })
201:                     }
202:                 }
203:                 function generateNamespaceId(namespace) {
204:                     namespace.id = Math.random().toString(36).substr(2);
205:                 }
206:                 function initPermission(namespace) {
207:                     PermissionService.has_modify_namespace_permission(
208:                         scope.appId,
209:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
210:                         .then(function (result) {
211:                             if (!result.hasPermission) {
212:                                 PermissionService.has_modify_namespace_env_permission(
213:                                     scope.appId,
214:                                     scope.env,
215:                                     namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName
216:                                 )
217:                                     .then(function (result) {
218:                                         //branch has same permission
219:                                         namespace.hasModifyPermission = result.hasPermission;
220:                                         if (namespace.branch) {
221:                                             namespace.branch.hasModifyPermission = result.hasPermission;
222:                                         }
223:                                     });
224:                             }
225:                             else {
226:                                 //branch has same permission
227:                                 namespace.hasModifyPermission = result.hasPermission;
228:                                 if (namespace.branch) {
229:                                     namespace.branch.hasModifyPermission = result.hasPermission;
230:                                 }
231:                             }
232:                         });
233:                     PermissionService.has_release_namespace_permission(
234:                         scope.appId,
235:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
236:                         .then(function (result) {
237:                             if (!result.hasPermission) {
238:                                 PermissionService.has_release_namespace_env_permission(
239:                                     scope.appId,
240:                                     scope.env,
241:                                     namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName
242:                                 )
243:                                     .then(function (result) {
244:                                         //branch has same permission
245:                                         namespace.hasReleasePermission = result.hasPermission;
246:                                         if (namespace.branch) {
247:                                             namespace.branch.hasReleasePermission = result.hasPermission;
248:                                         }
249:                                     });
250:                             }
251:                             else {
252:                                 //branch has same permission
253:                                 namespace.hasReleasePermission = result.hasPermission;
254:                                 if (namespace.branch) {
255:                                     namespace.branch.hasReleasePermission = result.hasPermission;
256:                                 }
257:                             }
258:                         });
259:                 }
260:                 function initLinkedNamespace(namespace) {
261:                     if (!namespace.isPublic || !namespace.isLinkedNamespace || namespace.format != 'properties') {
262:                         return;
263:                     }
264:                     //load public namespace
265:                     ConfigService.load_public_namespace_for_associated_namespace(scope.env, scope.appId, scope.cluster,
266:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
267:                         .then(function (result) {
268:                             var publicNamespace = result;
269:                             namespace.publicNamespace = publicNamespace;
270:                             var linkNamespaceItemKeys = [];
271:                             namespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
272:                                 var key = item.item.key;
273:                                 linkNamespaceItemKeys.push(key);
274:                             });
275:                             publicNamespace.viewItems = [];
276:                             publicNamespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
277:                                 var key = item.item.key;
278:                                 if (key) {
279:                                     publicNamespace.viewItems.push(item);
280:                                 }
281:                                 item.covered = linkNamespaceItemKeys.indexOf(key) >= 0;
282:                                 if (item.isModified || item.isDeleted) {
283:                                     publicNamespace.isModified = true;
284:                                 } else if (key) {
285:                                     publicNamespace.hasPublishedItem = true;
286:                                 }
287:                             });
288:                         });
289:                 }
290:                 function initNamespaceViewName(namespace) {
291:                     if (!viewType) {
292:                         if (namespace.isPropertiesFormat) {
293:                             switchView(namespace, namespace_view_type.TABLE);
294:                         } else {
295:                             switchView(namespace, namespace_view_type.TEXT);
296:                         }
297:                     } else if (viewType == namespace_view_type.TABLE) {
298:                         namespace.viewType = namespace_view_type.TABLE;
299:                     }
300:                 }
301:                 function initNamespaceLock(namespace) {

303:                         namespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
304:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)

307:                             namespace.isEmergencyPublishAllowed = result.isEmergencyPublishAllowed;
308:                         });
309:                 }
310:                 function initUserOperateBranchScene(namespace) {
311:                     var operateBranchStorage = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(operate_branch_storage_key));
312:                     var namespaceId = [scope.appId, scope.env, scope.cluster, namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName].join(
313:                         "+");
314:                     if (!operateBranchStorage) {
315:                         operateBranchStorage = {};

318:                         operateBranchStorage[namespaceId] = namespace.branchName;
319:                     }

321:                     switchBranch(operateBranchStorage[namespaceId], false);

343:             function switchBranch(branchName, forceShowBody) {
344:                 if (branchName != 'master') {
345:                     initRules(scope.namespace.branch);
346:                 }
347:                 if (forceShowBody) {
348:                     scope.showNamespaceBody = true;
349:                 }
350:                 scope.namespace.displayControl.currentOperateBranch = branchName;
351:                 //save to local storage
352:                 var operateBranchStorage = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(operate_branch_storage_key));
353:                 if (!operateBranchStorage) {
354:                     return;
355:                 }
356:                 var namespaceId = [scope.appId, scope.env, scope.cluster, scope.namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName].join(
357:                     "+");
358:                 operateBranchStorage[namespaceId] = branchName;
359:                 localStorage.setItem(operate_branch_storage_key, JSON.stringify(operateBranchStorage));
360:             }
361:             function switchView(namespace, viewType) {
362:                 namespace.viewType = viewType;
363:                 if (namespace_view_type.TEXT == viewType) {
364:                     namespace.text = parseModel2Text(namespace);
365:                 } else if (namespace_view_type.TABLE == viewType) {
366:                 } else if (namespace_view_type.HISTORY == viewType) {
367:                     loadCommitHistory(namespace);
368:                 } else if (namespace_view_type.INSTANCE == viewType) {
369:                     refreshInstancesInfo(namespace);
370:                 }
371:             }
372:             function switchInstanceViewType(namespace, type) {
373:                 namespace.instanceViewType = type;
374:                 loadInstanceInfo(namespace);
375:             }
376:             function loadCommitHistory(namespace) {
377:                 if (!namespace.commits) {
378:                     namespace.commits = [];
379:                     namespace.commitPage = 0;
380:                 }
381:                 var size = 10;
382:                 CommitService.find_commits(scope.appId,
383:                     scope.env,
384:                     namespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
385:                     namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
386:                     namespace.commitPage,
387:                     size)
388:                     .then(function (result) {
389:                         if (result.length < size) {
390:                             namespace.hasLoadAllCommit = true;
391:                         }
392:                         for (var i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
393:                             //to json
394:                             result[i].changeSets = JSON.parse(result[i].changeSets);
395:                             namespace.commits.push(result[i]);
396:                         }
397:                         namespace.commitPage += 1;
398:                     }, function (result) {
399:                         toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ApolloNsPanel.LoadingHistoryError'));
400:                     });
401:             }
402:             function loadInstanceInfo(namespace) {
403:                 var size = 20;
404:                 if (namespace.isBranch) {
405:                     size = 2000;
406:                 }
407:                 var type = namespace.instanceViewType;
408:                 if (namespace_instance_view_type.LATEST_RELEASE == type) {
409:                     if (!namespace.latestRelease) {
410:                         ReleaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(scope.appId,
411:                             scope.env,
412:                             namespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
413:                             namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
414:                             .then(function (result) {
415:                                 namespace.isLatestReleaseLoaded = true;
416:                                 if (!result) {
417:                                     namespace.latestReleaseInstances = {};
418:                                     namespace.latestReleaseInstances.total = 0;
419:                                     return;
420:                                 }
421:                                 namespace.latestRelease = result;
422:                                 InstanceService.findInstancesByRelease(scope.env,
423:                                     namespace.latestRelease.id,
424:                                     namespace.latestReleaseInstancesPage,
425:                                     size)
426:                                     .then(function (result) {
427:                                         namespace.latestReleaseInstances = result;
428:                                         namespace.latestReleaseInstancesPage++;
429:                                     })
430:                             });
431:                     } else {
432:                         InstanceService.findInstancesByRelease(scope.env,
433:                             namespace.latestRelease.id,
434:                             namespace.latestReleaseInstancesPage,
435:                             size)
436:                             .then(function (result) {
437:                                 if (result && result.content.length) {
438:                                     namespace.latestReleaseInstancesPage++;
439:                                     result.content.forEach(function (instance) {
440:                                         namespace.latestReleaseInstances.content.push(
441:                                             instance);
442:                                     })
443:                                 }
444:                             })
445:                     }
446:                 } else if (namespace_instance_view_type.NOT_LATEST_RELEASE == type) {
447:                     if (!namespace.latestRelease) {
448:                         return;
449:                     }
450:                     InstanceService.findByReleasesNotIn(scope.appId,
451:                         scope.env,
452:                         scope.cluster,
453:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
454:                         namespace.latestRelease.id)
455:                         .then(function (result) {
456:                             if (!result || result.length == 0) {
457:                                 return
458:                             }
459:                             var groupedInstances = {},
460:                                 notLatestReleases = [];
461:                             result.forEach(function (instance) {
462:                                 var configs = instance.configs;
463:                                 if (configs && configs.length > 0) {
464:                                     configs.forEach(function (instanceConfig) {
465:                                         var release = instanceConfig.release;
466:                                         //filter dirty data
467:                                         if (!release) {
468:                                             return;
469:                                         }
470:                                         if (!groupedInstances[release.id]) {
471:                                             groupedInstances[release.id] = [];
472:                                             notLatestReleases.push(release);
473:                                         }
474:                                         groupedInstances[release.id].push(instance);
475:                                     })
476:                                 }
477:                             });
478:                             namespace.notLatestReleases = notLatestReleases;
479:                             namespace.notLatestReleaseInstances = groupedInstances;
480:                         })
481:                 } else {
482:                     InstanceService.findInstancesByNamespace(scope.appId,
483:                         scope.env,
484:                         scope.cluster,
485:                         namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
486:                         '',
487:                         namespace.allInstancesPage)
488:                         .then(function (result) {
489:                             if (result && result.content.length) {
490:                                 namespace.allInstancesPage++;
491:                                 result.content.forEach(function (instance) {
492:                                     namespace.allInstances.push(instance);
493:                                 })
494:                             }
495:                         });
496:                 }
497:             }
498:             function refreshInstancesInfo(namespace) {
499:                 namespace.instanceViewType = namespace_instance_view_type.LATEST_RELEASE;
500:                 namespace.latestReleaseInstancesPage = 0;
501:                 namespace.latestReleaseInstances = [];
502:                 namespace.latestRelease = undefined;
503:                 if (!namespace.isBranch) {
504:                     namespace.notLatestReleaseNames = [];
505:                     namespace.notLatestReleaseInstances = {};
506:                     namespace.allInstancesPage = 0;
507:                     namespace.allInstances = [];
508:                 }
509:                 initNamespaceInstancesCount(namespace);
510:                 loadInstanceInfo(namespace);
511:             }

575:             }

662:             function parseModel2Text(namespace) {
663:                 if (namespace.items.length == 0) {
664:                     namespace.itemCnt = 0;
665:                     return "";
666:                 }
667:                 //文件模式
668:                 if (!namespace.isPropertiesFormat) {
669:                     return parseNotPropertiesText(namespace);
670:                 } else {
671:                     return parsePropertiesText(namespace);
672:                 }
673:             }
674:             function parseNotPropertiesText(namespace) {
675:                 var text = namespace.items[0].item.value;
676:                 var lineNum = text.split("\n").length;
677:                 namespace.itemCnt = lineNum;
678:                 return text;
679:             }
680:             function parsePropertiesText(namespace) {
681:                 var result = "";
682:                 var itemCnt = 0;
683:                 namespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
684:                     //deleted key
685:                     if (!item.item.dataChangeLastModifiedBy) {
686:                         return;
687:                     }
688:                     if (item.item.key) {
689:                         //use string \n to display as new line
690:                         var itemValue = item.item.value.replace(/\n/g, "\\n");
691:                         result +=
692:                             item.item.key + " = " + itemValue + "\n";
693:                     } else {
694:                         result += item.item.comment + "\n";
695:                     }
696:                     itemCnt++;
697:                 });
698:                 namespace.itemCnt = itemCnt;
699:                 return result;
700:             }
701:             function toggleItemSearchInput(namespace) {
702:                 namespace.displayControl.showSearchInput = !namespace.displayControl.showSearchInput;
703:             }
704:             function searchItems(namespace) {
705:                 var searchKey = namespace.searchKey.toLowerCase();
706:                 var items = [];
707:                 namespace.items.forEach(function (item) {
708:                     var key = item.item.key;
709:                     if (key && key.toLowerCase().indexOf(searchKey) >= 0) {
710:                         items.push(item);
711:                     }
712:                 });
713:                 namespace.viewItems = items;
714:             }
715:             function publish(namespace) {
716:                 if (!namespace.hasReleasePermission) {
717:                     AppUtil.showModal('#releaseNoPermissionDialog');
718:                     return;
719:                 } else if (namespace.lockOwner && scope.user == namespace.lockOwner) {
720:                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.PUBLISH_DENY, {
721:                         namespace: namespace,
722:                         mergeAndPublish: false
723:                     });
724:                     return;
725:                 }
726:                 if (namespace.isBranch) {
727:                     namespace.mergeAndPublish = false;
728:                 }
729:                 EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.PUBLISH_NAMESPACE,
730:                     {
731:                         namespace: namespace
732:                     });
733:             }
734:             function mergeAndPublish(branch) {
735:                 var parentNamespace = branch.parentNamespace;
736:                 if (!parentNamespace.hasReleasePermission) {
737:                     AppUtil.showModal('#releaseNoPermissionDialog');
738:                 } else if (parentNamespace.itemModifiedCnt > 0) {
739:                     AppUtil.showModal('#mergeAndReleaseDenyDialog');
740:                 } else if (branch.lockOwner && scope.user == branch.lockOwner) {
741:                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.PUBLISH_DENY, {
742:                         namespace: branch,
743:                         mergeAndPublish: true
744:                     });
745:                 } else {
746:                     EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.MERGE_AND_PUBLISH_NAMESPACE, { branch: branch });
747:                 }
748:             }
749:             function rollback(namespace) {
750:                 EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.PRE_ROLLBACK_NAMESPACE, { namespace: namespace });
751:             }
752:             function deleteNamespace(namespace) {
753:                 EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.PRE_DELETE_NAMESPACE, { namespace: namespace });
754:             }
755:             scope.aceConfig = {
756:                 $blockScrolling: Infinity,
757:                 showPrintMargin: false,
758:                 theme: 'eclipse',
759:                 mode: scope.namespace.format === 'yml' ? 'yaml' : (scope.namespace.format === 'txt' ? undefined : scope.namespace.format),
760:                 onLoad: function (_editor) {
761:                     _editor.$blockScrolling = Infinity;

  1: directive_module.directive('releasemodal', releaseModalDirective);
  2: function releaseModalDirective($translate, toastr, AppUtil, EventManager, ReleaseService, NamespaceBranchService) {
  3:     return {
  4:         restrict: 'E',
  5:         templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/release-modal.html',
  6:         transclude: true,
  7:         replace: true,
  8:         scope: {
  9:             appId: '=',
 10:             env: '=',
 11:             cluster: '='
 12:         },
 13:         link: function (scope) {
 14:             scope.switchReleaseChangeViewType = switchReleaseChangeViewType;
 15:             scope.release = release;
 16:             scope.releaseBtnDisabled = false;
 17:             scope.releaseChangeViewType = 'change';
 18:             scope.releaseComment = '';
 19:             scope.isEmergencyPublish = false;
 20:             EventManager.subscribe(EventManager.EventType.PUBLISH_NAMESPACE,
 21:                 function (context) {
 22:                     var namespace = context.namespace;
 23:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace = context.namespace;
 24:                     scope.isEmergencyPublish = !!context.isEmergencyPublish;
 25:                     var date = new Date().Format("yyyyMMddhhmmss");
 26:                     if (namespace.mergeAndPublish) {
 27:                         namespace.releaseTitle = date + "-gray-release-merge-to-master";
 28:                     } else if (namespace.isBranch) {
 29:                         namespace.releaseTitle = date + "-gray";
 30:                     } else {
 31:                         namespace.releaseTitle = date + "-release";
 32:                     }
 33:                     AppUtil.showModal('#releaseModal');
 34:                 });
 35:             function release() {
 36:                 if (scope.toReleaseNamespace.mergeAndPublish) {
 37:                     mergeAndPublish();
 38:                 } else if (scope.toReleaseNamespace.isBranch) {
 39:                     grayPublish();
 40:                 } else {
 41:                     publish();
 42:                 }
 43:             }
 44:             function publish() {
 45:                 scope.releaseBtnDisabled = true;
 46:                 ReleaseService.publish(scope.appId, scope.env,
 47:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
 48:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 49:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.releaseTitle,
 50:                     scope.releaseComment,
 51:                     scope.isEmergencyPublish).then(
 52:                         function (result) {
 53:                             AppUtil.hideModal('#releaseModal');
 54:                             toastr.success($translate.instant('ReleaseModal.Published'));
 55:                             scope.releaseBtnDisabled = false;
 56:                             EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
 57:                                 {
 58:                                     namespace: scope.toReleaseNamespace
 59:                                 })
 60:                         }, function (result) {
 61:                             scope.releaseBtnDisabled = false;
 62:                             toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ReleaseModal.PublishFailed'));
 63:                         }
 64:                     );
 65:             }
 66:             function grayPublish() {
 67:                 scope.releaseBtnDisabled = true;
 68:                 ReleaseService.grayPublish(scope.appId, scope.env,
 69:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.parentNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
 70:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 71:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
 72:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.releaseTitle,
 73:                     scope.releaseComment,
 74:                     scope.isEmergencyPublish).then(
 75:                         function (result) {
 76:                             AppUtil.hideModal('#releaseModal');
 77:                             toastr.success($translate.instant('ReleaseModal.GrayscalePublished'));
 78:                             scope.releaseBtnDisabled = false;
 79:                             scope.toReleaseNamespace.branchItems.forEach(function (item, index) {
 80:                                 if (item.isDeleted) {
 81:                                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.branchItems.splice(index, 1);
 82:                                 } else {
 83:                                     item.isModified = false;
 84:                                 }
 85:                             });
 86:                             scope.toReleaseNamespace.itemModifiedCnt = 0;
 87:                             scope.toReleaseNamespace.lockOwner = undefined;
 88:                             if (!scope.toReleaseNamespace.rules
 89:                                 || !scope.toReleaseNamespace.rules.ruleItems
 90:                                 || !scope.toReleaseNamespace.rules.ruleItems.length) {
 91:                                 scope.toReleaseNamespace.viewType = 'rule';
 92:                                 AppUtil.showModal('#grayReleaseWithoutRulesTips');
 93:                             }
 94:                         }, function (result) {
 95:                             scope.releaseBtnDisabled = false;
 96:                             toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ReleaseModal.GrayscalePublishFailed'));
 97:                         });
 98:             }
 99:             function mergeAndPublish() {
100:                 NamespaceBranchService.mergeAndReleaseBranch(scope.appId,
101:                     scope.env,
102:                     scope.cluster,
103:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
104:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
105:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.releaseTitle,
106:                     scope.releaseComment,
107:                     scope.isEmergencyPublish,
108:                     scope.toReleaseNamespace.mergeAfterDeleteBranch)
109:                     .then(function (result) {
110:                         toastr.success($translate.instant('ReleaseModal.AllPublished'));
111:                         EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
112:                             {
113:                                 namespace: scope.toReleaseNamespace
114:                             })
115:                     }, function (result) {
116:                         toastr.error(AppUtil.errorMsg(result), $translate.instant('ReleaseModal.AllPublishFailed'));
117:                     });
118:                 AppUtil.hideModal('#releaseModal');
119:             }
120:             function switchReleaseChangeViewType(type) {
121:                 scope.releaseChangeViewType = type;
122:             }
123:         }
124:     }
125: }

  1: directive_module.directive('rollbackmodal', rollbackModalDirective);
  2: function rollbackModalDirective($translate, AppUtil, EventManager, ReleaseService, toastr) {
  3:     return {
  4:         restrict: 'E',
  5:         templateUrl: AppUtil.prefixPath() + '/views/component/rollback-modal.html',
  6:         transclude: true,
  7:         replace: true,
  8:         scope: {
  9:             appId: '=',
 10:             env: '=',
 11:             cluster: '='
 12:         },
 13:         link: function (scope) {
 14:             scope.isRollbackTo = false;
 15:             scope.showRollbackAlertDialog = showRollbackAlertDialog;
 16:             EventManager.subscribe(EventManager.EventType.PRE_ROLLBACK_NAMESPACE,
 17:                 function (context) {
 18:                     if (context.toReleaseId) {
 19:                         preRollbackTo(context.namespace, context.toReleaseId);
 20:                     } else {
 21:                         preRollback(context.namespace);
 22:                     }
 23:                 });
 24:             EventManager.subscribe(EventManager.EventType.ROLLBACK_NAMESPACE,
 25:                 function (context) {
 26:                     if (context.toReleaseId) {
 27:                         rollbackTo(context.toReleaseId);
 28:                     } else {
 29:                         rollback();
 30:                     }
 31:                 });
 32:             function preRollback(namespace) {
 33:                 scope.toRollbackNamespace = namespace;
 34:                 ReleaseService.findActiveReleases(scope.appId,
 35:                     scope.env,
 36:                     scope.cluster,
 37:                     scope.toRollbackNamespace.baseInfo.namespaceName,
 38:                     0, 2)
 39:                     .then(function (result) {
 40:                         if (result.length <= 1) {
 41:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('Rollback.NoRollbackList'));
 42:                             return;
 43:                         }
 44:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease = result[0];
 45:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.secondRelease = result[1];
 46:                         ReleaseService.compare(scope.env,
 47:                             scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease.id,
 48:                             scope.toRollbackNamespace.secondRelease.id)
 49:                             .then(function (result) {
 50:                                 scope.toRollbackNamespace.releaseCompareResult = result.changes;
 51:                                 AppUtil.showModal('#rollbackModal');
 52:                             })
 53:                     });
 54:             }
 55:             function preRollbackTo(namespace, toReleaseId) {
 56:                 scope.isRollbackTo = true;
 57:                 scope.toRollbackNamespace = namespace;
 58:                 scope.toRollbackNamespace.isPropertiesFormat = namespace.format == 'properties';
 59:                 ReleaseService.findLatestActiveRelease(scope.appId,
 60:                     scope.env,
 61:                     namespace.baseInfo.clusterName,
 62:                     namespace.baseInfo.namespaceName)
 63:                     .then(function (result) {
 64:                         if (!result) {
 65:                             toastr.error($translate.instant('Rollback.NoRollbackList'));
 66:                             return;
 67:                         }
 68:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease = result;
 69:                         ReleaseService.get(scope.env,
 70:                             toReleaseId)
 71:                             .then(function (result) {
 72:                                 scope.toRollbackNamespace.secondRelease = result;
 73:                                 if (scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease.id == scope.toRollbackNamespace.secondRelease.id) {
 74:                                     toastr.error($translate.instant('Rollback.SameAsCurrentRelease'));
 75:                                     return;
 76:                                 }
 77:                                 ReleaseService.compare(scope.env,
 78:                                     scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease.id,
 79:                                     scope.toRollbackNamespace.secondRelease.id)
 80:                                     .then(function (result) {
 81:                                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.releaseCompareResult = result.changes;
 82:                                         AppUtil.showModal('#rollbackModal');
 83:                                     })
 84:                             })
 85:                     })
 86:             }
 87:             function rollback() {
 88:                 scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = true;
 89:                 ReleaseService.rollback(scope.env,
 90:                     scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease.id)
 91:                     .then(function (result) {
 92:                         toastr.success($translate.instant('Rollback.RollbackSuccessfully'));
 93:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = false;
 94:                         AppUtil.hideModal('#rollbackModal');
 95:                         EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_NAMESPACE,
 96:                             {
 97:                                 namespace: scope.toRollbackNamespace
 98:                             });
 99:                     }, function (result) {
100:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = false;
101:                         AppUtil.showErrorMsg(result, $translate.instant('Rollback.RollbackFailed'));
102:                     })
103:             }
104:             function rollbackTo(toReleaseId) {
105:                 scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = true;
106:                 ReleaseService.rollbackTo(scope.env,
107:                     scope.toRollbackNamespace.firstRelease.id,
108:                     toReleaseId
109:                     )
110:                     .then(function (result) {
111:                         toastr.success($translate.instant('Rollback.RollbackSuccessfully'));
112:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = false;
113:                         AppUtil.hideModal('#rollbackModal');
114:                         EventManager.emit(EventManager.EventType.REFRESH_RELEASE_HISTORY, {releaseId: toReleaseId});
115:                     }, function (result) {
116:                         scope.toRollbackNamespace.rollbackBtnDisabled = false;
117:                         AppUtil.showErrorMsg(result, $translate.instant('Rollback.RollbackFailed'));
118:                     })
119:             }
120:             function showRollbackAlertDialog() {
121:                 AppUtil.hideModal("#rollbackModal");
122:                 AppUtil.showModal("#rollbackAlertDialog");
123:             }
124:         }
125:     }
126: }

 1: $(document).ready(function () {
 2:     setInterval(function () {
 3:         $('[data-tooltip="tooltip"]').tooltip({
 4:                                                   trigger : 'hover'
 5:                                               });
 6:     }, 1000);
 7: });
 8: Date.prototype.Format = function (fmt) {
 9:     var o = {
10:         "M+": this.getMonth() + 1,
11:         "d+": this.getDate(),
12:         "h+": this.getHours(),
13:         "m+": this.getMinutes(),
14:         "s+": this.getSeconds(),
15:         "q+": Math.floor((this.getMonth() + 3) / 3),
16:         "S": this.getMilliseconds()
17:     };
18:     if (/(y+)/.test(fmt)) {
19:         fmt = fmt.replace(RegExp.$1, (this.getFullYear() + "").substr(4 - RegExp.$1.length));
20:     }
21:     for (var k in o) {
22:         if (new RegExp("(" + k + ")").test(fmt)) {
23:             fmt =
24:                 fmt.replace(RegExp.$1,
25:                             (RegExp.$1.length == 1) ? (o[k]) : (("00" + o[k]).substr(("" + o[k]).length)));
26:         }
27:     }
28:     return fmt;
29: };

File: apollo-portal/src/main/resources/static/scripts/services/EventManager.js
================
 1: appService.service('EventManager', [function () {
 2:     var ALL_OBJECT = '*';
 3:     var eventRegistry = {};
 4:     function emit(eventType, context, objectId) {
 5:         if (!eventType) {
 6:             return;
 7:         }
 8:         if (!eventRegistry[eventType]) {
 9:             return;
10:         }
11:         context = context || {};
12:         if (objectId != null && objectId != ALL_OBJECT) {
13:             emitEventToSubscribers(eventRegistry[eventType][objectId], context);
14:             emitEventToSubscribers(eventRegistry[eventType][ALL_OBJECT]);
15:         } else {
16:             emitEventToSubscribers(eventRegistry[eventType][ALL_OBJECT], context);
17:         }
18:     }
19:     function emitEventToSubscribers(subscribers, context) {
20:         if (subscribers) {
21:             subscribers.forEach(function (subscriber) {
22:                 subscriber.callback(context);
23:             })
24:         }
25:     }
26:     function subscribe(eventType, callback, objectId) {
27:         if (!eventType || !callback) {
28:             return;
29:         }
30:         objectId = objectId || ALL_OBJECT;
31:         eventRegistry[eventType] = eventRegistry[eventType] || {};
32:         eventRegistry[eventType][objectId] = eventRegistry[eventType][objectId] || [];
33:         var subscriber = {
34:             id: Math.random() * Math.random(),
35:             callback: callback
36:         };
37:         eventRegistry[eventType][objectId].push(subscriber);
38:         return subscriber.id;
39:     }
40:     function unsubscribe(eventType, subscriberId, objectId) {
41:         if (!eventType || !subscriberId) {
42:             return;
43:         }
44:             objectId = objectId || ALL_OBJECT;
45:         if (eventRegistry[eventType] && eventRegistry[eventType][objectId]) {
46:             var subscribers = eventRegistry[eventType][objectId];
47:             subscribers.forEach(function (subscriber, index) {
48:                 if (subscriber.id == subscriberId) {
49:                     subscribers.splice(index, 1);
50:                 }
51:             })
52:         }
53:     }
54:     return {
55:         ALL_OBJECT: ALL_OBJECT,
56:         emit: emit,
57:         subscribe: subscribe,
58:         unsubscribe: unsubscribe,
59:         EventType: {
60:             REFRESH_NAMESPACE: 'refresh_namespace',
61:             REFRESH_RELEASE_HISTORY: 'refresh_release_history',
62:             PUBLISH_NAMESPACE: 'pre_public_namespace',
63:             MERGE_AND_PUBLISH_NAMESPACE: 'merge_and_publish_namespace',
64:             PRE_ROLLBACK_NAMESPACE: 'pre_rollback_namespace',
65:             ROLLBACK_NAMESPACE: 'rollback_namespace',
66:             EDIT_GRAY_RELEASE_RULES: 'edit_gray_release_rules',
67:             UPDATE_GRAY_RELEASE_RULES: 'update_gray_release_rules',
68:             PUBLISH_DENY: 'publish_deny',
69:             EMERGENCY_PUBLISH: 'emergency_publish',
70:             PRE_DELETE_NAMESPACE: 'pre_delete_namespace',
71:             DELETE_NAMESPACE: 'delete_namespace',
72:             DELETE_NAMESPACE_FAILED: 'delete_namespace_failed',
73:             CHANGE_ENV_CLUSTER: "change_env_cluster",
74:             SYNTAX_CHECK_TEXT_FAILED: "syntax_check_text_failed"
75:         }
76:     }
77: }]);

File: mvnw

  1: #!/bin/sh
  2: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3: # Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
  4: # or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
  5: # distributed with this work for additional information
  6: # regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
  7: # to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
  8: # "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
  9: # with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
 10: #
 11: #    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
 12: #
 13: # Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 14: # software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 15: # "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 16: # KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 17: # specific language governing permissions and limitations
 18: # under the License.
 19: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20: 
 21: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22: # Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 23: #
 24: # Required ENV vars:
 25: # ------------------
 26: #   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 27: #
 28: # Optional ENV vars
 29: # -----------------
 30: #   M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 31: #   MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 32: #     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 33: #       set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 34: #   MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 35: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36: 
 37: if [ -z "$MAVEN_SKIP_RC" ] ; then
 38: 
 39:   if [ -f /etc/mavenrc ] ; then
 40:     . /etc/mavenrc
 41:   fi
 42: 
 43:   if [ -f "$HOME/.mavenrc" ] ; then
 44:     . "$HOME/.mavenrc"
 45:   fi
 46: 
 47: fi
 48: 
 49: # OS specific support.  $var _must_ be set to either true or false.
 50: cygwin=false;
 51: darwin=false;
 52: mingw=false
 53: case "`uname`" in
 54:   CYGWIN*) cygwin=true ;;
 55:   MINGW*) mingw=true;;
 56:   Darwin*) darwin=true
 57:     # Use /usr/libexec/java_home if available, otherwise fall back to /Library/Java/Home
 58:     # See https://developer.apple.com/library/mac/qa/qa1170/_index.html
 59:     if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
 60:       if [ -x "/usr/libexec/java_home" ]; then
 61:         export JAVA_HOME="`/usr/libexec/java_home`"
 62:       else
 63:         export JAVA_HOME="/Library/Java/Home"
 64:       fi
 65:     fi
 66:     ;;
 67: esac
 68: 
 69: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
 70:   if [ -r /etc/gentoo-release ] ; then
 71:     JAVA_HOME=`java-config --jre-home`
 72:   fi
 73: fi
 74: 
 75: if [ -z "$M2_HOME" ] ; then
 76:   ## resolve links - $0 may be a link to maven's home
 77:   PRG="$0"
 78: 
 79:   # need this for relative symlinks
 80:   while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
 81:     ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
 82:     link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
 83:     if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
 84:       PRG="$link"
 85:     else
 86:       PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
 87:     fi
 88:   done
 89: 
 90:   saveddir=`pwd`
 91: 
 92:   M2_HOME=`dirname "$PRG"`/..
 93: 
 94:   # make it fully qualified
 95:   M2_HOME=`cd "$M2_HOME" && pwd`
 96: 
 97:   cd "$saveddir"
 98:   # echo Using m2 at $M2_HOME
 99: fi
100: 
101: # For Cygwin, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
102: if $cygwin ; then
103:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
104:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$M2_HOME"`
105:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
106:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME"`
107:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
108:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --unix "$CLASSPATH"`
109: fi
110: 
111: # For Mingw, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
112: if $mingw ; then
113:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
114:     M2_HOME="`(cd "$M2_HOME"; pwd)`"
115:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
116:     JAVA_HOME="`(cd "$JAVA_HOME"; pwd)`"
117:   # TODO classpath?
118: fi
119: 
120: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
121:   javaExecutable="`which javac`"
122:   if [ -n "$javaExecutable" ] && ! [ "`expr \"$javaExecutable\" : '\([^ ]*\)'`" = "no" ]; then
123:     # readlink(1) is not available as standard on Solaris 10.
124:     readLink=`which readlink`
125:     if [ ! `expr "$readLink" : '\([^ ]*\)'` = "no" ]; then
126:       if $darwin ; then
127:         javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
128:         javaExecutable="`cd \"$javaHome\" && pwd -P`/javac"
129:       else
130:         javaExecutable="`readlink -f \"$javaExecutable\"`"
131:       fi
132:       javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
133:       javaHome=`expr "$javaHome" : '\(.*\)/bin'`
134:       JAVA_HOME="$javaHome"
135:       export JAVA_HOME
136:     fi
137:   fi
138: fi
139: 
140: if [ -z "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
141:   if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME"  ] ; then
142:     if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
143:       # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
144:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
145:     else
146:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
147:     fi
148:   else
149:     JAVACMD="`which java`"
150:   fi
151: fi
152: 
153: if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
154:   echo "Error: JAVA_HOME is not defined correctly." >&2
155:   echo "  We cannot execute $JAVACMD" >&2
156:   exit 1
157: fi
158: 
159: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
160:   echo "Warning: JAVA_HOME environment variable is not set."
161: fi
162: 
163: CLASSWORLDS_LAUNCHER=org.codehaus.plexus.classworlds.launcher.Launcher
164: 
165: # traverses directory structure from process work directory to filesystem root
166: # first directory with .mvn subdirectory is considered project base directory
167: find_maven_basedir() {
168: 
169:   if [ -z "$1" ]
170:   then
171:     echo "Path not specified to find_maven_basedir"
172:     return 1
173:   fi
174: 
175:   basedir="$1"
176:   wdir="$1"
177:   while [ "$wdir" != '/' ] ; do
178:     if [ -d "$wdir"/.mvn ] ; then
179:       basedir=$wdir
180:       break
181:     fi
182:     # workaround for JBEAP-8937 (on Solaris 10/Sparc)
183:     if [ -d "${wdir}" ]; then
184:       wdir=`cd "$wdir/.."; pwd`
185:     fi
186:     # end of workaround
187:   done
188:   echo "${basedir}"
189: }
190: 
191: # concatenates all lines of a file
192: concat_lines() {
193:   if [ -f "$1" ]; then
194:     echo "$(tr -s '\n' ' ' < "$1")"
195:   fi
196: }
197: 
198: BASE_DIR=`find_maven_basedir "$(pwd)"`
199: if [ -z "$BASE_DIR" ]; then
200:   exit 1;
201: fi
202: 
203: ##########################################################################################
204: # Extension to allow automatically downloading the maven-wrapper.jar from Maven-central
205: # This allows using the maven wrapper in projects that prohibit checking in binary data.
206: ##########################################################################################
207: if [ -r "$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar" ]; then
208:     if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
209:       echo "Found .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar"
210:     fi
211: else
212:     if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
213:       echo "Couldn't find .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar, downloading it ..."
214:     fi
215:     jarUrl="https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/takari/maven-wrapper/0.4.2/maven-wrapper-0.4.2.jar"
216:     while IFS="=" read key value; do
217:       case "$key" in (wrapperUrl) jarUrl="$value"; break ;;
218:       esac
219:     done < "$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"
220:     if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
221:       echo "Downloading from: $jarUrl"
222:     fi
223:     wrapperJarPath="$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar"
224: 
225:     if command -v wget > /dev/null; then
226:         if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
227:           echo "Found wget ... using wget"
228:         fi
229:         wget "$jarUrl" -O "$wrapperJarPath"
230:     elif command -v curl > /dev/null; then
231:         if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
232:           echo "Found curl ... using curl"
233:         fi
234:         curl -o "$wrapperJarPath" "$jarUrl"
235:     else
236:         if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
237:           echo "Falling back to using Java to download"
238:         fi
239:         javaClass="$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.java"
240:         if [ -e "$javaClass" ]; then
241:             if [ ! -e "$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.class" ]; then
242:                 if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
243:                   echo " - Compiling MavenWrapperDownloader.java ..."
244:                 fi
245:                 # Compiling the Java class
246:                 ("$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac" "$javaClass")
247:             fi
248:             if [ -e "$BASE_DIR/.mvn/wrapper/MavenWrapperDownloader.class" ]; then
249:                 # Running the downloader
250:                 if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
251:                   echo " - Running MavenWrapperDownloader.java ..."
252:                 fi
253:                 ("$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" -cp .mvn/wrapper MavenWrapperDownloader "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR")
254:             fi
255:         fi
256:     fi
257: fi
258: ##########################################################################################
259: # End of extension
260: ##########################################################################################
261: 
262: export MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=${MAVEN_BASEDIR:-"$BASE_DIR"}
263: if [ "$MVNW_VERBOSE" = true ]; then
264:   echo $MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR
265: fi
266: MAVEN_OPTS="$(concat_lines "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/jvm.config") $MAVEN_OPTS"
267: 
268: # For Cygwin, switch paths to Windows format before running java
269: if $cygwin; then
270:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
271:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$M2_HOME"`
272:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
273:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$JAVA_HOME"`
274:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
275:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --windows "$CLASSPATH"`
276:   [ -n "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR" ] &&
277:     MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=`cygpath --path --windows "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR"`
278: fi
279: 
280: WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
281: 
282: exec "$JAVACMD" \
283:   $MAVEN_OPTS \
284:   -classpath "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar" \
285:   "-Dmaven.home=${M2_HOME}" "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=${MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR}" \
286:   ${WRAPPER_LAUNCHER} $MAVEN_CONFIG "$@"

================
File: mvnw.cmd
================
  1: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2: @REM Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
  3: @REM or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
  4: @REM distributed with this work for additional information
  5: @REM regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
  6: @REM to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
  7: @REM "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
  8: @REM with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
  9: @REM
 10: @REM    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
 11: @REM
 12: @REM Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 13: @REM software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 14: @REM "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 15: @REM KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 16: @REM specific language governing permissions and limitations
 17: @REM under the License.
 18: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19: 
 20: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21: @REM Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 22: @REM
 23: @REM Required ENV vars:
 24: @REM JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 25: @REM
 26: @REM Optional ENV vars
 27: @REM M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 28: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO - set to 'on' to enable the echoing of the batch commands
 29: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE - set to 'on' to wait for a key stroke before ending
 30: @REM MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 31: @REM     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 32: @REM set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 33: @REM MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 34: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35: 
 36: @REM Begin all REM lines with '@' in case MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO is 'on'
 37: @echo off
 38: @REM set title of command window
 39: title %0
 40: @REM enable echoing my setting MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO to 'on'
 41: @if "%MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%" == "on"  echo %MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%
 42: 
 43: @REM set %HOME% to equivalent of $HOME
 44: if "%HOME%" == "" (set "HOME=%HOMEDRIVE%%HOMEPATH%")
 45: 
 46: @REM Execute a user defined script before this one
 47: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPre
 48: @REM check for pre script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
 49: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat"
 50: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd"
 51: :skipRcPre
 52: 
 53: @setlocal
 54: 
 55: set ERROR_CODE=0
 56: 
 57: @REM To isolate internal variables from possible post scripts, we use another setlocal
 58: @setlocal
 59: 
 60: @REM ==== START VALIDATION ====
 61: if not "%JAVA_HOME%" == "" goto OkJHome
 62: 
 63: echo.
 64: echo Error: JAVA_HOME not found in your environment. >&2
 65: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 66: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 67: echo.
 68: goto error
 69: 
 70: :OkJHome
 71: if exist "%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" goto init
 72: 
 73: echo.
 74: echo Error: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory. >&2
 75: echo JAVA_HOME = "%JAVA_HOME%" >&2
 76: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 77: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 78: echo.
 79: goto error
 80: 
 81: @REM ==== END VALIDATION ====
 82: 
 83: :init
 84: 
 85: @REM Find the project base dir, i.e. the directory that contains the folder ".mvn".
 86: @REM Fallback to current working directory if not found.
 87: 
 88: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%MAVEN_BASEDIR%
 89: IF NOT "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%"=="" goto endDetectBaseDir
 90: 
 91: set EXEC_DIR=%CD%
 92: set WDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
 93: :findBaseDir
 94: IF EXIST "%WDIR%"\.mvn goto baseDirFound
 95: cd ..
 96: IF "%WDIR%"=="%CD%" goto baseDirNotFound
 97: set WDIR=%CD%
 98: goto findBaseDir
 99: 
100: :baseDirFound
101: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%WDIR%
102: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
103: goto endDetectBaseDir
104: 
105: :baseDirNotFound
106: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
107: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
108: 
109: :endDetectBaseDir
110: 
111: IF NOT EXIST "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config" goto endReadAdditionalConfig
112: 
113: @setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
114: for /F "usebackq delims=" %%a in ("%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config") do set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=!JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS! %%a
115: @endlocal & set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=%JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS%
116: 
117: :endReadAdditionalConfig
118: 
119: SET MAVEN_JAVA_EXE="%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
120: set WRAPPER_JAR="%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar"
121: set WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
122: 
123: set DOWNLOAD_URL="https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/takari/maven-wrapper/0.4.2/maven-wrapper-0.4.2.jar"
124: FOR /F "tokens=1,2 delims==" %%A IN (%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.properties) DO (
125: 	IF "%%A"=="wrapperUrl" SET DOWNLOAD_URL=%%B 
126: )
127: 
128: @REM Extension to allow automatically downloading the maven-wrapper.jar from Maven-central
129: @REM This allows using the maven wrapper in projects that prohibit checking in binary data.
130: if exist %WRAPPER_JAR% (
131:     echo Found %WRAPPER_JAR%
132: ) else (
133:     echo Couldn't find %WRAPPER_JAR%, downloading it ...
134: 	echo Downloading from: %DOWNLOAD_URL%
135:     powershell -Command "(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadFile('%DOWNLOAD_URL%', '%WRAPPER_JAR%')"
136:     echo Finished downloading %WRAPPER_JAR%
137: )
138: @REM End of extension
139: 
140: %MAVEN_JAVA_EXE% %JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS% %MAVEN_OPTS% %MAVEN_DEBUG_OPTS% -classpath %WRAPPER_JAR% "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%" %WRAPPER_LAUNCHER% %MAVEN_CONFIG% %*
141: if ERRORLEVEL 1 goto error
142: goto end
143: 
144: :error
145: set ERROR_CODE=1
146: 
147: :end
148: @endlocal & set ERROR_CODE=%ERROR_CODE%
149: 
150: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPost
151: @REM check for post script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
152: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat"
153: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd"
154: :skipRcPost
155: 
156: @REM pause the script if MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE is set to 'on'
157: if "%MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE%" == "on" pause
158: 
159: if "%MAVEN_TERMINATE_CMD%" == "on" exit %ERROR_CODE%
160: 
161: exit /B %ERROR_CODE%

   1: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
   2: <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
   3: 	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/maven-v4_0_0.xsd">
   4: 	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
   5: 	<groupId>com.ctrip.framework.apollo</groupId>
   6: 	<artifactId>apollo</artifactId>
   7: 	<version>${revision}</version>
   8: 	<name>Apollo</name>
   9: 	<packaging>pom</packaging>
  10: 	<description>Ctrip Configuration Center</description>
  11: 	<url>https://github.com/ctripcorp/apollo</url>
  12: 	<organization>
  13: 		<name>Ctrip, Inc.</name>
  14: 		<url>http://www.ctrip.com</url>
  15: 	</organization>
  16: 	<licenses>
  17: 		<license>
  18: 			<name>Apache License, Version 2.0</name>
  19: 			<url>http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0</url>
  20: 		</license>
  21: 	</licenses>
  22: 	<scm>

 5: 
 6: RUN \
 7:     echo "http://mirrors.aliyun.com/alpine/v3.8/main" > /etc/apk/repositories && \
 8:     echo "http://mirrors.aliyun.com/alpine/v3.8/community" >> /etc/apk/repositories  && \

10:     apk add --no-cache procps curl bash && \

12:     echo "Asia/Shanghai" > /etc/timezone
13: 
14: CMD ["bash"]

================
File: scripts/build.bat
================
 1: @echo off
 2: 
 3: rem apollo config db info
 4: set apollo_config_db_url="jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/ApolloConfigDB?characterEncoding=utf8"
 5: set apollo_config_db_username="root"
 6: set apollo_config_db_password=""
 7: 
 8: rem apollo portal db info
 9: set apollo_portal_db_url="jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/ApolloPortalDB?characterEncoding=utf8"
10: set apollo_portal_db_username="root"
11: set apollo_portal_db_password=""
12: 
13: rem meta server url, different environments should have different meta server addresses
14: set dev_meta="http://localhost:8080"
15: set fat_meta="http://someIp:8080"
16: set uat_meta="http://anotherIp:8080"
17: set pro_meta="http://yetAnotherIp:8080"
18: 
19: set META_SERVERS_OPTS=-Ddev_meta=%dev_meta% -Dfat_meta=%fat_meta% -Duat_meta=%uat_meta% -Dpro_meta=%pro_meta%
20: 
21: rem =============== Please do not modify the following content =============== 
22: rem go to script directory
23: cd "%~dp0"
24: 
25: cd ..
26: 
27: rem package config-service and admin-service
28: echo "==== starting to build config-service and admin-service ===="
29: 
30: call mvn clean package -DskipTests -pl apollo-configservice,apollo-adminservice -am -Dapollo_profile=github -Dspring_datasource_url=%apollo_config_db_url% -Dspring_datasource_username=%apollo_config_db_username% -Dspring_datasource_password=%apollo_config_db_password%
31: 
32: echo "==== building config-service and admin-service finished ===="
33: 
34: echo "==== starting to build portal ===="
35: 
36: call mvn clean package -DskipTests -pl apollo-portal -am -Dapollo_profile=github,auth -Dspring_datasource_url=%apollo_portal_db_url% -Dspring_datasource_username=%apollo_portal_db_username% -Dspring_datasource_password=%apollo_portal_db_password% %META_SERVERS_OPTS%
37: 
38: echo "==== building portal finished ===="
39: 
40: pause

================
File: scripts/docker-quick-start/sql/apolloconfigdb.sql
================
  1: /*!40101 SET @OLD_CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT=@@CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT */;
  2: /*!40101 SET @OLD_CHARACTER_SET_RESULTS=@@CHARACTER_SET_RESULTS */;
  3: /*!40101 SET @OLD_COLLATION_CONNECTION=@@COLLATION_CONNECTION */;
  4: /*!40101 SET NAMES utf8 */;
  5: /*!40014 SET @OLD_FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=@@FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS, FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0 */;
  6: /*!40101 SET @OLD_SQL_MODE=@@SQL_MODE, SQL_MODE='NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO' */;
  7: /*!40111 SET @OLD_SQL_NOTES=@@SQL_NOTES, SQL_NOTES=0 */;
  8: # Create Database
  9: #
 10: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ApolloConfigDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4;
 11: Use ApolloConfigDB;
 12: # Dump of table app
 13: #
 14: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `App`;
 15: CREATE TABLE `App` (
 16:   `Id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
 17:   `AppId` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'AppID',
 18:   `Name` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '应用名',
 19:   `OrgId` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '部门Id',
 20:   `OrgName` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '部门名字',
 21:   `OwnerName` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'ownerName',
 22:   `OwnerEmail` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'ownerEmail',
 23:   `IsDeleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '1: deleted, 0: normal',
 24:   `DataChange_CreatedBy` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '创建人邮箱前缀',
 25:   `DataChange_CreatedTime` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 26:   `DataChange_LastModifiedBy` varchar(64) DEFAULT '' COMMENT '最后修改人邮箱前缀',
 27:   `DataChange_LastTime` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '最后修改时间',
 28:   PRIMARY KEY (`Id`),
 29:   KEY `AppId` (`AppId`(191)),
 30:   KEY `DataChange_LastTime` (`DataChange_LastTime`),
 31:   KEY `IX_Name` (`Name`(191))

 1: {{- if .Values.ingress.enabled -}}

 5: apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
 6: {{- else -}}
 7: apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
 8: {{- end }}

11:   name: {{ $fullName }}

13:     {{- include "apollo.portal.labels" . | nindent 4 }}

17:   {{- end }}

19: {{- if .Values.ingress.tls }}
20:   tls:
21:   {{- range .Values.ingress.tls }}
22:     - hosts:
23:       {{- range .hosts }}
24:         - {{ . | quote }}
25:       {{- end }}
26:       secretName: {{ .secretName }}
27:   {{- end }}
28: {{- end }}
29:   rules:
30:   {{- range .Values.ingress.hosts }}
31:     - host: {{ .host | quote }}
32:       http:
33:         paths:
34:         {{- range .paths }}
35:           - path: {{ . }}
36:             backend:
37:               serviceName: {{ $fullName }}
38:               servicePort: {{ $svcPort }}
39:         {{- end }}
40:   {{- end }}
41: {{- end }}

File: scripts/helm/apollo-portal/templates/NOTES.txt
================
 1: Portal url for current release:
 2: {{- if contains "NodePort" .Values.service.type }}
 3:   export NODE_PORT=$(kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}" services {{ include "apollo.portal.fullName" . }})
 4:   export NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.items[0].status.addresses[0].address}")
 5:   echo http://$NODE_IP:$NODE_PORT
 6: {{- else if contains "LoadBalancer" .Values.service.type }}
 7:      NOTE: It may take a few minutes for the LoadBalancer IP to be available.
 8:            You can watch the status of by running 'kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} svc -w {{ include "apollo.portal.fullName" . }}'
 9:   export SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} {{ include "apollo.portal.serviceName" . }} --template "{{"{{ range (index .status.loadBalancer.ingress 0) }}{{.}}{{ end }}"}}")
10:   echo http://$SERVICE_IP:{{ .Values.service.port }}
11: {{- else if contains "ClusterIP" .Values.service.type }}
12:   export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -l "app={{ include "apollo.portal.fullName" . }}" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
13:   echo "Visit http://127.0.0.1:8070 to use your application"
14:   kubectl --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward $POD_NAME 8070:8070
15: {{- end }}
16: 
17: {{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
18: 
19: Ingress:
20: {{- range $host := .Values.ingress.hosts }}
21:   {{- range .paths }}
22:   http{{ if $.Values.ingress.tls }}s{{ end }}://{{ $host.host }}{{ . }}
23:   {{- end }}
24: {{- end }}
25: {{- end }}

File: scripts/helm/apollo-service/templates/NOTES.txt

 1: Meta service url for current release:
 2: {{- if contains "NodePort" .Values.configService.service.type }}
 3:   export NODE_PORT=$(kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}" services {{ include "apollo.configService.fullName" . }})
 4:   export NODE_IP=$(kubectl get nodes --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -o jsonpath="{.items[0].status.addresses[0].address}")
 5:   echo http://$NODE_IP:$NODE_PORT{{ .Values.configService.config.contextPath }}
 6: {{- else if contains "LoadBalancer" .Values.configService.service.type }}
 7:      NOTE: It may take a few minutes for the LoadBalancer IP to be available.
 8:            You can watch the status of by running 'kubectl get --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} svc -w {{ include "apollo.configService.fullName" . }}'
 9:   export SERVICE_IP=$(kubectl get svc --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} {{ include "apollo.configService.serviceName" . }} --template "{{"{{ range (index .status.loadBalancer.ingress 0) }}{{.}}{{ end }}"}}")
10:   echo http://$SERVICE_IP:{{ .Values.service.port }}{{ .Values.configService.config.contextPath }}
11: {{- else if contains "ClusterIP" .Values.configService.service.type }}
12:   echo {{ include "apollo.configService.serviceUrl" .}}
13: 
14: For local test use:
15:   export POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} -l "app={{ include "apollo.configService.fullName" . }}" -o jsonpath="{.items[0].metadata.name}")
16:   echo http://127.0.0.1:8080{{ .Values.configService.config.contextPath }}
17:   kubectl --namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward $POD_NAME 8080:8080
18: {{- end }}
19: 
20: {{- if .Values.configService.ingress.enabled }}
21: 
22: Ingress:
23: {{- range $host := .Values.configService.ingress.hosts }}
24:   {{- range .paths }}
25:   http{{ if $.Values.configService.ingress.tls }}s{{ end }}://{{ $host.host }}{{ . }}
26:   {{- end }}
27: {{- end }}
28: {{- end }}
29: 
30: Urls registered to meta service:
31: Config service: {{ include "apollo.configService.serviceUrl" .}}
32: Admin service: {{ include "apollo.adminService.serviceUrl" .}}

  1: /*!40101 SET @OLD_CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT=@@CHARACTER_SET_CLIENT */;
  2: /*!40101 SET @OLD_CHARACTER_SET_RESULTS=@@CHARACTER_SET_RESULTS */;
  3: /*!40101 SET @OLD_COLLATION_CONNECTION=@@COLLATION_CONNECTION */;
  4: /*!40101 SET NAMES utf8 */;
  5: /*!40014 SET @OLD_FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=@@FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS, FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0 */;
  6: /*!40101 SET @OLD_SQL_MODE=@@SQL_MODE, SQL_MODE='NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO' */;
  7: /*!40111 SET @OLD_SQL_NOTES=@@SQL_NOTES, SQL_NOTES=0 */;
  8: # Create Database
  9: #
 10: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS ApolloConfigDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET = utf8mb4;
 11: Use ApolloConfigDB;
 12: # Dump of table app
 13: #
 14: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `App`;
 15: CREATE TABLE `App` (
 16:   `Id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
 17:   `AppId` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'AppID',
 18:   `Name` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '应用名',
 19:   `OrgId` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '部门Id',
 20:   `OrgName` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '部门名字',
 21:   `OwnerName` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'ownerName',
 22:   `OwnerEmail` varchar(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT 'ownerEmail',
 23:   `IsDeleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '1: deleted, 0: normal',
 24:   `DataChange_CreatedBy` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '创建人邮箱前缀',
 25:   `DataChange_CreatedTime` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 26:   `DataChange_LastModifiedBy` varchar(64) DEFAULT '' COMMENT '最后修改人邮箱前缀',
 27:   `DataChange_LastTime` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '最后修改时间',
 28:   PRIMARY KEY (`Id`),
 29:   KEY `AppId` (`AppId`(191)),
 30:   KEY `DataChange_LastTime` (`DataChange_LastTime`),
 31:   KEY `IX_Name` (`Name`(191))
 32: ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='应用表';
 33: # Dump of table appnamespace
 34: # ------------------------------------------------------------
 35: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `AppNamespace`;
 36: CREATE TABLE `AppNamespace` (
 37:   `Id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '自增主键',
 38:   `Name` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'namespace名字，注意，需要全局唯一',
 39:   `AppId` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'app id',
 40:   `Format` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'properties' COMMENT 'namespace的format类型',
 41:   `IsPublic` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT 'namespace是否为公共',
 42:   `Comment` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '注释',
 43:   `IsDeleted` bit(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0' COMMENT '1: deleted, 0: normal',
 44:   `DataChange_CreatedBy` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' COMMENT '创建人邮箱前缀',
 45:   `DataChange_CreatedTime` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
 46:   `DataChange_LastModifiedBy` varchar(64) DEFAULT '' COMMENT '最后修改人邮箱前缀',
